verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
नृपाणां कथितःसर्वो भवता वंशविस्तरः ।
वंशानुचरितं चैव यथावदनुवर्णितम् ।
अंशावतारो ब्रह्मर्षे योऽयं यदुकुलोद्भवः ।
विष्णोस्तं विस्तरेणाहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
nripanam kathitahsarvo bhavata vamshavistarah |
vamshanucharitam chaiva yathavadanuvarnitam |
amshavataro brahmarshe yo'yam yadukulodbhavah |
vishnostam vistarenaham shrotumichchhami tattvatah ||

verses.sa:
चकार यानि कर्माणि भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः ।
अंशांशेनावतीर्योर्व्यां तत्र तानि मुने वद ॥
verses.rom:
chakara yani karmani bhagavan purushottamah |
amshamshenavatiryorvyam tatra tani mune vada ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपारशर उवाच
मैत्रेय श्रूयतामेतद्यत्पृष्टोऽहमिह त्वया ।
विष्णोरंशांशसंभूतिचरितं जगतो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
maitreya shruyatametadyatprishto'hamiha tvaya |
vishnoramshamshasambhuticharitam jagato hitam ||

verses.sa:
देवकस्य सुतां पूर्वं वसुदेवो महामुने ।
उपयेमे महाभागां देवकीं देवतोपमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
devakasya sutam purvam vasudevo mahamune |
upayeme mahabhagam devakim devatopamam ||

verses.sa:
कंसस्तयोर्वररथं चोदयामास सारथिः ।
वसुदेवस्य देवक्या संयोगे भोजनन्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsastayorvararatham chodayamasa sarathih |
vasudevasya devakya samyoge bhojanandanah ||

verses.sa:
आथान्तरिक्षे वागुच्चैः कंसमाभाष्य सादरम् ।
मेघगंभीरनिर्घोषं समाभाष्येदमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
athantarikshe vaguchchaih kamsamabhashya sadaram |
meghagambhiranirghosham samabhashyedamabravit ||

verses.sa:
यामेतां वहसे मूढ सह भर्त्रा रथे स्थिताम् ।
अस्यास्तवाष्टमो गर्भः प्राणानपहरिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yametam vahase mudha saha bhartra rathe sthitam |
asyastavashtamo garbhah prananapaharishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्याकर्ण्यं समुत्पाट्य खड्गं कंसो महाबलः ।
देवकीं हन्तुमारब्धो वसुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityakarnyam samutpatya khadgam kamso mahabalah |
devakim hantumarabdho vasudevo'bravididam ||

verses.sa:
न हन्तव्या महाभाग देवकी भवतानघ ।
समर्पयिष्ये सकलान्गर्भानस्योदरोद्भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
na hantavya mahabhaga devaki bhavatanagha |
samarpayishye sakalangarbhanasyodarodbhavan ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तथेत्याह ततः कंसो वसुदेवं द्विजोत्तम ।
न घातयामास च तां देवकींसत्यगौरवात् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tathetyaha tatah kamso vasudevam dvijottama |
na ghatayamasa cha tam devakimsatyagauravat ||

verses.sa:
एतस्मिन्नेवकाले तु भूरिभारावपीडिता ।
जगाम धरणी मेरौ समाजं त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
etasminnevakale tu bhuribharavapidita |
jagama dharani merau samajam tridivaukasam ||

verses.sa:
स ब्रह्मकान्सुरान्सर्वान्प्रणिपत्याथ मेदिनि ।
कथयामास तत्सर्वं खेदात्करुणभाषिणी ॥
verses.rom:
sa brahmakansuransarvanpranipatyatha medini |
kathayamasa tatsarvam khedatkarunabhashini ||

verses.sa:
भूमिरुवाच
अग्निःसुवर्णस्य गुरुर्गवां सूर्यः परो गुरुः ।
ममाप्यखिललो कानां कुरुर्नारायणो गुरुः ॥
verses.rom:
bhumiruvacha
agnihsuvarnasya gururgavam suryah paro guruh |
mamapyakhilalo kanam kururnarayano guruh ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिपतिर्ब्रह्म पूर्वेषामपि पूर्वजः ।
कलाकाष्ठानिमेषात्मा कालश्चाव्यक्तमूर्तिमान् ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatipatirbrahma purveshamapi purvajah |
kalakashthanimeshatma kalashchavyaktamurtiman ||

verses.sa: तदंशभूतःसर्वैषां समूहो वःसुरोत्तमाः ॥
verses.rom: tadamshabhutahsarvaisham samuho vahsurottamah ||

verses.sa:
आदित्या सरुतःसाध्या रुद्रा वस्वश्विवह्नयः ।
पितरो ये च लोकानां स्रष्टारोऽत्रिपुरोगमाः ॥
verses.rom:
aditya sarutahsadhya rudra vasvashvivahnayah |
pitaro ye cha lokanam srashtaro'tripurogamah ||

verses.sa: एते तस्याप्रमेयस्य विष्णो रूपं महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom: ete tasyaprameyasya vishno rupam mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
यक्षराक्षसदैतेयपिशाचोरगदानवाः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैवरूपं विष्णोर्महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
yaksharakshasadaiteyapishachoragadanavah |
gandharvapsarasashchaivarupam vishnormahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
ग्रहर्क्षतारकाचित्रगगनाग्निजलानिलाः ।
अहं च विषयाश्चैव सर्व विष्णुमयं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
graharkshatarakachitragaganagnijalanilah |
aham cha vishayashchaiva sarva vishnumayam jagat ||

verses.sa:
तथा चानेकरूपस्य यस्य रूपाण्य हर्निशम् ।
बाध्यबाधकतां यान्ति कल्लोला इव सागरे ॥
verses.rom:
tatha chanekarupasya yasya rupanya harnisham |
badhyabadhakatam yanti kallola iva sagare ||

verses.sa:
तत्सांप्रतममी दैत्याः कालनेमिपुरोगमाः ।
मर्त्यलोकं समाक्रम्य बाधन्तेऽहर्निशं प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatsampratamami daityah kalanemipurogamah |
martyalokam samakramya badhante'harnisham prajah ||

verses.sa:
कालनेमिर्हतो योऽसौ विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ।
उग्रसेनसुतः कंसःसंभूतःस महासुरः ॥
verses.rom:
kalanemirhato yo'sau vishnuna prabhavishnuna |
ugrasenasutah kamsahsambhutahsa mahasurah ||

verses.sa:
आरिष्टो धेनुकः केशी प्रलंबो नरकस्तथा ।
सुंदोऽसुरस्तथात्युग्रो बाणश्चापि बलेःसुतः ॥
verses.rom:
arishto dhenukah keshi pralambo narakastatha |
sumdo'surastathatyugro banashchapi balehsutah ||

verses.sa:
तथान्ये च महावीर्या नृपाणां भवनेषु ये ।
समुत्पन्ना दुरात्मानस्तान्न संख्यातुमुत्सहे ॥
verses.rom:
tathanye cha mahavirya nripanam bhavaneshu ye |
samutpanna duratmanastanna samkhyatumutsahe ||

verses.sa:
अक्षोहिण्योत्र बहुला दिव्यमूर्तिधराःसुराः ।
महाबलानां दृप्तानां दैत्येन्द्रणां ममोपरि ॥
verses.rom:
akshohinyotra bahula divyamurtidharahsurah |
mahabalanam driptanam daityendranam mamopari ||

verses.sa:
तद्भूरिभार पीडार्ता न शक्नोम्यमरेश्वराः ।
बिभर्तुमात्मानमहमिति विज्ञापयामि वः ॥
verses.rom:
tadbhuribhara pidarta na shaknomyamareshvarah |
bibhartumatmanamahamiti vijnapayami vah ||

verses.sa:
क्रियतां तन्महाभागा मम भारावतारणम् ।
यथा रसातलं नाहं गच्छेयमतिविह्वला ॥
verses.rom:
kriyatam tanmahabhaga mama bharavataranam |
yatha rasatalam naham gachchheyamativihvala ||

verses.sa:
इत्याकर्ण्य धरावाक्यमशेषैस्त्रिदशेश्वरैः ।
भुवो भारावतारार्थं ब्रह्मा प्राह प्रचोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
ityakarnya dharavakyamasheshaistridasheshvaraih |
bhuvo bharavatarartham brahma praha prachoditah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मोवाच
यथाह वसुधा सर्वं सत्यमेव दिवौकसः ।
अहं भवो भवन्तश्च सर्वे नारायणात्मकाः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmovacha
yathaha vasudha sarvam satyameva divaukasah |
aham bhavo bhavantashcha sarve narayanatmakah ||

verses.sa:
विभूतयश्च यास्तस्य तासामेव परस्परम् ।
आधिक्यन्यू६ अताबाध्यबाधकत्वेन वर्तते ॥
verses.rom:
vibhutayashcha yastasya tasameva parasparam |
adhikyanyu6 atabadhyabadhakatvena vartate ||

verses.sa:
तदागच्छत गच्छामः क्षीराब्धेस्तटमुत्तमम् ।
तत्राराध्य हरिं तस्मै सर्वं विज्ञापयाम वै ॥
verses.rom:
tadagachchhata gachchhamah kshirabdhestatamuttamam |
tatraradhya harim tasmai sarvam vijnapayama vai ||

verses.sa:
सर्वथैव जगत्यर्थे स सर्वात्मा जगन्मयः ।
सत्त्वांशेनावतीर्योर्व्यां धर्मस्य कुरुते स्थितिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvathaiva jagatyarthe sa sarvatma jaganmayah |
sattvamshenavatiryorvyam dharmasya kurute sthitim ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययो तत्र सह देवैः पितामहः ।
समाहितमनाश्चैवं तुष्टाव गरुडध्वजम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktva prayayo tatra saha devaih pitamahah |
samahitamanashchaivam tushtava garudadhvajam ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मोवाच
द्वे विद्ये त्वमनाम्नायपरा चैवापरा तथा ।
त एव भवतो रूपे मूर्तामूर्तात्मिके प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
brahmovacha
dve vidye tvamanamnayapara chaivapara tatha |
ta eva bhavato rupe murtamurtatmike prabho ||

verses.sa:
द्वे ब्रह्मणी त्वणीयोतिस्थूलात्मन्सर्व सर्ववित् ।
शब्दब्रह्मपरं चैव ब्रह्म ब्रह्ममयस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom:
dve brahmani tvaniyotisthulatmansarva sarvavit |
shabdabrahmaparam chaiva brahma brahmamayasya yat ||

verses.sa:
ऋग्वेदस्त्वं यजुर्वेदःसामवेदस्त्वथर्वणः ।
शिक्षाकल्पो निरुक्तं च च्छन्दो ज्योतिषमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
rigvedastvam yajurvedahsamavedastvatharvanah |
shikshakalpo niruktam cha chchhando jyotishameva cha ||

verses.sa:
इतिहासपुराणे च तथा व्याकरणं प्रभो ।
मीमांसा न्यायशास्त्रं च धर्मशास्त्राण्यधोक्षज ॥
verses.rom:
itihasapurane cha tatha vyakaranam prabho |
mimamsa nyayashastram cha dharmashastranyadhokshaja ||

verses.sa:
आत्माऽत्मदेहगुणवद्विचाराचारि यद्वच ।
तदप्याद्यपते नान्यदध्यात्मात्मस्वरूपवत् ॥
verses.rom:
atma'tmadehagunavadvicharachari yadvacha |
tadapyadyapate nanyadadhyatmatmasvarupavat ||

verses.sa:
त्वमव्यक्तमनिर्देश्यमचिन्त्यानामवर्मवत् ।
अपाणिपादरूपं च शुद्धं नित्यं परात्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamavyaktamanirdeshyamachintyanamavarmavat |
apanipadarupam cha shuddham nityam paratparam ||

verses.sa:
शृणोष्यकर्णः परिपश्यसि त्वमचक्षुरूपो बहुरूपरूपः ।
अपादहस्तो जवनो ग्रहीता त्वं वेत्सि सर्वं च सर्ववेद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
shrinoshyakarnah paripashyasi tvamachakshurupo bahuruparupah |
apadahasto javano grahita tvam vetsi sarvam cha sarvavedyah ||

verses.sa:
अणोरणीयां समसत्स्वरूपं त्वां पश्यतो ज्ञाननिवृत्तिरग्र्या ।
धीरस्य धीरस्य बिभर्ति नान्यद्वरेण्यरूपात्परतः परात्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
anoraniyam samasatsvarupam tvam pashyato jnananivrittiragrya |
dhirasya dhirasya bibharti nanyadvarenyarupatparatah paratman ||

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वनाभिर्भुवनस्य गोप्ता सर्वाणि भूतानि तवान्तराणि ।
यद्भूतभव्यं यदणोरणीयः पुमांस्त्वमेकः प्रकृतेः परस्तात् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishvanabhirbhuvanasya gopta sarvani bhutani tavantarani |
yadbhutabhavyam yadanoraniyah pumamstvamekah prakriteh parastat ||

verses.sa:
एकश्चतुर्धा भगवान्हुताशो वर्चोविभूतं जगतो ददासि ।
त्वं विश्वतश्चक्षुरनन्तमूर्ते त्रेधा पदं त्वं निदधासि धातः ॥
verses.rom:
ekashchaturdha bhagavanhutasho varchovibhutam jagato dadasi |
tvam vishvatashchakshuranantamurte tredha padam tvam nidadhasi dhatah ||

verses.sa:
यथाग्निरेको बहुधा समिध्यते विकारभेदैरविकाररूपः ।
तथा भवान्सर्वगतैकरूपी रूपाण्यशेषाण्यनुपुष्यतीश ॥
verses.rom:
yathagnireko bahudha samidhyate vikarabhedairavikararupah |
tatha bhavansarvagataikarupi rupanyasheshanyanupushyatisha ||

verses.sa:
एकं तवाग्र्यं परमं पदं यत्पश्यन्ति त्वां सूरयो ज्ञानदृश्यम् ।
त्वत्तो नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति स्वरूपं यद्वा भूतं यच्च भव्यं परात्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
ekam tavagryam paramam padam yatpashyanti tvam surayo jnanadrishyam |
tvatto nanyatkinchidasti svarupam yadva bhutam yachcha bhavyam paratman ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपस्त्वं समष्टिव्यष्टिरूपवान् ।
सर्वज्ञःसर्वनित्सर्वशक्तिज्ञानबलर्धिमान् ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktavyaktasvarupastvam samashtivyashtirupavan |
sarvajnahsarvanitsarvashaktijnanabalardhiman ||

verses.sa:
अन्यूनश्चाप्यवृद्धिश्च स्वाधीनो नादिमान्वशी ।
क्लमतन्द्री भयक्रोधकामादिभिरसंयुतः ॥
verses.rom:
anyunashchapyavriddhishcha svadhino nadimanvashi |
klamatandri bhayakrodhakamadibhirasamyutah ||

verses.sa:
निरवद्यः परः प्राप्तेर्निरधिष्ठोऽक्षरः क्रमः ।
सर्वेश्वरः पराधारो धाम्नां धामात्मकोऽक्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
niravadyah parah prapterniradhishtho'ksharah kramah |
sarveshvarah paradharo dhamnam dhamatmako'kshayah ||

verses.sa:
सकलावरणानीतनिरालंबनभावन ।
महाविभूतिसंस्थान नमस्ते पुरुषोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sakalavarananitaniralambanabhavana |
mahavibhutisamsthana namaste purushottama ||

verses.sa:
नाकारणात्कारणाद्वा कारणाकारणान्न च ।
शरीरग्रहणं वापि धर्मत्राणाय केवलम् ॥
verses.rom:
nakaranatkaranadva karanakarananna cha |
shariragrahanam vapi dharmatranaya kevalam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्येवं संस्तवं श्रुत्वा मनसा भगवानजः ।
ब्रह्माणमाह प्रीतेन विश्वरूपं प्रकाशयन् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityevam samstavam shrutva manasa bhagavanajah |
brahmanamaha pritena vishvarupam prakashayan ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भोभो ब्रह्मंस्त्वया मत्तःसह देवैर्यदिष्यते ।
तदुच्यतामशेषं च सिद्धमेवावधार्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
bhobho brahmamstvaya mattahsaha devairyadishyate |
taduchyatamashesham cha siddhamevavadharyatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततो ब्रह्मा हरेर्दिव्य विश्विरूपमवेक्ष्य तत् ।
तुष्टाव भूयो देवेषु साध्वसावनतात्मसु ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tato brahma harerdivya vishvirupamavekshya tat |
tushtava bhuyo deveshu sadhvasavanatatmasu ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नमो नमस्तेस्तु सहस्रकृत्वःसहस्रबाहो बहुवक्त्रपाद ।
नमोनमस्ते जगतः प्रवृत्तिविनाशसंस्थानकराप्रमेय ॥
verses.rom:
brahmovacha
namo namastestu sahasrakritvahsahasrabaho bahuvaktrapada |
namonamaste jagatah pravrittivinashasamsthanakaraprameya ||

verses.sa:
सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मातिबृहत्प्रमाम गरीयसामप्यतिगौरवात्मन् ।
प्रधानबुद्धीन्द्रियवत्प्रधानमूलात्परात्मन्भगवन्प्रसीद ॥
verses.rom:
sukshmatisukshmatibrihatpramama gariyasamapyatigauravatman |
pradhanabuddhindriyavatpradhanamulatparatmanbhagavanprasida ||

verses.sa:
एषा मही देव महीप्रसूतैर्महासुरैः पीडितशैलबन्धा ।
परायणं त्वां जगतामुपैति भारावतारार्थमपारसार ॥
verses.rom:
esha mahi deva mahiprasutairmahasuraih piditashailabandha |
parayanam tvam jagatamupaiti bharavatararthamaparasara ||

verses.sa:
एते वयं वृत्ररिपुस्तथायं नासत्यदस्त्रौ वरुणस्तथैव ।
इमे च रुद्रा वसवःससूर्याःसमीरणाग्निप्रसुखास्तथान्ये ॥
verses.rom:
ete vayam vritraripustathayam nasatyadastrau varunastathaiva |
ime cha rudra vasavahsasuryahsamiranagniprasukhastathanye ||

verses.sa:
सुराःसमस्ताःसुरनाथकार्यमेभिर्मया यच्च तदीश सर्वाम् ।
आज्ञापयाज्ञां परिपालयन्तस्तवैव तिष्ठाम सदास्तदोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
surahsamastahsuranathakaryamebhirmaya yachcha tadisha sarvam |
ajnapayajnam paripalayantastavaiva tishthama sadastadoshah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु भगवान्परमेश्वरः ।
उज्जहारात्मनः केशौ सितकृष्णौ महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
evam samstuyamanastu bhagavanparameshvarah |
ujjaharatmanah keshau sitakrishnau mahamune ||

verses.sa:
उवाच च सुरानेतौ मत्केशौ वसुधातले ।
अवतीर्य भुवो भारक्लेशहानिं करिष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
uvacha cha suranetau matkeshau vasudhatale |
avatirya bhuvo bharakleshahanim karishyatah ||

verses.sa:
सुराश्च सकलाःस्वांशैरवतीर्य महीतले ।
कुर्वन्तु युद्धमुन्मत्तैः पूर्वोत्पन्नैर्महासुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
surashcha sakalahsvamshairavatirya mahitale |
kurvantu yuddhamunmattaih purvotpannairmahasuraih ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्षयमशेषास्ते दैतेया धरमीतले ।
प्रयास्यन्ति न संदेहो मद्दृपातविचूर्णिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kshayamasheshaste daiteya dharamitale |
prayasyanti na samdeho maddripatavichurnitah ||

verses.sa:
वसुदेवस्य या पत्नी देवकी देवतोपमा ।
तत्रायमष्टमो गर्भो मत्केशो भविता सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
vasudevasya ya patni devaki devatopama |
tatrayamashtamo garbho matkesho bhavita surah ||

verses.sa:
अवतीर्य च तत्रायं कंसं घातयिता भुवि ।
कालनेमीं समुद्भूतमित्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
avatirya cha tatrayam kamsam ghatayita bhuvi |
kalanemim samudbhutamityuktvantardadhe harih ||

verses.sa:
अदृश्याय ततस्तस्मै प्रणिपत्य महामुने ।
मेरुपृष्ठं सुरा जग्मुरवतेरुश्च भूतले ॥
verses.rom:
adrishyaya tatastasmai pranipatya mahamune |
meruprishtham sura jagmuravaterushcha bhutale ||

verses.sa:
कंसाय चाष्टमो गर्भो देवक्या धरणीधरः ।
भविष्यतीत्याच चक्षे भगवान्नारदो मुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsaya chashtamo garbho devakya dharanidharah |
bhavishyatityacha chakshe bhagavannarado munih ||

verses.sa:
कंसोऽपि तदुपश्रुत्य नारदात्कुपितस्ततः ।
देवकीं वसुदेवं च गृहे गुप्तावधारयत् ॥
verses.rom:
kamso'pi tadupashrutya naradatkupitastatah |
devakim vasudevam cha grihe guptavadharayat ||

verses.sa:
वसुदेवेन कंसाय तेनैवोक्तं यथा पुरा ।
तथैव वसुदेवोऽपि पुत्रमर्पितवान् द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
vasudevena kamsaya tenaivoktam yatha pura |
tathaiva vasudevo'pi putramarpitavan dvija ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राःषड्गर्भा इति विश्रुताः ।
विष्णुप्रयुक्ता स्तान्निद्राक्रमाद्गर्भानयोजयत् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyakashipoh putrahshadgarbha iti vishrutah |
vishnuprayukta stannidrakramadgarbhanayojayat ||

verses.sa:
योगनिद्रा महामाया वैष्णवी मोहितं यया ।
अविद्यया जगत्सर्वं तामाह भगवान्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
yoganidra mahamaya vaishnavi mohitam yaya |
avidyaya jagatsarvam tamaha bhagavanharih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
निद्रे गच्छ ममादेशात्पातालातलसंश्रयान् ।
एकैकत्वेन षड्गर्भान्देवकीजठरं नय ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
nidre gachchha mamadeshatpatalatalasamshrayan |
ekaikatvena shadgarbhandevakijatharam naya ||

verses.sa:
हतेषु तेषु कंसेन शेषाख्योंशस्ततो मम ।
अंशांशोनादरे तस्याःसप्तमः संभविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
hateshu teshu kamsena sheshakhyomshastato mama |
amshamshonadare tasyahsaptamah sambhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
गोकुले वसुदेवस्य भार्यान्या रोहिणी स्थिता ।
तस्याःस संभूतिसमं देवि नेयस्त्वयोदरम् ॥
verses.rom:
gokule vasudevasya bharyanya rohini sthita |
tasyahsa sambhutisamam devi neyastvayodaram ||

verses.sa:
सप्तमो भोजरा जस्य भयाद्रोधोपरोधतः ।
देवक्याः पितितो गर्भ इति लोको वदिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
saptamo bhojara jasya bhayadrodhoparodhatah |
devakyah pitito garbha iti loko vadishyati ||

verses.sa:
गर्भसंकर्षणात्सोऽथ लोके संकर्षणेति वै ।
संज्ञामवाप्स्यते वीरः श्वेताद्रिशिखरोपमः ॥
verses.rom:
garbhasamkarshanatso'tha loke samkarshaneti vai |
samjnamavapsyate virah shvetadrishikharopamah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽहं संभविष्यामि देवकीजठरे शुभे ।
भर्गं त्वया यशोदाया गन्तव्यमविलंबितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'ham sambhavishyami devakijathare shubhe |
bhargam tvaya yashodaya gantavyamavilambitam ||

verses.sa:
प्रावृट्काले च नभसि कृष्णाष्टम्यामहं निशि ।
उत्पत्स्यामि नवम्यां तु प्रसूतिं त्वमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
pravritkale cha nabhasi krishnashtamyamaham nishi |
utpatsyami navamyam tu prasutim tvamavapsyasi ||

verses.sa:
यशोदाशयने मां तु देवक्यास्त्वामनिन्दिते ।
मच्छक्तिप्रोरितमतिर्वसुदेवो नयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yashodashayane mam tu devakyastvamanindite |
machchhaktiproritamatirvasudevo nayishyati ||

verses.sa:
कंसश्च त्वामुपादाय देवि शैलशिलातले ।
प्रक्षेप्स्यत्यन्तारिक्षे च संस्थानं त्वमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
kamsashcha tvamupadaya devi shailashilatale |
prakshepsyatyantarikshe cha samsthanam tvamavapsyasi ||

verses.sa:
ततस्त्वां शतदृक्छक्रः प्रणम्य मम गौरवात् ।
प्रणिपातानतशिरा भगिनीत्वे ग्रहीष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
tatastvam shatadrikchhakrah pranamya mama gauravat |
pranipatanatashira bhaginitve grahishyati ||

verses.sa:
त्वं च शुंभनिशुंभादीन्हत्वा दैत्यान्सहस्रशः ।
स्थानैरनेकैः पृथिवीमशेषां मण्डयिष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam cha shumbhanishumbhadinhatva daityansahasrashah |
sthanairanekaih prithivimashesham mandayishyasi ||

verses.sa:
त्वं भूतिः सन्नतिः क्षान्तिः कान्तिर्द्यौः पृथिवी धृतिः ।
लज्जापुष्टी रुषा या तु काचिदन्या त्वमेव सा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam bhutih sannatih kshantih kantirdyauh prithivi dhritih |
lajjapushti rusha ya tu kachidanya tvameva sa ||

verses.sa:
ये त्वामार्येति दुर्गेति वेदगर्भांबिकेति च ।
भद्रेति भद्रकालीति क्षेमदा भग्यदेति च ॥
verses.rom:
ye tvamaryeti durgeti vedagarbhambiketi cha |
bhadreti bhadrakaliti kshemada bhagyadeti cha ||

verses.sa:
प्रातश्चैवापराह्ने च स्तोष्यन्त्यानम्रमूर्तयः ।
तेषां हि प्रार्थितं सर्वं मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
pratashchaivaparahne cha stoshyantyanamramurtayah |
tesham hi prarthitam sarvam matprasadadbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
सुरामांसोपहरैश्च भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च पूजिता ।
नॄणामशेषसामांस्त्वं प्रसन्ना संप्रदास्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
suramamsopaharaishcha bhakshyabhojyaishcha pujita |
nrinamasheshasamamstvam prasanna sampradasyasi ||

verses.sa:
ते सर्वे सर्वदा भद्रे मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् ।
असंदिग्धा भविष्यन्ति गच्छ देवि यथोदितम् ।
इति विष्णुमहापुराणे पञ्चमांशे प्रथमोऽध्यायः (१)
verses.rom:
te sarve sarvada bhadre matprasadadasamshayam |
asamdigdha bhavishyanti gachchha devi yathoditam |
iti vishnumahapurane panchamamshe prathamo'dhyayah (1)

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—You have described to me at length the origin and spread of the families of kings. I wish to hear in particular, O venerable saint, why Vishnu incarnated a portion of himself in the family of Yadus. Tell me, O Muni, what actions did the illustrious and excellent Purusha perform in his descent upon the earth.

Parāçara said:—I shall relate to you, O Maitreya, what you have requested me to do—the birth, of a portion of Vishnu and the benefits which his actions conferred upon the world. O great Muni, Vasudeva espoused the illustrious god-like Devaki, the daughter of Devaka. After their marriage, Kansa, the increaser of the race of Bhoja, drove their car as charioteer. A voice was heard in the sky, loud and deep as thunder, which addressing Kansa, said—"O foolish, the eighth child of this damsel, whom thou art carrying in the car, along with her husband, shall destroy thy life".

Hearing this the highly powerful Kansa uplifted his sword and was about to slay Devaki when Vasudeva said—"O thou having long arms, Devaki should not be slain by thee; I shall hand over to thee every child that she shall bring forth".

O foremost of twice-born ones, saying 'so be it' Kansa obeyed Vasudeva's request and out of respect for him did not slay Devaki.

In the meantime, Earth, oppressed by her heavy load, repaired to an assembly of celestials on Mount Meru and addressing them, with Brahmā, at their head, described in piteous accents all her distresses. "Agni" said Earth "is the progenitor of gold; Surja, the rays of light; the Supreme Nārāyana, is my guide and the guide of all spheres; He is Brahmā, the lord of the lord of patriarchs, the eldest of the eldest born, one identical with minutes and hours and time having form though indiscrete. O celestials, you are all but a portion of Him. The Sun, the winds, the saints, the Rudras, the Vasus, the Aswins, fire, patriarchs of whom Attri is the first, are all but the forms of the mighty and inscrutable Vishnu. The Yakshas, the Rākshasas, the Daityas, Pisachas, Uragas, Dānavas, Gandharvas, and Apsaras are all but the forms of the glorious Vishnu. The sky painted with stars, fire, water, wind, myself, and this manifest universe are all identical with Vishnu. Still the diverse forms of that manifold being encounter and succeed one another night and day like the waves of the sea. Amongst them Kālanemi and other Dānavas have occupied the regions under the earth and been distressing the subjects continually. The mighty Vishnu destroyed the Daitya Kālanemi and he has now been born as Kansa, the son of Ugrasena. The Asuras, Aristha, Dhenuka, Keshi, Pralamba, Naraka, Sunda, Atyugravana, and the son of Bali and other highly powerful ones born in various royal families, cannot be counted. O celestials, many Akshauhini hosts of powerful Daityas—the chiefs of their race, assuming beautiful shapes, are now treading upon me. I am unable, being oppressed by this load, to support myself; I have therefore come to you for help, O celestial chiefs, O illustrious deities, it becomes you to relieve me of this burden, lest helpless I sink into the nethermost abyss".

Parāçara said Hearing these words of Earth, Brahmā at their request, explained to them how her burden might be lightened. "Deities" said Brahmā "all that earth has said is true. Myself, Siva and you all are but a portion of Nārāyana; the impersonations of his power are for ever mutually fluctuating; and excess or diminution is indicated by the predominance of the strong and the depression of the weak. Come, therefore, let us go to the northern shore of the milky sea and having glorified Hari, report to him what we have heard. He, who is the soul of all and at one with the universe, descends, for the preservation of Earth in a small portion of his essence, to establish righteousness below". Accordingly Brahmā, accompanied by the celestials went to the milky ocean and with minds devoted to him, praised him, whose emblem is Garuda. Brahmā said "O lord, thou art distinct from the Vedas, thy double nature is two-fold wisdom, superior and inferior, and thou art the essential end of both. Thou, alike possessed and devoid of form, art the two-fold Brahmā; smallest of the least and largest of the large; all and knowing all things; that spirit which is language, that spirit which is Supreme; that which is Brahmā and of which Brahmā is composed. Thou art the Rich, the Yajush, the Sāman and the Atharvan Vedas. Thou art accentuation, ritual, signification, metre and astronomy; history, tradition, grammar, theology, logic and law and art inscrutable. Thou art the doctrine that seeks to find out the distinctions between soul and life and body and matter endowed with qualifications and that doctrine is nothing else but thy nature inherent in and presiding over it.

"Thou art imperceptible, indescribable, inconceivable,—without name, or colour, or hands or feet, pure, eternal and infinite. Thou hearest without ears and seest without eyes. Thou art one and manifold. Thou movest without feet and holdest without hands. Thou knowest all but art not by all to be known. He who observes thee as the most subtile of atoms, not substantially existent, puts an end to ignorance and the final liberation is the meed of that wise man whose understanding cherishes nothing but thee in the form of supreme delight. Thou art the common centre of all, the protector of the universe and all beings exist in thee. Thou art all that has been or will be. Thou art the atom of atoms; thou art spirit, thou only art separate from primeval nature. Thou, as the lord of fire, in four manifestations, givest light and fertility to Earth. Thou art the eye of all and assumer of many shapes and without any hinderance travellest the three regions of the universe. As fire, though one, is variously lighted and though unchangeable in its essence, is modified in many ways, so thou, lord, who art omnipresent, takest upon thee all modifications, that exist. Thou art one supreme; thou art that supreme and eternal state which the wise behold with the eye of knowledge. There is nothing else but thou, O lord, nothing else has been or will be. Thou art both discrete and indiscrete, universal and individual, omniscient, all-seeing, omnipotent, possessed of all wisdom and strength and power. Thou art subject, neither to increase nor decrease. Thou art independent and without beginning. Thou art the subjugator of all. Thou art not subject to weariness, sloth, fear, anger or desire. Thou art free from sin, supreme, merciful, uniform, undecaying, lord over all, the support of all, the fountain of light, and imperishable. Salutation unto thee, uninvested by material envelopes, unexposed to sensible imaginings, aggregate of elemental substance, spirit supreme. Thou assumest a shape, O pervader of the universe, not as the consequence of virtue or vice nor from any mixture of the two, but for the sole object of upholding righteousness in the universe".

Parāçara said:—Having heard these eulogiums, the unborn universal Hari, pleased, said to Brahmā—"Tell me, Brahmā, what your and the celestials desire—and consider that already gratified".

Beholding that divine and universal form of Hari, Brahmā again prostrated himself and began to chant his glories—"Salutation unto thee, again and again, O thou having a thousand forms, having a thousand arms, many faces and many feet. Salutation unto thee, the illimitable author of creation, destruction and preservation and the inscrutable. Be propitiated with us, O god, O great soul, most subtile of the subtile, most vast of the great; O thou, who art nature, intellect and consciousness and who art other spirit even than the spiritual root of those principles. O lord, this earth, oppressed by powerful Asuras and shaken to her very foundation, comes to thee, the upholder of the universe, to be relieved of her burden. Myself, Indra, the Aswins, Varuna, Yama, the Rudras the Vasus, the sun, the winds, fire and all other deities are prepared to do whatever thou shalt and desire us to do. Do thou, who art perfect, O king of the celestials, give thy orders to thy servants, we are ready".

When Brahmā had said this, the supreme deity plucked off two hairs, one white and one black and said to the celestials—"These my hairs shall go down upon earth and shall relieve her of the burden of her distress. Let all the deities, in their own portions, descend upon earth and fight with the proud Asuras who are there assembled and every one of them shall be slain. Doubt not this—they shall be destroyed by the withering glance of my eyes. This, my black hair, shall be impersonated in the eighth conception of the goddess-like Devaki, the wife of Vasudeva and shall destroy Kansa, who is the demon Kālanemi". Having said this, Hari disappeared and the celestials, bowing to him, though invisible, went back to the summit of the mount Meru from where they came down on earth.

Thereupon the illustrious Muni Nārada said that, the supporter of the earth, Vishnu, would be the eighth child of Devaki, Hearing this from Nārada, Kansa greatly excited with wrath, kept Vasudeva and Devaki in secret confinement.

According to his promise Vasudeva delivered to Kansa each infant as soon as it was born. It is said these, to the number of six, were the children of the demon Hiranya-Kasipu, introduced into the womb of Devaki by Yogonidra, at the behest of Vishnu, who was his illusory energy and by whom the whole world is beguiled, and who is known as utter ignorance. The great god said to her—"Go, Nidrā, to the nether regions and by my command introduce there six princes to the womb of Devaki. When these shall be destroyed by Kansa, the seventh conception shall be a portion of Sesha, who is a portion of me. There is another wife of Vasudeva in Gokula named Rohini and this you shall transfer to her, before the time of birth. The rumour shall be that Devaki miscarries through the anxiety of imprisonment and dread of the king of Bhojas. And on account of his being extracted from his mother's womb, the child shall be designated Sankarshana and he shall be like the peak of the white mountain in bulk and complexion. I shall myself then descend in the eighth auspicious conception of Devaki and you shall immediately enter into the womb of Yasoda. In the night of the eighth lunation of the dark half of the month of Nabhas in the season of the rains, I shall be born. You will be born on the ninth. Being aided by my energy Vasudeva shall carry me to the bed of Yasoda and you to that of Devaki. When Kansa shall dash you against a stone, O worshipful dame, you shall attain to the sky and then the thousand-eyed Indra, out of reverence for me, shall bow unto you and shall accept you as his sister. Having destroyed Sumbha and Nisumbha and thousands of other Daityas you shall sanctify the earth in many places. You are wealth, progeny, fame, patience, heaven and earth, fortitude, modesty, nutrition, dawn and every other female (form or virtue). Those, who shall reverentially invoke you, morning and evening, and praise and call you Aryā, Durgā, Vedagarbhā, Ambica, Bhadrā, Bhadrakālikā, Kshemi, or Kshemankari, shall receive, by my grace, whatever they desire. And pleased with their offerings of wine and flesh and various other kinds you shall gratify the prayers of mankind. By my favour all men shall have perpetual faith in you. Assured of this, go, goddess, and satisfy my orders!"

verses.sa:
यथोक्तं सा जगद्धात्री देवदेवेन वै तदा ।
षड़गर्भ-गर्भविन्यासं चक्र चान्यस्य कर्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathoktam sa jagaddhatri devadevena vai tada |
sharagarbha-garbhavinyasam chakra chanyasya karshanam ||

verses.sa:
सप्तमे रोहिणी प्राप्ते गर्भेगर्भं ततो हरिः ।
लोकत्रयोपकाराय देवक्याः प्रविवेश वै ॥
verses.rom:
saptame rohini prapte garbhegarbham tato harih |
lokatrayopakaraya devakyah pravivesha vai ||

verses.sa:
योगनिद्रा यशोदायास्तस्मिन्नेव ततो दिने ।
सम्भूता जठरे तदूदू यथोक्तं परमेष्ठिना ॥
verses.rom:
yoganidra yashodayastasminneva tato dine |
sambhuta jathare tadudu yathoktam parameshthina ||

verses.sa:
ततो ग्रहगणाः सम्यक् प्रचचार दिवि द्रिज ।
विष्णोरंशे बुवं याते ऋतवश्वाभवन् शुभाः ॥
verses.rom:
tato grahaganah samyak prachachara divi drija |
vishnoramshe buvam yate ritavashvabhavan shubhah ||

verses.sa:
न सेहे देवकी द्रष्टुं कश्विदप्यतितेजसा ।
जाज्वल्यमानां तां दृष्ट्वा मनांसि क्षोभमाययुः ॥
verses.rom:
na sehe devaki drashtum kashvidapyatitejasa |
jajvalyamanam tam drishtva manamsi kshobhamayayuh ||

verses.sa:
अदृष्टां पुरुषैः स्त्रीभिर्देवकीं देवतागणाः ।
विभ्राणां वपुषा विष्णुं तुष्टु वुस्तामहर्निशम् ॥
verses.rom:
adrishtam purushaih stribhirdevakim devataganah |
vibhranam vapusha vishnum tushtu vustamaharnisham ||

verses.sa:
प्रकृतिस्त्व परा सुक्ष्मा ब्रह्मगर्भाभवः पुरा ।
ततो वाणी जगद्धातुर्व्वेदगर्भासि शोभने ॥
verses.rom:
prakritistva para sukshma brahmagarbhabhavah pura |
tato vani jagaddhaturvvedagarbhasi shobhane ||

verses.sa:
सूर्य्यस्वरूपगर्भासि सृष्टिभूता सनातनि ।
बीजभूता तु सर्व्वस्य यज्ञभूताभवस्त्रयी ॥
verses.rom:
suryyasvarupagarbhasi srishtibhuta sanatani |
bijabhuta tu sarvvasya yajnabhutabhavastrayi ||

verses.sa:
फलगर्भा त्वमेवेज्या वह्निगर्भा तथारणिः ।
अदितिर्देवगर्भा त्वं दैत्यगर्भा तथा दितिः ॥
verses.rom:
phalagarbha tvamevejya vahnigarbha tatharanih |
aditirdevagarbha tvam daityagarbha tatha ditih ||

verses.sa:
ज्योतूस्त्रा वासरगर्भा त्वं ज्ञानगर्भासि सन्नतिः ।
नयगर्भा परा नीतिर्लज्जा त्वं प्रश्रयोदूहा ॥
verses.rom:
jyotustra vasaragarbha tvam jnanagarbhasi sannatih |
nayagarbha para nitirlajja tvam prashrayoduha ||

verses.sa:
कामगर्भा तथेच्छा त्वं तुष्टिः सन्तोषगर्भिणी ।
मेधा च भोधगर्भासि धैर्य्यगर्भोदूहा धृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
kamagarbha tathechchha tvam tushtih santoshagarbhini |
medha cha bhodhagarbhasi dhairyyagarbhoduha dhritih ||

verses.sa:
ग्रहर्क्षतारकागर्भा द्यौरस्य खिलहैतुकी ।
एता विभूतयो देवि । तथान्याश्व सहस्त्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
graharkshatarakagarbha dyaurasya khilahaituki |
eta vibhutayo devi | tathanyashva sahastrashah ||

verses.sa:
तथासङ्खया जगद्धात्रि । साम्प्रतं जठरे तव ।
समुद्राद्रि-द्रीप-वन-पत्तनभूषणा ॥
verses.rom:
tathasankhaya jagaddhatri | sampratam jathare tava |
samudradri-dripa-vana-pattanabhushana ||

verses.sa:
ग्राम-खर्व्वट-खैटाढया समस्ता पृथिवी शुभे ।
समस्तवह्नयोऽम्भांसि सकलाश्व समीरणाः ॥
verses.rom:
grama-kharvvata-khaitadhaya samasta prithivi shubhe |
samastavahnayo'mbhamsi sakalashva samiranah ||

verses.sa:
ग्रहर्क्षतारकाचित्रं विमानशतसङूकुलम् ।
अवकाशमशेषस्य यदूददातिनभःस्थलम् ॥
verses.rom:
graharkshatarakachitram vimanashatasanukulam |
avakashamasheshasya yadudadatinabhahsthalam ||

verses.sa:
भूर्लोकश्व भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोकोऽथ महर्ज्जनः ।
तपश्व ब्रह्मलोकश्व ब्रह्माण्डमखिलं शुभे ॥
verses.rom:
bhurlokashva bhuvarlokah svarloko'tha maharjjanah |
tapashva brahmalokashva brahmandamakhilam shubhe ||

verses.sa:
तदन्तरे स्थिता देवा दैत्य-गन्धर्व्व-चारणाः ।
महोरगास्तथ यक्षा राक्षसाः प्रेतगुह्यकाः ॥
verses.rom:
tadantare sthita deva daitya-gandharvva-charanah |
mahoragastatha yaksha rakshasah pretaguhyakah ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्याः पशवश्वान्ये ये ज जीवा यशस्विनि ।
तैरन्तः स्थैरनन्तोऽसौ सर्वेशः सर्व्वभावनः ॥
verses.rom:
manushyah pashavashvanye ye ja jiva yashasvini |
tairantah sthairananto'sau sarveshah sarvvabhavanah ||

verses.sa:
रूपकर्म्मखरूपाणि न परिच्छेदगोचरे ।
यस्याखिलप्रमाणानि सि विष्णुर्गर्भगस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
rupakarmmakharupani na parichchhedagochare |
yasyakhilapramanani si vishnurgarbhagastava ||

verses.sa:
त्वं खाहा त्वं स्वधा विद्या सुधा त्वं ज्योतिरम्बरे ।
त्वं स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा विद्या सुधा त्वं ज्योतिरम्बरे ।
त्वं सर्व्वलोकरक्षार्थमवतीर्णा महीतले ॥
verses.rom:
tvam khaha tvam svadha vidya sudha tvam jyotirambare |
tvam svaha tvam svadha vidya sudha tvam jyotirambare |
tvam sarvvalokaraksharthamavatirna mahitale ||

verses.sa:
प्रसीद देवि । सर्व्वस्य जगतः शं शुभे । कुरु ।
प्रीत्या त्वं धारयेशानं धृतं येनाखिलं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
prasida devi | sarvvasya jagatah sham shubhe | kuru |
pritya tvam dharayeshanam dhritam yenakhilam jagat ||

prose.en: Being thus ordered by the god of gods, Jagadhatri (the nurse of the universe) transferred six embryos into the womb of Devaki. And the seventh conception was conveyed into the womb of Rohini after which Hari, for the behoof of the three worlds, entered into the womb of Devaki. And as commanded by the great god, Yogonidrā, on that very day entered into the womb of Yasoda. The portion of Vishnu having descended on earth, the planets moved in auspicious order and the seasons became regular and genial. No body could gaze upon Devaki, invested with light—and beholding her thus dazzling, the minds of the people were disturbed. The celestials, invisible to men and women alike, chanted the praises of Devaki, day and night, from the time that Vishnu entered into her person. They said—"Thou art that Prakriti infinite and subtile, which formerly bore Brahmā in its womb. O nurse of the universe, thou art his words—from thee have sprung the Vedas, O fair damsel, O thou existing perpetually, thou art the very creation and in thy womb is the Sun: thou art the seed of all—thou art the parent of the tri-form Sacrifice. Thou art Sacrifice whence all fruit proceeds—thou art wood whose attrition creates fire. As Aditi thou art the mother of the celestials, as Diti thou art the mother of the Daityas their foes. Thou art light which creates day-thou art humility—the mother of true wisdom; thou art royal policy the mother of order—thou art modesty the mother of affection. Thou art desire from whom love is produced—thou art contentment from which resignation is produced; thou art intelligence, the mother of knowledge, thou art patience the parent of fortitude; thou art heavens whose children are stars, and from thee proceeds all that exists. These and thousand others are thy mighty faculties, O goddess; and numberless are the contents of thy womb, O mother of the universe. That Vishnu, whose real form, nature, name, dimensions are above human conception, is in thy womb, with whom are identical the whole earth, embellished with oceans, rivers, continents, cities, villages, hamlets, towns; all the fires, waters and winds, the stars, asterisms and planets, the sky abounding in variegated cars of the celestials and ether that provides space for all substance; the spheres of earth, sky and heaven; of saints, sages, ascetics and of Brahmā: the white egg of Brahmā, with all its populations of Gods, demons, spirits, snake-gods, fiends, demons, ghosts and imps, men and animals, and whatever creatures have life. Thou art Swahā, thou art Swadhā, thou art wisdom, ambrosia, light and heaven. Thou hast descended upon earth for the preservation of the universe. Have pity upon us, O goddess, and do good unto the world. Be proud of bearing that deity by whom the universe is upheld".

verses.sa:
एवं संस्तूयमाना सा देवैर्दैवमधारयत् ।
गर्भेण पुण्डरीकाक्षं जगतस्त्राणकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
evam samstuyamana sa devairdaivamadharayat |
garbhena pundarikaksham jagatastranakaranam ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽखिलजगत्पद्मबोधायाच्युतभान्ना ।
देवकीपूर्व्वसन्ध्यायामाविर्भूतं महात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
tato'khilajagatpadmabodhayachyutabhanna |
devakipurvvasandhyayamavirbhutam mahatmana ||

verses.sa:
तज्जन्मदिनमत्यर्थमाह्लाद्यमलदिङूमुखम् ।
बभूव सर्वलोकस्य कौमुदी शशिनो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
tajjanmadinamatyarthamahladyamaladinumukham |
babhuva sarvalokasya kaumudi shashino yatha ||

verses.sa:
सन्तः सन्तोषमधिकं प्रशमं चण्डमारुतः ।
प्रसादं निम्रगा याता जायमाने जनार्दृने ॥
verses.rom:
santah santoshamadhikam prashamam chandamarutah |
prasadam nimraga yata jayamane janardrine ||

verses.sa:
सिन्धवो निजशब्देन वाद्य चक्त र्मनोहरम् ।
जगुर्गन्धर्व्वपतयो ननृतुश्वाप्सरोगणाः ॥
verses.rom:
sindhavo nijashabdena vadya chakta rmanoharam |
jagurgandharvvapatayo nanritushvapsaroganah ||

verses.sa:
ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षाणि देवा भुव्यन्तरीक्षगाः ।
जज्वलुश्वाग्रयः शान्ता जायमाने जनार्द्दने ॥
verses.rom:
sasrijuh pushpavarshani deva bhuvyantarikshagah |
jajvalushvagrayah shanta jayamane janarddane ||

verses.sa:
मध्यरात्रेऽखिलाधारे जायमाने जनार्दने ।
मन्द्र जगर्ज्जुर्जलदाः पूष्पचवृष्टिचो द्रिच ॥
verses.rom:
madhyaratre'khiladhare jayamane janardane |
mandra jagarjjurjaladah pushpachavrishticho dricha ||

verses.sa:
फुल्लेन्दीवरपत्राभं चतुर्बीहुमुदीक्ष्य तम् ।
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं जातं तुष्टावानकदुन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
phullendivarapatrabham chaturbihumudikshya tam |
shrivatsavakshasam jatam tushtavanakadundubhih ||

verses.sa:
अभिष्टूय च तं वागभिः प्रसन्नप्तभिर्महामतिः ।
विज्ञापयामास तदा कंसाद्भीतो द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
abhishtuya cha tam vagabhih prasannaptabhirmahamatih |
vijnapayamasa tada kamsadbhito drijottama ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञातोऽसि देवदेवेश । शचङ्ख-चक्र-गदाधर ।
दिव्यरूपमिदं देव प्रसादेनोपसंहर ॥
verses.rom:
jnato'si devadevesha | shachankha-chakra-gadadhara |
divyarupamidam deva prasadenopasamhara ||

verses.sa:
अद्यवै देव । कंसोऽयं कुरुते मम घातनम् ।
अवतीर्ण इति ज्ञात्वा त्वमस्मिन मम मन्दिरे ॥
verses.rom:
adyavai deva | kamso'yam kurute mama ghatanam |
avatirna iti jnatva tvamasmina mama mandire ||

verses.sa:
योऽनन्तरूपोऽखिलविशरूपो गर्भेषु लोकान् वपुषा बिभर्त्ति ।
प्रसीदतामेष स देवदेवः स्वमाययावुष्कृतबालरूपः ॥
verses.rom:
yo'nantarupo'khilavisharupo garbheshu lokan vapusha bibhartti |
prasidatamesha sa devadevah svamayayavushkritabalarupah ||

verses.sa:
उपसहर सर्व्वात्मन् । रूपमेज्वतुर्भुजम् ।
जानातु मावतारं ते कंसोऽयं दितिजाधमः ॥
verses.rom:
upasahara sarvvatman | rupamejvaturbhujam |
janatu mavataram te kamso'yam ditijadhamah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽहं यत् त्वया पूर्व्वं पुत्रार्थिन्या तदद्य ते ।
सफलं देवि। सञ्जातं जातोऽहं यत् तवोदरात् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'ham yat tvaya purvvam putrarthinya tadadya te |
saphalam devi| sanjatam jato'ham yat tavodarat ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवांस्तूष्णीं बभूव मुनिसत्तम ।
वसुदेवोऽपि तं रात्रावादाय प्रययौ बहिः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva bhagavamstushnim babhuva munisattama |
vasudevo'pi tam ratravadaya prayayau bahih ||

verses.sa:
मोहिताश्वाभवंस्तत्र रक्षिणो योगनिद्रया ।
मथुराद्रारपालाश्व ब्रजत्यानकदुन्दुभौ ॥
verses.rom:
mohitashvabhavamstatra rakshino yoganidraya |
mathuradrarapalashva brajatyanakadundubhau ||

verses.sa:
वर्षतां जलदानाञ्च तोयमत्युल्वणं निशि ।
संछाद्यानुययौ शेषः फणेनानकदुन्दुभिम् ॥
verses.rom:
varshatam jaladanancha toyamatyulvanam nishi |
samchhadyanuyayau sheshah phanenanakadundubhim ||

verses.sa:
यमुनां चातिगम्भीरां नानावर्त्तसमाकुलाम् ।
वसुदेवो वहन् विष्णु जानुमात्रबहां ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
yamunam chatigambhiram nanavarttasamakulam |
vasudevo vahan vishnu janumatrabaham yayau ||

verses.sa:
कंसस्य करमादाय तत्रेवाभ्यागतांस्तटे ।
नन्दादीन् गोपवृन्दांश्व यमुनाया ददर्श सः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsasya karamadaya tatrevabhyagatamstate |
nandadin gopavrindamshva yamunaya dadarsha sah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मिन् काले यशोदापि मोहिता योगनिद्रया ।
तामेव कन्यां मैत्रेय । प्रसूता मोहिते जने ॥
verses.rom:
tasmin kale yashodapi mohita yoganidraya |
tameva kanyam maitreya | prasuta mohite jane ||

verses.sa:
वसुदेवोऽपि विन्यस्य बालमादाय दारिकाम् ।
यसोदाशायने तुर्णमाजगामामितद्यु तिः ॥
verses.rom:
vasudevo'pi vinyasya balamadaya darikam |
yasodashayane turnamajagamamitadyu tih ||

verses.sa:
ददृशे च प्रबुद्धा सा यशोदा जातमात्मजम् ।
नीलोतूपलदलश्यामं ततोऽत्यर्थं मुदं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
dadrishe cha prabuddha sa yashoda jatamatmajam |
nilotupaladalashyamam tato'tyartham mudam yayau ||

verses.sa:
आदाय वसुदेवोऽपि दारिकां निजमन्दिरम् ।
देवकीशयने न्यस्य यथापूर्व्वमतिष्ठत ॥
verses.rom:
adaya vasudevo'pi darikam nijamandiram |
devakishayane nyasya yathapurvvamatishthata ||

verses.sa:
ततो बालध्वनिं श्रुत्वा रक्षिणः सहसोत्थिताः ।
कंसायावेदयामासुर्देवकीप्रसवं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
tato baladhvanim shrutva rakshinah sahasotthitah |
kamsayavedayamasurdevakiprasavam drija ||

verses.sa:
कंसस्तूर्णमुपेत्यैनां ततो जग्राह बालिकाम् ।
मुञ्च मुञ्चति देवक्या सन्नकण्ठया निवारितः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsasturnamupetyainam tato jagraha balikam |
muncha munchati devakya sannakanthaya nivaritah ||

verses.sa:
चिक्षेप च शिलापृष्ठे सा क्षिप्ता वियति स्थितिम् ।
अवाप रूपञ्च महत् सायुधाष्टमहाभुजम् ॥
verses.rom:
chikshepa cha shilaprishthe sa kshipta viyati sthitim |
avapa rupancha mahat sayudhashtamahabhujam ||

verses.sa:
प्रजहास तथैवोच्चैः कंसञ्च रुषिताब्रवीत् ।
किं मया क्षिप्तया मूढ़!जातो यस्तवां वधिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
prajahasa tathaivochchaih kamsancha rushitabravit |
kim maya kshiptaya murha!jato yastavam vadhishyati ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वस्वभूतो देवानामासीन्मृत्युः पुरा स ते ।
तदेतत् सम्प्रधार्य्याशु क्रियतां हितमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvasvabhuto devanamasinmrityuh pura sa te |
tadetat sampradharyyashu kriyatam hitamatmanah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवी दिंव्यस्त्रगू-गन्ध-भूषणा ।
पश्यतो भोजराजस्य स्तुता सिद्धैर्विहायसि ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva prayayau devi dimvyastragu-gandha-bhushana |
pashyato bhojarajasya stuta siddhairvihayasi ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said;—Being thus eulogised by the celestials; Devaki conceived in her womb the lotus-eyed deity—the saviour of the universe. The sun of Achyuta rose in the dawn of Devaki to cause the lotus-petal of the universe to expand. On the day of his birth, all the quarters were lighted up with joy and it gave delight to all people like unto the rays of the moon.

The pious obtained new delight; the strong wind were pacified and the river flowed silently when Janārddana was about to be born. The oceans made music with their murmurings, the Gandharvas began to sing and the Apsaras began to dance. At the time of Janārddana's birth the celestials, stationed in the sky, began to pour flowers and the holy fires glowed with a mild flame. At midnight, when the supporter of all was about to be born, the clouds began to emit low sounds and pour down rain of flowers.

As soon as Anakadundhubhi saw the child, looking like full-blown lotus-petals, having four arms and the mystic mark Sribatsa an his breast; he began to chant his glories in terms of love and respect and represented the fears he entertained of Kansa. Vasudeva said, "I have known thee, O sovereign lord of the celestials, O thou the holder of conch, discus and mace. Be pleased to withhold this thy celestial form, for Kansa will surely destroy me when he will know that thou hast descended in my dwelling". Devaki said,—"God of gods, who art identical with all things, in whose person all the religions of the world exist and who, by illusion, hast assumed the condition of an infant, have pity me, withold thy four-armed shape. Let not Kansa, the wicked son of Diti, know of this birth".

To this Bhagavat replied—"O worshipful dame, I was worshipped by thee before to be born as thy son. Thy prayers have now been granted and I am now born as thy son". So saying he was silent and Vasudeva, taking the babe, went out the same night. The guards and gate-keepers of Mathura were all charmed by Yoganidrā and none of them obstructed the passage of Anakadundhubhi. It was raining heavily at that time and the many-headed serpent Sesha followed Vasudeva spreading his hoods above their heads. And when he, with the child in his arms, crossed the Yamuna, deep as it was and dangerous with numerous whirlpools, the waters were silent and rose not above his knee. On the bank he saw Nanda and others who had come there to bring tribute to Kansa, but they did not see him. At that time Yasoda was also influenced by Yoganidrā, whom she had given birth as her daughter and whom the wise Vasudeva took up, placing his son in her place by the side of the mother. He then speedily came back home. When Yasoda awoke, she found she had been delivered of a boy as black as the dark lotus-leaves; and she was greatly delighted.

Vasudeva, taking the female child of Yasoda, reached his house unperceived and placed the child in the bed of Devaki. He then remained as usual. The guards were awakened by the cry of the new-born babe and starting up they informed Kansa that Devaki had given birth to a child. Kansa immediately went to the house of Vasudeva where he got hold of the infant. Devaki faintingly prevented him, crying out again and again—"Do not destroy it! Do not destroy it". Kansa dashed it against a stone; it at once went up to the sky and expanded into a gigantic figure, having eight arms each bearing a formidable weapon. This terrible figure laughed and said to Kansa. "What benefit have you derived, O Kansa, by hurling me to the ground? He is born who shall destroy thee, the mighty one amongst celestials, who was formerly the destroyer, Considering this do thou accomplish what shall tend to thy welfare". Having said this, the goddess, decorated with heavenly unguents and garlands, and glorified by the spirits of the air, disappeared from the sight of the king of the Bhojas.

verses.sa:
कंसस्ततोद्रिग्रमनाः प्राह सव्वीन महासुरान् ।
प्रलम्बकेशिप्रमुखानाहूयासुरपुङ्गवान् ॥
verses.rom:
kamsastatodrigramanah praha savvina mahasuran |
pralambakeshipramukhanahuyasurapungavan ||

verses.sa:
हे प्रलम्ब! महाबाहो ! केशिन् !धेनुक!पूतने !
अरिष्टाद्यस्तथा चान्यैः श्रूयतां वचनं मम ॥
verses.rom:
he pralamba! mahabaho ! keshin !dhenuka!putane !
arishtadyastatha chanyaih shruyatam vachanam mama ||

verses.sa:
मां हन्तुममरैर्यत्रः कृतः किल दुरात्मभिः ।
मद्रीर्य्यतापितैवींरो न त्वेतान् गणयाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
mam hantumamarairyatrah kritah kila duratmabhih |
madriryyatapitaivimro na tvetan ganayamyaham ||

verses.sa:
किमिन्द्रणाल्पवीर्य्येण किं हरेणैकचारिणा ।
हरिणा वापि किं साध्यं छिद्रष्वसुरघातिना ॥
verses.rom:
kimindranalpaviryyena kim harenaikacharina |
harina vapi kim sadhyam chhidrashvasuraghatina ||

verses.sa:
किमादित्यैः किं वसुभिरल्पवीय्यैः किमग्रिभिः ।
किञ्चान्यैरमरैः सर्व्वैर्मदूबाहुबलनिर्ज्जितैः ॥
verses.rom:
kimadityaih kim vasubhiralpaviyyaih kimagribhih |
kinchanyairamaraih sarvvairmadubahubalanirjjitaih ||

verses.sa:
किं न दृष्टोऽमरपतिर्मया संयुगमेत्य सः ।
पृष्ठेनैव वहन् वाणानपागच्छन्न वक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
kim na drishto'marapatirmaya samyugametya sah |
prishthenaiva vahan vananapagachchhanna vakshasa ||

verses.sa:
मद्राष्ट्रे वारिता वृष्टिर्यदा शक्रेणा किं तदा ।
मद्राणभिन्नैर्जलदैरापोऽमुक्ता यथेप्सिताः ॥
verses.rom:
madrashtre varita vrishtiryada shakrena kim tada |
madranabhinnairjaladairapo'mukta yathepsitah ||

verses.sa:
किमुर्व्ब्यामवनीपाला मद्रबाहुबलभीरवः ।
न सर्व्वे सन्नतिं याता जरासन्धमृते गुरुम् ॥
verses.rom:
kimurvbyamavanipala madrabahubalabhiravah |
na sarvve sannatim yata jarasandhamrite gurum ||

verses.sa:
अमरेषु च मेऽवज्ञा जायते दैत्यपुङ्गवाः ।
हास्यं मे जायते बींरास्तेषु यत्रपरेष्वपि ॥
verses.rom:
amareshu cha me'vajna jayate daityapungavah |
hasyam me jayate bimrasteshu yatrapareshvapi ||

verses.sa:
तथापि खलु दुष्टानां तेषामभ्यधिकं मया ।
अपकाराय देत्येन्द्रा यतनीयं दुरात्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi khalu dushtanam teshamabhyadhikam maya |
apakaraya detyendra yataniyam duratmanam ||

verses.sa:
तदू ये यशस्विनः केचित् पृथिव्यां ये च यज्विनः ।
कार्य्यो देबापकाराय तेषां सर्व्वात्मना वधः ॥
verses.rom:
tadu ye yashasvinah kechit prithivyam ye cha yajvinah |
karyyo debapakaraya tesham sarvvatmana vadhah ||

verses.sa:
उत्पन्नश्वापि मृत्युर्मे भूतपूर्व्वः स वै किल ।
इत्येतदू बालिका प्राह देवकीगर्भसम्भवा ॥
verses.rom:
utpannashvapi mrityurme bhutapurvvah sa vai kila |
ityetadu balika praha devakigarbhasambhava ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादू बालेषु परमो यत्रः कार्य्यो महीतले ।
यत्रोद्रिक्तं बलं बाले स हन्तव्यः प्रयत्रतः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadu baleshu paramo yatrah karyyo mahitale |
yatrodriktam balam bale sa hantavyah prayatratah ||

verses.sa:
इत्याज्ञाप्यासुरान् कंसः प्रविश्यात्मगृहं ततः ।
मुमोच वसुदेवञ्च देवकीञ्च निरोधतः ॥
verses.rom:
ityajnapyasuran kamsah pravishyatmagriham tatah |
mumocha vasudevancha devakincha nirodhatah ||

verses.sa:
युवयोर्घातिता गर्भा वृथैवैते मयाधुना ।
कोऽप्यन्य एव नाशाय बालो मम समुदूगतः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvayorghatita garbha vrithaivaite mayadhuna |
ko'pyanya eva nashaya balo mama samudugatah ||

verses.sa:
तदलं परितापेन नूनं तद्भाविनो हि ते ।
अर्भका युवयोर्दोषाच्चायुषो यद्रियोजिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tadalam paritapena nunam tadbhavino hi te |
arbhaka yuvayordoshachchayusho yadriyojitah ||

verses.sa:
इत्याश्वास्य विमुक्त्वां च कंसस्तौ परिशङ्कितः ।
अन्तर्गहं द्रिजश्वेष्ठ प्रविवेश पुनः स्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityashvasya vimuktvam cha kamsastau parishankitah |
antargaham drijashveshtha pravivesha punah svakam ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Kansa, greatly disturbed in mind, called together all the leading Asuras, Pralamba, Kesin and others and said to them—"O ye, leading Asuras, Pralamba, Dhenuka, Putanā, Arishta and all others, hear my words. O heroes, the wicked celestials, troubled by my power, have been trying to destroy me—but I do not much care for them. Save murdering the Asuras by fraud, what can the weak Indra and the ascetic Hara or Hari do? What have we to fear from the Adityas, the Vasus, the Agnis or any other of the immortals who have all been defeated by my resistless arms? Have you not seen the king of the celestials, when he had come out into the conflict, quickly fly from the field receiving my arrows upon his back, not bravely upon his breast? When Indra withheld rains from my kingdom, were not the clouds compelled by my arrows to pour water as much as was acquired? Are not all the kings of the earth afraid of my prowess and subject to my orders, save my father Jarasandha? O ye leading and heroic Daityas, I have already got hatred towards the celestials—it has created my laughter that they have been trying to slay me. And it is my fixed determination to inflict still deeper degradation upon those vicious and wicked-minded celestials.

"Let us therefore kill every man who is known for liberality (in making gifts to gods and Brāhmans) and let every man who is celebrated for performing sacrifices be slain; and thus the celestials shall the deprived of the means they live upon. The goddess, who has taken her birth as the child of Devaki, has said to me that he is again born who destroyed me in one of my previous birth. Let us vigorously find out all young children upon earth and let every boy in whom there are signs of unusual vigour, be killed mercilessly".

Having passed these orders Kansa went to his palace and liberated Vasudeva and Devaki from their captivity. He said to them.—"In vain have I killed all your children, for he, who is destined to kill me, has escaped. It is useless to regret the the past. The children, who shall be born to you after this, may enjoy life till its natural close; no one shall cut it short". Having thus consoled them, Kansa, greatly terrified for himself, went into the inner apartments of his palace.

verses.sa:
विमुक्तो वसुदेवोऽस्य नन्दस्य शकटं गतः ।
प्रह्टष्टं दृष्टवान् नन्दं पूत्रो जातो ममेति वै ॥
verses.rom:
vimukto vasudevo'sya nandasya shakatam gatah |
prahtashtam drishtavan nandam putro jato mameti vai ||

verses.sa:
वसुदेवोऽपि तं प्राह दिष्ठया दिष्ठयति सादरम् ।
वार्द्धकेऽपि समुत्पन्नस्तनयोऽयं तवाघुना ॥
verses.rom:
vasudevo'pi tam praha dishthaya dishthayati sadaram |
varddhake'pi samutpannastanayo'yam tavaghuna ||

verses.sa:
दत्तो हि वार्षिकः सर्व्वो भवद्भिर्नृ पतेः करः ।
यदर्थमागतास्तस्मान्नावस्थेयं महाधनाः ॥
verses.rom:
datto hi varshikah sarvvo bhavadbhirnri pateh karah |
yadarthamagatastasmannavastheyam mahadhanah ||

verses.sa:
यदर्थमागताः कार्य्यं तन्निष्पन्नं किमास्यते ?
भतद्भिर्गम्यतां नन्द! तच्छीघ्रं निजगोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadarthamagatah karyyam tannishpannam kimasyate ?
bhatadbhirgamyatam nanda! tachchhighram nijagokulam ||

verses.sa:
ममापि बालकस्तत्र रोहिणीप्रसवी हि यः ।
स रक्षणीयो भवता यथायं तनयो निजः ॥
verses.rom:
mamapi balakastatra rohiniprasavi hi yah |
sa rakshaniyo bhavata yathayam tanayo nijah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्ताः प्रययुर्गोपा नन्दगोपपुरोगमाः ।
शकटारोपितैर्भाण्डैः करं दत्त्वा महाबलाः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah prayayurgopa nandagopapurogamah |
shakataropitairbhandaih karam dattva mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
वसतां गोकुले तेषां पूतना बालघातिनी ।
सुप्तं कृषूणमुपादाय रात्रौ तस्मै ददौ स्तनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vasatam gokule tesham putana balaghatini |
suptam krishunamupadaya ratrau tasmai dadau stanam ||

verses.sa:
यस्मै यस्मै स्तनं पूतना सम्प्रयच्छति ।
तस्य तस्य क्षणोनाङ्ग बालकस्योपहन्यते ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai yasmai stanam putana samprayachchhati |
tasya tasya kshanonanga balakasyopahanyate ||

verses.sa:
कुषूणस्तस्याः स्तनं गाढ़ं कराभ्यामवपीड़ितम् ।
गृहोत्वा प्राणसहितं पपौ कोपसमन्वितः ॥
verses.rom:
kushunastasyah stanam garham karabhyamavapiritam |
grihotva pranasahitam papau kopasamanvitah ||

verses.sa:
सा विमुक्तमहारावा विच्छिन्नस्त्रंयुबन्धना ।
पपात पूतना भूमौ म्रियमाणतिभीषणा ॥
verses.rom:
sa vimuktamaharava vichchhinnastramyubandhana |
papata putana bhumau mriyamanatibhishana ||

verses.sa:
तन्नादश्रुतिसन्त्रासात् प्रबुद्धास्ते व्रजौकसः ।
ददृशुः पूतनोत्सङ्गे कृषूणं ताञ्च निपातिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tannadashrutisantrasat prabuddhaste vrajaukasah |
dadrishuh putanotsange krishunam tancha nipatitam ||

verses.sa:
आदाय कृषूणं सन्त्रस्ता यशोदापि द्रिजोत्तम!
गोपुच्छं भ्राम्य हस्तेन बालदोषमपाकरोत् ॥
verses.rom:
adaya krishunam santrasta yashodapi drijottama!
gopuchchham bhramya hastena baladoshamapakarot ||

verses.sa:
गोः करीषमुपादाय नन्दगोफोऽपि मस्तके ।
कृषूणस्य प्रददौ रक्षां कुर्वंश्चैतदुदोरयन् ॥
verses.rom:
goh karishamupadaya nandagopho'pi mastake |
krishunasya pradadau raksham kurvamshchaitadudorayan ||

verses.sa:
रक्षतु त्वामशेषाणां भूतानां प्रभवो हरिः ।
यस्य नाभिसमुदूभूतपङ्कजादभवज्जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
rakshatu tvamasheshanam bhutanam prabhavo harih |
yasya nabhisamudubhutapankajadabhavajjagat ||

verses.sa:
येन दंष्ट्राग्रविधृता धारयत्यवनी जगत् ।
वराहरूपधूगू देवः स त्वां रक्षतु केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
yena damshtragravidhrita dharayatyavani jagat |
varaharupadhugu devah sa tvam rakshatu keshavah ||

verses.sa:
नखाङूकुरविनिर्भिन्न-वैरिवक्षःस्थलो विभुः ।
नृसिंहरूपी सर्व्वत्र स त्वां रक्षतु केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
nakhanukuravinirbhinna-vairivakshahsthalo vibhuh |
nrisimharupi sarvvatra sa tvam rakshatu keshavah ||

verses.sa:
वामनो रक्षतु सदा भवन्तं यः क्षणादभूत् ।
त्रिविक्रमः क्रमाकान्त-त्रैलोक्यः स्फुरदायुधः ॥
verses.rom:
vamano rakshatu sada bhavantam yah kshanadabhut |
trivikramah kramakanta-trailokyah sphuradayudhah ||

verses.sa:
शिरस्ते पातु गोविन्दः कणठं रक्षतु केशवः ।
गुह्यञ्च जठरं विष्णुर्जङ्घा-पादौ जनार्द्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
shiraste patu govindah kanatham rakshatu keshavah |
guhyancha jatharam vishnurjangha-padau janarddanah ||

verses.sa:
मुखं बाहू प्रबाहू च मनः सर्व्वेन्द्रियाणि च ।
रक्षत्वव्याहतैश्वर्य्यस्तव नारयणोऽव्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
mukham bahu prabahu cha manah sarvvendriyani cha |
rakshatvavyahataishvaryyastava narayano'vyayah ||

verses.sa:
शाङ्ग-चक्र-गदा-खडूग-शङ्खनादहताः क्षयम् ।
गच्छन्तु प्रते-कुष्माण्ड-राक्षसा ये तवाहिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shanga-chakra-gada-khaduga-shankhanadahatah kshayam |
gachchhantu prate-kushmanda-rakshasa ye tavahitah ||

verses.sa:
त्वां पातु दिक्षु वैकुणठो विदिक्षु मधुसूदनः ।
ह्टषीकेशोऽम्बरे भूमौ रक्षतु त्वां महीधरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam patu dikshu vaikunatho vidikshu madhusudanah |
htashikesho'mbare bhumau rakshatu tvam mahidharah ||

verses.sa:
एवं कृतस्वस्त्ययनो नन्दगोपेन बालकः ।
शायितः शकटस्याधो बालपर्य्यङ्किकातले ॥
verses.rom:
evam kritasvastyayano nandagopena balakah |
shayitah shakatasyadho balaparyyankikatale ||

verses.sa:
ते च गोपा महदू दृष्ट्वा पूतनायाः कलेवरम् ।
मृतायाः परमं त्रासं विस्मयं परमं ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
te cha gopa mahadu drishtva putanayah kalevaram |
mritayah paramam trasam vismayam paramam yayuh ||

prose.en:
When Vasudeva was freed, he went to the wagon of Nanda and found him greatly delighted that a son was born to him. He then kindly said to him "It is a blessing that you have got a son in your old age. Have you given your annual tribute to the king? If you have finished your work, you should not wait here for you are men of property. Why do you wait here since the work that has brought you, is finished? Go therefore, speedily, O Nanda, to your Gokula. I have also got a son there, born of Rohini, and he should be brought up by you as this your own son".

Parāçara said:—Thus having paid their dues to the king and placed their goods in their wagons, Nanda and other cow-herds went to their village. And while they were thus living in Gokula, Putanā the child-killer, taking up Krishna, asleep in night, gave him her breast to suck. And whatever child is suckled by Putanā in night, dies instantly having its limbs wearied and exhausted. But laying hold of the breast with two hands, Krishna sucked it with such violence that he drained it of the life and the terrible Putanā, roaring aloud and giving way in every point, fell on the ground dead. Hearing those cries, the inhabitants of Vraja, terrified, got up and saw Putanā lying on the earth with Krishna in her arms. Snatching up Krishna, Yasoda waved over him a cow-tail-brush to guard him from harm, whilst Nanda placed dried cow-dung powdered upon his head; he gave him also an amulet, saying at the same time—"May Hari the lord of creation, he, from the lotus of whose navel the world was produced and on the tip of whose tusks the globe was upraised from waters, protect thee. May that Kesava, who assumed the form of a boar, protect thee. May that Kesava, who, as the man-lion, rent with his sharp nails, the bosom of his foe, save thee. May that Kesava, who appearing first as the dwarf, traversed with all his power with three paces, the three regions of the universe, constantly protect thee. May Govinda guard thy belly, Janarddana thy legs and feet, the eternal and irresistible Nārāyana thy face, thine arms, thy mind and thy faculties of sense. May all ghosts, goblins and malignant spirits, that shall be engaged in thy mischief, be destroyed by the bow, the discus, the mace, the sword of Vishnu and the by echo of his conch shell. May Vaikuntha guard thee in thy cardinal points and Madhusudana in the intermediate ones. May Hrishikesha defend thee in the sky and Mahidhara upon earth". Having recited these prayers to avert all evil, Nanda caused the child to sleep in his bed underneath the wagon. Seeing the huge carcass of Putanā the cow-herds were filled with surprise and fear.

verses.sa:
कदाचिच्छकटाधस्ताच्छयानो मधुसूदनः ।
चिक्षेप चरणावूद्ध्व स्तन्यार्थी प्ररुरोद च ॥
verses.rom:
kadachichchhakatadhastachchhayano madhusudanah |
chikshepa charanavuddhva stanyarthi praruroda cha ||

verses.sa:
तस्य पादप्रहारेणा शकटं परिवर्त्तितम् ।
विध्वस्तकुम्भभाणडं बै विपरीतं पपात च ॥
verses.rom:
tasya padapraharena shakatam parivarttitam |
vidhvastakumbhabhanadam bai viparitam papata cha ||

verses.sa:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्व्वो गोपगोपीजनो द्रिज !
आजगामाथ ददृशे बालमुत्तानशायिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato hahakritam sarvvo gopagopijano drija !
ajagamatha dadrishe balamuttanashayinam ||

verses.sa:
गोपाः केनेति केनेदं शकटं पखिर्त्तितम् ।
तत्रैवं बालकाश्वोचुर्बालेनानेन पातितम् ।
रुदता दृष्टमस्माभिः पादविक्षेपताड़ितम् ।
शकटं परिवृत्तं वै नैतदन्यस्य चोष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
gopah keneti kenedam shakatam pakhirttitam |
tatraivam balakashvochurbalenanena patitam |
rudata drishtamasmabhih padavikshepataritam |
shakatam parivrittam vai naitadanyasya choshtitam ||

verses.sa:
ततः पुनरतीवासन् गोपा विस्मितचेतसः ।
नन्दगोपोऽपि जग्राह बालमत्यन्तविस्मितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah punarativasan gopa vismitachetasah |
nandagopo'pi jagraha balamatyantavismitah ||

verses.sa:
यशोदा शकटारूढ़भग्रभाण्डकपालिकाः ।
शकटं चार्च्चयामास दधि-पुष्प-फलाक्षतैः ॥
verses.rom:
yashoda shakatarurhabhagrabhandakapalikah |
shakatam charchchayamasa dadhi-pushpa-phalakshataih ||

verses.sa:
गर्गश्व गोकुले तत्र वसुदेवप्रणोदितः ।
प्रच्छन्न एव गोपानां संस्काराकरोत् तयोः ॥
verses.rom:
gargashva gokule tatra vasudevapranoditah |
prachchhanna eva gopanam samskarakarot tayoh ||

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठञ्च राममित्याह कृष्णञ्चवै तथापरम् ।
गर्गो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठो नाम कुर्व्वन् महामतिः ॥
verses.rom:
jyeshthancha ramamityaha krishnanchavai tathaparam |
gargo matimatam shreshtho nama kurvvan mahamatih ||

verses.sa:
स्वल्पेनैव हि कालेन रिङ्गिणौ तौ तदा ब्रजे ।
घृष्टजानुकरौ तौ हि बभूवतुरुभावपि ॥
verses.rom:
svalpenaiva hi kalena ringinau tau tada braje |
ghrishtajanukarau tau hi babhuvaturubhavapi ||

verses.sa:
करीषभस्मदिग्धाङ्गौ भ्रममाणावितस्ततः ।
न निवारायितु शेके यशोदा न च रोहिणी ॥
verses.rom:
karishabhasmadigdhangau bhramamanavitastatah |
na nivarayitu sheke yashoda na cha rohini ||

verses.sa:
गोवांटमध्ये क्रीड़न्तौ वत्सवाटगतौ पुनः ।
तदहर्जातगोवतूसपुच्छाकर्षणतत्परौ ॥
verses.rom:
govamtamadhye krirantau vatsavatagatau punah |
tadaharjatagovatusapuchchhakarshanatatparau ||

verses.sa:
यदा यशोदा तौ बालावेकस्थानचरावुभौ ।
शशाकि नो वाररितु क्रीड़न्तावतिचञ्चलौ ॥
verses.rom:
yada yashoda tau balavekasthanacharavubhau |
shashaki no vararitu krirantavatichanchalau ||

verses.sa:
यशोदा यष्टिमादाय कोपेनानुगता च तम् ।
कृष्णां कमलपत्राक्षं तर्ज्जयन्ती रुषा तदा ।
दाम्रा बद्धा तदा मध्ये निबध्याथ उदूखले ।
कृष्णमक्लिष्टकर्म्माणमाह चेदममर्षिता ॥
verses.rom:
yashoda yashtimadaya kopenanugata cha tam |
krishnam kamalapatraksham tarjjayanti rusha tada |
damra baddha tada madhye nibadhyatha udukhale |
krishnamaklishtakarmmanamaha chedamamarshita ||

verses.sa:
यदि शक्रोषि गच्छ त्वमतिचञ्चलचेष्टित !
इत्युक्त्वा च निजं कर्म्म सा चकार कुटुम्बिनी ॥
verses.rom:
yadi shakroshi gachchha tvamatichanchalacheshtita !
ityuktva cha nijam karmma sa chakara kutumbini ||

verses.sa:
व्यग्रायामथ तस्यां स कर्षमाण उदूखलम् ।
यमलार्ज्जुनमध्येन जगाम कमलेक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
vyagrayamatha tasyam sa karshamana udukhalam |
yamalarjjunamadhyena jagama kamalekshanah ||

verses.sa:
कर्षता वृक्षयोर्मध्ये तिर्य्यगूगतमुदूखलम् ।
भग्रावुत्तुङ्गशाखाग्रो तेन तौ यमलार्ज्जुनौ ॥
verses.rom:
karshata vrikshayormadhye tiryyagugatamudukhalam |
bhagravuttungashakhagro tena tau yamalarjjunau ||

verses.sa:
ततः कटकटाशब्दं समाकर्ण्य च कातरः ।
आजगाम ब्रजजनो ददृशे च महाद्र मौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatah katakatashabdam samakarnya cha katarah |
ajagama brajajano dadrishe cha mahadra mau ||

verses.sa:
भग्रस्कन्धौ निपतितौ भग्रशाखौ महीतले ।
नवोदूगताल्पदन्तांशु-सितहासञ्च बालकम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhagraskandhau nipatitau bhagrashakhau mahitale |
navodugatalpadantamshu-sitahasancha balakam ||

verses.sa:
तयोर्मध्यगतं बद्धं दाम्रा गाढ़ तथोदरे ।
ततश्व दामोदरतां स ययौ दामबन्धनात् ॥
verses.rom:
tayormadhyagatam baddham damra garha tathodare |
tatashva damodaratam sa yayau damabandhanat ||

verses.sa:
गोपबृद्धास्ततः सर्व्वे नन्दगोपपुरोगमाः ।
मन्त्रयामासुरुद्रिग्रा महोत्पातातिभीरवः ॥
verses.rom:
gopabriddhastatah sarvve nandagopapurogamah |
mantrayamasurudrigra mahotpatatibhiravah ||

verses.sa:
स्थानेनेह न नः कार्य्यं गच्छामोऽन्यन्महावनम् ।
उत्पाता बहवो ह्यत्र दृश्यन्ते नाशहेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
sthaneneha na nah karyyam gachchhamo'nyanmahavanam |
utpata bahavo hyatra drishyante nashahetavah ||

verses.sa:
पूतनाया विनाशश्व शकटस्य विपर्य्ययः ।
विना वातादि-दोषेण द्रु मयोः पतनं तथा ।
वृन्दावनमितः स्थानात् तस्माद् गच्छाम मा चिरम् ।
यावद्भौममहोत्पात-दोषो नाभिभवेदू व्रजम् ॥
verses.rom:
putanaya vinashashva shakatasya viparyyayah |
vina vatadi-doshena dru mayoh patanam tatha |
vrindavanamitah sthanat tasmad gachchhama ma chiram |
yavadbhaumamahotpata-dosho nabhibhavedu vrajam ||

verses.sa:
इति कृत्वा मतिं सर्व्वे गमने ते व्रजौकसः ।
ऊचुः स्वं स्वं कुलं शीघ्रं गम्यतां मा विलम्बयताम् ॥
verses.rom:
iti kritva matim sarvve gamane te vrajaukasah |
uchuh svam svam kulam shighram gamyatam ma vilambayatam ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्षणेनः प्रययु शकटैर्गोधनैस्तथा ।
यूथशो वतूसबालांश्व कालयन्तो व्रजौकसः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kshanenah prayayu shakatairgodhanaistatha |
yuthasho vatusabalamshva kalayanto vrajaukasah ||

verses.sa:
द्रव्यावयवनिद्धूतं क्षणामात्रेण तत् तथा ।
काक-काकी-समाकीर्णां व्रजस्थानमभूदू द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
dravyavayavaniddhutam kshanamatrena tat tatha |
kaka-kaki-samakirnam vrajasthanamabhudu drija ||

verses.sa:
वृन्दावनं भगवता कृष्णोनाक्लिष्टकर्म्मणा ।
शुभेन मनसा ध्यातं गबां वृद्धिमभीप्सता ॥
verses.rom:
vrindavanam bhagavata krishnonaklishtakarmmana |
shubhena manasa dhyatam gabam vriddhimabhipsata ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तत्रातिरूक्षेऽपि घर्म्मकाले द्रिजोत्तम!
प्रावृटूकाल इवोद्भूतं नवं शस्यं समन्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastatratirukshe'pi gharmmakale drijottama!
pravritukala ivodbhutam navam shasyam samantatah ||

verses.sa:
स समावासितः सर्व्वो व्रजो वृन्दावने ततः ।
खकटोवाचटपर्य्यन्तश्वन्द्रार्द्धाकारसंस्थितिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa samavasitah sarvvo vrajo vrindavane tatah |
khakatovachataparyyantashvandrarddhakarasamsthitih ||

verses.sa:
वत्सपालौ च संवृत्तौ राम-दामोदरौ ततः
एकस्थानस्थितौ गोष्ठे चेरतुर्बाललीलया ॥
verses.rom:
vatsapalau cha samvrittau rama-damodarau tatah
ekasthanasthitau goshthe cheraturbalalilaya ||

verses.sa:
बर्हिपत्रकृतापीड़ौ वन्यपुष्पावतंसकौ ।
गोपवेणुकृतातोद्य-पत्रवाद्यकृतस्वनौ ॥
verses.rom:
barhipatrakritapirau vanyapushpavatamsakau |
gopavenukritatodya-patravadyakritasvanau ||

verses.sa:
काकपक्षधरौ बालौ कुमाराविव पावकी ।
हसन्तौ च रमन्तौ च चेरतुस्तै महाबलौ ।
क्वचिद्धसन्तावन्योन्यं क्रीड़मानौ तथापरैः ।
गोपपुत्रैः समं वत्सांश्वारयन्तौ विचेरतुः ॥
verses.rom:
kakapakshadharau balau kumaraviva pavaki |
hasantau cha ramantau cha cheratustai mahabalau |
kvachiddhasantavanyonyam kriramanau tathaparaih |
gopaputraih samam vatsamshvarayantau vicheratuh ||

verses.sa:
कालेन गच्छता तौ तु सप्तवर्षौ महाव्रजे ।
सर्व्वस्य जगतः पालौ वत्सपालौ बभूवतुः ॥
verses.rom:
kalena gachchhata tau tu saptavarshau mahavraje |
sarvvasya jagatah palau vatsapalau babhuvatuh ||

verses.sa:
प्रावृटूकालस्ततोऽतीव मेघौघस्थगिताम्बरः ।
बभूव वारिधाराभिरैक्यं कुर्व्वन् दिशामिव ॥
verses.rom:
pravritukalastato'tiva meghaughasthagitambarah |
babhuva varidharabhiraikyam kurvvan dishamiva ||

verses.sa:
प्ररूढ़नवशस्याञया शक्रगोपाचिता मही ।
तदा मारकतीवासीत् पद्मरागविभूषिता ॥
verses.rom:
prarurhanavashasyanaya shakragopachita mahi |
tada marakativasit padmaragavibhushita ||

verses.sa:
जग्मुरुन्मार्गवाहानि निम्रगाम्भांसि सर्व्वतः ।
मनांसि दुव्विनीतानां प्राप्य लक्ष्मीं नवामिव ॥
verses.rom:
jagmurunmargavahani nimragambhamsi sarvvatah |
manamsi duvvinitanam prapya lakshmim navamiva ||

verses.sa:
न रेजेऽन्तरितश्वन्द्रो निर्म्मलो मलिनैर्घनैः ।
सद्राक्यवादो मूर्खाणां प्रगलूभाभिरिवोक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
na reje'ntaritashvandro nirmmalo malinairghanaih |
sadrakyavado murkhanam pragalubhabhirivoktibhih ||

verses.sa:
निगु णोनापि चापेन शक्रस्य गगने पदम् ।
अवाप्यताविवेकस्य नृपस्येव परिग्रहे ॥
verses.rom:
nigu nonapi chapena shakrasya gagane padam |
avapyatavivekasya nripasyeva parigrahe ||

verses.sa:
मेघपृष्ठे बलाकानां रराज विमला ततिः ।
दुर्वृत्ते वृत्त्चेष्टेव कुलीनस्यातिशोभना ॥
verses.rom:
meghaprishthe balakanam raraja vimala tatih |
durvritte vrittcheshteva kulinasyatishobhana ||

verses.sa:
न बबन्धाम्बरे स्थैर्य्य विद्यु दत्यन्तचञ्चला ।
मैत्रीव प्रवरे पुंसि दुर्ज्जनेन प्रयोजिता ॥
verses.rom:
na babandhambare sthairyya vidyu datyantachanchala |
maitriva pravare pumsi durjjanena prayojita ||

verses.sa:
मार्गा बभूवुरस्पष्टा नवशस्यचयावृताः ।
अर्थान्तरमनुप्राप्ताः प्रजड़ानामिवोक्तयः ।
उन्मत्तशिखिसारङ्ग तस्मिन् काले महावने ।
कृष्ण-रामौ मुदा युक्तौ गोपालैश्चैरतुः सह ॥
verses.rom:
marga babhuvuraspashta navashasyachayavritah |
arthantaramanupraptah prajaranamivoktayah |
unmattashikhisaranga tasmin kale mahavane |
krishna-ramau muda yuktau gopalaishchairatuh saha ||

verses.sa:
क्वचिदू गोपैः समं रम्यं गेयनृत्यरतावुभौ ।
चेरतुः क्कचिदत्यर्थं शीतवृक्षतलाश्रयौ ॥
verses.rom:
kvachidu gopaih samam ramyam geyanrityaratavubhau |
cheratuh kkachidatyartham shitavrikshatalashrayau ||

verses.sa:
क्वचित् कदम्बस्रक्-चित्रौ मयूरस्त्रग्धरौ क्वचित् ।
विचित्रौ क्वचिदास्येतां विविधैर्गिरिधातुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
kvachit kadambasrak-chitrau mayurastragdharau kvachit |
vichitrau kvachidasyetam vividhairgiridhatubhih ||

verses.sa:
पर्णशय्यासु संसुप्तौ क्वचिन्नद्रान्तरैषिणौ ।
क्वचिद् गर्ज्जति जीमूते हाहाकारखादृतौ ॥
verses.rom:
parnashayyasu samsuptau kvachinnadrantaraishinau |
kvachid garjjati jimute hahakarakhadritau ||

verses.sa:
गायतामन्यगोपानां प्रशंसापरमौ क्वचित् ।
मयूरकेकानुगतौ गोपवेषुप्रवादकौ ॥
verses.rom:
gayatamanyagopanam prashamsaparamau kvachit |
mayurakekanugatau gopaveshupravadakau ||

verses.sa:
इति नानाविधैर्भावैरुत्तमप्रीतिसंयुतौ ।
क्रीड़ासक्तौ वने तस्मिन् चेरतुः प्रीतमानसौ ॥
verses.rom:
iti nanavidhairbhavairuttamapritisamyutau |
krirasaktau vane tasmin cheratuh pritamanasau ||

verses.sa:
विकाले तु समं गोभिर्गोपवृन्दसमन्बितौ ।
आजग्मतुः कृष्ण-बलौ गोपवेशधरावुभौ ॥
verses.rom:
vikale tu samam gobhirgopavrindasamanbitau |
ajagmatuh krishna-balau gopaveshadharavubhau ||

verses.sa:
विकाले च यथाजोष व्रजमत्य महाबलौ ।
गोपैः समानैः सहितौ चिक्रीड़ातेऽमराविव ॥
verses.rom:
vikale cha yathajosha vrajamatya mahabalau |
gopaih samanaih sahitau chikrirate'maraviva ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said Once on a time while the slayer of Madhu was asleep underneath the wagon, he cried for the breast and kicking up his feet he overturned the vehicle and all the pots and pans were upset and broken. Hearing the noise the wives of the cow-herds came exclaiming—"Ah! Ah!" and there they found the child sleeping on his back. "Who could have overturned the wagon?" exclaimed the cow-herds. "That child" said some of the boys who saw the circumstance. "We saw him," said the boys, "crying and kicking the wagon and so the wagon was upset; no one else had anything to do with it".

The cow-herds were therefore greatly surprised and not knowing what to do Nanda at once took up the boy and Yasoda offered worship to the broken pieces of pots and to the wagon, with curds, flowers, fruits and unbruised grain.

Being commissioned by Vasudeva, Garga performed the initiatory rites of the two boys secretly in Vraja. The eldest was named Rāma and the other Krishna by the wise Garga, the foremost of the intelligent. In a short time they began to crawl about the ground, supporting themselves on their hands and knees and creeping everywhere, often amidst ashes and filth. Neither Rohini nor Yasoda was able to prevent them from getting into the cow-pens or amongst the calves, where they amused themselves by pulling their tails. When Yasoda could not prevent the two boys, who always rambled together, from playing naughtily, she became angry and taking up a stick remonstrated with Krishna having eyes like lotus-petals. Fastening a cord round his waist she tied him to the wooden mortar and being angry, she said to him "Now you wicked boy, get away from here, if you can". Having said this, she went about her domestic affairs. As soon as she had gone, the lotus-eyed Krishna, trying to extricate himself, pulled the mortar after him to the space between the two Arjuna trees that grew near together. Being dragged there the mortar became wedged between the two trees, and Krishna having pulled it, the two huge trees covered with many leaves, were uprooted. Hearing the cracking noise the inhabitants of Vraja came to see what was the matter and there they beheld the two huge trees with broken branches and stems lying on the ground with the child fixed between them, with a rope round his belly, laughing and shewing his white teeth, just budded. It is from this that Krishna is called Dāmodara from the binding of dama (rope) round his udara (belly). The elders among the cow-herds, with Nanda at their head, looked upon these circumstances with alarm, considering them as inauspicious signs. They said—"We cannot remain in this place—let us go to some other part of the forest Here many evil omens threaten us with destruction—the death of Putanā, the upsetting of the wagon and the fall of the trees without their being uprooted by the wind. Let us go away from here without any delay and go to Vrindavana, where evil omens may no longer disturb us".

Having thus made up their minds, the inhabitants of Vraja communicated their intention to their families and desired them to go without delay. Accordingly they started with their wagons and their cattle, driving before them their bulls and cows and calves; they threw away the fragments of their household stores and in no time Vraja was overspread with flights of crows. Vrindavana was selected by Krishna, who was above the influence of actions, for the sake of providing for the nourishment of the kine, for there in the hottest season the new grass springs up as profusely as the rains. Having gone to Vrindavana from Vraja, the inhabitants of the latter up their wagons in the form of a crescent.

As the two boys Rāma and Damodara grew up, they lived always together in the same place and engaged in the same boyish sports. They made themselves crests of the peacocks' plumes and garlands of forest flowers and musical instruments of reeds and leaves or played upon the pipes used by cowherds; their hair was arranged like the wings of the crow, and they looked like two young princes and portions of the god of war. They were robust, and walked about always laughing and playing sometimes with each other, sometimes with other boys; driving, along with other young cowherds, the calves to the pasture. Thus the two protectors of the universe were keepers of cattle until they became seven years old in the cow-pens of Vrindavana.

Then began the rainy season when the atmosphere was full of clouds and the quarters of the horizon were blended into one by the driving showers. The water of the rivers rose and overflowed their banks, and spread beyond all limits like the mind of the weak and wicked transported beyond restraint by sudden prosperity. The pure radiance of the moon was obscured by heavy vapours as the teachings of the sacred writings are darkened by the arrogant scoffs of the unbelievers. The bow of Indra held its place unstrung in the sky like a worthless person elevated to honour by an indiscreet king. White line of storks appeared upon the back of the clouds in such contrast as the bright conduct of a man of respectability opposes to the conduct of a scoundrel. The ever-fickle lightning, being newly allied with the sky, was like the friendship of a profligate for a man of substance. Overgrown by the spreading grain, the paths became difficult of being traced like the words of the ignorant carrying no definite meaning.

Krishna and Rāma, delighted, began to live in the forest in that beautiful season maddening the peacocks and bees. Sometimes they sang and danced with the cow-herds and sometimes sat under the cool shade of a huge tree for rest. Sometimes they beautified themselves with garlands of Kadamba flowers and again with garlands of peacocks' feathers; sometimes they painted themselves with the minerals of the mountain; sometimes they slept on beds of leaves and sometimes they rejoiced with the infants of the cow-herds, hearing the muttering of the clouds; sometimes they praised the songs of the boys, sometimes mimicked the cry the peacocks and sometimes played on pipes.

Thus greatly attached to each other and participating, in various emotions and sports, Rāma and Krishna delightedly resided in that forest. And every evening they used to come back home like two cow-boys along with the cows and cow-herds. And coming home in the evening, the two deities heartily engaged in sports giving delight to the sons of the cow-herds.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
एकदा तु विना रामं कृष्णो वृंदावनं ययौ
विचचार वृतो गोपैर्वन्यपुष्पस्रगुज्ज्वलः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ekada tu vina ramam krishno vrimdavanam yayau
vichachara vrito gopairvanyapushpasragujjvalah ||

verses.sa:
स जगामाथ कालिंदीं लोलकल्लोलशालिनीम्
तीरसंलग्नफेनौघैर्हसंतीमिव सर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa jagamatha kalimdim lolakallolashalinim
tirasamlagnaphenaughairhasamtimiva sarvatah ||

verses.sa:
तस्याश्चातिमहाभीमं विषाग्निश्रितवारिणम्
ह्रदं कालीयनागस्य ददर्शातिविभीषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyashchatimahabhimam vishagnishritavarinam
hradam kaliyanagasya dadarshativibhishanam ||

verses.sa:
विषाग्निना प्रसरता दग्धतीरमहीरुहम्
वाताहतांबुविक्षेपस्पर्शदग्धविहंगमम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishagnina prasarata dagdhatiramahiruham
vatahatambuvikshepasparshadagdhavihamgamam ||

verses.sa:
तमतीव महारौद्रं मृत्युवक्त्रमिवापरम्
विलोक्य चिंतयामास भगवान्मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
tamativa maharaudram mrityuvaktramivaparam
vilokya chimtayamasa bhagavanmadhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्वसति दुष्टात्मा कालीयोऽसौ विषायुधः
यो मया निर्जितस्त्यक्त्वा दुष्टो गच्छेत्पयोनिधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asminvasati dushtatma kaliyo'sau vishayudhah
yo maya nirjitastyaktva dushto gachchhetpayonidhim ||

verses.sa:
तेनेयं दूषिता सर्वा यमुना सागरंगमा
न नरैर्गोधनैश्चापि तृषार्त्तैरुपभुज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
teneyam dushita sarva yamuna sagaramgama
na narairgodhanaishchapi trisharttairupabhujyate ||

verses.sa:
तदस्य नागराजस्य कर्त्तव्यो निग्रहो मया
निस्त्रासास्तु सुखं येन चरेयुर्व्रजवासिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tadasya nagarajasya karttavyo nigraho maya
nistrasastu sukham yena chareyurvrajavasinah ||

verses.sa:
एतदर्थं तु लोकेस्मिन्नवतारः कृतो मया
यदेषामुत्पथस्थानां कार्या शांतिर्दुरात्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
etadartham tu lokesminnavatarah krito maya
yadeshamutpathasthanam karya shamtirduratmanam ||

verses.sa:
तदेतं नातिदूरस्थं कदंबमुरुशाखिनम्
अधिरुह्य पतिष्यामि ह्रदेऽस्मिन्ननिलाशिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tadetam natidurastham kadambamurushakhinam
adhiruhya patishyami hrade'sminnanilashinah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्थं विचिंत्य बद्धा च गाढं परिकरं ततः
निपपात ह्रदे तत्र नागराजस्य वेगतः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ittham vichimtya baddha cha gadham parikaram tatah
nipapata hrade tatra nagarajasya vegatah ||

verses.sa:
तेनातिपतता तत्र क्षोभितस्स महाह्रदः
अत्यर्थं दूरजातांस्तु समसिंचन्महीरुहान् ॥
verses.rom:
tenatipatata tatra kshobhitassa mahahradah
atyartham durajatamstu samasimchanmahiruhan ||

verses.sa:
ते हि दुष्टविषज्वालातप्तांबुपवनोक्षिताः
जज्वलुः पादपास्सद्यो ज्वालाव्याप्तदिगंतराः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi dushtavishajvalataptambupavanokshitah
jajvaluh padapassadyo jvalavyaptadigamtarah ||

verses.sa:
आस्फोटयामास तदा कृष्णो नागह्रदे भुजम्
तच्छब्दश्रवणाच्चाशु नागराजोऽभ्युपागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
asphotayamasa tada krishno nagahrade bhujam
tachchhabdashravanachchashu nagarajo'bhyupagamat ||

verses.sa:
आताम्रनयनः कोपाद्विषज्वालाकुलैर्मुखैः
