वृतो महाविषैश्चान्यैरुरगैरनिलाशनैः ॥
verses.rom:
atamranayanah kopadvishajvalakulairmukhaih
vrito mahavishaishchanyairuragairanilashanaih ||

verses.sa:
नागपत्न्यश्च शतशो हारिहारोपशोभिताः
प्रकंपिततनुक्षेपचलत्कुंतलकांतयः ॥
verses.rom:
nagapatnyashcha shatasho hariharopashobhitah
prakampitatanukshepachalatkumtalakamtayah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रवेष्टितस्सर्पैस्स कृष्णे भोगबंधनैः
ददंशुस्तेऽपि तं कृष्णं विषज्वालाकुलैर्मुखैः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah praveshtitassarpaissa krishne bhogabamdhanaih
dadamshuste'pi tam krishnam vishajvalakulairmukhaih ||

verses.sa:
तं तत्र पतितं दृष्ट्वा सर्पभोगैर्निपीडितम्
गोपा व्रजमुपागम्य चुक्रुशुः शोकलालसाः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tatra patitam drishtva sarpabhogairnipiditam
gopa vrajamupagamya chukrushuh shokalalasah ||

verses.sa:
गोपा ऊचुः
एष मोहं गतः कृष्णो मग्नौ वै कालियह्रदे
भक्ष्यते नागराजेन तमागच्छत पश्यत ॥
verses.rom:
gopa uchuh
esha moham gatah krishno magnau vai kaliyahrade
bhakshyate nagarajena tamagachchhata pashyata ||

verses.sa:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्र ते गोपा वज्रपा तोपमं वचः
गोप्यश्च त्वरिता जग्मुर्यशोदाप्रमुखा ह्रदम् ॥
verses.rom:
tachchhrutva tatra te gopa vajrapa topamam vachah
gopyashcha tvarita jagmuryashodapramukha hradam ||

verses.sa:
हाहा क्वासाविति जनो गोपीनामतिविह्वलः
यशोदया समं भ्रान्तो द्रु तप्रस्खलितं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
haha kvasaviti jano gopinamativihvalah
yashodaya samam bhranto dru tapraskhalitam yayau ||

verses.sa:
नंदगोपश्च गोपाश्च रामश्चाद्भुतविक्रमः
त्वरितं यमुनां जग्मुः कृष्णदर्शनलालसाः ॥
verses.rom:
namdagopashcha gopashcha ramashchadbhutavikramah
tvaritam yamunam jagmuh krishnadarshanalalasah ||

verses.sa:
ददृशुश्चापि ते तत्र सर्पराजवशंगतम्
निष्प्रयत्नीकृतं कृष्णं सर्पभोगविवेष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadrishushchapi te tatra sarparajavashamgatam
nishprayatnikritam krishnam sarpabhogaviveshtitam ||

verses.sa:
नंदगोपोपि निश्चेष्टो न्यस्य पुत्रमुखे दृशम्
यशोदा च महाभागा बभूव मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
namdagopopi nishcheshto nyasya putramukhe drisham
yashoda cha mahabhaga babhuva munisattama ||

verses.sa:
गोप्यस्त्वन्या रुदंत्यश्च ददृशुः शोककातराः
प्रोचुश्च केशवं प्रीत्या भयकातर्यगद्गदम् ॥
verses.rom:
gopyastvanya rudamtyashcha dadrishuh shokakatarah
prochushcha keshavam pritya bhayakataryagadgadam ||

verses.sa:
गोप्य ऊचुः
सर्वा यशोदया सार्द्धं विशामोत्र महाह्रदम्
सर्पराजस्य नो गंतुमस्माभिर्युज्यते व्रजम् ॥
verses.rom:
gopya uchuh
sarva yashodaya sarddham vishamotra mahahradam
sarparajasya no gamtumasmabhiryujyate vrajam ||

verses.sa:
दिवसः को विना सूर्यं विना चंद्रे ण का निशा
विना वृषेण का गावो विना कृष्णेन को व्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
divasah ko vina suryam vina chamdre na ka nisha
vina vrishena ka gavo vina krishnena ko vrajah ||

verses.sa:
विनाकृता न यास्यामः कृष्णेनानेन गोकुलम्
अरम्यं नातिसेव्यं च वारिहीनं यथा सरः ॥
verses.rom:
vinakrita na yasyamah krishnenanena gokulam
aramyam natisevyam cha varihinam yatha sarah ||

verses.sa:
यत्र नेंदीवरश्यामकायकांतिरयं हरिः
तेनापि पातुर्वासेन रतिरस्तीति विस्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra nemdivarashyamakayakamtirayam harih
tenapi paturvasena ratirastiti vismayah ||

verses.sa:
उत्फुल्लपंकजदलस्पष्टकांतिविलोचनम्
अपश्यंतो हरिं दीनाः कथं गोष्ठे भविष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
utphullapamkajadalaspashtakamtivilochanam
apashyamto harim dinah katham goshthe bhavishyatha ||

verses.sa:
अत्यंतमधुरालापहृताश्षोमनोरथम्
न विना पुंडरीकाक्षं यास्यामो नंदगोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
atyamtamadhuralapahritashshomanoratham
na vina pumdarikaksham yasyamo namdagokulam ||

verses.sa:
भोगेनावेष्टितस्यापि सर्पराजस्य पश्यत
स्मितशोभिमुखं गोप्यः कृष्णस्यास्मद्विलोकने ॥
verses.rom:
bhogenaveshtitasyapi sarparajasya pashyata
smitashobhimukham gopyah krishnasyasmadvilokane ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इति गोपीवचः श्रुत्वा रौहिणेयो महाबलः
गोपांश्च त्रासविधुरान्विलोक्य स्तिमितेक्षणान् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
iti gopivachah shrutva rauhineyo mahabalah
gopamshcha trasavidhuranvilokya stimitekshanan ||

verses.sa:
नंदं च दीनमत्यर्थं न्यस्तदृष्टिं सुतानने
मूर्च्छाकुलां यशोदां च कृष्णमाहात्मसंज्ञया ॥
verses.rom:
namdam cha dinamatyartham nyastadrishtim sutanane
murchchhakulam yashodam cha krishnamahatmasamjnaya ||

verses.sa:
किमिदं देवदेवेश भावोऽयं मानुषस्त्वया
व्यज्यतेत्यंतमात्मानं किमनंतं न वोत्सि यत् ॥
verses.rom:
kimidam devadevesha bhavo'yam manushastvaya
vyajyatetyamtamatmanam kimanamtam na votsi yat ||

verses.sa:
त्वमेव जगतो नाभिरराणामिव संश्रयः
कर्त्तापहर्त्ता पाता च त्रैलोक्यं त्वं त्रयीमयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvameva jagato nabhiraranamiva samshrayah
karttapahartta pata cha trailokyam tvam trayimayah ||

verses.sa:
सेंद्रै रुद्रा ग्निवसुभिरादित्यैर्मरुदश्विभिः
चिंत्यसे त्वमचिंत्यात्मन् समस्तैश्चैव योगिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
semdrai rudra gnivasubhiradityairmarudashvibhih
chimtyase tvamachimtyatman samastaishchaiva yogibhih ||

verses.sa:
जगत्यर्थं जगन्नाथ भारावतरणेच्छया
अवतीर्णोऽसि मर्त्येषु तवांशश्चाहमग्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
jagatyartham jagannatha bharavataranechchhaya
avatirno'si martyeshu tavamshashchahamagrajah ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्यलीलां भगवन् भजता भवता सुराः
विडम्बयन्तस्त्वल्लीलां सर्व एव सहासते ॥
verses.rom:
manushyalilam bhagavan bhajata bhavata surah
vidambayantastvallilam sarva eva sahasate ||

verses.sa:
अवतार्य भवान्पूर्वं गोकुले तु सुरांगनाः
क्रीडार्थमात्मनः पश्चादवर्तीर्णोऽसि शाश्वत ॥
verses.rom:
avatarya bhavanpurvam gokule tu suramganah
kridarthamatmanah pashchadavartirno'si shashvata ||

verses.sa:
अत्रावतीर्णयोः कृष्ण गोपा एव हि बांधवाः
गोप्यश्च सीदतः कस्मादेतान्बंधूनुपेक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
atravatirnayoh krishna gopa eva hi bamdhavah
gopyashcha sidatah kasmadetanbamdhunupekshase ||

verses.sa:
दर्शितो मानुषो भावो दर्शितं बालचापलम्
तदयं दम्यतां कृष्ण दुष्टात्मा दशनायुधः ॥
verses.rom:
darshito manusho bhavo darshitam balachapalam
tadayam damyatam krishna dushtatma dashanayudhah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इति संस्मारितः कृष्णः स्मितभिन्नोष्ठसंपुटः
आस्फोट्य मोचयामास स्वदेहं भोगिबंधनात् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
iti samsmaritah krishnah smitabhinnoshthasamputah
asphotya mochayamasa svadeham bhogibamdhanat ||

verses.sa:
आनम्य चापि हस्ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां मध्यमं शिरः
आरुह्याभुग्नशिरसः प्रणनर्त्तोरुविक्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
anamya chapi hastabhyamubhabhyam madhyamam shirah
aruhyabhugnashirasah prananarttoruvikramah ||

verses.sa:
प्राणाः फणेऽभवंश्चास्य कृष्णस्यांघ्रिनिकुट्टनैः
यत्रोन्नतिं च कुरुते ननामास्य ततश्शिरः ॥
verses.rom:
pranah phane'bhavamshchasya krishnasyamghrinikuttanaih
yatronnatim cha kurute nanamasya tatashshirah ||

verses.sa:
मूर्च्छामुपाययौ भ्रांत्या नागः कृष्णस्य रेचकैः
दंडपातनिपातेन ववाम रुधिरं बहु ॥
verses.rom:
murchchhamupayayau bhramtya nagah krishnasya rechakaih
damdapatanipatena vavama rudhiram bahu ||

verses.sa:
तं विभुग्नशिरोग्रीवमास्येभ्यस्स्रुतशोणितम्
विलोक्य करुणं जग्मुस्तत्पत्न्यो मधुसूदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vibhugnashirogrivamasyebhyassrutashonitam
vilokya karunam jagmustatpatnyo madhusudanam ||

verses.sa:
नागपत्न्य ऊचुः
ज्ञातोऽसि देवदेवेश सर्वज्ञस्त्वमनुत्तमः
परं ज्योतिरचिंत्यं यत्तदंशः परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
nagapatnya uchuh
jnato'si devadevesha sarvajnastvamanuttamah
param jyotirachimtyam yattadamshah parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
न समर्थाः सुरास्स्तोतुं यमनन्यभवं विभुम्
स्वरूपवर्णनं तस्य कथं योषित्करिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
na samarthah surasstotum yamananyabhavam vibhum
svarupavarnanam tasya katham yoshitkarishyati ||

verses.sa:
यस्याऽखिलमहीर्व्योमजलाग्निपवनात्मकम्
ब्रह्मांडमल्पकाल्पांशः स्तोष्यामस्तं कथं वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya'khilamahirvyomajalagnipavanatmakam
brahmamdamalpakalpamshah stoshyamastam katham vayam ||

verses.sa:
यमतो न विदुर्नित्यं यत्स्वरूपं हि योगिनः
परमार्थमणोरल्पं स्थूलात्स्थूलं नताः स्म तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamato na vidurnityam yatsvarupam hi yoginah
paramarthamanoralpam sthulatsthulam natah sma tam ||

verses.sa:
न यस्य जन्मने धाता यस्य चांताय नांतकः
स्थितिकर्त्ता न चान्योस्ति यस्य तस्मै नमस्सदा ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya janmane dhata yasya chamtaya namtakah
sthitikartta na chanyosti yasya tasmai namassada ||

verses.sa:
कोपः स्वल्पोऽपि ते नास्ति स्थितिपालनमेव ते
कारणं कालियस्यास्य दमने श्रूयतां वचः ॥
verses.rom:
kopah svalpo'pi te nasti sthitipalanameva te
karanam kaliyasyasya damane shruyatam vachah ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रियोनुकंप्यास्साधूनां मूढा दीनाश्च जंतवः
यतस्ततोस्य दीनस्य क्षम्यतां क्षमतांवर ॥
verses.rom:
striyonukampyassadhunam mudha dinashcha jamtavah
yatastatosya dinasya kshamyatam kshamatamvara ||

verses.sa:
समस्त जगदाधारो भवानल्पबलः फणी
त्वत्पादपीडितो जह्यान्मुहूर्त्तार्द्धेन जीवितम् ॥
verses.rom:
samasta jagadadharo bhavanalpabalah phani
tvatpadapidito jahyanmuhurttarddhena jivitam ||

verses.sa:
पन्नगोल्पवीर्योऽयं क्व भवान्भुवनाश्रयः
प्रीतिद्वेषौ समोत्कृष्टगोचरौ भवतोऽव्यय ॥
verses.rom:
pannagolpaviryo'yam kva bhavanbhuvanashrayah
pritidveshau samotkrishtagocharau bhavato'vyaya ||

verses.sa:
ततः कुरु जगत्स्वामिन्प्रसादमवसीदतः
प्राणांस्त्यजति नागोऽयं भर्तृभिक्षा प्रदीयताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kuru jagatsvaminprasadamavasidatah
pranamstyajati nago'yam bhartribhiksha pradiyatam ||

verses.sa:
भुवनेश जगन्नाथ महापुरुषपूर्वज
प्राणांस्त्यजति नागोऽयं भर्तृभिक्षां प्रयच्छ नः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvanesha jagannatha mahapurushapurvaja
pranamstyajati nago'yam bhartribhiksham prayachchha nah ||

verses.sa:
वेदांतवेद्य देवेश दुष्टदैत्यनिबर्हण
प्राणांस्त्यजति नागोऽयं भर्तृभिक्षा प्रदीयताम् ॥
verses.rom:
vedamtavedya devesha dushtadaityanibarhana
pranamstyajati nago'yam bhartribhiksha pradiyatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्ते ताभिराश्वस्य क्लांतदेहोपि पन्नगः
प्रसीद देवदेवेति प्राह वाक्यं शनैः शनैः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityukte tabhirashvasya klamtadehopi pannagah
prasida devadeveti praha vakyam shanaih shanaih ||

verses.sa:
कालिय उवाच
तवाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं नाथ स्वाभाविकं परम्
निरस्तातिशयं यस्य तस्य स्तोष्यामि किन्न्वहम् ॥
verses.rom:
kaliya uvacha
tavashtagunamaishvaryam natha svabhavikam param
nirastatishayam yasya tasya stoshyami kinnvaham ||

verses.sa:
त्वं परस्त्वं पस्याद्यः परं त्वत्तः परात्मक
परस्मात्परमो यस्त्वं तस्य स्तोष्यामि किन्न्वहम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam parastvam pasyadyah param tvattah paratmaka
parasmatparamo yastvam tasya stoshyami kinnvaham ||

verses.sa:
यस्माद्ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च चंद्रेद्रं! मरुदश्विनः
वसवश्च सहादित्यैस्तस्य स्तोष्यामि किन्न्वहम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadbrahma cha rudrashcha chamdredram! marudashvinah
vasavashcha sahadityaistasya stoshyami kinnvaham ||

verses.sa:
एकावयवसूक्ष्मांशो यस्यैतदखिलं जगत्
कल्पनावयवस्यांशस्तस्य स्तोष्यामि किन्न्वहम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekavayavasukshmamsho yasyaitadakhilam jagat
kalpanavayavasyamshastasya stoshyami kinnvaham ||

verses.sa:
सदसद्रू पिणो यस्य ब्रह्माद्यास्त्रिश्श्वोराः
परमार्थं न जानंति तस्य स्तोष्यामि किन्न्वहम् ॥
verses.rom:
sadasadru pino yasya brahmadyastrishshvorah
paramartham na janamti tasya stoshyami kinnvaham ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माद्यैरर्चिते यस्तु गंधपुष्पानुलेपनैः
नंदनादिसमुद्भूतैस्सोर्च्यते वा कथं मया ॥
verses.rom:
brahmadyairarchite yastu gamdhapushpanulepanaih
namdanadisamudbhutaissorchyate va katham maya ||

verses.sa:
यस्यावताररूपाणि देवराजस्सदार्च्चति
न वेत्ति परमं रूपं सोऽर्च्यते वा कथं मया ॥
verses.rom:
yasyavatararupani devarajassadarchchati
na vetti paramam rupam so'rchyate va katham maya ||

verses.sa:
विषयेभ्यस्समावृत्त्य सर्वाक्षाणि च योगिनः
यमर्चयंति ध्यानेन सोऽर्च्यते वा कथं मया ॥
verses.rom:
vishayebhyassamavrittya sarvakshani cha yoginah
yamarchayamti dhyanena so'rchyate va katham maya ||

verses.sa:
हृदि संकल्प्य यद्रूपं ध्यानेनार्चंति योगिनः
भावपुष्पादिना नाथः सोर्च्यते वा कथं मया ॥
verses.rom:
hridi samkalpya yadrupam dhyanenarchamti yoginah
bhavapushpadina nathah sorchyate va katham maya ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं ते देवदेवेश नार्चनादौ स्तुतौ न च
सामर्थ्यवान् कृपामात्रमनोवृत्तिः प्रसीद मे ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham te devadevesha narchanadau stutau na cha
samarthyavan kripamatramanovrittih prasida me ||

verses.sa:
सर्पजातिरियं क्रुरा यस्यां जातोस्मि केशव
तत्स्वभावोऽयमत्रास्ति नापराधो ममाच्युत ॥
verses.rom:
sarpajatiriyam krura yasyam jatosmi keshava
tatsvabhavo'yamatrasti naparadho mamachyuta ||

verses.sa:
सृज्यते भवता सर्वं तथा संह्रीयते जगत्
जातिरूपस्वभावाश्च सृज्यंते सृजता त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
srijyate bhavata sarvam tatha samhriyate jagat
jatirupasvabhavashcha srijyamte srijata tvaya ||

verses.sa:
यथाहं भवता सृष्टो जात्या रूपेण चेश्वर
स्वभावेन च साधुत्वं तथेदं चेष्टितं मया ॥
verses.rom:
yathaham bhavata srishto jatya rupena cheshvara
svabhavena cha sadhutvam tathedam cheshtitam maya ||

verses.sa:
यद्यन्यथा प्रवर्त्तेयं देवदेव ततो मयि
न्याय्यो दण्डनिपातो वै तवैव वचनं यथा ॥
verses.rom:
yadyanyatha pravartteyam devadeva tato mayi
nyayyo dandanipato vai tavaiva vachanam yatha ||

verses.sa:
तथाप्यज्ञे जगत्स्वामिन्दंडं पातितवान्मयि
स श्लाघ्योयं दंडस्त्वत्तो मे नान्यतो वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tathapyajne jagatsvamindamdam patitavanmayi
sa shlaghyoyam damdastvatto me nanyato varah ||

verses.sa:
हतवीर्यो हतविषो दमितोऽहं त्वयाऽच्युत
जीवितं दीयतामेकमाज्ञापय करोमि किम् ॥
verses.rom:
hataviryo hatavisho damito'ham tvaya'chyuta
jivitam diyatamekamajnapaya karomi kim ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
नात्र स्थेयं त्वया सर्प कदाचिद्यमुनाजले
सपुत्रपरिवारस्त्वं समुद्र सलिलं व्रज ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
natra stheyam tvaya sarpa kadachidyamunajale
saputraparivarastvam samudra salilam vraja ||

verses.sa:
मत्पदानि च ते सर्प दृष्ट्वा मूर्द्धनि सागरे
गरुडः पन्नगरिपुस्त्वयि न प्रहरिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
matpadani cha te sarpa drishtva murddhani sagare
garudah pannagaripustvayi na praharishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्त्वा सर्पराजं तं मुमोच भगवान्हरिः
प्रणम्य सोपि कुष्णाय जगाम पयसां निधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktva sarparajam tam mumocha bhagavanharih
pranamya sopi kushnaya jagama payasam nidhim ||

verses.sa:
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां सभृत्यसुतबांधवः
समस्तभार्यासहितः परित्यज्य स्वकं ह्रदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pashyatam sarvabhutanam sabhrityasutabamdhavah
samastabharyasahitah parityajya svakam hradam ||

verses.sa:
गते सर्पे परिष्वज्य मृतं पुनरिवागतम्
गोपा मूर्द्धनि हार्देन सिषिचुर्नेत्रजैर्जलैः ॥
verses.rom:
gate sarpe parishvajya mritam punarivagatam
gopa murddhani hardena sishichurnetrajairjalaih ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णमक्लिष्टकर्माणमन्ये विस्मितचेतसः
तुष्टुवुर्मुदिता गोपा दृष्ट्वा शिवजलां नदीम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishnamaklishtakarmanamanye vismitachetasah
tushtuvurmudita gopa drishtva shivajalam nadim ||

verses.sa:
गीयमानः स गोपीभिश्चारितैस्साधुचेष्टितैः
संस्तूयमानो गोपैश्च कृष्णो व्रजमुपागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
giyamanah sa gopibhishcharitaissadhucheshtitaih
samstuyamano gopaishcha krishno vrajamupagamat ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो! सप्तमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho! saptamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Once on a time Krishna went to Vrindavana, without Balarāma; and there, adorned with garlands of wild flowers, roamed he, encircled by the cow-herds, He then repaired to the banks of Kalindi, undulating and sparkling with foam and as if smiling when the waves dashed against the banks. There he saw the pool with the dreadful serpent Kāliya, boiling with the fires of poison. By the touch of that poison the huge trees on the banks were withered and being touched by the waters raised by the wind the birds were scorched. Beholding that dreadful serpent, like the second mouth of death, the illustrious Slayer of Mahdhu thought—"Forsooth, the wicked and poisonous serpent Kāliya lives here, who, being defeated by me, was constrained to leave the ocean whose waters were defiled. By him the waters of the Yamuna, flowing to the ocean, have been poisoned, and the thirsty cows and cow-herds cannot satisfy their thirst. I must slay this serpent, so that the inhabitants of Vraja may live here happily freed from fear. I have descended upon the land of mortals to chastise the wicked, led astray into vicious paths; I shall therefore climb up the neighbouring Kadamba tree and jump down into the pool".

Parāçara said:—Having thus thought within himself he bound his clothes tightly about him and jumped boldly into the pool of the serpent-king. The huge lake was agitated as soon as he fell into it, and the waves raised thereby began to sprinkle the distant trees, which being touched by the water and wind, thus poisoned, were immediately set on fire, and the whole horizon was ablaze. Having dived into the lake, Krishna struck his arms defiantly. Hearing that noise the serpent-king immediately issued out—whose eyes were coppery and hoods were flaming with deadly venom. He was encircled by many other powerful and poisonous snakes living upon air and hundreds of serpent-nymphs adorned with rich ornaments, whose earrings glittered with brilliance as the wearers moved along. Coiling themselves around Krishna, they all bit him with teeth from which fiery poison came out. Beholding him in the lake thus surrounded by serpents, his companions immediately went to Vraja bewailing aloud his fate. "Krishna has foolishly jumped into the lake of the serpent Kāliya, and is being devoured by that serpent-king; do ye come and behold him". Hearing those words, resembling the fall of thunder, the cow-herds and their wives headed by Yasoda, proceeded speedily towards the lake. "Alas where is Krishna gone" cried the wives of the cow-herds greatly bewildered; and Yasoda, terrified, with faltering steps, proceeded quickly. Rāma, gifted with great prowess, Nanda and other cow-herds being anxious to see Krishna, arrived quickly at the bank of the Yamuna and beheld him surrounded by, snakes, possessed by the serpent-king and motionless. O foremost of Munis, looking at the countenance of their son, the cow-herd Nanda and the noble Yasoda became stupified. And the wives of the other cow-herds stricken with grief and keeping, saw him; and with words expressive of fear and affliction, they, out of love towards Keshava, said—"We shall all with Yasoda enter this huge lake of the serpent-king; we shall not be able to go back to Vraja. What is day without the sun, night without the moon, cow without a bull and Vraja without Krishna? Without Krishna we shall not return to Vraja, like unto a pond without water, in his absence, nor shall we roam in the forest. We do not like to live there, even if it be the house of our mothers, where there is not Hari, having the countenance like lotus-petals. How shall we live sorrowfully without beholding Hari in pasture having eyes resembling full-blown lotus-petals? We shall not go back to the house of Nanda in Gokula without the lotus-eyed Krishna, who with his pleasant conversation has stolen all our hearts. O ye cow-herds! behold, Krishna is still casting smiling looks upon us, although he is encircled by snakes engaged by the serpent-king".

Parāçara said:—Hearing those wards of the wives of the cow-herds and beholding the cow-herds stricken with fear the highly-powerful son of Rohini looked settled (for some time.) And then seeing Nanda, with fixed looks towards Krishna and Yasoda almost in a swoon, he began to chant by signs the glories of Krishna—"O god of gods, why art thou displaying these human characteristics? Dost thou not perceive thyself at one with one without end? Thou art the centre of creation, as the nave is of the spokes of a wheel. A portion of thee, I have even also born, as thy eldest brother. To share in thy sports as men, the celestials have all descended under a like disguise. Having made all the goddesses descend in Gokula for thy sport, thou hast afterwards descended, although thou art existing perpetually. Wherefore Krishna dost thou neglect these celestials who, as cow-herds, are thy friends and kin—and these sorrowing females, who also are thy relations? Thou hast assumed, the character of man; thou hast displayed the tricks of childhood. Now let this dreadful snake although armed with poisoned fangs, be vanquished (by thee)".

Being thus reminded of his real character by Rāma, Krishna smiled gently and immediately freed himself from the coils of the snakes. And catching with both his hands the middle hood of the serpent-king, that highly powerful (Krishna) bent it down and set his foot upon the hitherto-unbended hood; and danced upon it victoriously. And the hood of the serpent was bruised by the treading of Krishna's feet, and wherever the snake attempted to raise his head, it was again trodden down. Trampled upon by the feet of Krishna as they changed position in the dance, the snakes fainted and vomitted froth much blood. Seeing the head and neck of their king thus bruised and blood flowing from this mouth, the females of the snake-king implored the mercy of the Slayer of Madhu.

The females of the serpent-king said—"We have recognized thee, O god of gods, O supreme lord of all. Thou art a portion of that supreme light and the mighty lord. Thou art the self-existent lord and even the celestials are unable to praise thee worthily, and how can the females truly chant thy glories? How can we sing his glories whose portions are earth, sky, water, fire and air? Even the holy ascetics have in vain sought to know thy real essence. We bow to that form, which is the most subtiles of atoms, the largest of the large; to him whose birth is without a creator, whose end knows no destroyer and who alone is the cause of duration. There is no anger in thee, thou protectest the world and hence this punishment of Kāliya. Hear us. The virtuous should pity women; and creatures are pitied even by the fools; let therefore the foremost of the forgiving have compassion upon this poor creature. Thou art the upholder of the universe and this snake is gifted with but little strength, if and oppressed by thee, he shall in no time give up his life. There is a vast difference between this poor serpent of limited strength and thyself in whom the world reposes. Friendship and enmity are felt towards equals and superiors and not for those who are infinitely inferior to us. This unfortunate snake is about to die,—give us therefore, as a matter of charity, our husband!"

Parāçara said:—When the wives of the serpent-king had said this, he, too, although wearied, repeated feebly his prayers for clemency. "Pardon me" he said—"O god of gods, how shall I address thee, who art possessed, through thine own strength and essence, of the eight great faculties and art in energy unmatched? Thou art the Supreme, the originator of the supreme; thou art the supreme spirit and from thee, the Supreme proceeds: thou art beyond all finite objects: how can I sing thy glories? How can I chant his greatness from whom have sprung Brahmā, Rudra, Chandra, Indra, the Maruts, the Aswins, the Vasus and the Adityas—of whom but, a small portion is the whole universe, which is destined to represent his essence and whose nature, primitive or derived is beyond the conception of Brahmā and other immortals. How can I approach him who is worshipped by the celestials with incense and flowers culled from the groves of Nandana? How can I adore him whose incarnate portion are being worshipped even by the king of celestials and whose real nature he is not conscious of? How can I approach him, whom the sages, having their minds withdrawn from external objects, worship in thought and enshrining whose image in their hearts present to it the flowers of sanctity? I am quite unable, O god of gods, to worship thee or sing thy glories—by thy mercy only, be thou propitiated with me. O Kesava, the serpents are by nature, crooked. I am born in that race, so I am also wily, which is the characteristic of my own race, so I am not to blame in this, O Achyuta. Every thing has been created by thee and every thing is being destroyed by thee—and the species, form and nature of all things in the world, are thy work. Even such and I as thou hast created me in kind, in form and in nature. Such am I and such are my actions. Should I act differently then indeed should I deserve punishment; so thou hast destined. And that I have been punished by thee, is indeed a blessing—for punishment from thee alone is a favour.

"Behold I am now divested of strength and poison—deprived of both by thee. Save my life—I ask no more. Order me what shall I do".

Being thus addressed by Kaliya, Krishna said—"You must not wait here any more; go immediately, with your family and followers, to the sea. Garuda, the enemy of the serpents, will not injure thee if he sees the impressions of my feet upon your hood". Having said this, Hari liberated the serpent-king, who, respectfully bowing to his victor, went to the ocean accompanied by all his wives, servants and children, leaving the sight of all and the pool he had lived in. When the snake had departed, the cow-herds received back Govinda as one risen from dead and embraced him and bathed his forehead with tears of joy. Others, considering the water of the river pure, were filled with surprise, and chanted the glory of Krishna, who is above the influence of actions. Being thus glorified by his illustrious exploits and eulogized by the cow-herds and their wives, Krishna came back to Vraja.

verses.sa:
गाः पालयन्तौ च पुनः सहितौ बल-केशवौ ।
भ्रममाणौ वने तस्मिन् रम्यं तालवनं गतौ ॥
verses.rom:
gah palayantau cha punah sahitau bala-keshavau |
bhramamanau vane tasmin ramyam talavanam gatau ||

verses.sa:
तत्तु तालवनं दिव्यं धेनुको नाम दानवः ।
मृगमांसकृताहारः सदाध्यास्ते खराकृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tattu talavanam divyam dhenuko nama danavah |
mrigamamsakritaharah sadadhyaste kharakritih ||

verses.sa:
तत्तु तालवन पक्क-फलसम्पत्समन्वितम् ।
दृष्ट्वा स्पृहान्विता गोपाः फलादानेऽब्रु वन्, वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tattu talavana pakka-phalasampatsamanvitam |
drishtva sprihanvita gopah phaladane'bru van, vachah ||

verses.sa:
हे राम! हे कृष्ण! सदा धेनुकेनैष रक्ष्यते ।
भूप्रदेशो यतस्तस्मात् पक्कानीमानि सन्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
he rama! he krishna! sada dhenukenaisha rakshyate |
bhupradesho yatastasmat pakkanimani santi vai ||

verses.sa:
फलानि पश्य तालानां गन्धामोदितदींशि च ।
वयमत्तुमभीप्सामः पात्यन्तां यदि रोचसे ॥
verses.rom:
phalani pashya talanam gandhamoditadimshi cha |
vayamattumabhipsamah patyantam yadi rochase ||

verses.sa:
इति गोपकुमाराणां श्रुत्वा सङ्कर्षणो वचः ।
कृष्णश्व पातयामास भुवि तालफलानि वै ॥
verses.rom:
iti gopakumaranam shrutva sankarshano vachah |
krishnashva patayamasa bhuvi talaphalani vai ||

verses.sa:
फलानां पततां शब्दमाकर्ण्य स दुरासदः ।
आजगाम सुदुष्टात्मा कोपादू दैतेयगर्द्दभः ॥
verses.rom:
phalanam patatam shabdamakarnya sa durasadah |
ajagama sudushtatma kopadu daiteyagarddabhah ||

verses.sa:
पद्भयामुभाभ्यां स तदा पश्विमाभ्यां बली बलम् ।
जघानोरसि ताभ्याञ्च स च तेनाप्यगृह्यत ॥
verses.rom:
padbhayamubhabhyam sa tada pashvimabhyam bali balam |
jaghanorasi tabhyancha sa cha tenapyagrihyata ||

verses.sa:
गृहीत्वा भ्रामणेनैव सोऽम्बरे गतजीवितम् ।
तस्मिन्नेव च चिक्षेप वेगेन तृणराजनि ॥
verses.rom:
grihitva bhramanenaiva so'mbare gatajivitam |
tasminneva cha chikshepa vegena trinarajani ||

verses.sa:
ततः फलान्यनेकानि तालाग्रान्निपतन् खरः ।
पृथिव्यां पातयामास महावातोऽम्बुदानिव ॥
verses.rom:
tatah phalanyanekani talagrannipatan kharah |
prithivyam patayamasa mahavato'mbudaniva ||

verses.sa:
अन्यानप्यस्य वै ज्ञातीनागतान् दैत्यगर्द्दभान् ।
कृष्णाश्विक्षेप तालाग्र बलभद्रश्व लीलया ॥
verses.rom:
anyanapyasya vai jnatinagatan daityagarddabhan |
krishnashvikshepa talagra balabhadrashva lilaya ||

verses.sa:
क्षणेनालङ्कृता पृथ्वी पक्कस्तालफलैस्तथा ।
दैत्यगर्द्दभदेहैश्व मैत्रेय! शुशुभेऽधिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
kshanenalankrita prithvi pakkastalaphalaistatha |
daityagarddabhadehaishva maitreya! shushubhe'dhikam ||

verses.sa:
ततो गावो निराबाधास्तस्मिंस्तालवने द्रिज!
नवशस्य सुख चेरुर्यन्न भुक्तमभूत् पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
tato gavo nirabadhastasmimstalavane drija!
navashasya sukha cheruryanna bhuktamabhut pura ||

prose.en: Parāçara said:—Thereupon again driving their cattle, Kesava and Balarāma rambled together in the forest, and on one occasion went to a pleasing grove of palms. There lived in that pleasing grove a demon named Dhenuka, resembling an ass in appearance and living upon the flesh of deer. Beholding the fruits there ripe, the cow herds, being anxious to take them, said—"O Rāma! O Krishna! Dhenuka always lives here and therefore the trees are loaded with ripe fruits the smell of which perfumes the air. We wish to eat some. Will you throw some down?" Hearing those words, Krishna and Sankarsana brought down some fruits on the ground. Hearing the sound of the falling fruits, the dreadful and malignant demon Dhenuka, having the countenance of an ass, arrived there speedily, and being angry began to kick Rāma on the breast with his hinder heels. Catching him by his both hind legs, Rāma however hurled him round till he died; then he threw up the dead body to the top of the palm tree from the branches of which it struck down enough fruits like rain drops poured down on earth by the wind. The relatives of Dhenuka came running to his help, and Krishna and Rāma did the same thing with them until the trees were filled with dead asses and the ground was covered with ripe fruits. Thenceforth the cattle grazed unobstructed in the palm groves and cropped the new pasturage where they had never gone before.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तस्मिन्रासभदैतेये सानुगे विनिपातिते ।
सौम्यं तद्गोपगोपीनां रम्यं तालवनं बभौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tasminrasabhadaiteye sanuge vinipatite |
saumyam tadgopagopinam ramyam talavanam babhau ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तौ जातहर्षौ तु वसुदेवसुतावुभौ ।
हत्वा धेनुकदैतेयं भाण्डीरवटमागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatastau jataharshau tu vasudevasutavubhau |
hatva dhenukadaiteyam bhandiravatamagatau ||

verses.sa:
क्ष्वेलमानौ प्रगायन्तौ विचिन्वन्तौ च पादपान् ।
चारयन्तौ च गा दूरे व्याहरन्तौ च नामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
kshvelamanau pragayantau vichinvantau cha padapan |
charayantau cha ga dure vyaharantau cha namabhih ||

verses.sa:
निर्योगपाशस्कन्धौ तौ वनमालाविभूषितौ ।
शुशुभाते महात्मानौ बालशृङ्गाविवर्षभौ ॥
verses.rom:
niryogapashaskandhau tau vanamalavibhushitau |
shushubhate mahatmanau balashringavivarshabhau ||

verses.sa:
सुवर्णाञ्जनचूर्णाभ्यां तौ तदा रूषितांबरौ ।
महेन्द्रायुधसंयुक्तौ श्वेतकृष्णाविवांबुदौ ॥
verses.rom:
suvarnanjanachurnabhyam tau tada rushitambarau |
mahendrayudhasamyuktau shvetakrishnavivambudau ||

verses.sa:
चेरतुर्लौकसिद्धाभिः क्रीडाभिरितरेतरम् ।
समस्तलोकनाथानां नाथभूतौ भुवं गतौ ॥
verses.rom:
cheraturlaukasiddhabhih kridabhiritaretaram |
samastalokanathanam nathabhutau bhuvam gatau ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्यधर्माभिरतौ मानयन्तौ मनुष्यताम् ।
तज्जातिगुणयुक्ताभिः क्रीडाभिश्चेरतुर्वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
manushyadharmabhiratau manayantau manushyatam |
tajjatigunayuktabhih kridabhishcheraturvanam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्त्वान्दोलिकाभिश्च नियुद्धैश्च महाबलौ ।
व्यायामं चक्रतुस्तत्र क्षेपणीयैस्तथाश्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastvandolikabhishcha niyuddhaishcha mahabalau |
vyayamam chakratustatra kshepaniyaistathashmabhih ||

verses.sa:
तल्लिप्सुरसुरस्तत्र ह्युभयो रममाणयोः ।
आजगाम प्रलंबाख्यो गोपवेषतिरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tallipsurasurastatra hyubhayo ramamanayoh |
ajagama pralambakhyo gopaveshatirohitah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽवगाहत निःशङ्कस्तेषां मध्यममानुषः ।
मानुषं वपुरास्थाय प्रलंबो दानवोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
so'vagahata nihshankastesham madhyamamanushah |
manusham vapurasthaya pralambo danavottamah ||

verses.sa:
तयोशिछ्द्रान्तरप्रेप्सुरविषह्यममन्यत ।
कृष्णं ततो रौहिणेयं हन्तुं चक्रे मनोरथम् ॥
verses.rom:
tayoshichhdrantaraprepsuravishahyamamanyata |
krishnam tato rauhineyam hantum chakre manoratham ||

verses.sa:
हरिणाक्रीडनं नाम बालक्रीडनकं ततः ।
प्रकुर्वन्तो हि ते सर्वे द्वौद्वौ युगपदुत्थितौ ॥
verses.rom:
harinakridanam nama balakridanakam tatah |
prakurvanto hi te sarve dvaudvau yugapadutthitau ||

verses.sa:
श्रीदाम्ना सह गोविन्दः प्रलंबेन तथा बलः ।
गोपालौरपरैश्चान्ये गोपालाः पुप्लुवुस्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
shridamna saha govindah pralambena tatha balah |
gopalauraparaishchanye gopalah pupluvustatah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीदामानं ततः कृष्णः प्रलंबं रोहिणीसुतः ।
जितवान्कृष्णपक्षीयैर्गोपैरन्ये पराजिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shridamanam tatah krishnah pralambam rohinisutah |
jitavankrishnapakshiyairgopairanye parajitah ||

verses.sa:
ते वाहयन्तस्त्वन्योन्यं भाण्डीरं वटमेत्य वै ।
पुनर्निववृतुः सर्वे येये तत्र परिजिताः ॥
verses.rom:
te vahayantastvanyonyam bhandiram vatametya vai |
punarnivavrituh sarve yeye tatra parijitah ||

verses.sa:
संकर्षणं तु स्कन्धेन शीघ्रमुत्क्षिप्य दानवः ।
नभःस्थलं जगामाशु सचन्द्र इव वारिदः ॥
verses.rom:
samkarshanam tu skandhena shighramutkshipya danavah |
nabhahsthalam jagamashu sachandra iva varidah ||

verses.sa:
असहन्रौहिणेयस्य स भारं दानवोत्तमः ।
ववृधे स महाकायः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः ॥
verses.rom:
asahanrauhineyasya sa bharam danavottamah |
vavridhe sa mahakayah pravrishiva balahakah ||

verses.sa:
संकर्षणस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा दग्धशैलोपमाकृतिम् ।
स्रग्दामलंबाभरणं मकुटाटोपमस्तकम् ॥
verses.rom:
samkarshanastu tam drishtva dagdhashailopamakritim |
sragdamalambabharanam makutatopamastakam ||

verses.sa:
रौद्रं शकटचक्राक्षं पादन्यास चलत्क्षितिम् ।
अभीतमनसा तेन रक्षसा रोहिणीसुतः ।
ह्रियमाणस्ततः कृष्णमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
raudram shakatachakraksham padanyasa chalatkshitim |
abhitamanasa tena rakshasa rohinisutah |
hriyamanastatah krishnamidam vachanamabravit ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णाकृष्ण ह्रियाम्येष पर्वतोदग्रमूर्तिना ।
केनापि पश्य दैत्येन गोपालच्छद्मरूपिणा ॥
verses.rom:
krishnakrishna hriyamyesha parvatodagramurtina |
kenapi pashya daityena gopalachchhadmarupina ||

verses.sa:
यदत्र सांप्रतं कार्यं मया मधुनिषूदन ।
तत्कथ्यतां प्रयात्येष दुरात्मातित्वरान्वितः ॥
verses.rom:
yadatra sampratam karyam maya madhunishudana |
tatkathyatam prayatyesha duratmatitvaranvitah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तमाह रामं गोविन्दः स्मितभिन्नोष्ठसंपुटः ।
महात्मा रौहिणेयस्य बलवीर्यप्रमाणवित् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tamaha ramam govindah smitabhinnoshthasamputah |
mahatma rauhineyasya balaviryapramanavit ||

verses.sa:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
किमयं मानुषो भावो व्यक्तमेवावलंब्यते ।
सर्वात्मन् सर्वगुह्यानां गुह्यगुह्यात्मना त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
shrikrishna uvacha
kimayam manusho bhavo vyaktamevavalambyate |
sarvatman sarvaguhyanam guhyaguhyatmana tvaya ||

verses.sa:
स्मराशेषजगद्बीजकारणं कारणाग्रज ।
आत्मानमेकं तद्वच्च जगत्येकार्णवे च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
smarasheshajagadbijakaranam karanagraja |
atmanamekam tadvachcha jagatyekarnave cha yat ||

verses.sa:
किं न वेत्सि यथाहं च त्वं चैकं कारणं भुवः ।
भारावतारणार्थाय मर्त्यलोकमुपागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
kim na vetsi yathaham cha tvam chaikam karanam bhuvah |
bharavataranarthaya martyalokamupagatau ||

verses.sa:
नभश्शिरस्तेंबुवहाश्च केशाः पादौ क्षितिर्वक्त्रमनन्तवह्नि ।
सोमो मनस्ते श्वसितं समीरणो दिशश्चतस्रोऽव्यय बाहवस्ते ॥
verses.rom:
nabhashshirastembuvahashcha keshah padau kshitirvaktramanantavahni |
somo manaste shvasitam samirano dishashchatasro'vyaya bahavaste ||

verses.sa:
सहस्रवक्त्रो भगवान्महात्मा सहस्रहस्ताङ्घ्रिशरीरभेदः ।
सहस्रपद्मोद्भवयोनिराद्यःसहस्रशस्त्वां मुनयो गृणन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
sahasravaktro bhagavanmahatma sahasrahastanghrisharirabhedah |
sahasrapadmodbhavayoniradyahsahasrashastvam munayo grinanti ||

verses.sa:
दिव्यं हि रूपं तव वेत्ति नान्यो देवैरशेषैरवताररूपम् ।
तदर्च्यते वेत्सि न किं यदन्ते त्वय्येव विश्वं लयमभ्युपैति ॥
verses.rom:
divyam hi rupam tava vetti nanyo devairasheshairavatararupam |
tadarchyate vetsi na kim yadante tvayyeva vishvam layamabhyupaiti ||

verses.sa:
त्वया धृतेयं धरणी बिभर्ति चराचरं विश्वमनन्तमूर्ते ।
कृतादिभेदैरज कालरूपो निमेषपूर्वो जगदेतदत्सि ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya dhriteyam dharani bibharti characharam vishvamanantamurte |
kritadibhedairaja kalarupo nimeshapurvo jagadetadatsi ||

verses.sa:
अत्तं यथा बाडववह्निनांबु हिमस्वरूपं परिगृह्य कास्तम् ।
हिमाचले भानुमतोंशुसंगाज्जलत्वमभ्येति पुनस्तदेव ॥
verses.rom:
attam yatha badavavahninambu himasvarupam parigrihya kastam |
himachale bhanumatomshusamgajjalatvamabhyeti punastadeva ||

verses.sa:
एवं त्वया संहरणेऽत्तमेतज्जगत्समस्तं त्वदधीनकं पुनः ।
तवैव सर्गाय समुद्यतस्य जगत्त्वमभ्येत्यसुकल्पमीश ॥
verses.rom:
evam tvaya samharane'ttametajjagatsamastam tvadadhinakam punah |
tavaiva sargaya samudyatasya jagattvamabhyetyasukalpamisha ||

verses.sa:
भवानहं च विश्वात्मन्नेकमेव च कारणम् ।
जगतोस्य जगत्यर्थे भेदेनावां व्यवस्थितौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhavanaham cha vishvatmannekameva cha karanam |
jagatosya jagatyarthe bhedenavam vyavasthitau ||

verses.sa:
तत्स्मर्यताममेयात्मस्त्वयात्मा जहि दानवम् ।
मानुष्यमेवावलंब्य बन्धूनां क्रियतां हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatsmaryatamameyatmastvayatma jahi danavam |
manushyamevavalambya bandhunam kriyatam hitam ||

verses.sa:
श्री पराशर उवाच
इति संस्मारितो विप्र कृष्णेन सुमहात्मना ।
विहस्य पीडयामास प्रलंबं बलवान्बलः ॥
verses.rom:
shri parashara uvacha
iti samsmarito vipra krishnena sumahatmana |
vihasya pidayamasa pralambam balavanbalah ||

verses.sa:
मुष्टिना सोहनन्मूर्ध्नि कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ।
तेन चास्य प्रहारेण बहिर्याते विलोचने ॥
verses.rom:
mushtina sohananmurdhni kopasamraktalochanah |
tena chasya praharena bahiryate vilochane ||

verses.sa:
स निष्कासितमस्तिष्को मुखाच्छोणितमुद्वमन् ।
निपपात महीपृष्ठे दत्य वर्यो ममार च ॥
verses.rom:
sa nishkasitamastishko mukhachchhonitamudvaman |
nipapata mahiprishthe datya varyo mamara cha ||

verses.sa:
प्रलंबं निहतं दृष्ट्वा बलेनाद्भुतकर्मणा ।
प्रहृष्टास्तुष्टुवुर्गौपाःसाधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
pralambam nihatam drishtva balenadbhutakarmana |
prahrishtastushtuvurgaupahsadhusadhviti chabruvan ||

verses.sa:
संस्तूयमानो गोपैस्तु रामो दैत्ये निपातिते ।
प्रलंबं सह कृष्णेन पुनर्गोकुलमाययौ ॥
verses.rom:
samstuyamano gopaistu ramo daitye nipatite |
pralambam saha krishnena punargokulamayayau ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पञ्चमांशे नवमोऽध्यायः (९)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane panchamamshe navamo'dhyayah (9)

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—That demon, in the form of an ass, and all his relatives, being slain, the cow-herds and their wives began to roam at pleasure in that picturesque grove of palms. Having slain that fiend Dhenuka, the two sons of Vasudeva, greatly delighted, repaired to the Bhāndira fig-tree. They began to roam about shouting and singing and collecting fruits and flowers from the trees—sometimes driving the cattle to a distant pasture, sometimes calling them by their names, sometimes carrying the foot-ropes of the kine upon their shoulders, sometimes decorating themselves with garlands of forest flowers, they appeared like two young bulls when the horns first appear. Dressed, the one in yellow and and the other in sable garments, they appeared like two clouds one white and one black, surmounted by the bow of Indra. The two brothers, although lords of the universe, having descended upon earth, began to sport mutually with frolics beneficial to the world. Adopting human duties and assuming human character and engaged in human sports, they stayed about in the forest. And these two highly powerful (brothers) engaged in exercise, in swinging upon the boughs of trees, or in boxing and wresting and hurling stones.

Having seen Krishna and Balarāma thus sporting, this Asura Pralamba, on one occasion with a view to carry them away stealthily arrived there assuming, the guise of a cow-herd. And that foremost of demons, assuming a human shape, mixed with them, unsuspected. Then seeking their faults he found Krishna irrepressible and made up his mind accordingly to slay the son of Rohini.

The boys commenced playing at the game of leaping like deer, two and two together. Govinda was matched with Sridama and Balarāma with Pralamba; the other boys were coupled with one another and went leaping away. Krishna beat his companion and Balarāma his, and the boys who were on Krishna's side, were also victorious. The boys who were defeated, carrying the victorious boys on their shoulders went to the Bhāndira fig and then came back to the starting-place. And placing Sankarshana speedily on his shoulders the demon Pralamba did not tarry there and ran away like unto a cloud with the moon. Being unable to carry the weight of Rohini's son that foremost of fiends began to increase in bulk like unto a cloud in the rainy season. Beholding him like a scorched mountain, his head crowned with a diadem and his neck hung round with garlands, having eyes as large as cart wheels, a fearful form and shaking the earth with his tread, Balarāma called out, as he was carried away, "Krishna! Krishna! I am carried off by some demon, disguised as a cow-herd and huge as a mountain! What shall I do? Tell me Madhusudana, the villain runs away speedily".

Parāçara said:—The high-souled Krishna, cognisant of the prowess and strength of the son of Rohini, opened his mouth, smiling and said—"O thou the soul of all, the cause of cause and all that is alone when the world the destroyed, why art thou assuming clearly the character of a man? Dost thou not know that you and are alike the origin of the world and have come to relieve it of its load? The sky is thy head; the waters are thy person; earth is thy feet; eternal fire is thy mouth; the moon is thy mind; the wind is thy breath; the four regions are thy arms and hands. O big souled and highly powerful lord, thou hast a thousand heads, a thousand hands and feet and bodies. Thou art the beginning of all creation—Brahmā, sprung from lotus—and the sages have praised thee in these terms for a thousand times. No one else knoweth thy divine person. The celestials worship only thy incarnate person. Dost thou not know that in the end the whole world will disappear in thee? O thou of endless forms; thou art upholding all creation, mobile and immobile. Thou, being identical with time with its division of hours and minutes, devourest the world. As the waters of the sea, when swallowed up by submarine fire, are transferred into winds and thrown in the form of snow upon Himachala, where coming in contact with the rays of the sun, re-assume the watery nature, so this world, devoured by thee at the time of dissolution, is again created by thee at the end of a Kalpa through thy creative energy. Thou and I, soul of the universe, are but one and the same cause of the creation of earth, although for its protection we exist as distinct individuals! Bringing to thy memory, who thou art, O being of illimitable prowess, destroy thyself the demon. Suspending a while your human character, do what is right".

Thus reminded by the noble Krishna, the powerful Balarāma laughed and crushed Pralamba with his knees striking him simultaneously on the head and face with his fists so as to beat out both his eyes. Vomitting blood from his mouth and having his brain forced through the skull, the demon fell upon the ground and died. Seeing Pralamba slain the cow-herds were surprised and rejoiced and exclaimed "Well done!" and praised Balarāma. Thus praised by his play-mates and accompanied by Krishna, Balarāma, after the death of the demon Pralamba, came back to Gokula.

verses.sa:
तयोविंहरतोस्तत्र राम-केशवयोर्व्रजे ।
प्रावृट् व्यतीता विकसत्-सरोजा चाभवच्छरत् ॥
verses.rom:
tayovimharatostatra rama-keshavayorvraje |
pravrit vyatita vikasat-saroja chabhavachchharat ||

verses.sa:
अवापुस्तापमत्यर्थं शफर्य्यः पल्वलोदके ।
पुत्रक्षेत्रादिसक्तेन ममत्वेन यथा गृही ॥
verses.rom:
avapustapamatyartham shapharyyah palvalodake |
putrakshetradisaktena mamatvena yatha grihi ||

verses.sa:
मयूरा मौनिस्तस्थुः परित्यक्तमदा वने ।
असारतां परिज्ञाय संसारस्येव योगिनः ॥
verses.rom:
mayura maunistasthuh parityaktamada vane |
asaratam parijnaya samsarasyeva yoginah ||

verses.sa:
उत्सृज्य जलसर्वस्वं निर्म्मलाः सितमूर्त्तयः ।
तत्यजुश्वाम्बरं मेघा गृहं विज्ञानिनो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
utsrijya jalasarvasvam nirmmalah sitamurttayah |
tatyajushvambaram megha griham vijnanino yatha ||

verses.sa:
शरत्सूर्य्यांशुतप्तानि ययुः शोष संरासि च ।
बह्वालम्बि-ममत्वेन हृदयानीव देहिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sharatsuryyamshutaptani yayuh shosha samrasi cha |
bahvalambi-mamatvena hridayaniva dehinam ||

verses.sa:
कुमुदैः शरदम्भांसि योग्यतालक्षणं ययुः।
अवबोधैर्मनांसीव सम्बन्धममलात्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kumudaih sharadambhamsi yogyatalakshanam yayuh|
avabodhairmanamsiva sambandhamamalatmanam ||

verses.sa:
तारका विमले व्योम्नि रराजाखण्डमण्डलः ।
चन्द्रश्चरमदेहात्मा योगी साधुकुले यथा ॥
verses.rom:
taraka vimale vyomni rarajakhandamandalah |
chandrashcharamadehatma yogi sadhukule yatha ||

verses.sa:
शनकैः शनकैस्तीरं तत्यजुश्व जलाशयाः ।
ममत्वं क्षेत्रपुत्रादिरूढ़मुच्चैर्यथा बुधाः ॥
verses.rom:
shanakaih shanakaistiram tatyajushva jalashayah |
mamatvam kshetraputradirurhamuchchairyatha budhah ||

verses.sa:
पूर्व्वं त्यक्तैः सरोऽम्भोभिर्हंसा योगं पुनर्ययुः ।
क्लेशैः कुयोगिनोऽशेषैरन्तरायहता इव ॥
verses.rom:
purvvam tyaktaih saro'mbhobhirhamsa yogam punaryayuh |
kleshaih kuyogino'sheshairantarayahata iva ||

verses.sa:
निभृतोऽभवदत्यर्थं समुद्रः स्तिमितोदकः ।
क्रमावाप्तमहायोगो निश्वलात्मा यथा यतिः ॥
verses.rom:
nibhrito'bhavadatyartham samudrah stimitodakah |
kramavaptamahayogo nishvalatma yatha yatih ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वत्रातिप्रसन्नानि सलिलानि तदाभवन् ।
ज्ञाते सर्व्वगते विष्णौ मनांसीव सुमेधसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvatratiprasannani salilani tadabhavan |
jnate sarvvagate vishnau manamsiva sumedhasam ||

verses.sa:
बभूव निर्म्मलं व्योम शरदा ध्वस्ततोयदम् ।
योगाग्निदग्धक्लेशौघं योगिनामिव मानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
babhuva nirmmalam vyoma sharada dhvastatoyadam |
yogagnidagdhakleshaugham yoginamiva manasam ||

verses.sa:
सूर्य्यांशुजनितं तापं निन्यं तारापतिः शमम् ।
अहङ्कारोद्भवं दुःखं विवेकः सुमहानिव ॥
verses.rom:
suryyamshujanitam tapam ninyam tarapatih shamam |
ahankarodbhavam duhkham vivekah sumahaniva ||

verses.sa:
नभसोऽभ्रान् भुवः पङ्कान् कालुष्यं चाम्भसः शरत् ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यः प्रत्याहार इवाहरत् ॥
verses.rom:
nabhaso'bhran bhuvah pankan kalushyam chambhasah sharat |
indriyanindriyarthebhyah pratyahara ivaharat ||

verses.sa:
प्राणायाम इवाम्भोभिः सरसां कृतपूरकैः ।
अभ्यस्यतेऽनुदिवसं रेचकाकुम्भकादिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pranayama ivambhobhih sarasam kritapurakaih |
abhyasyate'nudivasam rechakakumbhakadibhih ||

verses.sa:
विमलाम्बरनक्षत्रे काले चाभ्यागते व्रजे।
ददर्शेन्द्रमहारम्भायौद्यतांस्तान् व्रजौकसः ॥
verses.rom:
vimalambaranakshatre kale chabhyagate vraje|
dadarshendramaharambhayaudyatamstan vrajaukasah ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णस्तानुत्सुकान् दृष्ट्वा गोपानुत्सवलालसान् ।
कौतूहलादिदं वाक्यं प्राह वृद्धान् महामतिः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnastanutsukan drishtva gopanutsavalalasan |
kautuhaladidam vakyam praha vriddhan mahamatih ||

verses.sa:
कोऽयं शक्रमहो नाम येन वो हर्ष आगतः ।
प्राह तं नन्दगोपश्व पृच्छन्तमतिसादरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko'yam shakramaho nama yena vo harsha agatah |
praha tam nandagopashva prichchhantamatisadaram ||

verses.sa:
मेघानां पयसां चेशो देवराजः शतक्रतुः ।
तेन सञ्चोदिता मेघा वर्षन्त्यम्बुमयं रसम् ॥
verses.rom:
meghanam payasam chesho devarajah shatakratuh |
tena sanchodita megha varshantyambumayam rasam ||

verses.sa:
तद्वृष्टिजनितं शस्यं वयमन्ये च देहिनः ।
वर्त्तयामोपयुञ्जानास्तर्पयामश्व देवताः ॥
verses.rom:
tadvrishtijanitam shasyam vayamanye cha dehinah |
varttayamopayunjanastarpayamashva devatah ||

verses.sa:
क्षीरवत्य इमा गावो वत्सवत्यश्व निर्वृताः ।
तेन संवर्द्धितैः शस्यैः पुष्टास्तुष्टा भवन्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
kshiravatya ima gavo vatsavatyashva nirvritah |
tena samvarddhitaih shasyaih pushtastushta bhavanti vai ||

verses.sa:
नासस्या नातृणा भूमिर्न बुभुक्षार्द्दितो जनः ।
दृश्यते यत्र दृश्यन्ते वृष्टिमन्तो बलाहकाः ॥
verses.rom:
nasasya natrina bhumirna bubhuksharddito janah |
drishyate yatra drishyante vrishtimanto balahakah ||

verses.sa:
भौममेतत् पयो दुग्धं गोभिः सूर्य्यस्य वारिदः ।
पर्ज्जन्यः सर्व्वलोकस्य भवाय भुवि वर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
bhaumametat payo dugdham gobhih suryyasya varidah |
parjjanyah sarvvalokasya bhavaya bhuvi varshati ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात् प्रावृषि राजानः सर्व्वे शक्र मुदा युताः ।
मखैः सुरेशमर्च्चन्ति वयमन्ये च मानवाः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmat pravrishi rajanah sarvve shakra muda yutah |
makhaih sureshamarchchanti vayamanye cha manavah ||

verses.sa:
नन्दगोपस्य वचनं श्रुत्वेत्थं शक्रपूजने ।
कोपाय त्रिदशेन्द्रस्य प्राह दामोदरस्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
nandagopasya vachanam shrutvettham shakrapujane |
kopaya tridashendrasya praha damodarastada ||

verses.sa:
न वयं कृषिकर्त्तारो वाणिज्यजीवनो न च ।
गावोऽस्मद्दैवतं तात! वयं वनचरा यतः ॥
verses.rom:
na vayam krishikarttaro vanijyajivano na cha |
gavo'smaddaivatam tata! vayam vanachara yatah ||

verses.sa:
आन्वीक्षिकी त्रयी वार्त्ता दण्डनीतिस्तथापरा ।
विद्याचतुष्टयं त्वेतत् वार्त्तामत्र शृणुष्व मे ॥
verses.rom:
anvikshiki trayi vartta dandanitistathapara |
vidyachatushtayam tvetat varttamatra shrinushva me ||

verses.sa:
कृषिर्वणिज्या तद्वच्च तृतीयं पशुपालनम् ।
विद्या ह्येका महाभाग! वार्त्ता वृत्तित्रयाश्रया ॥
verses.rom:
krishirvanijya tadvachcha tritiyam pashupalanam |
vidya hyeka mahabhaga! vartta vrittitrayashraya ||

verses.sa:
कर्षकाणां कृषिर्वृत्तिः पणयं विपणिजीविनाम् ।
अस्माकं गाः परा वृत्तिर्वार्त्ताभेदैरियं त्रिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
karshakanam krishirvrittih panayam vipanijivinam |
asmakam gah para vrittirvarttabhedairiyam tribhih ||

verses.sa:
विद्यया यो यया युक्तस्तस्य स दैवतं महत् ।
सैव पूज्यार्च्चनीया च सैव तस्योपकारिका ॥
verses.rom:
vidyaya yo yaya yuktastasya sa daivatam mahat |
saiva pujyarchchaniya cha saiva tasyopakarika ||

verses.sa:
यो यस्य फलमश्नन् वै पूजयत्यपरं नरः ।
इह च प्रेत्य चैवासौ न तदाप्नोति शोभनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo yasya phalamashnan vai pujayatyaparam narah |
iha cha pretya chaivasau na tadapnoti shobhanam ||

verses.sa:
कृष्यान्ता प्रथिता सीमा सीमान्तञ्च पुनर्वनम् ।
वनान्ता गिरयः सर्व्वे ते चास्माकं परा गतिः ॥
verses.rom:
krishyanta prathita sima simantancha punarvanam |
vananta girayah sarvve te chasmakam para gatih ||

verses.sa:
न द्वारबन्धावरणा न गृहक्षेत्रिणस्तथा ।
सुखिनस्त्वखिले लोके यथा वै चक्रचारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
na dvarabandhavarana na grihakshetrinastatha |
sukhinastvakhile loke yatha vai chakracharinah ||

verses.sa:
श्रूयन्ते गिरयश्चैव वनोऽस्मिन् कामरूपिणः ।
तत्तद्रूपं समास्थाय रमन्ते स्वेषु सानुषु ॥
verses.rom:
shruyante girayashchaiva vano'smin kamarupinah |
tattadrupam samasthaya ramante sveshu sanushu ||

verses.sa:
यदा चैते प्रबाध्यन्ते तेषां ये काननौकसः ।
तदा सिंहादिरूपैस्तान् घातयन्ति महीधराः ॥
verses.rom:
yada chaite prabadhyante tesham ye kananaukasah |
tada simhadirupaistan ghatayanti mahidharah ||

verses.sa:
गिरियज्ञस्त्वयं तस्माद् गोयज्ञश्च प्रवर्त्त्यताम् ।
किमस्माकं महेन्द्रेण गावः शैलाश्व देवताः ॥
verses.rom:
giriyajnastvayam tasmad goyajnashcha pravarttyatam |
kimasmakam mahendrena gavah shailashva devatah ||

verses.sa:
मन्त्रयज्ञपरा विप्राः सीतायज्ञाश्व कर्षकाः ।
गिरि-गोयज्ञशीलाश्व वयमद्रिवनाश्रयाः ॥
verses.rom:
mantrayajnapara viprah sitayajnashva karshakah |
giri-goyajnashilashva vayamadrivanashrayah ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद् गोवर्द्धनः शैलो भवद्भिर्विविधार्हणैः ।
अर्च्च्यतां पूज्यतां मेध्यान् पशून् हत्वा विधानतः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmad govarddhanah shailo bhavadbhirvividharhanaih |
archchyatam pujyatam medhyan pashun hatva vidhanatah ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वघोषस्य सन्दोहो गृह्यतां मा विचार्य्यताम् ।
भोज्यन्तां तेन वै विप्रास्तथा ये चाभिवाञ्छकाः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvaghoshasya sandoho grihyatam ma vicharyyatam |
bhojyantam tena vai viprastatha ye chabhivanchhakah ||

verses.sa:
तत्रार्चिते कृते होमे भोजितेषु द्विजातिषु ।
शरत्पुष्पकृतापीड़ाः परिगच्छन्तु गोगणाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatrarchite krite home bhojiteshu dvijatishu |
sharatpushpakritapirah parigachchhantu goganah ||

verses.sa:
एतन्मम मतं गोपाः सम्प्रीत्या क्रियते यदि ।
ततः कृता भवेत् प्रीतिर्गवामद्रेस्तथा मम ॥
verses.rom:
etanmama matam gopah sampritya kriyate yadi |
tatah krita bhavet pritirgavamadrestatha mama ||

verses.sa:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नन्दाद्यास्ते व्रजौकसः ।
प्रीत्युत्फुल्लमुखा विप्र! साधु साध्वित्यथाब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
iti tasya vachah shrutva nandadyaste vrajaukasah |
prityutphullamukha vipra! sadhu sadhvityathabruvan ||

verses.sa:
शोभनं ते मतं वत्स! यदेतद्भवतोदितम् ।
तत् करिष्यामहे सर्व्वं गिरियज्ञः प्रवर्त्त्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
shobhanam te matam vatsa! yadetadbhavatoditam |
tat karishyamahe sarvvam giriyajnah pravarttyatam ||

verses.sa:
तथा च कृतवन्तस्ते गिरियज्ञं व्रजौकसः ।
दधि-पायस-मांसाद्यैर्ददुः शैलबलिं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
tatha cha kritavantaste giriyajnam vrajaukasah |
dadhi-payasa-mamsadyairdaduh shailabalim tatah ||

verses.sa:
द्विजांश्च भोजयामासुः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
अन्यानप्यागतानित्थं कृष्णेनोक्तं यथा पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
dvijamshcha bhojayamasuh shatasho'tha sahasrashah |
anyanapyagatanittham krishnenoktam yatha pura ||

verses.sa:
गावः शैलं ततश्चक्रुरर्चितास्ताः प्रदक्षिणम् ।
ऋषभाश्चापि नर्द्दन्तः सतोया जलदा इव ॥
verses.rom:
gavah shailam tatashchakrurarchitastah pradakshinam |
rishabhashchapi narddantah satoya jalada iva ||

verses.sa:
गिरिमूर्द्धनि कृष्णोऽपि शैलोऽहमिति मूर्त्तिमान् ।
बुभुजेऽन्नं बहु तदा गोपवर्य्याहृतं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
girimurddhani krishno'pi shailo'hamiti murttiman |
bubhuje'nnam bahu tada gopavaryyahritam dvija ||

verses.sa:
अन्येन कृष्णो रूपेण गोपैः सह गिरेः शिरः ।
अधिरुह्यार्च्चयामास द्रितीयामात्मनस्तनुम् ॥
verses.rom:
anyena krishno rupena gopaih saha gireh shirah |
adhiruhyarchchayamasa dritiyamatmanastanum ||

verses.sa:
अन्तर्द्धानं गते तस्मिन् गोपा लब्ध्वा ततो वरान् ।
कृत्वा गिरिमखं गोष्ठं निजमभ्याययुः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
antarddhanam gate tasmin gopa labdhva tato varan |
kritva girimakham goshtham nijamabhyayayuh punah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Whilst Krishna and Rāma were thus sporting in Vraja the rainy season ended—the autumn appeared and the lotuses became full-blown. The Safari fish in their watery burrows, were oppressed by the heat like a man by his selfish desires, who is attached to his family. The peacocks, renouncing all amusements, became silent like the ascetics withdrawing themselves from worldly enjoyments considering their unreality. The clouds of shining whiteness, exhausted of their watery wealth, deserted the sky like the wise who have acquired wisdom, departing from their home. Evaporated by the rays of the autumnal sun, the lakes were dried up, like the hearts of men withered by the contact of selfishness. The silent waters of the autumn were beautified by white water-lilies, like the minds of the pure by the perception of truth. The moon shone with undiminished brilliance in the sky crested with star like the saint, who has reached the last stage of bodily existence in the company of the pious. The rivers and lakes slowly went far off from their banks as the wise by degrees shrink from the selfish attachment that connects them with their wife and children. The swans again began to frequent those lakes which they had abandoned before like false ascetics whose devotions are interrupted and they are again stricken with numberless afflictions. The ocean, with silent waters, became perfectly calm like the accomplished saint who has gone through rigid penances and has acquired undisturbed tranquility of spirit. Everywhere the waters are as clear and pure as the minds of the wise who behold Vishnu in all things. The autumnal sky was perfectly free from clouds like the heart of the ascetic, whose cares have been devoured by the fire of devotion. The moon allayed the fervours of the sun as discrimination removes the pain consequent upon egotism. The autumn removed the clouds from the sky; the muddiness of the earth and the discoloration of the waters, as abstraction draws away the senses from the objects of perception. The water of the lake, by becoming full, stationary and again declined, performed as if the exercise of inspiring, suppressing and expiring the vital air.

At this season, when the heavens were clear and bright with stars, Krishna, once repairing to Vraja, saw the inhabitants engaged in the celebration of a sacrifice in honor of Sakra. Beholding all the cow-herds busily and anxiously engaged in making preparation, Krishna, gifted with high, intellect, as if, out of curiosity asked the elders, saying—"What festival of Sakra is this, in which you are taking so much delight?" To him thus asking, the cow-herd thus lovingly said—"Satakratu (performer of hundred sacrifices), the king of the celestials, is the lord of the clouds and waters; ordered by him the clouds pour down water on earth, by which the grain is produced, on which we and other embodied beings live and by which we please the gods. By this too these cows bear calves and give milk and are happy and well-nourished. Wherever the clouds pour waters, the earth is neither barren of corn, nor bare of verdure, nor is man stricken with hunger. Having drunk the milk of the earth by means of the rays of the sun, Indra, the giver of water, pours it again on earth for the sustenance of all the worlds. For this reason all sovereign princes offer, with delight, sacrifices to Indra at the end of the rainy reason, and so also do we and so do the other people".

Parāçara said:—Having heard the words of the cow-herd Nanda regarding the worship of Sakra, Dāmodara, to excite the anger of the lord of celestials, said—"We, father, are neither cultivators of the soil, nor merchants—we are sojourners in the forests and cows are our gods. There are four divisions of knowledge—logical, spiritual, practical, and political. Hear from me, what is the practical science. Agriculture, commerce and tending of cattle—the knowledge of these three professions, O noble Sire, is the practical science. Agriculture is the means of subsistence to the cultivators, buying and selling to the traders, and tending of cattle is our subsistence. The practical science has thus been divided into three branches. The object, that is cultivated by any one, should be to him, his chief deity—he must worship that, for that is his benefactor. O father, the man who worships another's deity, receiving the fruit from his own, does not obtain a prosperous situation either in this world or in the next. Where the land is no longer cultivated there are limits assigned, beyond which begins the forest; the forests are bounded by the hills and so far do our limits extend. We are not confined within doors or walls, we have neither fields nor homes; we wander about happily wherever we like in our wagons. We have heard that the spirits of these mountains, assuming whatever shapes they like, walk in the woods upon their own precipices. If they are displeased with those who inhabit the forests, then transforming themselves to lions and beasts of prey, they will like the offenders. We are thus bound to worship the mountains and sacrifices to cattle. What have we to do with Indra? Cattle and mountains are our gods. Brāhmans offer worship with prayer; cultivators of the earth worship their landmarks; but we, who tend our cattle in the forests and mountains, should worship them and our kine. Let prayer and offerings be then made to the mountain Govardhana and let us duly kill a victim. Let milk be collected from all stations and let us feed Brāhmans and all others who wish to partake of it—no need of any judgment about it. When the oblations have been presented and the Brahmans have been fed let the cow-herds circumambulate the cows decorated with garlands of autumnal dowers. If the cow-herds pay attention to these suggestions, they will secure the favour of the mountain of the cattle and also mind".

When Nanda and other cow-herds heard the speech of Krishna, their faces were brilliant with joy and they said that he had spoken well. "You have judged aright, child" exclaimed they "we will do exactly as you have said and offer worship to the mountain". Accordingly the inhabitants of Braja worshipped the mountain presenting to it curds and milk and flesh; and they fed hundreds and thousands of Brāhmans and many other guests who came to the ceremony even as Krishna had directed; and when they had made their offerings they circumambulated the cows and the bulls that cried as loud as roaring clouds. Upon the summit of Govaradhana Krishna stood and said "I am the mountain" and partook of the food presented by the cow-herds; whilst in his own form as Krishna, he ascended the hill with other cow-herds and worshipped his other self. Having promised them many blessings the mountain-person of Krishna disappeared, and the ceremony being finished the cow-herds returned to their homes.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
मखे प्रतिहते शक्रो मैत्रेयातिरुषान्वितः ।
संवर्त्तकं नाम गणं तोयदानामथाऽब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
makhe pratihate shakro maitreyatirushanvitah |
samvarttakam nama ganam toyadanamatha'bravit ||

verses.sa:
भोभो मेघा निशम्यैतद्वचनं गदतो मम ।
आज्ञानंतरमेवाशु क्रियतामविचारितम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhobho megha nishamyaitadvachanam gadato mama |
ajnanamtaramevashu kriyatamavicharitam ||

verses.sa:
नंदगोपस्सुदुर्बुद्धिर्गोपैरन्यैस्सहायवान् ।
कृष्णाश्रयं बलाध्मातो मखभंगमचीकरत् ॥
verses.rom:
namdagopassudurbuddhirgopairanyaissahayavan |
krishnashrayam baladhmato makhabhamgamachikarat ||

verses.sa:
आजीवो याः परस्तेषां गावस्तस्य च कारणम् ।
तागावो वृष्टिपातेन पीड्यन्तां वचनान्मम ॥
verses.rom:
ajivo yah parastesham gavastasya cha karanam |
tagavo vrishtipatena pidyantam vachananmama ||

verses.sa:
अहमप्यद्रि शृंगाभं तुंगमारुह्य वारणम् ।
साहाय्यं वः करिष्यामि वाय्वम्बूत्सर्गयोजितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahamapyadri shrimgabham tumgamaruhya varanam |
sahayyam vah karishyami vayvambutsargayojitam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्याज्ञप्तास्ततस्तेन मुमुचुस्ते बलाहकाः ।
वातवर्षं महाभीममभावाय गवां द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityajnaptastatastena mumuchuste balahakah |
vatavarsham mahabhimamabhavaya gavam dvija ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्षणेन पृथिवी ककुभॐबरमेव च ।
एकं धारामहासारपूरेणनाभवन्मुने ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kshanena prithivi kakubhaombarameva cha |
ekam dharamahasarapurenanabhavanmune ||

verses.sa:
विद्युल्लताकषाघातत्रस्तैरिव घनैर्घनम् ।
नादापूरितदिक्चक्रैर्धारासारमपात्यत ॥
verses.rom:
vidyullatakashaghatatrastairiva ghanairghanam |
nadapuritadikchakrairdharasaramapatyata ||

verses.sa:
अंधकारीकृते लोके वर्षद्भिरनिशं घनैः ।
अधश्चोर्ध्वं च तिर्यक् च जगदाप्यमिवाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
amdhakarikrite loke varshadbhiranisham ghanaih |
adhashchordhvam cha tiryak cha jagadapyamivabhavat ||

verses.sa:
गावस्तु तेन पतता वर्षवातेन वेगिना ।
धूताः प्राणाञ्जहुस्सन्नत्रिकसक्थिशिरोधराः ॥
verses.rom:
gavastu tena patata varshavatena vegina |
dhutah prananjahussannatrikasakthishirodharah ||

verses.sa:
क्रोडेन वत्सानाक्रम्य तस्थुरन्या महामुने ।
गावो विवत्साश्च कृता वारिपूरेण चापराः ॥
verses.rom:
krodena vatsanakramya tasthuranya mahamune |
gavo vivatsashcha krita varipurena chaparah ||

verses.sa:
वत्साश्च दीनवदना वातकंपितकंधराः ।
त्राहित्राहीत्यल्पशब्दाः कृष्णमूचुरिवातुराः ॥
verses.rom:
vatsashcha dinavadana vatakampitakamdharah |
trahitrahityalpashabdah krishnamuchurivaturah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तद्गोकुलं सर्वं गोगोपीगोपसंकुलम् ।
अतीवार्त्तं हरिर्दृष्ट्वा मैत्रेयाचिंतयत्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastadgokulam sarvam gogopigopasamkulam |
ativarttam harirdrishtva maitreyachimtayattada ||

verses.sa:
एतत्कृतं महेंद्रे ण मखभंगविरोधिना ।
तदेतदखिलं गोष्ठं त्रातव्यमधुना मया ॥
verses.rom:
etatkritam mahemdre na makhabhamgavirodhina |
tadetadakhilam goshtham tratavyamadhuna maya ||

verses.sa:
इममद्रि महं धैर्यादुत्पाट्योरुशिखाघनम् ।
धारयिष्यामि गोष्ठस्य पृथुच्छत्रमिवोपरि ॥
verses.rom:
imamadri maham dhairyadutpatyorushikhaghanam |
dharayishyami goshthasya prithuchchhatramivopari ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इति कृत्वामतिं कृष्णो गोवर्द्धनमहीधरम् ।
उत्पाट्यैककरेणैव धारयामास लीलया ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
iti kritvamatim krishno govarddhanamahidharam |
utpatyaikakarenaiva dharayamasa lilaya ||

verses.sa:
गोपांश्चाह हसञ्छौरिस्समुत्पाटितभूधरः ।
विशध्वमत्रत्वरिताः कृतं वर्षनिवारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
gopamshchaha hasanchhaurissamutpatitabhudharah |
vishadhvamatratvaritah kritam varshanivaranam ||

verses.sa:
सुनिवातेषु देश्षोउ! यथा जोषमिहास्यताम् ।
प्रविश्यतां न भेतव्यं गिरिपाताच्च निर्भयैः ॥
verses.rom:
sunivateshu deshshou! yatha joshamihasyatam |
pravishyatam na bhetavyam giripatachcha nirbhayaih ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तास्तेन ते गोपा विविशुर्गोधनैस्सह ।
शकटारोपितैर्भांडैर्गोप्यश्चासारपीडिताः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktastena te gopa vivishurgodhanaissaha |
shakataropitairbhamdairgopyashchasarapiditah ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोपि तं दधारैव शैलमत्यंतनिश्चलम् ।
व्रजौकवासिभिर्हर्षविस्मिताक्षैर्निरीक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnopi tam dadharaiva shailamatyamtanishchalam |
vrajaukavasibhirharshavismitakshairnirikshitah ||

verses.sa:
गोपगोपीजनैर्हृष्टैः प्रीतिविस्तारितेक्षणैः ।
संस्तूयमानचरितः कृष्णश्शैलमधारयत् ॥
verses.rom:
gopagopijanairhrishtaih pritivistaritekshanaih |
samstuyamanacharitah krishnashshailamadharayat ||

verses.sa:
सप्तरात्रं महामेघा ववर्षुर्नंदगोकुले ।
इंद्रे ण चोदिता विप्र गोपानां नाशकारिणा ॥
verses.rom:
saptaratram mahamegha vavarshurnamdagokule |
imdre na chodita vipra gopanam nashakarina ||

verses.sa:
ततो धृते महाशैले परित्राते च गोकुले ।
मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञो बलभिद्वारयामास तान्घनान् ॥
verses.rom:
tato dhrite mahashaile paritrate cha gokule |
mithyapratijno balabhidvarayamasa tanghanan ||

verses.sa:
व्यभ्रे नभसि देवेंद्रे वितथात्मवचस्यथ ।
निष्क्रम्य गोकुलं हृष्टं स्वस्थानं पुनरागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
vyabhre nabhasi devemdre vitathatmavachasyatha |
nishkramya gokulam hrishtam svasthanam punaragamat ||

verses.sa:
मुमोच कृष्णोपि तदा गोवर्द्धनमहाचलम् ।
स्वस्थाने विस्मितमुखैर्दृष्टस्तैस्तु व्रजौकसैः ॥
verses.rom:
mumocha krishnopi tada govarddhanamahachalam |
svasthane vismitamukhairdrishtastaistu vrajaukasaih ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांश एकादशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsha ekadasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said—Being thus disappointed of offerings in the sacrifice, O Maitreya, Sakra, greatly angry, addressed the attendant clouds called Samvarttaka saying—"O ye clouds! hear what I say and do ye speedily execute without any judgment my behests. The foolish cow-herd Nanda and his companions, relying upon the protection of Krishna have withheld the usual offerings to us. Now therefore, distress the cattle, with wind and rain at my command, that are their subsistance and whence their occupation is derived. Ascending my elephant, huge as a mountain summit, I will give you assistance in strengthening the tempest".

Parsara said:—O twice-born one, being thus commanded by the celestial-chief, the clouds came down in a fearful storm of rain and wind to destroy the cattle. In a moment, the earth the points of the horizon and the sky were all blended into one by the heavy and incessant showers. Being afraid of the lightning's scourge, the clouds filled the quarters with their muttering and pouring down uninterrupted torrents. The clouds pouring down waters day and night, the earth was filled with darkness; and above below and on every side the world was filled with water. The cattle, pelted by the storm, shrank cowering into the smallest size or gave up their breath. Some covered their calves with flanks and some saw their young ones carried away by the flood. Trembling in the wind, the calves cast their piteous looks at their mothers or begged, in low moans, as if, the help of Krishna. Beholding all Gokula moved with terror and cow-herds and cow-herdesses and cattle stricken with consternations, Hari thus thought "This is the work of Mahendra, who has been offended for withholding sacrifices from me; it is therefore my duty to defend this village of herdsmen. I will uplift this spacious mountain from its snowy base and hold it up as a large umbrella over the cow-pens". Having thus made up his mind, Krishna immediately upheld the mountain Govardhana with one hand as if in sport, and said to the cow-herds—"Behold the mountain is on high; enter beneath it speedily, and it will shelter you from the storm; here you will be secure and happy in places defended from the wind; enter speedily and fear not that the mountain will fall". Thereupon, all the people with their cattle, wagons, goods, women, afflicted as they were by rain, went to the shelter of the mountain which he held steadily over their heads; and Krishna, as he supported the mountain, was contemplated with delight and astonishment by the inhabitants of Vraja. As his eyes expanded with joy and wonder, the cow-herds and cow-herdesses sang his glories. For seven days and nights did the vast clouds, despatched by Indra, pour down showers upon the Gokula of Nanda, to destroy the dwellers, but they were protected by the height of the mountain. And being baffled in his purpose, the Indra, the destroyer of Bala, ordered the clouds to cease. The threats of Indra having been fruitless and the sky clear, all the inhabitants of Gokula came out from the shelter and went back to their respective habitations. Then Krishna, in the presence of the inhabitants of the forests filled with surprise, restored the great mountain Govardhana to its original site.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
धृते गोवर्द्धने शैले परित्राते च गोकुले ।
रोचयामास कृष्णस्य दर्शनं पाकशासनः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
dhrite govarddhane shaile paritrate cha gokule |
rochayamasa krishnasya darshanam pakashasanah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽधिरुह्य महानागमैरावतममित्रजित् ।
गोवर्द्धनगिरौ कृष्णं ददर्श त्रिदश्श्वोरः ॥
verses.rom:
so'dhiruhya mahanagamairavatamamitrajit |
govarddhanagirau krishnam dadarsha tridashshvorah ||

verses.sa:
चारयंतं महावीर्यं गास्तु गोपवपुर्धरम् ।
कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गोपं वृतं गोपकुमारकैः ॥
verses.rom:
charayamtam mahaviryam gastu gopavapurdharam |
kritsnasya jagato gopam vritam gopakumarakaih ||

verses.sa:
गरुडं च ददर्शोच्चैरंतर्द्धानगतं द्विज ।
कृतच्छायं हरेर्मूर्ध्नि पक्षाभ्यां पक्षिपुंगवम् ॥
verses.rom:
garudam cha dadarshochchairamtarddhanagatam dvija |
kritachchhayam harermurdhni pakshabhyam pakshipumgavam ||

verses.sa:
अवरुह्य स नागेंद्रा देकांते मधुसूदनम् ।
शक्रस्सस्मितमाहेदं प्रीतिविस्तारितेक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
avaruhya sa nagemdra dekamte madhusudanam |
shakrassasmitamahedam pritivistaritekshanah ||

verses.sa:
इंद्र उवाच।
कृष्णकृष्ण शृणुष्वेदं यदर्थ महामागतः ।
त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो नैतच्चिंत्यं त्वयाऽन्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
imdra uvacha|
krishnakrishna shrinushvedam yadartha mahamagatah |
tvatsamipam mahabaho naitachchimtyam tvaya'nyatha ||

verses.sa:
भारावतारणार्थाय पृथिव्याः पृथिवीतले ।
अवतीर्णोऽखिलाधार त्वमेव परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
bharavataranarthaya prithivyah prithivitale |
avatirno'khiladhara tvameva parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
मखभंगविरोधेन मया गोकुलनाशकाः ।
समादिष्टा महामेघास्तैश्चेदं कदनं कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
makhabhamgavirodhena maya gokulanashakah |
samadishta mahameghastaishchedam kadanam kritam ||

verses.sa:
त्रातास्ताश्च त्वया गावस्समुत्पाट्य महीधरम् ।
तेनाऽहं तोषितो वीरकर्मणाऽत्यद्भुतेन ते ॥
verses.rom:
tratastashcha tvaya gavassamutpatya mahidharam |
tena'ham toshito virakarmana'tyadbhutena te ||

verses.sa:
साधितं कृष्ण देवानामहं मन्ये प्रयोजनम् ।
त्वयायमद्रि प्रवरः करेणैकेन यद्धृतः ॥
verses.rom:
sadhitam krishna devanamaham manye prayojanam |
tvayayamadri pravarah karenaikena yaddhritah ||

verses.sa:
गोभिश्च चोदितः कृष्ण त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः ।
त्वया त्राताभिरत्यर्थं युष्मत्सत्कारकारणात् ॥
verses.rom:
gobhishcha choditah krishna tvatsakashamihagatah |
tvaya tratabhiratyartham yushmatsatkarakaranat ||

verses.sa:
स त्वां कृष्णाभिषेक्ष्यामि गवां वाक्यप्रचोदितः ।
उपेंद्र त्वे गवामिंद्रो गोविंदस्त्वं भविष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam krishnabhishekshyami gavam vakyaprachoditah |
upemdra tve gavamimdro govimdastvam bhavishyasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
अथोपवाह्यादादाय घंटामैरावताद्गजात् ।
अभिषेकं तया चक्रे पवित्रजलपूर्णया ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
athopavahyadadaya ghamtamairavatadgajat |
abhishekam taya chakre pavitrajalapurnaya ||

verses.sa:
क्रियमाणेऽभिषेके तु गावः कृष्णस्य तत्क्षणात् ।
प्रस्नवोद्भूतदुग्धाद्रा रं! सद्यश्चक्रुर्वसुन्धराम् ॥
verses.rom:
kriyamane'bhisheke tu gavah krishnasya tatkshanat |
prasnavodbhutadugdhadra ram! sadyashchakrurvasundharam ||

verses.sa:
अभिषिच्य गवां वाक्यादुपेंद्रं वै जनार्दनम् ।
प्रीत्या सप्रश्रयं वाक्यं पुनराह शचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhishichya gavam vakyadupemdram vai janardanam |
pritya saprashrayam vakyam punaraha shachipatih ||

verses.sa:
गवामेतत्कृतं वाक्यं तथान्यदपि मे शृणु ।
यद्ब्रवीमि महाभाग भारावतरणेच्छया ॥
verses.rom:
gavametatkritam vakyam tathanyadapi me shrinu |
yadbravimi mahabhaga bharavataranechchhaya ||

verses.sa:
ममंशः पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्यां पृथिवीधर ।
अवतीर्णोऽर्जुनोनाम संरक्ष्यो भवता सदा ॥
verses.rom:
mamamshah purushavyaghra prithivyam prithividhara |
avatirno'rjunonama samrakshyo bhavata sada ||

verses.sa:
भारावतरणे साह्यं स ते वीरः करिष्यति ।
संरक्षणीयो भवता यथात्मा मधुसूदन ॥
verses.rom:
bharavatarane sahyam sa te virah karishyati |
samrakshaniyo bhavata yathatma madhusudana ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
जानामि भारते वंशो! जातं पार्थं तवांशतः ।
तमहं पालयिष्यामि यावत्स्थास्यामि भूतले ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha|
janami bharate vamsho! jatam partham tavamshatah |
tamaham palayishyami yavatsthasyami bhutale ||

verses.sa:
यावन्महीतले शक्र स्थास्याम्यहमरिंदम ।
न तावदर्जुनं कश्चिद्देवेंद्र युधि जेष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yavanmahitale shakra sthasyamyahamarimdama |
na tavadarjunam kashchiddevemdra yudhi jeshyati ||

verses.sa:
कंसो नाम महाबाहुर्दैत्योऽरिष्टस्तथाऽसुरः ।
केशी कुवलयापीडो नरकाद्यास्तथा परे ॥
verses.rom:
kamso nama mahabahurdaityo'rishtastatha'surah |
keshi kuvalayapido narakadyastatha pare ||

verses.sa:
हतेषु तेषु देवेंद्र भविष्यति महाहवः ।
तत्र विद्धि सहस्राक्ष भारावतरणं कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
hateshu teshu devemdra bhavishyati mahahavah |
tatra viddhi sahasraksha bharavataranam kritam ||

verses.sa:
स त्वं गच्छ न संतापं पुत्रार्थे कर्त्तुमर्हसि ।
नार्जुनस्य रिपुः कश्चिन्ममाग्रे प्रभविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam gachchha na samtapam putrarthe karttumarhasi |
narjunasya ripuh kashchinmamagre prabhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
अर्जुनार्थे त्वहं सर्वान्युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमान् ।
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे कुंत्यै दास्याम्यविक्षताम् ॥
verses.rom:
arjunarthe tvaham sarvanyudhishthirapurogaman |
nivritte bharate yuddhe kumtyai dasyamyavikshatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्युक्तः संपरिष्वज्य देवाराजो जनार्दनम् ।
आरुह्यैरावतं नागं पुनरेव दिवं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityuktah samparishvajya devarajo janardanam |
aruhyairavatam nagam punareva divam yayau ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णो हि सहितो गोभिर्गोपालैश्च पुनर्व्रजम् ।
आजगामाऽथ गोपीनां दृष्टिपूतेन वर्त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
krishno hi sahito gobhirgopalaishcha punarvrajam |
ajagama'tha gopinam drishtiputena vartmana ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो! द्वादशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho! dvadasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—After the inhabitants of Gokula had been saved by the upholding of the mountain Govardhana, the chastiser of Paka (Indra) became desirous of seeing Krishna. Having mounted his huge elephant Airavata, that lord of the celestials, the destroyer of enemies, beheld the mighty Krishna on the mount Govardhana, tending cattle, assuming the person of a cow-boy and encircled by the sons of cow-herds, although the protector of the universe. He saw above his head, Garuda, the king of birds, invisible to men, spreading out his wings to shade the head of Hari. Descending from his elephant and taking him at a distance, Sakra, having his eyes expanded with delight, said to the Slayer of Madhu—"Hear! hear, O Krishna, why I have come here; why I have come to thee; do not think otherwise of it. Thou, O lord, who art the supporter of the universe, hast descended upon earth to relieve her of her burden. Being enraged on account of my rites being obstructed, I sent the clouds to deluge Gokula and they have done this evil deed. By upholding the mountain, thou hast preserved the cattle and really, O hero, I am much pleased with thy wonderous deed. The object of the celestials is, now, I think, accomplished, for with thy single hand thou hast uplifted this chief of mountains. Being commissioned by the cattle, O Krishna, I have come to thee, to honour thee for thou didst save them. At their words, I shall install thee as Upendra and as the Indra of the cows thou shalt be called Govinda". Saying this, Mahendra took a ewer from his elephant Airavata and with the holy water it contained performed the regal ceremony of sprinkling. And as the ceremony was being performed, the cattle deluged the earth with their milk.

Having thus inaugurated Krishna, Indra, the husband of Sachi, again affectionately said—"I have done this at the request of the cattle; hear, I shall speak something else to thee, O noble one, being desirous of relieving the earth of her burden. O foremost of men, a portion of mine, under the name of Arjuna, has descended upon earth—do thou protect him always. He shall assist thee in relieving the earth of her burden. He should be protected by thee, O Slayer of Madhu, like thy own Self".

The Deity said "I know that in the family of Bharata, thy son has been born by Pritha. I shall protect him as long as I shall live on this earth. O Sakra, O Slayer of foes, O lord of the celestials, as long I shall be on this earth, no one shall be able to vanquish Arjuna in conflict. The highly powerful Asura Kansa and Arishtha Keshi, Nāraka and others being slain, there shall take place a terrible conflict, O king of the celestials; know that, O thousand-eyed deity, as what will relieve earth of her burden. Do thou go; it behoves thee not to be anxious for thy son. No enemy of Arjuna shall grow in power before me. For Arjuna I shall render back Yudhishthira and his brothers to Kunti after the great battle of Kurukshetra".

Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed, the king of the celestials embraced Janarddana and having mounted the elephant Airavata again went to the celestial region. Krishna too with the cows and cow-herds came back to Vraja by the way sanctified by the looks of the females of the cow-herds.

verses.sa:
गते शक्र तु गोपालाः कृष्णमक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।
ऊचुः प्रीत्या धृतं दृष्ट्वा तेन गोवर्द्धनाचलम् ॥
verses.rom:
gate shakra tu gopalah krishnamaklishtakarinam |
uchuh pritya dhritam drishtva tena govarddhanachalam ||

verses.sa:
वयमस्मान्महाबाहो! भवता महतो भयात् ।
गावश्व भवता त्राता गिरिधारणकर्म्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
vayamasmanmahabaho! bhavata mahato bhayat |
gavashva bhavata trata giridharanakarmmana ||

verses.sa:
बालीक्रीड़ेयमतुला गोपालत्वं जुगुप्सितम् ।
दिव्यञ्च कर्म्म भवतः किमेतत् तात!कथ्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
balikrireyamatula gopalatvam jugupsitam |
divyancha karmma bhavatah kimetat tata!kathyatam ||

verses.sa:
कालियो दमितस्तोये प्रलम्बो विनिपातितः ।
धृतो गोवर्द्धनश्वायं शङ्कितानि मनांसि नः ॥
verses.rom:
kaliyo damitastoye pralambo vinipatitah |
dhrito govarddhanashvayam shankitani manamsi nah ||

verses.sa:
सत्यं सत्यं हरेः पादौ शापामीऽमितविक्रम ।
यथा त्वद्रीर्य्यमालोक्य न त्वां मन्यामहे नरम् ॥
verses.rom:
satyam satyam hareh padau shapami'mitavikrama |
yatha tvadriryyamalokya na tvam manyamahe naram ||

verses.sa:
प्रीतिः सस्त्रीकुमारस्य व्रजस्य तव केशव!
कर्म्म चेदमशक्यं यत् समस्तैस्त्रिदशैरपि ॥
verses.rom:
pritih sastrikumarasya vrajasya tava keshava!
karmma chedamashakyam yat samastaistridashairapi ||

verses.sa:
बालत्वं चातिवीर्य्यञ्च जन्म जास्मास्वशोभनम् ।
चिन्त्यमानममेयात्मन्!शङ्कां कृष्ण प्रयच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
balatvam chativiryyancha janma jasmasvashobhanam |
chintyamanamameyatman!shankam krishna prayachchhati ||

verses.sa:
देवो वा दानवो वा त्वं यक्षो गन्धर्व्व एव वा ।
किं वास्माकं विचारेण बान्धवोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
devo va danavo va tvam yaksho gandharvva eva va |
kim vasmakam vicharena bandhavo'si namo'stu te ||

verses.sa:
क्षणं भूत्वा त्वसौ तूष्णीं किञ्चित् प्रणयकोपवान् ।
इत्येवमुक्तस्तैर्गोपैः कृष्णोऽप्याह महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
kshanam bhutva tvasau tushnim kinchit pranayakopavan |
ityevamuktastairgopaih krishno'pyaha mahamune ||

verses.sa:
मत्सम्बन्धेन भो गोपा! यदि लज्जा न जायते ।
शलाध्यो वाहं ततऋः किं वो विचारेण प्रयोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
matsambandhena bho gopa! yadi lajja na jayate |
shaladhyo vaham tatarih kim vo vicharena prayojanam ||

verses.sa:
यदि वोऽस्ति मयि प्रीतिः श्लाध्योऽहं भवतां यदि ।
तदात्मबन्धुसदृशी बुद्धिर्वः क्रियतां मयि ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vo'sti mayi pritih shladhyo'ham bhavatam yadi |
tadatmabandhusadrishi buddhirvah kriyatam mayi ||

verses.sa:
नाहं देवो न गन्धर्व्वो न यक्षो न च दानवः ।
अहं वो बान्धवो जातो नास्ति चिन्त्यमतोऽन्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
naham devo na gandharvvo na yaksho na cha danavah |
aham vo bandhavo jato nasti chintyamato'nyatha ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रुत्वा हरेर्वाक्यं बद्धमौनास्ततो वनम् ।
ययूर्गोपा महाभाग!तस्मिन् प्रणयकोपितनि ॥
verses.rom:
iti shrutva harervakyam baddhamaunastato vanam |
yayurgopa mahabhaga!tasmin pranayakopitani ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णस्तु विमलं व्योम शरच्चन्द्रस्य चन्दिरकाम् ।
तथा कुमुदिनीं फुल्लामामोदितदिगन्तराम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishnastu vimalam vyoma sharachchandrasya chandirakam |
tatha kumudinim phullamamoditadigantaram ||

verses.sa:
वनराजिं तथा कूजदूभृङ्गमालां मनोरमाम् ।
विलोक्य सह गोपीभिर्मनश्वक्र रतिं प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
vanarajim tatha kujadubhringamalam manoramam |
vilokya saha gopibhirmanashvakra ratim prati ||

verses.sa:
सह रामेणा मधुरमतीव वनिताप्रियम् ।
जगौ कलपदं शौरिर्नानातन्त्री-कृतव्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
