saha ramena madhuramativa vanitapriyam |
jagau kalapadam shaurirnanatantri-kritavratam ||

verses.sa:
रम्यं गीतध्वनि श्रत्वा सन्त्यज्यावसथांस्तदा ।
आजग्मुस्त्वरिता गोप्यो यत्रास्ते मधृसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
ramyam gitadhvani shratva santyajyavasathamstada |
ajagmustvarita gopyo yatraste madhrisudanah ||

verses.sa:
शनैः शनैर्ज्जगौ गोपी काचित् तस्य लयानुगम् ।
दत्तावधाना काचित्तू तमेव मनसास्मरत् ॥
verses.rom:
shanaih shanairjjagau gopi kachit tasya layanugam |
dattavadhana kachittu tameva manasasmarat ||

verses.sa:
काचित् कृष्णेति कृष्णेति प्रेक्त्वा लज्जामुपागता ।
ययौ च काचित् प्रेमान्धा ततपार्श्वमविलज्जिता ॥
verses.rom:
kachit krishneti krishneti prektva lajjamupagata |
yayau cha kachit premandha tataparshvamavilajjita ||

verses.sa:
काचिदावसथस्यान्तः स्थिता दृष्ट्वा बहिर्गुरून् ।
तन्मयत्वेन गोविन्दं दध्यौ मीलितलोचना ॥
verses.rom:
kachidavasathasyantah sthita drishtva bahirgurun |
tanmayatvena govindam dadhyau militalochana ||

verses.sa:
तच्विन्ताविपुलाह्लाद-क्षीणपुणयचया तथा ।
तदप्राप्ति-महादुःविलीनाशेषपातका ॥
verses.rom:
tachvintavipulahlada-kshinapunayachaya tatha |
tadaprapti-mahaduhvilinasheshapataka ||

verses.sa:
चिन्तयन्ती जगत्सूतिं परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणम् ।
निरुच्छ्वासतया मुक्ति गतान्या गोपकन्यका ॥
verses.rom:
chintayanti jagatsutim parabrahmasvarupinam |
niruchchhvasataya mukti gatanya gopakanyaka ||

verses.sa:
गोपीपरिवृतो रात्रि शरचन्द्रमनोरमाम् ।
मानयामास गोविन्दो रासारम्भरसोत्सुकः ॥
verses.rom:
gopiparivrito ratri sharachandramanoramam |
manayamasa govindo rasarambharasotsukah ||

verses.sa:
गोप्यश्व वृन्दशः कृष्णचेष्टास्वायत्तमूर्त्तयः ।
अन्यदेशं गते कृष्णो चेरुर्वृन्दावमान्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
gopyashva vrindashah krishnacheshtasvayattamurttayah |
anyadesham gate krishno cherurvrindavamantaram ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णो निरुद्धह्टदया इदसूचुः परस्परम् ।
कृष्णोऽहमेतल्ललितं व्रजाम्यालोक्यतां गतिः ।
अन्या ब्रवीति कष्णस्य मम गीतिर्निशम्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishno niruddhahtadaya idasuchuh parasparam |
krishno'hametallalitam vrajamyalokyatam gatih |
anya braviti kashnasya mama gitirnishamyatam ||

verses.sa:
दुषृकालिय!तिष्ठात्र कृणोऽहमिति चापरा ।
बाहुमास्फोठ्य कृष्णस्य लीलासर्व्वस्वमाददे ॥
verses.rom:
dushrikaliya!tishthatra krino'hamiti chapara |
bahumasphothya krishnasya lilasarvvasvamadade ||

verses.sa:
अन्यां ब्रवीति भो गोपा!निः शङ्कः स्थीयतामिह ।
अलं बृष्टिभयेनात्र धृतो गोवर्द्धनो मया ॥
verses.rom:
anyam braviti bho gopa!nih shankah sthiyatamiha |
alam brishtibhayenatra dhrito govarddhano maya ||

verses.sa:
धेनुकोऽयं मया क्षिप्तो विचरन्लु यथेच्छया ।
गोपी ब्रवीति वै चान्या कृष्मालीलानुकारिणी ॥
verses.rom:
dhenuko'yam maya kshipto vicharanlu yathechchhaya |
gopi braviti vai chanya krishmalilanukarini ||

verses.sa:
एवं नानाप्रकारासु कृष्णचेष्टासु तास्तदा ।
गोप्या व्यग्राः समं चरू रम्य वृन्दावनान्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
evam nanaprakarasu krishnacheshtasu tastada |
gopya vyagrah samam charu ramya vrindavanantaram ||

verses.sa:
विलोक्यैका भुवं प्राह् गोपी गोपवराङ्गना ।
पुलकाञ्चितसर्व्वाङ्गी विकाशि-नयनोत्पला ॥
verses.rom:
vilokyaika bhuvam prah gopi gopavarangana |
pulakanchitasarvvangi vikashi-nayanotpala ||

verses.sa:
ध्वजवज्राङ्कु शाब्जाङ्क-रेखावन्त्यालि पश्यत ।
पदान्येतानि कृष्णस्य लीलालङ्कृतगामिनः ॥
verses.rom:
dhvajavajranku shabjanka-rekhavantyali pashyata |
padanyetani krishnasya lilalankritagaminah ||

verses.sa:
कापि तेम समं याता कृतपुण्या मदालसा ।
पदानि तस्याश्चैतानि घनान्यल्पतनूनि च ॥
verses.rom:
kapi tema samam yata kritapunya madalasa |
padani tasyashchaitani ghananyalpatanuni cha ||

verses.sa:
पुष्पावचयमत्रोच्चैश्वक्रे दामोदरो ध्रु वम् ।
येनाग्राक्रान्तिमात्राणि पदान्यत्र महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
pushpavachayamatrochchaishvakre damodaro dhru vam |
yenagrakrantimatrani padanyatra mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
अत्रोपविश्य सा तेन कापि पुष्पैरलङ्कृता ।
अन्यजन्मनि सर्व्वात्मा विष्णुरभ्यर्ज्वितो यया ॥
verses.rom:
atropavishya sa tena kapi pushpairalankrita |
anyajanmani sarvvatma vishnurabhyarjvito yaya ||

verses.sa:
पुष्पबन्धनसम्मान-कृतमानामपास्य ताम् ।
नन्दगोपसुतो यातो मार्गेणानेन पश्यत ॥
verses.rom:
pushpabandhanasammana-kritamanamapasya tam |
nandagopasuto yato margenanena pashyata ||

verses.sa:
अनुयानेऽसमर्थान्या नितम्बभरमन्थरा ।
या गन्तव्ये द्रुतं याति निम्रपादाग्रसंस्थितिः ॥
verses.rom:
anuyane'samarthanya nitambabharamanthara |
ya gantavye drutam yati nimrapadagrasamsthitih ||

verses.sa:
हस्तन्यस्ताग्रहस्तेयं तेन याति तथा सखि!
अनायत्तपदन्यासा लक्ष्यते पदपद्धतिः ॥
verses.rom:
hastanyastagrahasteyam tena yati tatha sakhi!
anayattapadanyasa lakshyate padapaddhatih ||

verses.sa:
हस्तसंस्पर्शमात्रेण धूर्त्तेनैषा विमानिता ।
नैराश्यमन्दगामिन्या निवुत्तं लक्ष्यते पदम ॥
verses.rom:
hastasamsparshamatrena dhurttenaisha vimanita |
nairashyamandagaminya nivuttam lakshyate padama ||

verses.sa:
नूनमुक्ता त्वरामीति पुनरेष्यामि तेऽन्तिकम् ।
तेन कृष्णेन येनैषा त्वरिता पदपद्धतिः ॥
verses.rom:
nunamukta tvaramiti punareshyami te'ntikam |
tena krishnena yenaisha tvarita padapaddhatih ||

verses.sa:
प्रविष्टो गहनं कृष्णः पदमत्र न लक्ष्यते ।
निवर्त्तध्व शशाङ्कस्य नैतद्दीधितिगोचरे ॥
verses.rom:
pravishto gahanam krishnah padamatra na lakshyate |
nivarttadhva shashankasya naitaddidhitigochare ||

verses.sa:
निवृत्तास्तास्ततो गोप्यो निराशाः कृष्णदर्शने ।
यमुनातीरमागत्य जगुस्तज्वरितं तदा ॥
verses.rom:
nivrittastastato gopyo nirashah krishnadarshane |
yamunatiramagatya jagustajvaritam tada ||

verses.sa:
ततो ददृशुरायान्तं विकाशिमुखपङ्कजम् ।
गोप्यस्त्रैलोक्यगोप्तारं कृष्णमक्लिष्टचेष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato dadrishurayantam vikashimukhapankajam |
gopyastrailokyagoptaram krishnamaklishtacheshtitam ||

verses.sa:
काचिदालोक्य गोविन्दमायान्तमतिहर्षिता ।
कूष्ण् कृष्णेति कृष्णेति प्राह नान्यदुदैरयत् ॥
verses.rom:
kachidalokya govindamayantamatiharshita |
kushn krishneti krishneti praha nanyadudairayat ||

verses.sa:
काचिदू भ्रू भङ्गुरं कृत्वा ललाटफलकं हरिम् ।
विलोक्य नैत्रभृङ्गाभ्यां पपौ यन्मुखपङ्कजम् ॥
verses.rom:
kachidu bhru bhanguram kritva lalataphalakam harim |
vilokya naitrabhringabhyam papau yanmukhapankajam ||

verses.sa:
काचिदालोक्य गोविन्दं निमीलित-विलोचना ।
तस्यैव रूपं ध्यायन्ती योगारूढ़ेव चाबभौ ॥
verses.rom:
kachidalokya govindam nimilita-vilochana |
tasyaiva rupam dhyayanti yogarurheva chababhau ||

verses.sa:
ततः काश्वित् प्रियालापैः काश्विदू भ्रू भङ्गवीक्षणः ।
निन्येऽनुनयमन्याञ्च करस्पर्शेन माघवः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kashvit priyalapaih kashvidu bhru bhangavikshanah |
ninye'nunayamanyancha karasparshena maghavah ||

verses.sa:
ताभिः प्रसन्नचित्तामभिर्गोपीभिः सह सादरम् ।
रराम रासगोष्ठीभिरुदारचरितो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
tabhih prasannachittamabhirgopibhih saha sadaram |
rarama rasagoshthibhirudaracharito harih ||

verses.sa:
रासमणडलबन्धोऽपि कृष्णपार्श्वमनुजूझता ।
गोपीजनेन नैवाभूदेकस्थानस्थिरात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
rasamanadalabandho'pi krishnaparshvamanujujhata |
gopijanena naivabhudekasthanasthiratmana ||

verses.sa:
हर्ते प्रगृह्य चैकैकां गोपिकां रासमणडलीम् ।
चकार तत्करस्पर्श-निमीलितदृशं हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
harte pragrihya chaikaikam gopikam rasamanadalim |
chakara tatkarasparsha-nimilitadrisham harih ||

verses.sa:
ततः स ववृते रासश्वलदूवलयनिः स्वनः ।
अनुयातशरतूकाव्यगेयगीतिरनुक्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa vavrite rasashvaladuvalayanih svanah |
anuyatasharatukavyageyagitiranukramat ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णाः शरज्वन्द्रमसं कौमुदीं कुमुदाकरम् ।
जगौ गोपीजनस्त्वेकं कूष्णनाम पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnah sharajvandramasam kaumudim kumudakaram |
jagau gopijanastvekam kushnanama punah punah ||

verses.sa:
परिवर्त्तश्रमेणोक चलदूवलयलापिनीम् ।
ददौ बाहुलतां स्कन्धे गोपी मधुनिघातिनः ॥
verses.rom:
parivarttashramenoka chaladuvalayalapinim |
dadau bahulatam skandhe gopi madhunighatinah ||

verses.sa:
काचित् प्रविलसदूबाहुः परिरभ्य चुचुम्ब तम् ।
गोपी गीतस्तुतिव्याज-निपुणा मधुसूदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
kachit pravilasadubahuh parirabhya chuchumba tam |
gopi gitastutivyaja-nipuna madhusudanam ||

verses.sa:
गोपी-कपोल-संश्लेषमभिपत्य हरेभुर्जौ ।
पुलकोदूगमशस्याय स्वेदाम्बुघनतां गतौ ॥
verses.rom:
gopi-kapola-samshleshamabhipatya harebhurjau |
pulakodugamashasyaya svedambughanatam gatau ||

verses.sa:
रासगेयं जगौ कृष्णेति यावत् तारतरध्वनिः ।
साधु कृष्णेति कृष्णेतितावत् ता द्रिगुणं अगुः ॥
verses.rom:
rasageyam jagau krishneti yavat tarataradhvanih |
sadhu krishneti krishnetitavat ta drigunam aguh ||

verses.sa:
गते तु गमनं चक्रु र्वलने सम्मुखं ययुः ।
प्रतिलोमानुलोमाब्यां भेजुर्गोपाङ्गना हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
gate tu gamanam chakru rvalane sammukham yayuh |
pratilomanulomabyam bhejurgopangana harim ||

verses.sa:
स तथा सह गोपीभी रराम मघुसूदनः ।
यथाब्दकोटिप्रमितः क्षणस्तेन विनामवत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tatha saha gopibhi rarama maghusudanah |
yathabdakotipramitah kshanastena vinamavat ||

verses.sa:
ता वार्य्यमाणाः पतिभिः पितृभिर्भ्रातृभिस्तथा ।
कृष्णां गोपाङ्गना रात्रौ रमयन्ति रतिप्रियाः ॥
verses.rom:
ta varyyamanah patibhih pitribhirbhratribhistatha |
krishnam gopangana ratrau ramayanti ratipriyah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽपि कैशोरकवयो मानयन् मधुसूदनः ।
रेमे ताभिरमेयात्मा क्षपासु क्षपिताहितः ॥
verses.rom:
so'pi kaishorakavayo manayan madhusudanah |
reme tabhirameyatma kshapasu kshapitahitah ||

verses.sa:
तद्भर्त्तृषु तथा तासु सर्व्वभूतेषु चेश्वरः ।
आत्मखरूपरूपोऽसौ व्याप्य सर्व्वमवस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
tadbharttrishu tatha tasu sarvvabhuteshu cheshvarah |
atmakharuparupo'sau vyapya sarvvamavasthitah ||

verses.sa:
यथा समस्तभूतेषु नभोऽग्रिः पृथिवी जलम् ।
वायुश्वात्मा तथैवासौ व्याप्य सर्व्वमवस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha samastabhuteshu nabho'grih prithivi jalam |
vayushvatma tathaivasau vyapya sarvvamavasthitah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Sakra having departed, the cow-herds, on seeing him uplift the mountain Govardhana, said to Krishna of wonderous deeds, delightedly:—"O thou of mighty arms, thou hast saved us from a great fear; by holding up the mountain thou hast protected the cows. Wonderful are thy childish sports and insignificant is the condition of a herdsman and all thy actions are those of a god. Tell us what is the meanings of all this. Kaliya has been vanquished in the water; Pralamba has been killed; Govardhana has been lifted up; our minds are filled with surprise. We can swear by the feet of Hari, O thou of unbounded might, that beholding thy powers we do not consider thee as man. O Kesava, the woman, the children and the old of Vraja are all pleased with thee—even all the celestials cannot perform the deeds thou hast done. Thy boyhood and thy prowess; thy humiliating birth amongst us, are contradictions that fill us with surprise whenever we think of them. Be thou a god, or a demon or a Yaksha or a Gandharva, or whatever, we may consider thee, we should respect thee for thou art our friend".

When they had finished, Krishna remained silent for some time as if hurt and wounded and then said to them, "Herdsmen, if you are not ashamed of my relationship, if I have deserved your praise, then what necessity have you to discuss thus concerning me? If you have any love for me, if I merit your praise, then consider me as your friend. I am neither a god, nor a Gandharva nor a Yaksha nor a demon—I am born as thy friend and you should not think otherwise of me".

Parāçara said Being addressed thus, O great Muni the cow-herds remained silent and went into the woods leaving Krishna apparently displeased. Beholding the clear sky with the autumnal moon, and the air perfumed with the fragrance of the wild water-lily in whose buds the clustering bees were murmuring their songs, he felt inclined to join with the females of cow-herds in sport. Thereupon with Rāma he began singing sweet low strains in various measures such as the woman loved; and they, as soon as they heard the music, left their homes and hastened to meet the Slayer of Madhu. One damsel gently sang an accompaniment to his song, another attentively listened to his music: one called him by the name and then shrank in bashfulness: whilst another, more bold and prompted by love, pressed close to his side; one, as she came out, saw some of the seniors of her family and dared not venture satisfying herself with meditating on Krishna with closed eyes and whole-minded devotion by which immediately all acts of merit were effaced by rapture and all sin was expiated by regret at not seeing him: and others again, reflecting upon the cause of the world, in the form of the Supreme Brahma, obtained, by their sighing, final emancipation. Thus encircled by the females of cow-herds Krishna thought the lovely moon-light night of autumn suited to the Rāsa dance. Many of them so imitated the different actions of Krishna that in his absence they wandered through Vrindavana representing his person. "I am Krishna" exclaims one "behold the beauty of my movements". "I am Krishna" cries another "Listen to my song". "Wait! wicked Kāliya, I am Krishna" cries out another striking her arms defiantly. A fourth cries out: "Herdsmen, fear nothing, be steady, there is no danger of the storm any more for I uplift the Govardhana for your protection," and a fifth exclaims—"Now let the cattle graze wherever they will, for I have slain Dhenuka". In this wise the females of the cow-herds imitated the various actions of Krishna, and in his absence removed their sorrow by mimicking his sports. One damsel, looking on the earth with the down of her person erect and expanded eyes, exclaims "See here are the impressions of Krishna's feet and as he has gone, he has left those marks of the banner, the thunder-bolt and the goad. What fortunate damsel is going with him inebriate with her passion as her irregular footmarks prove? Here Damodara has called flowers from on high, for we see alone the marks of the tips of his feet. Here a nymph has sat down with him be-decked with flowers, fortunate in having propitiated Vishnu in a pristine birth. Having left her in a haughty mood because he had adored her with flowers, the son of Nanda has gone by this road; for see, unable to follow him with equal steps his companion has here tripped along upon her toes; and that holding his hand, the damsel has passed on is evident from the uneven and intermingled footsteps. The wicked Krishna merely took her by the hand and then left her. The damsel, being disappointed, is returning in faltering steps—for such her foot-marks indicate. Forsooth he proposed to her that he would come back soon, for here are his own footsteps returning with speed. Here he has entered the thick forest but as the rays of the moon do not enter here his footsteps can be traced no farther". Being hopeless of beholding Krishna, the females of the cow-herds came back and arriving at the banks of the Yamuna, they began to sing his songs. They immediately saw the protector of the three worlds, with a smiling countenance, coming speedily towards them, on which one cried out "Krishna, Krishna" being unable to utter any thing else. One liked to contract her forehead with frowns as drinking with the bees of her eyes the lotus of the face of Hari: another, shutting her eyes, meditated, in her mind, upon his form as if being engaged in an act of devotion. Thereupon coming amongst them Mādhaba conciliated some with soft words some with gentle looks and some he took by the hand and the illustrious deity sported with them in the stations of the dance, after all the damsels had been propitiated. As each of the damsels attempted to remain in one place close to the side of Krishna, the circle of the dance could not be constructed. Thereupon taking each by the hand and when their eyelids were closed by the effects of such touch Hari formed the circle. Then began the dance in accompaniment with the music of their clashing bracelets and songs that celebrated in sweet melody the beauty of the autumnal season. Krishna sang the moon of autumn, a mine of gentle rays but the damsels chanted the praise of Krishna only. At times, one of them exhausted by the revolving dance, threw her arms, adorned with the tinkling bracelets round the neck of the Slayer of Madhu: another proficient in the art of singing his praises embraced him. The drops of perspiration from the arms of Hari were like fertilizing rain which produced a drop of dew upon the temples of the damsels of cow-herds. Krishna sang the melody that was suited to the dance. The damsels again and again repeated—"Bravo, Krishna," to his song. When leading, they followed him, when coming back, they met him and whether he went forwards or backwards they always followed his footsteps. Whilst sporting thus with the females of the cow-herds, they regarded one moment in his absence as a myriad of years. And although prohibited in vain by their husbands and brothers, they went out in night to sport with Krishna, the idol of their affection. Thus the deity of unbounded prowess, the remover of all imperfections, assumed the character of a youth amongst the damsels of Vraja, pervading their natures and that of their lords, by his own essence all diffusive like the wind, for even as in all creatures the elements of ether, fire, water, and air are comprehended, so also is he everywhere present and in all.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
प्रदोषाग्रे कदाचित्तु रासासक्ते जनार्दने।
त्रासयन्समदो गोष्ठमरिष्टस्समुपागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
pradoshagre kadachittu rasasakte janardane|
trasayansamado goshthamarishtassamupagamat ||

verses.sa:
स तोयतोयदच्छायस्तीक्ष्णशृंगोर्कलोचनः।
खुराग्रपातैरत्यर्थं दारयन्धरणीतलम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa toyatoyadachchhayastikshnashrimgorkalochanah|
khuragrapatairatyartham darayandharanitalam ||

verses.sa:
लेलिहानस्सनिष्पेषं जिह्वयोष्ठौ पुनःपुनः।
संरंभाविद्धलांगूलः कठिनस्कंधबंधनः ॥
verses.rom:
lelihanassanishpesham jihvayoshthau punahpunah|
samrambhaviddhalamgulah kathinaskamdhabamdhanah ||

verses.sa:
उदग्रककुदाभोगप्रमाणो दुरतिक्रमः।
विण्मूत्रलिप्तपृष्ठांगो गवामुद्वेगकारकः ॥
verses.rom:
udagrakakudabhogapramano duratikramah|
vinmutraliptaprishthamgo gavamudvegakarakah ||

verses.sa:
प्रलंबकंठोऽतिमुखस्तरुखातांकिताननः।
पातयन्स गवां गर्भान्दैत्यो वृषभरूपधृक् ॥
verses.rom:
pralambakamtho'timukhastarukhatamkitananah|
patayansa gavam garbhandaityo vrishabharupadhrik ||

verses.sa: सूदयंस्तापसानुग्रो वनानटति यस्सदा ॥
verses.rom: sudayamstapasanugro vananatati yassada ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तमतिघोराक्षमवेक्ष्यातिभयातुराः।
गोपा गोपस्त्रियश्चैव कृष्णकृष्णेति चुक्रुशुः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastamatighorakshamavekshyatibhayaturah|
gopa gopastriyashchaiva krishnakrishneti chukrushuh ||

verses.sa:
सिंहनादं ततश्चक्रे तलशब्दं च केशवः।
तच्छब्दश्रवणाच्चाऽसौ दामोदरमुपाययौ ॥
verses.rom:
simhanadam tatashchakre talashabdam cha keshavah|
tachchhabdashravanachcha'sau damodaramupayayau ||

verses.sa:
अग्रन्यस्तविषाणाग्रः कृष्णकुक्षिकृतेक्षणः ।
अभ्यधावत दुष्टात्मा कृष्णं वृषभदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
agranyastavishanagrah krishnakukshikritekshanah |
abhyadhavata dushtatma krishnam vrishabhadanavah ||

verses.sa:
आयांतं दैत्यवृषभं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णो महाबलः।
न चचाल तदा स्थानादवज्ञास्मितलीलया ॥
verses.rom:
ayamtam daityavrishabham drishtva krishno mahabalah|
na chachala tada sthanadavajnasmitalilaya ||

verses.sa:
आसन्नं चैव जग्राह ग्राहवन्मधुसूदनः।
जघान जानुना कुक्षौ विषाणग्रहणाचलम् ॥
verses.rom:
asannam chaiva jagraha grahavanmadhusudanah|
jaghana januna kukshau vishanagrahanachalam ||

verses.sa:
तस्य दर्पबलं भंक्त्वा गृहीतस्य विषाणयोः।
अपीडयदरिष्टस्य कंठं क्लिन्नमिवांबरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasya darpabalam bhamktva grihitasya vishanayoh|
apidayadarishtasya kamtham klinnamivambaram ||

verses.sa:
उत्पाट्य शृंगमेकं तु तेनैवाताडयत्ततः।
ममार स महादैत्यो मुखाच्छोणितमुद्वमन् ॥
verses.rom:
utpatya shrimgamekam tu tenaivatadayattatah|
mamara sa mahadaityo mukhachchhonitamudvaman ||

verses.sa:
तुष्टुवुर्निहते तस्मिन्दैत्ये गोपा जनार्दनम् ।
जंभे हते सहस्राक्षं पुरा देवगणा यथा ।
इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशे चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom:
tushtuvurnihate tasmindaitye gopa janardanam |
jambhe hate sahasraksham pura devagana yatha |
iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamshe chaturdasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en: One evening whilst Janārddana was engaged in Rāsa, the demon Aristha, disguised as a bull, came there striking terror into the hearts of all. His appearance was like a cloud saturated with waters—his two horns were very sharp and his two eyes were bright like the sun. As he proceeded, he ploughed up the ground with his hoofs: his tongue was repeatedly licking his lips; his tail was erect; the sinews of his shoulders were strong and between them rose a hump of enormous proportions; his haunches were soiled with ordure and he was a dread to the herds; his dewlap hung low and his face was marked with scars from butting against the trees. Terrifying all the kine, and destroying hermits and ascetics that demon, in the guise of a bull, haunts all the forests. Being greatly stricken with fear on beholding that dreadful bull, the cow-herds and their females cried out "Krishna, Krishna". Krishna then shouted and slapped his arms in defiance. When the demon heard the noise, he turned upon his challenger, and fixing his eyes and pointing his horns at the belly of Kesava, he ran furiously upon the youth. Krishna did not stir from his place, but smiling in sport and derision, awaited the near approach of the bull, when he seized him, as an alligator would have done and held him firmly by the horns, whilst he pressed his sides with his knees. Having thus humiliated his pride and held him captive by his horn, he wrung his throat as if it had been a piece of wet cloth; and then tearing off one of the horns, he beat the dreadful demon with it until he died vomiting blood from his mouth. Seeing him slain the herdsmen glorified Krishna, as the companies of the celestials of old praised Indra, when he triumphed over the Asura Jambha.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
ककुद्मति हतेऽरिष्टे धेनुके विनिपातिते ।
प्रलंबे निधनं निधनं नीते धृते गोवर्द्धनाचले ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
kakudmati hate'rishte dhenuke vinipatite |
pralambe nidhanam nidhanam nite dhrite govarddhanachale ||

verses.sa:
दमिते कालिये नागे भग्ने तुंगद्रु मद्वये ।
हतायां पूतनायां च शकटे परिवर्त्तिते ॥
verses.rom:
damite kaliye nage bhagne tumgadru madvaye |
hatayam putanayam cha shakate parivarttite ||

verses.sa:
कंसाय नारदः प्राह यथावृत्तमनुक्रमात् ।
यशोदादेवकीगर्भपरिवृत्ताद्यश्षोतः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsaya naradah praha yathavrittamanukramat |
yashodadevakigarbhaparivrittadyashshotah ||

verses.sa:
श्रुत्वा तत्सकलं कंसो नारदाद्देवदर्शनात् ।
वसुदेवं प्रति तदा कोपं चक्रे सुदुर्मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
shrutva tatsakalam kamso naradaddevadarshanat |
vasudevam prati tada kopam chakre sudurmatih ||

verses.sa:
सोतिकोपादुपालभ्य सर्वयादवसंसदि ।
जगर्ह यादवांश्चैव कार्यं चैतदचिंतयत् ॥
verses.rom:
sotikopadupalabhya sarvayadavasamsadi |
jagarha yadavamshchaiva karyam chaitadachimtayat ||

verses.sa:
यावन्न बलमारूढौ रामकृष्णौ सुबालकौ ।
तावदेव मया वध्यावसाध्यौ रूढयौवनौ ॥
verses.rom:
yavanna balamarudhau ramakrishnau subalakau |
tavadeva maya vadhyavasadhyau rudhayauvanau ||

verses.sa:
चाणूरोत्र महावीर्यो मुष्टिकश्च महाबलः ।
एताभ्यां मल्लयुद्धेन मारयिष्याम दुर्मती ॥
verses.rom:
chanurotra mahaviryo mushtikashcha mahabalah |
etabhyam mallayuddhena marayishyama durmati ||

verses.sa:
धनुर्महमहायोगव्याजेनानीय तौ व्रजात् ।
तथा तथा यतिष्यामि यास्येते संक्षयं यथा ॥
verses.rom:
dhanurmahamahayogavyajenaniya tau vrajat |
tatha tatha yatishyami yasyete samkshayam yatha ||

verses.sa:
श्वफल्कतनयं शूरमक्रूरं यदुपुंगवम् ।
तयोरानयनार्थाय प्रेषयिष्यामि गोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
shvaphalkatanayam shuramakruram yadupumgavam |
tayoranayanarthaya preshayishyami gokulam ||

verses.sa:
वृंदावनचरं घोरमादेक्ष्यामि च केशिनम् ।
तत्रैवासावतिबलस्तावुभौ घातयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vrimdavanacharam ghoramadekshyami cha keshinam |
tatraivasavatibalastavubhau ghatayishyati ||

verses.sa:
गजः कुवलायापीडो मत्सकाशमिहागतौ ।
घातयिष्यति वा गोपौ वसुदेवसुतावुभौ ॥
verses.rom:
gajah kuvalayapido matsakashamihagatau |
ghatayishyati va gopau vasudevasutavubhau ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्यालोच्य स दुष्टात्मा कंसो रामजनार्दनौ ।
हंतुं कृतमर्तिवीरावक्रूरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityalochya sa dushtatma kamso ramajanardanau |
hamtum kritamartiviravakruram vakyamabravit ||

verses.sa:
कंस उवाच।
भो भो दानपते वाक्यं क्रियतां प्रीतये मम ।
इतः स्यंदनमारुह्य गम्यतां नंदगोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
kamsa uvacha|
bho bho danapate vakyam kriyatam pritaye mama |
itah syamdanamaruhya gamyatam namdagokulam ||

verses.sa:
वसुदेव सुतौ तत्र विषणोरंशसमुद्भवौ ।
नाशाय किल संभूतौ मम दुष्टौ प्रवर्द्धतः ॥
verses.rom:
vasudeva sutau tatra vishanoramshasamudbhavau |
nashaya kila sambhutau mama dushtau pravarddhatah ||

verses.sa:
धनुर्महो ममाप्यत्र चतुर्दश्यां भविष्यति ।
आनेयौ भवता गत्वा मल्लयुद्धाय तत्र तौ ॥
verses.rom:
dhanurmaho mamapyatra chaturdashyam bhavishyati |
aneyau bhavata gatva mallayuddhaya tatra tau ||

verses.sa:
चाणूरमुष्टिकौ मल्लौ नियुद्धकुशलौ मम ।
ताभ्यां सहानयोर्युद्धं सर्वलोकोऽत्र पश्यतु ॥
verses.rom:
chanuramushtikau mallau niyuddhakushalau mama |
tabhyam sahanayoryuddham sarvaloko'tra pashyatu ||

verses.sa:
गजः कुवलयापीडो महामात्रप्रचोदितः ।
स वा हनिष्यते पापौ वसुदेवात्मजौ शिशू ॥
verses.rom:
gajah kuvalayapido mahamatraprachoditah |
sa va hanishyate papau vasudevatmajau shishu ||

verses.sa:
तौ हत्वा वसुदेवं च नंदगोपं च दुर्मतिम् ।
हनिष्ये पितरं चैनमुग्रसेनं सुदुर्मतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tau hatva vasudevam cha namdagopam cha durmatim |
hanishye pitaram chainamugrasenam sudurmatim ||

verses.sa:
ततस्समस्तगोपानां गोधनान्यखिलान्यहम् ।
वित्तं चापहरिष्यामि दुष्टानां मद्वधैषिणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatassamastagopanam godhananyakhilanyaham |
vittam chapaharishyami dushtanam madvadhaishinam ||

verses.sa:
त्वामृते यादवाश्चैते द्विषो दानपते मम ।
एतेषां च वधायाहं यतिष्येऽनुक्रमात्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamrite yadavashchaite dvisho danapate mama |
etesham cha vadhayaham yatishye'nukramattatah ||

verses.sa:
तदा निष्कंटकं सर्वं राज्यमेतदयादवम् ।
प्रसाधिष्ये त्वया तस्मान्मत्प्रीत्यै वीर गम्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tada nishkamtakam sarvam rajyametadayadavam |
prasadhishye tvaya tasmanmatprityai vira gamyatam ||

verses.sa:
यथा च माहिषं सर्पिर्दधिचाप्युपहार्य वै ।
गोपास्समानयंत्वाशु तथा वाच्यास्त्वया च ते ॥
verses.rom:
yatha cha mahisham sarpirdadhichapyupaharya vai |
gopassamanayamtvashu tatha vachyastvaya cha te ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्याज्ञप्तस्तदाऽक्रूरो महाभागवतो द्विज ।
प्रीतिमानभवत्कृष्णं श्वो द्रक्ष्यामीति सत्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityajnaptastada'kruro mahabhagavato dvija |
pritimanabhavatkrishnam shvo drakshyamiti satvarah ||

verses.sa:
तथेत्युक्त्वा च राजानं रथमारुह्य शोभनम् ।
निश्चक्राम ततः पुर्य्या मथुराया मधुप्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
tathetyuktva cha rajanam rathamaruhya shobhanam |
nishchakrama tatah puryya mathuraya madhupriyah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशे पंचदशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamshe pamchadasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
After these things had happened, Aristha, the bull demon and Dhenuka and Pralamba had been destroyed, Govardhana had been uplifted, the serpent Kailya had been vanquished, the two trees had been broken, the female fiend Putanā had been destroyed and the wagon had been overturned, Nārada went to Kansa and related to him the whole, beginning with the transference of the child from Devaki to Yosadā. Hearing this from Nārada, Kansa was greatly enraged with Vasudeva and remonstrated with him hard, and with all the Yadavas in an assembly of the race. Then thinking what was to be done he determined to destroy both Krishna and Rāma whilist they were yet young and before they had attained to man-hood. Accordingly he made up his mind, to invite them from Vraja under the plea of the solemn rite of the lustration of arms, when he would engage them in a trial of strength with his chief boxers Chānura and Mushtika, by whom they would undoubtedly be slain. "I will send" he said "the noble Akrura, the son of Swapalka to Gokula to bring them hither. I will order the dreadful Kesin, who frequents the forest of Vrindavan, to attack him, and he is of unequalled prowess and will, for certain, kill them; or if they come here, my elephant Kuvalayapida shall trample to death these two cow-boy sons of Vasudeva". Having thus planned to kill Rāma and Janārddana, the vicious Kansa sent for the heroic Akrura and said to him, "O master of liberal gifts, hear my words: and out of friendship for me perform my orders. Ascend your chariot and go to the house of the milkman Nanda. The two vicious boys, portions of Vishnu, have been born there, for the very object of bringing about my destruction. On the fourteenth lunation I intend celebrating the rite of the lustration of arms. I wish them to be brought here by you to take part in the games and that the people may behold them engage in a boxing match with my too skilled boxers Chānura and Mushtika; or by chance, my elephant, driven against them by his rider, shall destroy these vicious youngsters—the sons of Vasudeva. When they are out of the way, I shall kill Vasudeva himself, the cow-herds and my foolish father Ugrasena and I will get there by the flocks, herds and all the properties of the rebelious cow-herds who have ever been inimical to me. Save thou, lord of liberality, all the Yadavas have been my enemies and I will find out means for their destruction; and I shall then govern my kingdom with thee without any disturbance. If you regard me, do thou go as I direct thee; and thou shalt command the cow-herds to bring in speedily their supplies of milk and butter and curds".

Being thus advised the illustrious Akrura the immediately undertook to see Krishna and ascending his magnificent chariot he went, out from the city of Mathura.

verses.sa:
।
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
केशी चापि बलोदग्रः कंसदूतः प्रचोदितः ।
कृष्णस्य निधनाकांक्षी वृंदावनमुपागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
|
shriparashara uvacha |
keshi chapi balodagrah kamsadutah prachoditah |
krishnasya nidhanakamkshi vrimdavanamupagamat ||

verses.sa:
स खुरक्षतभूपृष्ठस्सटाक्षेपधुतांबुदः ।
द्रुतविक्रांतचंद्रार्कमार्गो गोपानुपाद्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa khurakshatabhuprishthassatakshepadhutambudah |
drutavikramtachamdrarkamargo gopanupadravat ||

verses.sa:
तस्य हेषितशब्देन गोपाला दैत्यवाजिनः ।
गोप्यश्च भयसंविग्ना गोविंदं शरणं ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
tasya heshitashabdena gopala daityavajinah |
gopyashcha bhayasamvigna govimdam sharanam yayuh ||

verses.sa:
त्राहित्राहीति गोविंदः श्रुत्वा तेषां ततो वचः ।
सतोयजलदध्वानगंभीरमिदमुक्तवान् ॥
verses.rom:
trahitrahiti govimdah shrutva tesham tato vachah |
satoyajaladadhvanagambhiramidamuktavan ||

verses.sa:
अलं त्रासेन गोपालाः केशिनः किं भयातुरैः ।
भवद्भिर्गोपजातीयैर्वीरवीर्यं विलोप्यते ॥
verses.rom:
alam trasena gopalah keshinah kim bhayaturaih |
bhavadbhirgopajatiyairviraviryam vilopyate ||

verses.sa:
किमनेनाल्पसारेण हेषिताटोपकारिणा ।
दैतेयबलवाह्येन वल्गता दुष्टवाजिना ॥
verses.rom:
kimanenalpasarena heshitatopakarina |
daiteyabalavahyena valgata dushtavajina ||

verses.sa:
एह्येहि दुष्ट कृष्णोऽहं पूष्णस्त्विव पिनाकधृत् ।
पातयिष्यामि दशनान्वदनादखिलांस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
ehyehi dushta krishno'ham pushnastviva pinakadhrit |
patayishyami dashananvadanadakhilamstava ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वाऽस्फोट्य गोविंदः केशिनस्संमुखं ययौ ।
विवृतास्यश्च सोप्येनं दैतेयाश्व उपाद्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva'sphotya govimdah keshinassammukham yayau |
vivritasyashcha sopyenam daiteyashva upadravat ||

verses.sa:
बाहुमाभोगिनं कृत्वा मुखे तस्य जनार्दनः ।
प्रवेशयामास तदा केशिनो दुष्टवाजिनः ॥
verses.rom:
bahumabhoginam kritva mukhe tasya janardanah |
praveshayamasa tada keshino dushtavajinah ||

verses.sa:
केशिनो वदनं तेन विशता कृष्णबाहुना ।
शातिता दशनाः पेतुः सिताब्भ्रावयवा इव ॥
verses.rom:
keshino vadanam tena vishata krishnabahuna |
shatita dashanah petuh sitabbhravayava iva ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णस्य ववृधे बाहुः केशिदेहगतो द्विज ।
विनाशाय यथा व्याधिरासंभूतेरुपेक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnasya vavridhe bahuh keshidehagato dvija |
vinashaya yatha vyadhirasambhuterupekshitah ||

verses.sa:
विपाटितोष्ठो बहुलं सफेनं रुधिरं वमन् ।
सोक्षिणी विवृते चक्रे विशिष्टे मुक्तबंधने ॥
verses.rom:
vipatitoshtho bahulam saphenam rudhiram vaman |
sokshini vivrite chakre vishishte muktabamdhane ||

verses.sa:
जघान धरणीं पादैश्शकृन्मूत्रं समुत्सृजन् ।
स्वेदार्द्र गात्रश्शांतश्च निर्यत्नस्सोऽभवत्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
jaghana dharanim padaishshakrinmutram samutsrijan |
svedardra gatrashshamtashcha niryatnasso'bhavattada ||

verses.sa:
व्यादितास्यमहारंध्रस्सोऽसुरः कृष्णबाहुना ।
निपातितो द्विधा भूमौ वैद्युतेन यथा द्रुमः ॥
verses.rom:
vyaditasyamaharamdhrasso'surah krishnabahuna |
nipatito dvidha bhumau vaidyutena yatha drumah ||

verses.sa:
द्विपादे पृष्ठपुच्छार्द्धे श्रवणैकाक्षिनासिके ।
केशिनस्ते द्विधा भूते शकले द्वे विरेजतुः ॥
verses.rom:
dvipade prishthapuchchharddhe shravanaikakshinasike |
keshinaste dvidha bhute shakale dve virejatuh ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा तु केशिनं कृष्णो गोपलैर्मुदितैर्वृतः ।
अनायस्ततनुस्स्वस्थो हसंस्तत्रैव तस्थिवान् ॥
verses.rom:
hatva tu keshinam krishno gopalairmuditairvritah |
anayastatanussvastho hasamstatraiva tasthivan ||

verses.sa:
ततो गोप्यश्च गोपाश्च हते केशिनि विस्मिताः ।
तुष्टुवुः पुंडरीकाक्षमनुरागमनोरमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato gopyashcha gopashcha hate keshini vismitah |
tushtuvuh pumdarikakshamanuragamanoramam ||

verses.sa:
अथाहांतर्हितो विप्र नारदो जलदे स्थितः ।
केशिनं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हर्षनिर्भरमानसः ॥
verses.rom:
athahamtarhito vipra narado jalade sthitah |
keshinam nihatam drishtva harshanirbharamanasah ||

verses.sa:
साधुसाधु जगन्नाथ लीलयैव यदच्युत ।
निहतोऽयं त्वया केशी क्लेशदस्त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sadhusadhu jagannatha lilayaiva yadachyuta |
nihato'yam tvaya keshi kleshadastridivaukasam ||

verses.sa:
युद्धोत्सुकोहमत्यर्थं नरवाजिमहाहवम् ।
अभूतपूर्वमन्यत्र द्रष्टुं स्वर्गादिहागतः ॥
verses.rom:
yuddhotsukohamatyartham naravajimahahavam |
abhutapurvamanyatra drashtum svargadihagatah ||

verses.sa:
कर्माण्यऽत्रावतारे ते कृतानि मधुसूदन ।
यानि तैर्विस्मितं चेतस्तोषमेतेन मे गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
karmanya'travatare te kritani madhusudana |
yani tairvismitam chetastoshametena me gatam ||

verses.sa:
तुरंगस्यास्य शक्रोपि कृष्ण देवाश्च बिभ्यति ।
धुतकेसरजालस्य ह्रेषतोऽभ्रावलोकिनः ॥
verses.rom:
turamgasyasya shakropi krishna devashcha bibhyati |
dhutakesarajalasya hreshato'bhravalokinah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मात्त्वयैष दुष्टात्मा हतः केशी जनार्दन ।
तस्मात्केशवनाम्ना त्वं लोके ख्यातो भविष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
yasmattvayaisha dushtatma hatah keshi janardana |
tasmatkeshavanamna tvam loke khyato bhavishyasi ||

verses.sa:
स्वस्त्यस्तु ते गमिष्यामि कंसयुद्धेऽधुना पुनः ।
परश्वोऽहं समेष्यामि त्वया केशिनिषूदन ॥
verses.rom:
svastyastu te gamishyami kamsayuddhe'dhuna punah |
parashvo'ham sameshyami tvaya keshinishudana ||

verses.sa:
उग्रसेनसुते कंसे सानुगे विनिपातिते ।
भारावतारकर्त्ता त्वं पृथिव्या पृथिवीधर ॥
verses.rom:
ugrasenasute kamse sanuge vinipatite |
bharavatarakartta tvam prithivya prithividhara ||

verses.sa:
तत्रानेकप्रकाराणि युद्धानि पृथिवीक्षिताम् ।
द्रष्टव्यानि मया युष्मत्प्रणीतानि जनार्दन ॥
verses.rom:
tatranekaprakarani yuddhani prithivikshitam |
drashtavyani maya yushmatpranitani janardana ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं यास्यामि गोविंद देवकार्यं महत्कृतम् ।
त्वयैव विदितं सर्वं स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु व्रजाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham yasyami govimda devakaryam mahatkritam |
tvayaiva viditam sarvam svasti te'stu vrajamyaham ||

verses.sa:
नारदे गते कृष्णस्सह गोपैस्सभाजितः ।
विवेश गोकुलं गोपीनेत्रपानैकभाजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
narade gate krishnassaha gopaissabhajitah |
vivesha gokulam gopinetrapanaikabhajanam ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुाहापुराणे पंचमांशो! षोडशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnuahapurane pamchamamsho! shodasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en: Parāçara said:—Being commissioned by Kansa's emissary, Kesin, elated with the confidence of his prowess, reached Vrindavana, being desirous of bringing about the destruction of Krishna. He assailed the cow-herds, spurning the ground with his hoofs, scattering the clouds with his mane and obstructing the paths of the sun and the moon. Being terrified by the neighings of the demon, assuming the shape of a steed, the cow-herds and their females fled to Govinda for shelter exclaiming "Save us! Save us!!" Hearing their cries, Govinda replied in a voice deep as the roaring of the thunder cloud. Srikrishna said: "Away with the fears of Keshin, O cowherds; being born as Gopals, why do you destroy my valour and heroism? Why are you afraid of one of such little might whose neighings are his only terrors, a galloping and vicious horse who is ridden by the strength of Daityas? Come on, wretch. I am Krishna and I will knock all thy teeth down thy throat, as the wielder of trident did to Pushan". Thus defying him, Govinda went to fight with Kesin. The demon with his mouth wide open, ran upon Krishna. But Krishna, enlarging his arms, thrust it into his mouth and knocked down the teeth which fell from his jaws like fragments of white clouds. Still the arm of Krishna in the throat of Krishna continued to enlarge, as a disease, neglected in the beginning, increasing till the dissolution. The torn lips of the demon vomitted forth foam and blood; his eyes rolled in affliction; his joints gave way; he struck the earth with his feet; his body was covered with perspiration and he became incapable of any exertion. Having his mouths rent open by the arm of Krishna, that dreadful demon fell down like a tree struck and shattered by lightning, divided into two portions. Each of those portions had two legs, half a back, half a tail, one ear, one eye and one nostril. Krishna stood, unhurt and smiling after the destruction of the demons encircled by the cow-herd, who, together with their females, were filled with surprise at the death of Kesin and glorified the lotus-eyed deity. Beholding the destruction of Kesin, the Brāhmin Nārada, invisible and seated in a cloud, delightedly exclaimed—"Well done, O lord of the universe who has easily destroyed Kesin, the oppresser of the celestials. I have never heard of such a combat between a man and a horse; being curious to behold it, I have come from heaven. My heart is filled with joy and surprise, O slayer of Madhu, on beholding the wonderful works thou hast done in thy descent upon earth. O Krishna Indra and other celestials lived in fear of this horse, who tossed his mane and neighed and looked down upon the clouds, Because thou hast slain the impious Kesin thou shalt be celebrated in the world by the name of Kesava. Farewell! I will now go. I shall meet thee again, O subduer of Kesin, in two days more, when thou shalt be engaged in a conflict with Kansa, When the son of Ugrasena, with his follwers shall have been slain, then, O upholder of the earth earth's burden will have been lightened by thee. Many are the battles of the kings that have to see, in which thou shalt be renowned; I will now go away, O Govinda. Thou hast accomplished a great deed admired by the celestials, I have been much pleased with thee and take my leave". When Nārada had departed, Krishna, who was the cynosure of the eyes of the damsels of Vraja, not the least surprised, went back with the cow-herds to Gokula.

verses.sa:
अक्रूरोऽपि विनिष्कम्य स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना ।
कृष्णसन्दर्शनायैकः प्रययौ नन्दगोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
akruro'pi vinishkamya syandanenashugamina |
krishnasandarshanayaikah prayayau nandagokulam ||

verses.sa:
चिन्तयामास चाक्रूरो नास्ति धन्यतरो मया ।
योऽहमंशावतीर्णास्य मुखं द्रक्ष्यामि चक्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
chintayamasa chakruro nasti dhanyataro maya |
yo'hamamshavatirnasya mukham drakshyami chakrinah ||

verses.sa:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सुप्रभाता च मे निशा ।
यदुन्नदाब्जपत्राक्षं विष्णोद्र क्ष्याम्यहं मुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
adya me saphalam janma suprabhata cha me nisha |
yadunnadabjapatraksham vishnodra kshyamyaham mukham ||

verses.sa:
अद्य मे सफले नेत्रे अद्य मे सफला गिरः ।
यन्मे परस्परालापो दृष्ट्वां विष्णुं भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
adya me saphale netre adya me saphala girah |
yanme parasparalapo drishtvam vishnum bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
पापं हरति यत् पुंसां स्मृतं सङ्कल्पनामयम् ।
तत् पुण्डरीकनयनं विष्णोद्र क्ष्याम्यहं मुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
papam harati yat pumsam smritam sankalpanamayam |
tat pundarikanayanam vishnodra kshyamyaham mukham ||

verses.sa:
निर्जग्मुश्व यतो वेदा वेदाङ्गन्यखिलानि च ।
द्रक्ष्यामि तत्प्रं धाम धाम्रां भगवतो मुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirjagmushva yato veda vedanganyakhilani cha |
drakshyami tatpram dhama dhamram bhagavato mukham ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञेषु यज्ञपुरुषः पुरुषैः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
इच्यते योऽखिलाधारस्तं द्रक्ष्यामि जगत्पातिम ॥
verses.rom:
yajneshu yajnapurushah purushaih purushottamah |
ichyate yo'khiladharastam drakshyami jagatpatima ||

verses.sa:
इष्ट्वा यमिन्द्रो यज्ञानां शतेनामरराजताम् ।
अवाप तमन्नादिमहं द्रक्ष्यामि केशवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishtva yamindro yajnanam shatenamararajatam |
avapa tamannadimaham drakshyami keshavam ||

verses.sa:
न ब्रह्मा नेन्द्र-रुद्रा-श्वि-वस्वा-दित्य-मरुदूगणाः ।
यस्य स्वरूपं जानन्ति स्प्रक्ष्यत्यङ्ग स मे हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
na brahma nendra-rudra-shvi-vasva-ditya-maruduganah |
yasya svarupam jananti sprakshyatyanga sa me harih ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वात्मा सर्व्ववित् सर्व्वः सर्व्वभूतेष्ववस्थितः ।
यो वितत्यात्ययो व्यापी स वक्ष्यति मया सह ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvatma sarvvavit sarvvah sarvvabhuteshvavasthitah |
yo vitatyatyayo vyapi sa vakshyati maya saha ||

verses.sa:
मत्स्य-कूर्म-पराहा-श्व-सिंहरूपादिभिः स्थितिम् ।
चकार जगतो योऽजः सोऽद्य मामालपिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
matsya-kurma-paraha-shva-simharupadibhih sthitim |
chakara jagato yo'jah so'dya mamalapishyati ||

verses.sa:
साम्प्रतञ्च जगत्स्वामी कार्य्यमात्मह्टदि स्थितम् ।
कर्त्तु मनुष्यतां प्राप्तः स्वेच्छादेहधृगव्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
sampratancha jagatsvami karyyamatmahtadi sthitam |
karttu manushyatam praptah svechchhadehadhrigavyayah ||

verses.sa:
योऽनन्तः पृथिवीं धत्ते शेखरस्थितिसंस्थिताम् ।
सोऽवतीर्णो जगत्यर्थे मामक्रूरेति वक्ष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yo'nantah prithivim dhatte shekharasthitisamsthitam |
so'vatirno jagatyarthe mamakrureti vakshyati ||

verses.sa:
पितृ-पुत्र-सुह्टदू-भ्रातृ-मातृ-बन्धुमयीमिमाम् ।
यन्मायां नालमुत्तर्त्तु जगत् नमो नमः ॥
verses.rom:
pitri-putra-suhtadu-bhratri-matri-bandhumayimimam |
yanmayam nalamuttarttu jagat namo namah ||

verses.sa:
तरत्यविद्यां विततां ह्टदि यस्मिन् निवेशिते ।
योगी मायाममेयाय तस्मै विद्यात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
taratyavidyam vitatam htadi yasmin niveshite |
yogi mayamameyaya tasmai vidyatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
यज्विभिर्यज्ञपुरुषो वासुदेवश्व सात्वतैः ।
वेदान्तवेदिभिर्विष्णुः प्रोच्यते यो नतोऽस्मि तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajvibhiryajnapurusho vasudevashva satvataih |
vedantavedibhirvishnuh prochyate yo nato'smi tam ||

verses.sa:
यथा तत्र जगद्धाम्रि धातर्य्योतत् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
सदसत् तेन सत्येन मय्यसौ यातु सौम्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha tatra jagaddhamri dhataryyotat pratishthitam |
sadasat tena satyena mayyasau yatu saumyatam ||

verses.sa:
स्मृते सकलकल्याण-भाजनं यत्र जायते ।
पुरुषस्तमजं नित्यं व्रजामि शरणं हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
smrite sakalakalyana-bhajanam yatra jayate |
purushastamajam nityam vrajami sharanam harim ||

verses.sa:
इत्थं सञ्चिन्तयन् विष्णु भक्तिनम्रात्ममानसः ।
अक्रूरो गोकुल प्राप्तः किञ्चित् सूर्य्ये विराजति ॥
verses.rom:
ittham sanchintayan vishnu bhaktinamratmamanasah |
akruro gokula praptah kinchit suryye virajati ||

verses.sa:
स ददर्श तदा तत्र कृष्णामादोहने गवाम् ।
वत्समध्यगतं फुल्लनीलोतूपलदलच्छविम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa dadarsha tada tatra krishnamadohane gavam |
vatsamadhyagatam phullanilotupaladalachchhavim ||

verses.sa:
अस्पष्टपद्मपत्राक्षं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम ।
प्रलम्बबाहुमायामि-तुङ्गोरःस्थलमुन्नसम् ॥
verses.rom:
aspashtapadmapatraksham shrivatsankitavakshasama |
pralambabahumayami-tungorahsthalamunnasam ||

verses.sa:
सविलासस्मिताधारं ब्रिभ्राणं मुखपङ्कजम् ।
तुङ्गरक्तनखं पद्भयां धरण्यां सुप्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
savilasasmitadharam bribhranam mukhapankajam |
tungaraktanakham padbhayam dharanyam supratishthitam ||

verses.sa:
विभ्राणं वाससी पीते वन्यपुष्पावभूषितम् ।
साद्रनीललताहस्तं सिताम्भोजावतंसकम् ॥
verses.rom:
vibhranam vasasi pite vanyapushpavabhushitam |
sadranilalatahastam sitambhojavatamsakam ||

verses.sa:
हंसकुन्देन्दुधवल नीलाम्बरधरं द्रिज!
तस्यानु बलभद्रञ्च ददर्श यदुनन्दनम् ॥
verses.rom:
hamsakundendudhavala nilambaradharam drija!
tasyanu balabhadrancha dadarsha yadunandanam ||

verses.sa:
प्राशुमुन्नतबाह्व सं विकाशिमुखपङ्कजम् ।
मेघमालापरिवृतं कैलासद्रिमिवापरम् ॥
verses.rom:
prashumunnatabahva sam vikashimukhapankajam |
meghamalaparivritam kailasadrimivaparam ||

verses.sa:
तौ दृष्ट्वा विकसदूक्तसरोजः स महामतिः ।
पुलकाञ्चितसर्व्वाङ्गस्तदाक्रू रोऽभवन्मुने ॥
verses.rom:
tau drishtva vikasaduktasarojah sa mahamatih |
pulakanchitasarvvangastadakru ro'bhavanmune ||

verses.sa:
एतत् तत् परमं घाम तदेतत् परमं पदम् ।
भगवद्रासुदेवांशो द्रिधा योऽयमवस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
etat tat paramam ghama tadetat paramam padam |
bhagavadrasudevamsho dridha yo'yamavasthitah ||

verses.sa:
साफल्यमक्ष्णोर्युगमेतदत्र दृष्टे जगद्धातरि यातमुच्चेः ।
अप्यङ्गमेतदू भगवतूप्रसादांदू दत्तेऽङ्गसङ्ग फलवन्मम स्यात ॥
verses.rom:
saphalyamakshnoryugametadatra drishte jagaddhatari yatamuchcheh |
apyangametadu bhagavatuprasadamdu datte'ngasanga phalavanmama syata ||

verses.sa:
अप्येष पूष्ठे मम हस्तपद्म करिष्यति श्रीमदनन्तमूर्त्तिः ।
यस्याङ्ग लिस्पर्शहताखिलाघैखाप्यते सिद्धिरनाशदोषा ॥
verses.rom:
apyesha pushthe mama hastapadma karishyati shrimadanantamurttih |
yasyanga lisparshahatakhilaghaikhapyate siddhiranashadosha ||

verses.sa: येनाग्रिविद्यु दूरविरश्मिमाला करालमत्युग्रनानां नयनाञ्जनानि ॥
verses.rom: yenagrividyu duravirashmimala karalamatyugrananam nayananjanani ||

verses.sa:
यत्राम्बु विन्यस्य बलिर्म्मनोज्ञा नवाप भोगान् वसुधातलस्थः ।
तथामरत्वं त्रिदशाधिपत्यं मन्वन्तरं पूर्णमपेतशत्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatrambu vinyasya balirmmanojna navapa bhogan vasudhatalasthah |
tathamaratvam tridashadhipatyam manvantaram purnamapetashatruh ||

verses.sa:
अप्येष मां कंसपरिग्रहेण दोषास्पदीभूतमदोषदुष्टम् ।
कर्त्तावमानोपहतं धिगस्तु तज्जन्मनः साधुबहिष्कृतं यत् ॥
verses.rom:
apyesha mam kamsaparigrahena doshaspadibhutamadoshadushtam |
karttavamanopahatam dhigastu tajjanmanah sadhubahishkritam yat ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानात्मकस्यामलसत्त्वराशेरपेतदोषस्य सदा स्फुटस्य
किं वा जगत्यत्र समस्तपुंसामज्ञातमस्यास्ति ह्टदि स्थितस्य ॥
verses.rom:
jnanatmakasyamalasattvarasherapetadoshasya sada sphutasya
kim va jagatyatra samastapumsamajnatamasyasti htadi sthitasya ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादहं भक्तिविनम्रचेता व्रजामि सर्व्वेश्वरमीश्वराणाम् ।
अंशावतारं पुरुषोत्तमस्य अनादिमध्यान्तमयस्य विष्णोः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadaham bhaktivinamracheta vrajami sarvveshvaramishvaranam |
amshavataram purushottamasya anadimadhyantamayasya vishnoh ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Having issued out of the house of Kansa, Akrurā being desirous of seeing Krishna, proceeded towards the house of Nanda in a swift-coursing car. He thought within himself. "There is none more fortunate than I, for I shall behold the countenance of a portion of the holder of discus. To-day my life has borne fruit, my night is followed by the dawn of day, for I shall behold the countenance of Vishnu resembling full-blown lotuses. Blessed are my eyes and blessed are my words, for on beholding Vishnu a conversation shall take place between him and me. I shall behold the countenance of Vishnu having lotus eyes, which, when seen only in imagination, removes all sins. I shall behold to-day the mouth of Vishnu—the glory of glories, whence proceeded the Vedas and all their divisions. I shall behold the lord of the universe by whom the world is sustained, who is worshipped as the best Purusha and as the male of sacrifice in sacrificial rites. I shall behold Keseva, who is without beginning or end, by worshipping whom with a hundred sacrifices, Indra obtained the sovereignty over the celestials. That Hari, whose nature is unknown to Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, the Aswins, the Vasus, the Adityas and Maruts, will this day touch my body. He, who is the soul of all omniscient, is identical with everything, omnipresent, permanent, undecaying, all-pervading, shall converse with me. He, the unborn, who has preserved the world in diverse forms of a fish, a tortoise, a boar, a horse, a lion, will this day talk with me. The lord of the universe, who assumes shapes at will, has taken upon him the condition of humanity to satisfy some object of his heart. The endless, who holds the earth upon his crest and who has descended upon earth for its protection, will this day call me by my name. Glory to that being, whose deceptive adoption of father, son, brother, friend, mother, and relative, the world is unable to comprehend. Salutation unto him, who is identical with true knowledge, who is inscrutable and through whom, when seated in his heart the ascetic gets over the worldly ignorance and illusion, I bow to him, who, by the performers of holy rites, is denominated Yajnapurusha (the male of a sacrifice), Vāsudeva, by the devotees and Vishnu by the adepts in Vedānta philosophy. May he, who comprises in himself, cause and effect and the world itself, be pleased with me, through his truth, for I always confide in that unborn and eternal Hari, by meditating on whom man becomes the repository of all auspicious things".

Parāçara said:—Thus meditating upon Vishnu, Akrura, having his mind animated by devout faith, reached Gokula a little before sun-set; and there he beheld Krishna amongst the cattle, dark as the leaf of the full-blown lotus; his eyes of the same colour and his breast adorned with Srivatsa mark; long-armed, broad-chested; having a high nose, a graceful countenance with smiles; treading firmly on the ground with feet whose nails were tinted red; dressed in yellow raiments and be-decked with a garland of forest flowers; having a creeper just collected in his hands, and a chaplet of white lotus-flowers on his head. Akrura also saw there Balabhadra, white as a jasmine, a swan or the moon dressed in a blue dress; having large and mighty arms and a countenance as radiant as a blue lotus, like the Kailāsa mountain adorned with a wreath of clouds.

When Akrura, beheld these two young men, his countenance expanded with joy and the down of his body stood erect with delight. And he thought—"This is the supreme happiness and repository; this the double manifestation of the divine Vāsudeva; blessed are my eyes for I have seen the protector of the universe and my bodily form shall yield fruit, when by the favour of the deity it shall come in contact with his person. Shall that assumer of infinite forms place his hand on my back by the touch of whose fingers alone all sins are dispelled and imperishable, felicity is secured. And by this hand holding the fierce irresistible discus blazing with all the flames of fire, lightning, and the sun, were slain the Daitya chiefs, and the collyrium from the eyes of their females was washed. Into this hand Bali poured water and obtained enjoyments in the region under the earth and immortality and dominion over the celestials for a whole Manwantara without danger from any enemy. Although I am not sinful, perhaps he will despise me for my connection with the vicious Kansa. If so, cursed is my birth who is counted amongst the wicked. What is there unknown to him who resides in the hearts of all men, who is ever existent, freed from imperfection, the aggregate of the quality of purity and at one with true knowledge? With a heart animated with devout faith I approach the lord of lords, the descended portion of that excellent Purusha, Vishnu, who his without beginning, middle or end".

verses.sa:
चिन्तयन्निति गोविन्दमुपागम्य स यादवः ।
अक्रूरोऽस्मीति चरणौ ननाम शिरसा हरेः ॥
verses.rom:
chintayanniti govindamupagamya sa yadavah |
akruro'smiti charanau nanama shirasa hareh ||

verses.sa:
सोऽप्येनं ध्वजवज्राब्ज-कृतचिह्नने पाणिना ।
संस्पृश्याकृष्य च प्रीत्या सुगाढं परिषस्वजे ॥
verses.rom:
so'pyenam dhvajavajrabja-kritachihnane panina |
samsprishyakrishya cha pritya sugadham parishasvaje ||

verses.sa:
कृतसंवादनौ तेन यथावदू बल-केशवौ ।
ततः प्रविष्टौ संह्टष्टौ तमादायात्ममन्दिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
kritasamvadanau tena yathavadu bala-keshavau |
tatah pravishtau samhtashtau tamadayatmamandiram ||

verses.sa:
सह ताभ्यां तदाक्रूरः कृतसंवादनादिकः ।
भुक्तभोज्यो यथान्यायमाचचक्षे ततस्तयोः ॥
verses.rom:
saha tabhyam tadakrurah kritasamvadanadikah |
bhuktabhojyo yathanyayamachachakshe tatastayoh ||

verses.sa:
यथा निर्भर्तूस्यते तेन कसेनानकदुन्दुभिः ।
यथा च देवकी देवी दानवेन दुरात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
yatha nirbhartusyate tena kasenanakadundubhih |
yatha cha devaki devi danavena duratmana ||

verses.sa:
उग्रसेने यथा कंसः सुदुरात्मा च वर्त्तते।
यं चैवार्थं समुद्दिश्य स ससेन विसर्ज्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
ugrasene yatha kamsah suduratma cha varttate|
yam chaivartham samuddishya sa sasena visarjjitah ||

verses.sa:
तत् सर्व्वं विस्तराच्छ्रु त्वा भगवान् केशिसूदनः ।
उवाचाखिलमप्येतजूज्ञातं दानपते!मया ॥
verses.rom:
tat sarvvam vistarachchhru tva bhagavan keshisudanah |
uvachakhilamapyetajujnatam danapate!maya ||

verses.sa:
करिष्ये च महाभाग!यदत्रौपयिकं मतम् ।
विचिन्त्यं नान्यथैतत् ते विद्धि कंसं हतं मया ॥
verses.rom:
karishye cha mahabhaga!yadatraupayikam matam |
vichintyam nanyathaitat te viddhi kamsam hatam maya ||

verses.sa:
अहं रामश्व मथुरा श्वो यास्यावः समं त्वया ।
गोपवृद्धाश्व यास्यन्ति आदायोपायनं बहु ॥
verses.rom:
aham ramashva mathura shvo yasyavah samam tvaya |
gopavriddhashva yasyanti adayopayanam bahu ||

verses.sa:
निशेयं नीयतां वीर!न चिन्तां कर्त्तुमर्हसि ।
त्रिरात्राभ्यन्तरे कंसं हनिष्यामि सहानुगम ॥
verses.rom:
nisheyam niyatam vira!na chintam karttumarhasi |
triratrabhyantare kamsam hanishyami sahanugama ||

verses.sa:
समादिश्य ततो गोपानक्रु रोऽपि सकेशवः ।
सुष्वाप बलभद्रश्व नन्दगोपगृहे सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
samadishya tato gopanakru ro'pi sakeshavah |
sushvapa balabhadrashva nandagopagrihe sukham ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रभाते विमले कृष्ण-रामौ महामती ।
अक्रूरेण समं गन्तुमुद्यतौ मथुरां प्रित ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabhate vimale krishna-ramau mahamati |
akrurena samam gantumudyatau mathuram prita ||

verses.sa:
दृष्ट्वा गोपीजनः सास्त्रः श्लथदूवलयबाहुकः ।
निः श्वस्य चातिदुः खार्त्तः प्राह चेदं परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
drishtva gopijanah sastrah shlathaduvalayabahukah |
nih shvasya chatiduh kharttah praha chedam parasparam ||

verses.sa:
मथुरां प्राप्य गोविन्दः कथं गोकुलमेष्यति ।
नागरस्त्री-कलालापमधु श्रोत्रेण पास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
mathuram prapya govindah katham gokulameshyati |
nagarastri-kalalapamadhu shrotrena pasyati ||

verses.sa:
विलासिवाक्यपानेषु नागरीणां कृतास्पदम् ।
चित्तमस्य कथ भूयो ग्राम्यगोपीषु यास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vilasivakyapaneshu nagarinam kritaspadam |
chittamasya katha bhuyo gramyagopishu yasyati ||

verses.sa:
सारं समस्तगोष्ठस्य विधिना हरता हरिम् ।
प्रह्टतं गोपयोषितूसु निर्गुणेन दुरात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
saram samastagoshthasya vidhina harata harim |
prahtatam gopayoshitusu nirgunena duratmana ||

verses.sa:
भावगर्भस्मितं वाक्यं विलासललिता गतिः ।
नागरीणामतीवैतत् कटाक्षैक्षितमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
bhavagarbhasmitam vakyam vilasalalita gatih |
nagarinamativaitat katakshaikshitameva cha ||

verses.sa:
ग्राम्यो हरिरयं तासां विलासनिगड़ैर्युतः ।
भवतीनां पुनः पाश्व कया युत्तया समेष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
gramyo harirayam tasam vilasanigarairyutah |
bhavatinam punah pashva kaya yuttaya sameshyati ||

verses.sa:
एषैष रथमारुह्य मथुरां याति केशवः ।
क्रूरेणाक्रू रकेणात्र निराशेन प्रतारितः ॥
verses.rom:
eshaisha rathamaruhya mathuram yati keshavah |
krurenakru rakenatra nirashena prataritah ||

verses.sa:
किं न वेत्ति नृशंसोऽत्र अनुरागपरं जनम् ।
येनेममक्ष्णोराह्लादं नयत्यन्यत्र नो हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
kim na vetti nrishamso'tra anuragaparam janam |
yenemamakshnorahladam nayatyanyatra no harim ||

verses.sa:
एश रामेण सहितः प्रयात्यत्यन्तनिर्घृणः ।
रथमारुह्य गोविन्दस्त्वर्य्यतामस्य वारणो ॥
verses.rom:
esha ramena sahitah prayatyatyantanirghrinah |
rathamaruhya govindastvaryyatamasya varano ||

verses.sa:
गुरूणामग्रतो वक्तुं किं ब्रवपीषि न नः क्षमम् ।
गुरवः किं करिष्यन्ति दग्धानां विरहाग्रिना ॥
verses.rom:
gurunamagrato vaktum kim bravapishi na nah kshamam |
guravah kim karishyanti dagdhanam virahagrina ||

verses.sa:
नन्दगोपमुखा गोपा गन्तुमेते समुद्यताः ।
नोद्यमं कुरुते कश्विदू गोविन्दविनिवर्त्तने ॥
verses.rom:
nandagopamukha gopa gantumete samudyatah |
nodyamam kurute kashvidu govindavinivarttane ||

verses.sa:
सुप्रभाताद्य रजनी मथुरावासियोषिताम् ।
पास्यन्त्यच्युतवक्ताब्जां यासां नेत्रालिपङूक्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
suprabhatadya rajani mathuravasiyoshitam |
pasyantyachyutavaktabjam yasam netralipanuktayah ||

verses.sa:
धन्यास्ते पथि ये कृष्णामितो यान्त्यनिवारिताः ।
उदूहिष्यन्ति पश्यन्तः स्वदेहं पुलकाञ्चितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhanyaste pathi ye krishnamito yantyanivaritah |
uduhishyanti pashyantah svadeham pulakanchitam ||

verses.sa:
मथुरानगरीपौरनयनानां महोतूसवः ।
गोविन्दावयवैर्दृष्टरतीवाद्य भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
mathuranagaripauranayananam mahotusavah |
govindavayavairdrishtarativadya bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
को नु स्वप्रः सुभाग्याभिर्दृष्टस्ताभिरधोक्षजम् ।
विस्तारिकान्तिनयना या द्रक्ष्यन्त्यनिवारितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko nu svaprah subhagyabhirdrishtastabhiradhokshajam |
vistarikantinayana ya drakshyantyanivaritam ||

verses.sa:
अहो गोपीजनस्यास्य दर्शयित्वा महानिधिम् ।
उद्धृतान्यत्र नेत्राणि विधात्राकरुणात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
aho gopijanasyasya darshayitva mahanidhim |
uddhritanyatra netrani vidhatrakarunatmana ||

verses.sa:
अनुरागेण शैथिल्यमस्मासु व्रजता हरेः !
शैथिल्यमुपयान्त्याशु करेषु वलयान्यपि ॥
verses.rom:
anuragena shaithilyamasmasu vrajata hareh !
shaithilyamupayantyashu kareshu valayanyapi ||

verses.sa:
अक्रूरः क्रूरह्टदयः शीघ्र प्रेरयते हयान् ।
एवमार्त्तासु योषित्सु घृणा कस्य न जायते ॥
verses.rom:
akrurah krurahtadayah shighra prerayate hayan |
evamarttasu yoshitsu ghrina kasya na jayate ||

verses.sa:
हा हा कृष्णरथस्योच्चैश्व क्ररेणुर्निरीक्ष्यताम् ।
दूरीकृतो हरिर्येन सोऽपि रेणुर्न लक्ष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ha ha krishnarathasyochchaishva krarenurnirikshyatam |
durikrito hariryena so'pi renurna lakshyate ||

verses.sa:
इत्येवमतिहार्द्दन गोपीजननिरीक्षितः ।
तत्याज व्रजभूभागं सह रामेण केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
ityevamatiharddana gopijananirikshitah |
tatyaja vrajabhubhagam saha ramena keshavah ||

verses.sa:
गच्छन्तो जविताश्वेन रथेन यमुनातटम् ।
प्राप्ता मध्याह्नसमये रामाक्रू रजनार्द्दनाः ॥
verses.rom:
gachchhanto javitashvena rathena yamunatatam |
prapta madhyahnasamaye ramakru rajanarddanah ||

verses.sa:
अथाह कृष्णमक्रूरो भवद्भयां तावदास्यताम् ।
यावत् करोमि कालिन्द्यामाह्निकार्हणमम्भसि ॥
verses.rom:
athaha krishnamakruro bhavadbhayam tavadasyatam |
yavat karomi kalindyamahnikarhanamambhasi ||

verses.sa:
तथेत्युक्तं ततः स्त्रातः स्वाचान्तः स महामतिः ।
दध्यौ ब्रह्म परं विप्र!प्रविश्य यमुनाजले ॥
verses.rom:
tathetyuktam tatah stratah svachantah sa mahamatih |
dadhyau brahma param vipra!pravishya yamunajale ||

verses.sa:
फणासहस्त्रमालाञय बलभद्र ददर्श सः ।
कुन्दमालाङ्गमुन्निद्र-पद्मपत्रारुणोक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
phanasahastramalanaya balabhadra dadarsha sah |
kundamalangamunnidra-padmapatrarunokshanam ||

verses.sa:
वृतं वासुकिरम्भाद्यैर्महद्भिः पवनाशिभिः ।
संस्तूयमानं गन्धर्वैर्वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥
verses.rom:
vritam vasukirambhadyairmahadbhih pavanashibhih |
samstuyamanam gandharvairvanamalavibhushitam ||

verses.sa:
दधानमसिते वस्त्रे चारुपद्मावतंसकम् ।
चारुकुण्डलिनं भान्तमन्तर्जलतले स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadhanamasite vastre charupadmavatamsakam |
charukundalinam bhantamantarjalatale sthitam ||

verses.sa:
तस्योतूसङ्ग घनश्याममाताम्रायतलोचनम् ।
चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्ग चक्राद्यायुधभूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyotusanga ghanashyamamatamrayatalochanam |
chaturbahumudaranga chakradyayudhabhushanam ||

verses.sa:
पीते वसानं वसने चित्रमाल्य-विभूषणाम् ।
शक्रचापतड़िन्माला-विचित्रमिव तोयदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pite vasanam vasane chitramalya-vibhushanam |
shakrachapatarinmala-vichitramiva toyadam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसञ्चारुकेयूरमुकुटोज्जवलम् ।
ददर्श कृष्णमक्लिष्ट-पुण्डरीकावतंसकम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrivatsavakshasancharukeyuramukutojjavalam |
dadarsha krishnamaklishta-pundarikavatamsakam ||

verses.sa:
सनन्दनाद्यैर्मुनिभिः सिद्धयोगैरकल्मषैः ।
विचिन्त्यमानं तत्रस्थैर्नासाग्रन्यस्तलोचनैः ॥
verses.rom:
sanandanadyairmunibhih siddhayogairakalmashaih |
vichintyamanam tatrasthairnasagranyastalochanaih ||

verses.sa:
बल-कृष्णौ तथाक्रूरः प्रत्यभिज्ञाय विस्मितः ।
सोऽचिन्तयदू रथाच्छीघ्रं कथमत्रागताविति ॥
verses.rom:
bala-krishnau tathakrurah pratyabhijnaya vismitah |
so'chintayadu rathachchhighram kathamatragataviti ||

verses.sa:
विवक्षोः स्तम्भयामास वाचं तस्य जनार्द्दनः ।
ततो निष्कम्य सलिलादू रथमभ्यागतः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
vivakshoh stambhayamasa vacham tasya janarddanah |
tato nishkamya saliladu rathamabhyagatah punah ||

verses.sa:
ददर्श तत्र चैवोभौ रथस्योपर्य्यधिष्ठितौ ।
राम-कृष्णौ यथापूर्व्वं मनुष्यवपुषान्वितौ ॥
verses.rom:
dadarsha tatra chaivobhau rathasyoparyyadhishthitau |
rama-krishnau yathapurvvam manushyavapushanvitau ||

verses.sa:
निमग्रश्व ततस्तोये स ददर्ख तथैव तौ ।
संस्तूयमानौ गन्धर्व्व-मुनि-सिद्ध-महोरगैः ॥
verses.rom:
nimagrashva tatastoye sa dadarkha tathaiva tau |
samstuyamanau gandharvva-muni-siddha-mahoragaih ||

verses.sa:
ततो विज्ञातसद्भावः स तु दानपतिस्तथा ।
तुष्टाव सर्व्वविज्ञानमयमच्युतमीश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato vijnatasadbhavah sa tu danapatistatha |
tushtava sarvvavijnanamayamachyutamishvaram ||

verses.sa:
सन्मात्ररूपिणेऽचिन्त्यमहिम्ने परमात्मने ।
व्यापिने नैकरूपैकखरूपाय नमो नमः ॥
verses.rom:
sanmatrarupine'chintyamahimne paramatmane |
vyapine naikarupaikakharupaya namo namah ||

verses.sa:
सत्त्वरूपाय तेऽचिन्त्य! हविर्भूताय ते नमः ।
नमोऽविज्ञातपाराय पराय प्रकृतेः प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
sattvarupaya te'chintya! havirbhutaya te namah |
namo'vijnataparaya paraya prakriteh prabho ||

verses.sa:
भूतात्मा चेन्द्रियात्मा च प्रधानात्मा तथा भवान् ।
आत्मा च परमात्मा च त्वमेकः पञ्चधा स्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
bhutatma chendriyatma cha pradhanatma tatha bhavan |
atma cha paramatma cha tvamekah panchadha sthitah ||

verses.sa:
प्रसीद सर्व्व सर्व्वात्मन् क्षराक्षरमयेश्वर ।
ब्रह्म-विष्णु-शिव्राद्याभिः कल्पनाभिरुदीरितः ॥
verses.rom:
prasida sarvva sarvvatman ksharaksharamayeshvara |
brahma-vishnu-shivradyabhih kalpanabhirudiritah ||

verses.sa:
अनाख्येयखरूपात्मन्!अनाख्येयप्रयोजन!
अनाख्येयाभिधानं त्वां नतोऽस्मि परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
anakhyeyakharupatman!anakhyeyaprayojana!
anakhyeyabhidhanam tvam nato'smi parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
न यत्र-नाथ!विद्यन्ते नामजात्यादिकल्पनाः ।
तदू ब्रह्म परमं नित्यमविकारि भवानजः ॥
verses.rom:
na yatra-natha!vidyante namajatyadikalpanah |
tadu brahma paramam nityamavikari bhavanajah ||

verses.sa:
न कल्पनामृतेऽर्थस्य सर्व्वस्याधिगमो यतः ।
ततः कृष्णाच्युतानन्तबिष्णुसंज्ञाभिरीडयसे ॥
verses.rom:
na kalpanamrite'rthasya sarvvasyadhigamo yatah |
tatah krishnachyutanantabishnusamjnabhiridayase ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वार्थस्त्वमज! विकल्पनाभिरेतदू दवाद्य जगदखिलं त्वमेव विश्वम् ।
विश्वात्मंस्त्वमिति विकारभावहीनः सर्व्वस्मिन् न हि भबतोऽस्ति
किञ्चिदन्यत् त्वं ब्रह्मा पशुपतिरर्य्यमा विधाता धाता त्वं त्रिदशपतिः समीरणोऽग्रिः ।
तोयेशो धनपतिरन्तकस्त्वमेको भिन्नार्थैर्जगदपि पासि शक्तिभेदैः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvarthastvamaja! vikalpanabhiretadu davadya jagadakhilam tvameva vishvam |
vishvatmamstvamiti vikarabhavahinah sarvvasmin na hi bhabato'sti
kinchidanyat tvam brahma pashupatiraryyama vidhata dhata tvam tridashapatih samirano'grih |
toyesho dhanapatirantakastvameko bhinnarthairjagadapi pasi shaktibhedaih ||

verses.sa:
विश्वं भवान् सृजति सूर्य्यगभस्तिरूपोविश्वञ्च ते गुणमयोऽयमज! प्रपञ्चः ।
रूपं परं सदितिवाचकमक्षरं यजज्ञानात्मने सदसते प्रणातोऽस्मि तस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
vishvam bhavan srijati suryyagabhastirupovishvancha te gunamayo'yamaja! prapanchah |
rupam param saditivachakamaksharam yajajnanatmane sadasate pranato'smi tasmai ||

verses.sa:
अँनमो वासुदेवाय नमः सङ्कर्षणाय ते ।
प्रद्यु म्राय नमस्तुभ्यमनिरुद्धाय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
annamo vasudevaya namah sankarshanaya te |
pradyu mraya namastubhyamaniruddhaya te namah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said Thus meditating, Akrura, born in the race of the Yadus, bowed his hand down to the feet of Hari saying—"I am Akrura". And Krishna placed his hand upon him, which was marked with the flag, the thunder-bolt, the lotus, and drew him towards him and affectionately embraced him.

Being thus honored by him, Balarāma and Kesava, delighted, entered with him their own habitation. Having entered into conversation with them and been fed, he related to them everything duly, how their father Anakadundhubi, the princess Devaki and even his own father had been insulted by the wicked demon Kansa and for what purpose he had been despatched. Having heard all from him the illustrious slayer of Kesin said—"O thou of liberal gift, I know all thou hast said; O great one, I shall devise proper measures for this—do not think otherwise of this; consider Kansa as already slain. Rāma and I will go to Mathura tomorrow along with you. The elders of the cow-herds shall accompany us carrying sufficient offerings. Rest here tonight and drive all thy anxiety. Within three nights I will destroy Kansa and all his followers".

Having thus commanded the cow-herds, Akrura with Kesava and Rāma retired to rest and slept soundly in the house of Nanda. The next morning was clear and the young men prepared to proceed to Mathura with Akrura. The females of the cow-herds, on seeing them about to depart, were much afflicted. They wept bitterly—their bracelets were loose upon their arms—and they thus thought within themselves—"If Govinda goes to Mathura, how will he come back to Gokula? His ears will be pleased by the sweet and finished conversation of the damsels of the city. And being used to the language of the graceful females of Mathura he will never again like the rustic expressions of the Gopees. Hari, the pride of our village is taken away and a fatal blow is laid upon us by inexorable destiny.

"The women of the city have sweet smiles, graceful language, beautiful air, elegant gait and significant glances. Hari is of rustic breeding, and, captivated by their fascinations, what likelihood is there of his returning to the society of any one amongst us? Kevasa, who has mounted the car to go to Mathura, has been deceived by the cruel, vile, and desperate Akrura. Does not the unfeeling traitor know the affection that we all here feel for our Hari, the joy of our eyes, that he is taking him away? Unkind that he is, Govinda is departing from us, along with Rāma: haste! let us stop him! Why talk of telling our seniors that we cannot bear his loss? What can they do for us, we are consumed by the fires of separation? The Gopas, with Nanda at their head, are themselves preparing to depart; no one makes any attempt to detain Govinda. Bright is the morning that succeeds to this night for the women of Mathura, for the bees of their eyes will feed upon the lotus face of Achyuta. Happy are they who may go hence without impediment, and behold, enraptured, Krishna on his journey. A great festival will delight today the eyes of the inhabitants of Mathura when they will behold the person of Govinda. What pleasurable dream was seen by the happy damsels of the city that their graceful eyes shall behold unobstructed the countenance of Krishna! Alas! the eyes of the females of cow-herds have been deprived of their vision by the relentless Brahmā, after he had shown them this great treasure. Hari departing with his love for us decayed, the bracelets from our arms slip. The cruel-hearted Akrura urges on the steeds; who does not feel pity for females like us who are bewailing? Alas! behold the dust of Krishna's chariot-wheels! and now he is distanced from us by that for even that dust is no longer to be seen". Thus lamented by the damsels, Kesava and Rāma left the hamlet of Vraja. Travelling in a car drawn by quick-coursing steeds they reached, at noon, the banks of the Yamuna when Akrura requested them to halt a little whilst he performed the usual daily ceremonial in the river. They having agreed to this, the high-minded Akrura bathed in the water and rinsed his mouth and then entering the stream he stood meditating upon the Supreme Being. He beheld, in his meditation, Balabhadra, having a thousand-hooded heads, a garland of jasmine flowers, having large-red eyes resembling lotus petals, surrounded by Vasuki, Rambba and other mighty serpents, praised by Gandharvas, decorated with garlands of wild flowers, clad in dark-coloured raiment, crowned with a chaplet of lotuses, adorned with brilliant ear-rings, drunk and standing at the bottom of the river in the water. He saw on his lap Vishnu, having four arms, and holding conch, discus, and mace, having the complexion of cloud, coppery and expansive eyes, excellent ear-rings and an elegant form, clad in yellow clothes, adorned with many coloured flowers and appearing like a cloud adorned with streams of lightnings and the bow of Indra; his breast was marked with celestial sign, four arms were adorned with keyuras and head with a brilliant crown: he was attended by Sanandana and other holy sages, who, fixing their eyes upon the tips of their noses, were absorbed in profound meditation.

Understanding them as Krishna and Balarāma, Akrura was struck with amazement; and he thought how they could so quickly have got there from the chariot. He desired to ask them of this, but Janarddana deprived him of the faculty of speech at that moment. Having come out of the waters he then came to the chariot and saw there, like before, Rāma and Krishna stationed in their human forms. And having entered the stream again he saw those two forms praised by Gandharvas, great ascetics, Siddhas and great serpents. Apprehending then their real nature he eulogized the eternal deity gifted with discriminative knowledge.

Akrura said:—"Salutation to thee, who art uniform and manifold, all pervading, Supreme spirit, of inconceivable glory and who art simple existence. Salutation to thee, O inscrutable, who art truth and the essence of oblations. Salutation to thee, O Lord, whose nature is unknown, who art beyond primeval matter, who existest in five forms, identical with the elements, with the faculties, with matter, with the living soul and with the Supreme spirit. Be propitiated with me, O soul of the universe, essence of all things, perishable or eternal, whether addressed by the name Brahmā, Vishnu, Siva or like. I adore thee, O God, whose nature is indestructible, whose purposes cannot be deciphered, whose name even is unknown; for the attributes of kind or appellation are not applicable to thee, who art that, the supreme Brahman, eternal, unchangeable, uncreated. But as our objects can not be accomplished but through some specific from, thou art termed by us Krishna, Achyuta, Ananta or Vishnu. Thou, unborn divinity, art all the objects of these impersonation; thou art the gods and all other beings; thou art the whole world, thou art all. Soul of the universe, thou art free from change and there is nothing except thee in all this existence. Thou art Brahmā, Pasupati, Aryaman, Dhātri and Vidhātri! Thou art Indra, air, fire, the regent of the waters, the god of wealth and the judge of the dead; and thou, although but one, presidest over the world with various energies directed to various purposes. Thou, identical with the solar ray, createst the universe: all elementary substance is composed of thy qualities; and thy supreme form is denoted by the imperishable term Sat. I bow to him who is identical with true knowledge and who is and is not perceptible. Salutation to him the lord Vasudeva, to Sankarsana, to Pradyumna and to Aniruddha".

verses.sa:
एवमन्तर्जले विष्णुमभिष्टूय स यादवः ।
अर्ज्जयामास सर्व्वेशं पुष्पैर्धूपैर्मनोरमैः ॥
verses.rom:
evamantarjale vishnumabhishtuya sa yadavah |
arjjayamasa sarvvesham pushpairdhupairmanoramaih ||

verses.sa:
परित्यक्तान्यविषयो मनस्तत्र निवेश्य सः ।
ब्रह्मभूते चिरं स्थित्वा विरराम समाधितः ॥
verses.rom:
parityaktanyavishayo manastatra niveshya sah |
brahmabhute chiram sthitva virarama samadhitah ||

verses.sa:
कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मन्यमानो महामतिः ।
आजगाम रथं भूयो निगम्य यमुनाम्भसः ॥
verses.rom:
kritakrityamivatmanam manyamano mahamatih |
ajagama ratham bhuyo nigamya yamunambhasah ||

verses.sa:
राम-कृष्णौ च ददृशे यथापूर्व्वं रथे स्थितौ ।
विस्मिताक्षस्तदाक्रू रस्तञ्च कृष्णोऽभ्यभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
rama-krishnau cha dadrishe yathapurvvam rathe sthitau |
vismitakshastadakru rastancha krishno'bhyabhashata ||

verses.sa:
नूनं ते दृष्टमाश्वर्य्यमक्रूर!यमुनाजले ।
विस्मयोतूफूल्लनयनो भवान् संलक्ष्यते यतः ॥
verses.rom:
nunam te drishtamashvaryyamakrura!yamunajale |
vismayotuphullanayano bhavan samlakshyate yatah ||

verses.sa:
अन्तर्जले यदाश्वर्य्यं दृष्टं तत्र मयाच्युत!
तदत्रापि हि पश्यामि मूत्तिंमत् पुरतः स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
antarjale yadashvaryyam drishtam tatra mayachyuta!
tadatrapi hi pashyami muttimmat puratah sthitam ||

verses.sa:
जगदेतन्महाश्वर्य्य रूपं यस्य महात्मनः ।
तेनाश्वर्य्यवरेणाहं भवता कृष्ण!सङ्गतः ॥
verses.rom:
jagadetanmahashvaryya rupam yasya mahatmanah |
tenashvaryyavarenaham bhavata krishna!sangatah ||

verses.sa:
तत् किमेतेन मथुरां व्रजामो मधुसूदन!
बिभेमि कंसाद्धिग् जन्म परपिण्डोपजीविनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tat kimetena mathuram vrajamo madhusudana!
bibhemi kamsaddhig janma parapindopajivinam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा चोदयामास तान् हयान् वातरंहसः ।
सम्प्राप्तश्वातिसायाह्र सोऽक्रूरो मथुरां पुरीम्‌ ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva chodayamasa tan hayan vataramhasah |
sampraptashvatisayahra so'kruro mathuram purim ||

verses.sa:
विलोक्य मथुरां कृष्णं रामञ्चाह स यादवः ।
पद्भयां यातं महावीर्य्यो रथेनैको विशाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
vilokya mathuram krishnam ramanchaha sa yadavah |
padbhayam yatam mahaviryyo rathenaiko vishamyaham ||

verses.sa:
गन्तव्यं वसुदेवस्य भवद्भयां न तथा गृहम् ।
युवयोर्हि कृते वृद्धः स कंसेन निरस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
gantavyam vasudevasya bhavadbhayam na tatha griham |
yuvayorhi krite vriddhah sa kamsena nirasyate ||

verses.sa:
इत्युत्तवा प्रविवेशाथ सोऽकूरो मथुरां पुरीम् ।
प्रिवष्टौ रामकृष्णौ, च राजमार्गमुपागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
ityuttava praviveshatha so'kuro mathuram purim |
privashtau ramakrishnau, cha rajamargamupagatau ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रीभिर्नरैश्व सानन्दं लोचनैरभिवीक्षितौ ।
जग्मतुलीलया वीरौ दृफ्तौ बालगजाविव ॥
verses.rom:
stribhirnaraishva sanandam lochanairabhivikshitau |
jagmatulilaya virau driphtau balagajaviva ||

verses.sa:
भ्रममाणौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा रजकं रङ्गकारकम् ।
अयाचेतां सुरूपाणि वासांसि रुचिराननौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhramamanau tu tau drishtva rajakam rangakarakam |
ayachetam surupani vasamsi ruchirananau ||

verses.sa:
कंसस्य रजकः सोऽथ प्रसादारूढ़विस्मयः ।
बहून्याक्षेपवाक्यानि प्राहोच्चै राम-केशवौ ॥
verses.rom:
kamsasya rajakah so'tha prasadarurhavismayah |
bahunyakshepavakyani prahochchai rama-keshavau ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तलप्रहारेण कृष्णस्तस्य दुरात्मनः ।
पातयामास कापेन रजकस्य शिरो भुवि ॥
verses.rom:
tatastalapraharena krishnastasya duratmanah |
patayamasa kapena rajakasya shiro bhuvi ||

verses.sa:
हत्वादाय च वस्त्राणि पीतनीलाम्बरौ ततः ।
कृष्ण-रामौ मुदा युक्तौ मालाकारगृहं गतौ ॥
verses.rom:
hatvadaya cha vastrani pitanilambarau tatah |
krishna-ramau muda yuktau malakaragriham gatau ||

verses.sa:
विकाशिनेत्रयुगलौ मालाकारोऽतिविस्मितः ।
एतौ कस्य कुतो वैतौ मैत्रेयाचिन्तयत् तदा ॥
verses.rom:
vikashinetrayugalau malakaro'tivismitah |
etau kasya kuto vaitau maitreyachintayat tada ||

verses.sa:
पीतनीलाम्बरधरौ तौ दृष्ट्वातिमनोहरौ ।
स तर्कयामास तदा भुवं देवावुपागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
pitanilambaradharau tau drishtvatimanoharau |
sa tarkayamasa tada bhuvam devavupagatau ||

verses.sa:
विकाशिमुखपद्माभ्यां ताभ्यां पुष्पाणि याचितः ।
भुवं विष्टभ्य हस्ताभ्यां पस्पर्श शिरसा महीम् ॥
verses.rom:
vikashimukhapadmabhyam tabhyam pushpani yachitah |
bhuvam vishtabhya hastabhyam pasparsha shirasa mahim ||

verses.sa:
प्रसादपरमौ नाथौ मम गेहमुपागतौ ।
धन्योऽहमर्ज्जयिष्यामीत्याह तौ माल्यजीवकः ॥
verses.rom:
prasadaparamau nathau mama gehamupagatau |
dhanyo'hamarjjayishyamityaha tau malyajivakah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रह्टश्टवदनस्तयोः पुष्पाणि कामतः ।
चारूण्येतान्यथैतानि प्रददौ स विलोभयन ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prahtashtavadanastayoh pushpani kamatah |
charunyetanyathaitani pradadau sa vilobhayana ||

verses.sa:
पुनः पुनः प्रणम्यासौ मालाकारौ नरोत्तमौ ।
ददौ पुष्पाणि चारूणि गन्धवन्त्यमलानि च ॥
verses.rom:
punah punah pranamyasau malakarau narottamau |
dadau pushpani charuni gandhavantyamalani cha ||

verses.sa:
मालाकाराय कृष्णोऽपि प्रसन्नः प्रददौ वरान ।
श्रीस्त्वां मतूसंश्रया भद्र! न कदाचित् प्रहास्तयि ॥
verses.rom:
malakaraya krishno'pi prasannah pradadau varana |
shristvam matusamshraya bhadra! na kadachit prahastayi ||

verses.sa:
बलहानिर्न ते सौम्य! धनहानिस्थथैव च ।
यावद्दिनानि तावज्व न नशिष्यति सन्ततिः ॥
verses.rom:
balahanirna te saumya! dhanahanisthathaiva cha |
yavaddinani tavajva na nashishyati santatih ||

verses.sa:
बुक्त्वा च विपुलान् भोगांस्तमन्ते मतूप्रसादजम् ।
ममानुस्मरणां प्राप्य दिव्यं लोकमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
buktva cha vipulan bhogamstamante matuprasadajam |
mamanusmaranam prapya divyam lokamavapsyasi ||

verses.sa:
धर्म्मे मनश्व ते भद्र!सर्व्वकालं भविष्यति ।
युष्मत्सन्ततिजातानां दीर्घमायुर्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
dharmme manashva te bhadra!sarvvakalam bhavishyati |
yushmatsantatijatanam dirghamayurbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
नोपसर्गादिकं दोषं युष्मत्सन्ततिसम्भवः ।
सम्प्राप्स्यति महाभाग!यावत् सूर्य्यो धरिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
nopasargadikam dosham yushmatsantatisambhavah |
samprapsyati mahabhaga!yavat suryyo dharishyati ||

verses.sa:
इतुक्त्वा तदूगृहात् कृष्णो बलदेवसहायवान् ।
निर्ज्जगाम मुनिश्वेष्ठ! मालाकारेण पूजितः ॥
verses.rom:
ituktva tadugrihat krishno baladevasahayavan |
nirjjagama munishveshtha! malakarena pujitah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Having thus praised Vishnu, standing in the stream that descendant of the Yadu race worshipped the lord of all with flowers, incense and all other beautiful articles. Having withdrawn his mind from every thing else and devoted it to Vishnu, he engaged, for some time, in the meditation, "I am Brahman" and then desisted from his abstraction. Then considering himself as blessed, the high-minded Akrura got up from the waters of the Yamuna and came to the chariot. Like before, he again saw stationed on the car Rāma and Krishna. Seeing Akrura thus amazed, Krishna said—"Forsooth, O Akrura, your eyes are expanded with surprise. Methinks you have seen something wonderful in the waters of the Yamuna".

Akruka said:—"O Achyuta, the wonder I saw in the waters, I behold here, before me in a bodily shape; I am united with thee, Krishna, the marvel I have seen and whose wonderous form is the universe. No more of this, let us go to Mathura, O Slayer of Madhu—I am afraid of Kansa. Oh! fie on them who eat the bread of another". Saying this he urged on the quick steeds and they arrived after sunset, at Mathura, When they came in sight of the city, Akrura said to Krishna and Rāma "You must now go on foot, whilst I proceed alone in the car; and you must not go to the house of Vasudeva for the elder has been banished by Kansa on your account".

Parāçara said:—Having said this Akrura alone entered the city of Mathura, Rāma and Krishna proceeded thereto following the public road. All the females and males of Mathura espied the two brothers with delight. And they went along sportively looking like two young elephants. As they roamed about, they saw a washerman colouring clothes and, with smiling countenances, they went and wanted of him some of his fine linen. He was a washerman of Kansa and was made insolent by his master's favour, so he remonstrated hard with Rāma and Kesava. Thereupon Krishna, in rage, struck down the head of that vicious-souled (washerman) on earth. Having thus killed him and taken yellow and blue raiment Krishna and Rāma, delightedly came to a flower-seller's shop. Seeing them, having expansive eyes, the flower-seller was astonished and thought, O Maitreya, who could they be or whence could they have come. Beholding two youths so lovely, dressed in yellow and blue garments, he took them to be divinities descended upon earth. Being asked for some flowers, by them, having mouths budding like lotuses he placed his hands upon the ground and touched it with his head, saying—"My lords have shown me great kindness, by coming to my house, fortunate that I am; I will pay them homage". Having said this, the flower-seller, with a smiling face, gave them whatever choice flowers they selected, to gain their favour. Prostrating himself again and again before them, he presented them again and again with flowers beautiful, fragrant and fresh. Being much pleased with him, Krishna gave him the blessing—"Fortune, O good friend, who depends on me, shall never forsake thee. Thou shalt never lose strength or wealth and thy family shall never be extinct. Enjoying many things, thou shalt, in the end, remembering me, attain to the region of the celestials. O good friend, thy mind shall always be in virtue and those, who shall be born in thy race, shall be long-lived.
