O great one, as long as the sun shall exist, none, in thy race, shall be disturbed with famine or other troubles".

Parāçara said:—Having said this and been worshipped by the flower-seller, O foremost of Munis, Krishna in the company of Balarāma, issued out of his house.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
राजमार्गे ततः कृष्णस्सानुलेपनभाजनाम् ।
ददर्श कुब्जामायांतीं नवयौवनगोचराम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
rajamarge tatah krishnassanulepanabhajanam |
dadarsha kubjamayamtim navayauvanagocharam ||

verses.sa:
तामाह ललितं कृष्णः कस्येदमनुलेपनम् ।
भवत्या नीयते सत्यं वदेंदीवरलोचने ॥
verses.rom:
tamaha lalitam krishnah kasyedamanulepanam |
bhavatya niyate satyam vademdivaralochane ||

verses.sa:
सकामेनेव सा प्रोक्ता सानुरागा हरिं प्रति ।
प्राह सा ललितं कुब्जा तद्दर्शनबलात्कृता ॥
verses.rom:
sakameneva sa prokta sanuraga harim prati |
praha sa lalitam kubja taddarshanabalatkrita ||

verses.sa:
कांत कस्मान्न जानासि कंसेन विनियोजिताम् ।
नैकवक्रेति विख्यातामनुलेपनकर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
kamta kasmanna janasi kamsena viniyojitam |
naikavakreti vikhyatamanulepanakarmani ||

verses.sa:
नान्यपिष्टं हि कंसस्य प्रीतये ह्यनुलेपनम् ।
भवाम्यहमतीवास्य प्रसादधनभाजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
nanyapishtam hi kamsasya pritaye hyanulepanam |
bhavamyahamativasya prasadadhanabhajanam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच।
सुगंधमेतद्रा जार्हं रुचिरं रुचिरानने ।
आवयोर्गात्र सदृशं दीयतामनुलेपनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrikrishna uvacha|
sugamdhametadra jarham ruchiram ruchiranane |
avayorgatra sadrisham diyatamanulepanam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
श्रुत्वैतदाह सा कुब्जा गृह्यतामिति सादरम् ।
अनुलेपनं च प्रददौ गात्रयोग्यमथोभयोः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
shrutvaitadaha sa kubja grihyatamiti sadaram |
anulepanam cha pradadau gatrayogyamathobhayoh ||

verses.sa:
भक्तिच्छेदानुलिप्तांगौ ततस्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ ।
सेंद्र चापौ व्यराजेतां सितकृष्णाविवांबुदौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhaktichchhedanuliptamgau tatastau purusharshabhau |
semdra chapau vyarajetam sitakrishnavivambudau ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तां चुबुके शौरिरुल्लापन विधानवित् ।
उत्पाट्य तोलयामास द्व्यंगुलेनाग्रपाणिना ॥
verses.rom:
tatastam chubuke shaurirullapana vidhanavit |
utpatya tolayamasa dvyamgulenagrapanina ||

verses.sa:
चकर्ष पद्भ्यां च तदा ऋजुत्वं केशवोऽनयत् ।
ततस्सा ऋजुतां प्राप्ता योषितामभवद्वरा ॥
verses.rom:
chakarsha padbhyam cha tada rijutvam keshavo'nayat |
tatassa rijutam prapta yoshitamabhavadvara ||

verses.sa:
विलासललितं प्राह प्रेमगर्भभरालसम् ।
वस्त्रे प्रगृह्य गोविंदं मम गेहं व्रजेति वै ॥
verses.rom:
vilasalalitam praha premagarbhabharalasam |
vastre pragrihya govimdam mama geham vrajeti vai ||

verses.sa:
एवमुक्तस्तया शौरी रामस्यालोक्य चाननम् ।
प्रहस्य कुब्जां तामाह नैकवक्रामनिंदिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
evamuktastaya shauri ramasyalokya chananam |
prahasya kubjam tamaha naikavakramanimditam ||

verses.sa:
आयास्ये भवतीगेहमिति तां प्रहसन्हरिः ।
विससर्ज जहासोच्चै रामस्यालोक्य चाननम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayasye bhavatigehamiti tam prahasanharih |
visasarja jahasochchai ramasyalokya chananam ||

verses.sa:
भक्तिभेदानुलिप्तांगौ नीलपीतांबरौ तु तौ ।
धनुश्शालां ततो यातौ चित्रमाल्योपशोभितौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhaktibhedanuliptamgau nilapitambarau tu tau |
dhanushshalam tato yatau chitramalyopashobhitau ||

verses.sa:
आयागं तद्धनूरत्नं ताभ्यां पृष्टैस्तु रक्षिभिः ।
आख्याते सहसा कृष्णो गृहीत्वा पूरयद्धनुः ॥
verses.rom:
ayagam taddhanuratnam tabhyam prishtaistu rakshibhih |
akhyate sahasa krishno grihitva purayaddhanuh ||

verses.sa:
ततः पूरयता तेन भज्यमानं बलाद्धनुः ।
चकार सुमहच्छब्दं मथुरा येन पूरिता ॥
verses.rom:
tatah purayata tena bhajyamanam baladdhanuh |
chakara sumahachchhabdam mathura yena purita ||

verses.sa:
अनुयुक्तौ ततस्तौ तु भग्ने धनुषि रक्षिभिः ।
रक्षिसैन्यं निहत्योभौ निष्क्रांतौ कार्मुकालयात् ॥
verses.rom:
anuyuktau tatastau tu bhagne dhanushi rakshibhih |
rakshisainyam nihatyobhau nishkramtau karmukalayat ||

verses.sa:
अक्रूरागमवृत्तांतमुपलभ्य महद्धनुः ।
भग्नं श्रुत्वा च कंसोऽपि प्राह चाणूरमुष्टिकौ ॥
verses.rom:
akruragamavrittamtamupalabhya mahaddhanuh |
bhagnam shrutva cha kamso'pi praha chanuramushtikau ||

verses.sa:
कंस उवाच।
गोपालदारकौ प्राप्तौ भवद्भ्यां तु ममाग्रतः ।
मल्लयुद्धेन हंतव्यौ मम प्राणहरौ हि तौ ॥
verses.rom:
kamsa uvacha|
gopaladarakau praptau bhavadbhyam tu mamagratah |
mallayuddhena hamtavyau mama pranaharau hi tau ||

verses.sa:
नियुद्धे तद्विनाश्नो भवद्भ्यां तोषितो ह्यहम् ।
दास्याम्यभिमतान्कामान्नान्यथैतौ महाबलौ ॥
verses.rom:
niyuddhe tadvinashno bhavadbhyam toshito hyaham |
dasyamyabhimatankamannanyathaitau mahabalau ||

verses.sa:
न्यायतोन्यायतो वापि भवद्भ्यां तौ ममाहितौ ।
हंताव्यौ तद्वधाद्रा ज्यं सामान्यं वां भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
nyayatonyayato vapi bhavadbhyam tau mamahitau |
hamtavyau tadvadhadra jyam samanyam vam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
इत्यादिश्य स तौ मल्लौ ततश्चाहूय हस्तिपम् ।
प्रोवाचोच्चैस्त्वया मल्लसमाजद्वारि कुंजरः ॥
verses.rom:
ityadishya sa tau mallau tatashchahuya hastipam |
provachochchaistvaya mallasamajadvari kumjarah ||

verses.sa:
स्थाप्यः कुवलयापीडस्तेन तौ गोपदारकौ ।
घातनीयौ नियुद्धाय रंगद्वारमुपागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
sthapyah kuvalayapidastena tau gopadarakau |
ghataniyau niyuddhaya ramgadvaramupagatau ||

verses.sa:
तमप्याज्ञाप्य दृष्ट्वा च सर्वान्मंचानुपाकृतान् ।
आसन्न मरणः कंसः सूर्योदयमुदैक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
tamapyajnapya drishtva cha sarvanmamchanupakritan |
asanna maranah kamsah suryodayamudaikshata ||

verses.sa:
ततः समस्तमंचेषु नागरस्स तदा जनः ।
राजमंचेषु चारूढास्सह भृत्यैर्नराधिपाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah samastamamcheshu nagarassa tada janah |
rajamamcheshu charudhassaha bhrityairnaradhipah ||

verses.sa:
मल्लप्राश्निकवर्गश्च रंगमध्यसमीपगः ।
कृतः कंसेन कंसोऽपि तुंगमंचे व्यवस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
mallaprashnikavargashcha ramgamadhyasamipagah |
kritah kamsena kamso'pi tumgamamche vyavasthitah ||

verses.sa:
अंतःपुराणां मंचाश्च तथाऽन्ये परिकल्पिताः ।
अन्ये च वारमुख्यानामन्ये नागरयोषिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
amtahpuranam mamchashcha tatha'nye parikalpitah |
anye cha varamukhyanamanye nagarayoshitam ||

verses.sa:
नंदगोपादयो गोपा मंचेष्वन्येष्ववस्थिताः ।
अक्रूरवसुदेवौ च मंचप्रांते व्यवस्थितौ ॥
verses.rom:
namdagopadayo gopa mamcheshvanyeshvavasthitah |
akruravasudevau cha mamchapramte vyavasthitau ||

verses.sa:
नागरीयोषितां मध्ये देवकीपुत्रगर्द्धिनी ।
अंतकालेऽपि पुत्रस्य द्रक्ष्यामीति मुखं स्थिता ॥
verses.rom:
nagariyoshitam madhye devakiputragarddhini |
amtakale'pi putrasya drakshyamiti mukham sthita ||

verses.sa:
वाद्यमानेषु तूर्येषु चाणूरे चातिवल्गति ।
हाहाकारपरे लोके ह्यास्फोटयति मुष्टिके ॥
verses.rom:
vadyamaneshu turyeshu chanure chativalgati |
hahakarapare loke hyasphotayati mushtike ||

verses.sa:
ईषद्धसंतौ तौ वीरौ बलभद्र जनार्दनौ ।
गोपवेषधरौ बालौ रंगद्वारमुपागतौ ॥
verses.rom:
ishaddhasamtau tau virau balabhadra janardanau |
gopaveshadharau balau ramgadvaramupagatau ||

verses.sa:
ततः कुवलयापीडो महामात्रप्रचोदितः ।
अभ्यधावत वेगेन हंतुं गोपकुमारकौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kuvalayapido mahamatraprachoditah |
abhyadhavata vegena hamtum gopakumarakau ||

verses.sa:
हाहाकारो महाञ्जज्ञे रंगमध्ये द्विजोत्तम ।
बलदेवोऽनुजं दृष्ट्वा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
hahakaro mahanjajne ramgamadhye dvijottama |
baladevo'nujam drishtva vachanam chedamabravit ||

verses.sa: हंतव्यो हि महाभाग नागोऽयं शत्रुचोदितः ॥
verses.rom: hamtavyo hi mahabhaga nago'yam shatruchoditah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तस्सोऽग्रजेनाथ बलदेवेन वै द्विज ।
सिंहनादं ततश्चक्रे माधवः परवीरहा ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktasso'grajenatha baladevena vai dvija |
simhanadam tatashchakre madhavah paraviraha ||

verses.sa:
करेण करमाकृष्य तस्य केशिनिषूदनः ।
भ्रामयामास तं शौरिरैरावतसमं बले ॥
verses.rom:
karena karamakrishya tasya keshinishudanah |
bhramayamasa tam shaurirairavatasamam bale ||

verses.sa:
ईशोपि सर्वजगतां बाललीलानुसारतः ।
क्रीडित्वा सुचिरं कृष्णः करिदंतपदांतरे ॥
verses.rom:
ishopi sarvajagatam balalilanusaratah |
kriditva suchiram krishnah karidamtapadamtare ||

verses.sa:
उत्पाट्य वामदंतं तु दक्षिणेनैव पाणिना ।
ताडयामास यंतारं तस्यासीच्छतधा शिरः ॥
verses.rom:
utpatya vamadamtam tu dakshinenaiva panina |
tadayamasa yamtaram tasyasichchhatadha shirah ||

verses.sa:
दक्षिणं दंतमुत्पाट्य बलभद्रो ऽपि तत्क्षणात् ।
स रोषस्तेन पार्श्वस्थान् गजपालानपोथयत् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinam damtamutpatya balabhadro 'pi tatkshanat |
sa roshastena parshvasthan gajapalanapothayat ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तूत्प्लुत्य वेगेन रौहिणेयो महाबलः ।
जघान वामपादेन मस्तके हस्तिनं रुषा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastutplutya vegena rauhineyo mahabalah |
jaghana vamapadena mastake hastinam rusha ||

verses.sa:
स पपात हतस्तेन बलभद्रे ण लीलया ।
सहस्राक्षेण वज्रेण ताडितः पर्वतो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
sa papata hatastena balabhadre na lilaya |
sahasrakshena vajrena taditah parvato yatha ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा कुवलयापीडं हस्त्यारोहप्रचोदितम् ।
मदासृगनुलिप्तांगौ हस्तिदंतवरायुधौ ॥
verses.rom:
hatva kuvalayapidam hastyarohaprachoditam |
madasriganuliptamgau hastidamtavarayudhau ||

verses.sa:
मृगमध्ये यथा सिंहौ गर्वलीलावलोकिनौ ।
प्रविष्टौ सुमहारंगं बलभद्र जनार्दनौ ॥
verses.rom:
mrigamadhye yatha simhau garvalilavalokinau |
pravishtau sumaharamgam balabhadra janardanau ||

verses.sa:
हाहाकारो महाञ्जज्ञे महारंगे त्वनंतरम् ।
कृष्णोऽयं बलभद्रो यमिति लोकस्य विस्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
hahakaro mahanjajne maharamge tvanamtaram |
krishno'yam balabhadro yamiti lokasya vismayah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽयं येन हता घोरा पूतना बालघातिनी ।
क्षिप्तं तु शकटं येन भग्नौ तु यमलार्जुनौ ॥
verses.rom:
so'yam yena hata ghora putana balaghatini |
kshiptam tu shakatam yena bhagnau tu yamalarjunau ||

verses.sa:
सोयं यः कालियं नागं ममर्दारुह्य वालकः ।
धृतो गोवर्द्धनो येन सप्तरात्रं महागिरिः ॥
verses.rom:
soyam yah kaliyam nagam mamardaruhya valakah |
dhrito govarddhano yena saptaratram mahagirih ||

verses.sa:
अरिष्टो धेनुकः केशी लीलयैव महात्मना ।
निहता येन दुर्वृत्ता दृश्यतामेष सोऽच्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
arishto dhenukah keshi lilayaiva mahatmana |
nihata yena durvritta drishyatamesha so'chyutah ||

verses.sa:
अयं चास्य महाबाहुर्बलभद्रो ऽग्रतोऽग्रजः ।
प्रयाति लीलया योषिन्मनोनयननंदनः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam chasya mahabahurbalabhadro 'grato'grajah |
prayati lilaya yoshinmanonayananamdanah ||

verses.sa:
अयं स कथ्यते प्राज्ञैः पुराणार्थविशारदैः ।
गोपालो यादवं वंशं मग्नमभ्यद्धरिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa kathyate prajnaih puranarthavisharadaih |
gopalo yadavam vamsham magnamabhyaddharishyati ||

verses.sa:
अयं हि सर्वलोकस्य विष्णोरखिलजन्मनः ।
अवतीर्णो महीमंशो नूनं भारहरो भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam hi sarvalokasya vishnorakhilajanmanah |
avatirno mahimamsho nunam bharaharo bhuvah ||

verses.sa:
इत्येवं वर्णिते पौरै रामे कृष्णे च तत्क्षणात् ।
उरस्तताप देवक्याः स्नेहस्नुतपयोधरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityevam varnite paurai rame krishne cha tatkshanat |
urastatapa devakyah snehasnutapayodharam ||

verses.sa:
महोत्सवमिवासाद्य पुत्राननविलोकनात् ।
युवेव वसुदेवोऽभूद्विहायाभ्यागतां जराम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahotsavamivasadya putrananavilokanat |
yuveva vasudevo'bhudvihayabhyagatam jaram ||

verses.sa:
विस्तारिताक्षियुगलो राजांतःपुरयोषिताम् ।
नागरस्त्रीसमूहश्च द्र ष्टुं न विरराम तम् ॥
verses.rom:
vistaritakshiyugalo rajamtahpurayoshitam |
nagarastrisamuhashcha dra shtum na virarama tam ||

verses.sa:
सख्यः पश्यत कृष्णस्य मुखमत्यरुणेक्षणम् ।
गजयुद्धकृतायासस्वेदांबुकणिकाचितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakhyah pashyata krishnasya mukhamatyarunekshanam |
gajayuddhakritayasasvedambukanikachitam ||

verses.sa:
विकासिशरदंभोजमपश्यामजलोक्षितम् ।
परिभूयं स्थितं जन्म सफलं क्रियतां दृशः ॥
verses.rom:
vikasisharadambhojamapashyamajalokshitam |
paribhuyam sthitam janma saphalam kriyatam drishah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीवत्सांकं महद्धाम बालस्यैतद्विलोक्यताम् ।
विपक्षक्षपणं वक्षो भुजयुग्मं च भामिनि ॥
verses.rom:
shrivatsamkam mahaddhama balasyaitadvilokyatam |
vipakshakshapanam vaksho bhujayugmam cha bhamini ||

verses.sa:
किं न पश्यसि दुग्धेंदुमृणालधवलाकृतिम् ।
बलभद्र मिमं नीलपरिधानमुपागतम् ॥
verses.rom:
kim na pashyasi dugdhemdumrinaladhavalakritim |
balabhadra mimam nilaparidhanamupagatam ||

verses.sa:
वल्गतामुष्टिकेनैव चाणूरेण तथा सखि ।
क्रीडतो बलभद्र स्य हरेर्हास्यं विलोक्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
valgatamushtikenaiva chanurena tatha sakhi |
kridato balabhadra sya harerhasyam vilokyatam ||

verses.sa:
सख्यः पश्यत चाणूरं नियुद्धार्थमयं हरिः ।
समुपैति न संत्यत्र किं वृद्धा मुक्तकारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhyah pashyata chanuram niyuddharthamayam harih |
samupaiti na samtyatra kim vriddha muktakarinah ||

verses.sa:
क्व यौवनोन्मुखीभूतसुकुमारतनुर्हरिः ।
क्व वज्रकठिनाभोगशरीरोऽयं महासुरः ॥
verses.rom:
kva yauvanonmukhibhutasukumaratanurharih |
kva vajrakathinabhogashariro'yam mahasurah ||

verses.sa:
इमौ सुललितैरंगैर्वर्त्तेते नवयौवनौ ।
दैतेयमल्लाश्चाणूरप्रमुखास्त्वतिदारुणाः ॥
verses.rom:
imau sulalitairamgairvarttete navayauvanau |
daiteyamallashchanurapramukhastvatidarunah ||

verses.sa:
नियुद्धप्राश्निकानां तु महानेष व्यतिक्रमः ।
यद्बालबलिनोर्युद्धं मध्यस्थैस्समुपेक्ष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
niyuddhaprashnikanam tu mahanesha vyatikramah |
yadbalabalinoryuddham madhyasthaissamupekshyate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्थं पुरस्त्रीलोकस्व वदतश्चालयन्भुवम् ।
ववल्ग बद्धकक्ष्यॐतर्जनस्य भगवान्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ittham purastrilokasva vadatashchalayanbhuvam |
vavalga baddhakakshyaomtarjanasya bhagavanharih ||

verses.sa:
बलभद्रो ऽपि चास्फोट्य ववल्गललितं तथा ।
पदेपदे तथा भूमिर्यन्न शीर्णा तदद्भुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
balabhadro 'pi chasphotya vavalgalalitam tatha |
padepade tatha bhumiryanna shirna tadadbhutam ||

verses.sa:
चाणूरेण ततः कृष्णो ययुधेऽमितविक्रमः ।
नियुद्धकुशलो दैत्यो बलभद्रे ण मुष्टिकः ॥
verses.rom:
chanurena tatah krishno yayudhe'mitavikramah |
niyuddhakushalo daityo balabhadre na mushtikah ||

verses.sa:
सन्निपातावधूतैस्तु चाणूरेण समं हरिः ।
प्रक्षेपणैर्मुष्टिभिश्च कीलवज्रनिपातनैः ॥
verses.rom:
sannipatavadhutaistu chanurena samam harih |
prakshepanairmushtibhishcha kilavajranipatanaih ||

verses.sa: पादोद्धूतैः प्रमृष्टैश्च तयोर्युद्धमभून्महत् ॥
verses.rom: padoddhutaih pramrishtaishcha tayoryuddhamabhunmahat ||

verses.sa:
अशस्त्रमतिघोरं तत्तयोर्युद्धं सुदारुणम् ।
बलप्राणविनिष्पाद्यं समाजोत्सवसन्निधौ ॥
verses.rom:
ashastramatighoram tattayoryuddham sudarunam |
balapranavinishpadyam samajotsavasannidhau ||

verses.sa:
यावद्यावच्च चाणूरो युयुधे हरिणा सह ।
प्राणहानिमवापाग्र्यां तावत्तावल्लवाल्लवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavadyavachcha chanuro yuyudhe harina saha |
pranahanimavapagryam tavattavallavallavam ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोपि युयुधे तेन लीलयैव जगन्मयः ।
खेदाच्चालयता कोपान्निजकेसरश्खोरम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishnopi yuyudhe tena lilayaiva jaganmayah |
khedachchalayata kopannijakesarashkhoram ||

verses.sa:
बलक्षयं विवृद्धिं च दृष्ट्वा चाणूकृष्णयोः ।
वारयामास तूर्याणि कंसः कोपपरायणः ॥
verses.rom:
balakshayam vivriddhim cha drishtva chanukrishnayoh |
varayamasa turyani kamsah kopaparayanah ||

verses.sa:
मृदंगादिषु तूर्येषु प्रतिषिद्धेषु तत्क्षणात् ।
खे संगतान्यवाद्यंत देवतूर्याण्यनेकशः ॥
verses.rom:
mridamgadishu turyeshu pratishiddheshu tatkshanat |
khe samgatanyavadyamta devaturyanyanekashah ||

verses.sa:
जय गोविंद चाणूरं जहि केशव दानवम् ।
अंतर्द्धानगता देवास्तमूचुरतिहर्षिताः ॥
verses.rom:
jaya govimda chanuram jahi keshava danavam |
amtarddhanagata devastamuchuratiharshitah ||

verses.sa:
चाणूरेण चिरं कालं पीडित्वा मधुसूदनः ।
उत्पाट्य भ्रामयामास तद्वधाय कृतोद्यमः ॥
verses.rom:
chanurena chiram kalam piditva madhusudanah |
utpatya bhramayamasa tadvadhaya kritodyamah ||

verses.sa:
भ्रामयित्वा शतगुणं दैत्यमल्लममित्रजित् ।
भूमावास्फोटयामास गगने गतजीवितम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhramayitva shatagunam daityamallamamitrajit |
bhumavasphotayamasa gagane gatajivitam ||

verses.sa:
भूमावास्फोटितस्तेन चाणूरः शतधाऽभवत् ।
रक्तस्रावमहापंकां चकार च तदा भुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhumavasphotitastena chanurah shatadha'bhavat |
raktasravamahapamkam chakara cha tada bhuvam ||

verses.sa:
बलदेवोऽपि तत्कालं मुष्टिकेन महाबलः ।
युयुधे दैत्यमल्लेन चाणूरेण यथा हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
baladevo'pi tatkalam mushtikena mahabalah |
yuyudhe daityamallena chanurena yatha harih ||

verses.sa:
सोऽप्येनं मुष्टिना मूर्ध्नि वक्षस्याहत्य जानुना ।
पातयित्वा धरापृष्ठे निष्पिपेष गतायुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'pyenam mushtina murdhni vakshasyahatya januna |
patayitva dharaprishthe nishpipesha gatayusham ||

verses.sa:
कृष्ण स्तोशलकं भूयो मल्लराजं महाबलम् ।
वाममुष्टिप्रहारेण पातयामास भूतले ॥
verses.rom:
krishna stoshalakam bhuyo mallarajam mahabalam |
vamamushtipraharena patayamasa bhutale ||

verses.sa:
चाणूरे नहते मल्ले मुष्टेके विनिपातिते ।
नीते क्षयं तोशलके सर्वे मल्लाः प्रदुद्रु वुः ॥
verses.rom:
chanure nahate malle mushteke vinipatite |
nite kshayam toshalake sarve mallah pradudru vuh ||

verses.sa:
ववल्गतुस्ततो रंगे कृष्णसंकर्षणावुभौ ।
समानवयसो गोपान्बलादाकृष्य हर्षितौ ॥
verses.rom:
vavalgatustato ramge krishnasamkarshanavubhau |
samanavayaso gopanbaladakrishya harshitau ||

verses.sa:
कंसोऽपि कोपरक्ताक्षः प्राहोच्चैर्व्यायतान्नरान् ।
गोपावेतौ समाजौघान्निष्क्राम्येतां बलादितः ॥
verses.rom:
kamso'pi koparaktakshah prahochchairvyayatannaran |
gopavetau samajaughannishkramyetam baladitah ||

verses.sa:
नंदोऽपि गृह्यतां पापो निर्गलैरायसैरिह ।
अवृद्धार्हेण दंडेन वसुदेवोऽपि बध्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
namdo'pi grihyatam papo nirgalairayasairiha |
avriddharhena damdena vasudevo'pi badhyatam ||

verses.sa:
वल्गंति गोपाः कृष्णेन ये चेमे सहिताः पुरः ।
गावो निगृह्य तामेषां यच्चास्ति वसु किंचन ॥
verses.rom:
valgamti gopah krishnena ye cheme sahitah purah |
gavo nigrihya tamesham yachchasti vasu kimchana ||

verses.sa:
एवमाज्ञापयानं तु प्रहस्य मधुसूदनः ।
उत्प्लुत्यारुह्य तं मंचं कंसं जग्राह वेगतः ॥
verses.rom:
evamajnapayanam tu prahasya madhusudanah |
utplutyaruhya tam mamcham kamsam jagraha vegatah ||

verses.sa:
केश्ष्वोआ!कृष्य विगलत्किरीटमवनीतले ।
स कंसं पातयामास तस्योपरि पपात च ॥
verses.rom:
keshshvoa!krishya vigalatkiritamavanitale |
sa kamsam patayamasa tasyopari papata cha ||

verses.sa:
अश्षोजगदाधारगुरुणा पततोपरि ।
कृष्णेन त्याजितः प्राणानुग्रसेनात्मजो नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
ashshojagadadharaguruna patatopari |
krishnena tyajitah prananugrasenatmajo nripah ||

verses.sa:
नृतस्य केश्षोउ! तदा गृहीत्वा मधुसूदनः ।
चकर्ष देहं कंसस्य रंगमध्ये महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
nritasya keshshou! tada grihitva madhusudanah |
chakarsha deham kamsasya ramgamadhye mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
गौरवेणातिपतता परिघातेन कृष्यता ।
कृता कंसस्य देहेन वेगेनेव महांभसः ॥
verses.rom:
gauravenatipatata parighatena krishyata |
krita kamsasya dehena vegeneva mahambhasah ||

verses.sa:
कंसे गृहीते कृष्णेन तद्भ्राताऽभ्यागतो रुषा ।
सुनामा बलभद्रे ण लीलयैव निपातितः ॥
verses.rom:
kamse grihite krishnena tadbhrata'bhyagato rusha |
sunama balabhadre na lilayaiva nipatitah ||

verses.sa:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वमासीत्तद्रं गमंडलम् ।
अवज्ञया हतं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णेन मथुरेश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato hahakritam sarvamasittadram gamamdalam |
avajnaya hatam drishtva krishnena mathureshvaram ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोऽपि वसुदेवस्य पादौ जग्राह सत्वरः ।
देवक्याश्च महाबाहुर्बलदेवसहायवान् ॥
verses.rom:
krishno'pi vasudevasya padau jagraha satvarah |
devakyashcha mahabahurbaladevasahayavan ||

verses.sa:
उत्थाप्य वसुदेवस्तं देवकी च जनार्दनम् ।
स्मृतजन्मोक्तवचनौ तावेव प्रणतौ स्थितौ ॥
verses.rom:
utthapya vasudevastam devaki cha janardanam |
smritajanmoktavachanau taveva pranatau sthitau ||

verses.sa:
श्रीवसुदेव उवाच।
प्रसीद सीदतां दत्तो देवानां यो वरः प्रभो ।
तथावयोः प्रसादेन कृतोद्धारस्स केशव ॥
verses.rom:
shrivasudeva uvacha|
prasida sidatam datto devanam yo varah prabho |
tathavayoh prasadena kritoddharassa keshava ||

verses.sa:
आराधितो यद्भगवानवतीर्णो गृहे मम ।
दुर्वृत्तनिधनार्थाय तेन नः पावितं कुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
aradhito yadbhagavanavatirno grihe mama |
durvrittanidhanarthaya tena nah pavitam kulam ||

verses.sa:
त्वमंतः सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतमयस्थितः ।
प्रवर्त्तेते समस्तात्मंस्त्वत्तो भूतभविष्यती ॥
verses.rom:
tvamamtah sarvabhutanam sarvabhutamayasthitah |
pravarttete samastatmamstvatto bhutabhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञैस्त्वमिज्यसेऽचिंत्य सर्वदेवमयाच्युत ।
त्वमेव यज्ञो यष्टा च यज्वनां परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnaistvamijyase'chimtya sarvadevamayachyuta |
tvameva yajno yashta cha yajvanam parameshvarah ||

verses.sa: समुद्भवस्समस्तस्य जगतस्त्वं जनार्दन ॥
verses.rom: samudbhavassamastasya jagatastvam janardana ||

verses.sa:
सापह्नवं मम मनो यदेतत्त्वयि जायते ।
देवक्याश्चात्मजप्रीत्या तदत्यंतविडंबना ॥
verses.rom:
sapahnavam mama mano yadetattvayi jayate |
devakyashchatmajapritya tadatyamtavidambana ||

verses.sa:
त्वं कर्त्ता सर्वभूतानामनादिनिधनो भवान् ।
त्वं मनुष्यस्य कस्यैषा जिह्वा पुत्रेति वक्ष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kartta sarvabhutanamanadinidhano bhavan |
tvam manushyasya kasyaisha jihva putreti vakshyati ||

verses.sa:
जगदेतज्जगन्नाथ संभूतमखिलं यतः ।
कया युक्त्या विना मायां सोऽस्मत्तः संभविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
jagadetajjagannatha sambhutamakhilam yatah |
kaya yuktya vina mayam so'smattah sambhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ।
स कोष्ठोत्संगशयनो मानुषो जाय ते कथम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasminpratishthitam sarvam jagatsthavarajamgamam |
sa koshthotsamgashayano manusho jaya te katham ||

verses.sa:
स त्वं प्रसीद परमेश्वर पाहि विश्वमंशावतारकरणैर्न ममासि पुत्रः ।
आब्रह्यपादपमिदं जगदेतदीश त्वत्तो विमोहयसि किं पुरुषोत्तमास्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam prasida parameshvara pahi vishvamamshavatarakaranairna mamasi putrah |
abrahyapadapamidam jagadetadisha tvatto vimohayasi kim purushottamasman ||

verses.sa:
मायाविमोहितदृशा तनयो ममेति कंसाद्भयं कृतमपास्तभयोऽतितीव्रम् ।
नीतोऽसि गोकुलमरातिभया कुलेन वृद्धिं गतोऽसि मम नास्ति ममत्वमीश ॥
verses.rom:
mayavimohitadrisha tanayo mameti kamsadbhayam kritamapastabhayo'titivram |
nito'si gokulamaratibhaya kulena vriddhim gato'si mama nasti mamatvamisha ||

verses.sa:
कर्माणि रुद्र मरुदश्विशतक्रतूनां साध्यानि यस्य न भवंति निरीक्षितानि ।
त्वं विष्णुरीश जगतामुपकारहेतोः प्राप्तोसि नः परिगतो विगतो हि मोहः ॥
verses.rom:
karmani rudra marudashvishatakratunam sadhyani yasya na bhavamti nirikshitani |
tvam vishnurisha jagatamupakarahetoh praptosi nah parigato vigato hi mohah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो! विंशोध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho! vimshodhyayah ||

prose.en:
While thus going along the high road, Krishna saw a young girl, who was crooked, carrying a pot of unguent. Krishna addressed her in sweet words and said—"For whom are you carrying that unguent? Tell me, lovely maiden, tell me truly". Being thus addressed by him through affection, Kubja being attracted by his affection and well disposed towards Hari, replied to him also mirthfully:—"Do you not know, my lord, that my name is Tribakra, I am the servant of Kansa and appointed to prepare his perfumes. Kansa does not like perfumes prepared by any other female and for this he loves me greatly and shows me favour". Krishna said:—"O thou having a lovely countenance, give us sufficient unguent used by the king, to rub upon our bodies". "Take it," Kubja said and she gave them as much of the unguent as was required for their persons and they rubbed it on various parts of their bodies and faces, till they looked like two clouds, one white and one black, decorated by the many-tinted bow of Indra. Then Krishna skilled in the curative art, took hold of her under the chin, with the thumb and two fingers and lifted up her head, whilst with his feet he pressed down her feet and in this way he made her straight. Being thus rendered straight, she became the most beautiful of damsels. Then filled with affection, she took Govinda by the garment and said "Come to my house". Hari, smiling, replied—"I shall come to your house sometime after". Having thus dismissed her and cast his looks towards Rāma, he laughed aloud.

Dressed then in blue and yellow raiment and annointed with fragrant unguents and adorned with beautiful garlands, Kesava and Rāma went to the hall of arms. They then inquired of the warder which excellent bow they would take. Being informed, Krishna at once took up a bow and bent it; then drawing it with violence he snapped it in two and all Mathura resounded with the noise made by its fracture. Abused by the guards for breaking the bow, Krishna and Rāma retorted and defied them and left the hall.

When Kansa came to know that Akrura had returned and Krishna had snapped the bow, he then said to Chānura and Mushtika:—"Two cow-herd boys have arrived—You must kill them both before me in a trial of strength, for they always try to kill me. When you two, gifted with great strength, shall destroy these two cow-herd boys—I shall give you whatever you will desire. These two boys are my enemies; by means, whether foul or fair, you must kill them both. They killed, the kingdom shall be ours in common". Having thus commanded the two wrestlers, he sent for his elephant-driver and said to him loudly:—"You must place my great elephant Kuvalayāpida who is as huge as a cloud charged with rain, near the gate of the arena and drive him upon the two boys when they shall attempt to enter". Having given these orders, he ascertained that the platforms were all ready and waited for the rising sun, not conscious of his impending death.

In the morning the citizens assembled on the platforms set apart for them, and the princes with the ministers and courtiers occupied the royal seats. Kansa made all those sit in front who were judges of the games whilst he himself sat apart, close by, upon a lofty throne. Separate platforms were also set up for the ladies of the palace and they sat there. Nanda and cow-herds had places set apart for them at the end of which sat Akrura and Vasudeva. Amongst the wives of the citizens was Devaki, mourning for her son, whose lovely countenance she desired to see even in the hour of destruction. Thereafter the bugles were sounded and Chānura sprang forth and Mushtika clapped his arms defiantly and people cried aloud "Alas". Covered with the temporal juice and blood of the elephant, whom they had killed when driven against them by the driver, Balabhadra and Janarddana confidently entered the arena, like two lions amidst a herd of deer, with proud looks towards all. There arose exclamations of pity and expressions of surprise from all the arena and people said "This is Krishna! This is Balabhadra!! This is that Krishna by whom the she-demon Putanā was killed. This is that Krishna by whom the wagon was upset. This is that Krishna who uprooted the two trees. This is that Krishna—the boy who danced upon the hooded fangs of the serpent Kāliya and who for seven days upheld the mountain Govardhana. Behold, this is that Krishna, who easily destroyed the demons Aristha, Dhenuka and Kesin. This is that Achyuta. There is his elder brother Balabhadra, before him, having long arms. He is young, sportively affording delight to the minds and eyes of the damsels. It has been foretold by the wise, skilled in the sense of Purānas that he shall, as a cow-herd, exalt the depressed Yadu race. This is a portion of the all-existing, all-generating Vishnu descended upon earth, who will assuredly lighten her load". The citizens having thus described Rāma and Krishna, Devaki's heart was filled with compassion and milk oozed out of her breast out of affection. And on beholding the faces of his son, Vasudeva forgot his infirmities and felt himself young again. The women of the palace, and the females of the city beheld Krishna with eyes wide open. "Look friends" said they to their companions "Look at the face of Krishna; his eyes are reddened by his conflict with the elephant and the drops of perspiration stand upon his cheek outweighing a full-blown lotus in autumn studded with glittering dew. Make your birth blessed and the faculty of vision fruitful, by beholding the breast of the boy, the seat of splendour and marked with the mystic sign Sribatsa; and see his arms menacing destruction to the enemies. Do you not see Balabhadra coming with him, clad in a blue raiment, having his countenance fair as the jasmine, as the moon and as the fibres of the lotus stem? See, how he gently smiles at the gestures of Mushtika and Chānura as they spring up. And see Hari is advancing to meet Chānura. Is there no elder present here who will judge rightly? How can the delicate form of Hari, just in his youth, match the huge and adamantine form of the great demon Chānura? Two youths of delicate and beautiful forms are on the one side and the athletic fiends headed by Chānura on the other. Is this fair? This is a great sin in the umpires to allow a contest between boys and strong men".

Parāçara said:—The women of the city having thus conversed with one another, Hari tightened his girdle and danced in the ring shaking the ground on which he trod. Balabhadra too, slapping his arms defiantly, danced—and wonder it is that the earth was not riven asunder by his trodding. The highly powerful Krishna engaged with Chānura and the demon Mushtika, well-versed in wrestling, began to fight with Balabhadra. Mutually entwining and pushing and pulling and beating each other with fists, arms and elbows and pressing each other with their knees, interlacing their arms, kicking with their feet, pressing with their whole weight upon another, fought Hari and Chānura. And at the time of this national festival, dreadful was the encounter, though without weapons, displaying strength and heroism. And as long as the contest continued, Chānura was gradually losing something of his original vigour and the wreath upon his head trembled from his fury and distress, whilst the world-comprehending Krishna wrestled with him but sportively. Seeing Chānura losing and Krishna gaining strength—Kansa, worked up with ire, ordered the music to cease. And as soon as music was stopped by Kansa countless celestial bugles were sounded in the welkin. And the celestials, greatly delighted and invisible, said "Krishna be thou crowned with success; Kesava, do thou slay that demon Chānura". Thereupon sporting for a long time with Chānura, Krishna, the slayer of Madhu, at last lifted him up and whirled him with the intention of slaying him. Having whirled Chānura round a hundred times until his breath was expended in the sky, he dashed his body on the ground. As soon as it fell it was sundered into a hundred pieces and the earth was strewn with a hundred pools of gory mire. Whilst this happened, the powerful Baladeva was engaged likewise with the demon bruiser Mushtika. Striking him on the head with his fists and on the breast with his knees, he stretched him on the ground, and pummelled him there till he was dead. Again, Krishna encountered the royal bruiser Tomalaka, and felled him to the earth with a blow of his left hand. When the other athletes saw Chānura, Mushtika, and Tomalaka killed, they fled from the field; and Krishna and Sankarshana danced victorious on the arena, dragging along with them by force the cowherds of their own age. Kansa, his eyes reddening with wrath, called aloud to the surrounding people, "Drive those two cow-boys out of the assembly; seize the villain Nanda, and secure him with chains of iron; put Vasudeva to death with tortures intolerable to his years; and lay hands upon the cattle, and whatever else belongs to those cowherds who are the associates of Krishna".

Upon hearing these orders, the destroyer of Madhu laughed at Kansa, and springing up to the place where he was seated, laid hold of him by the hair of his head, and struck his tiara to the ground: then casting him down upon the earth, Govinda threw himself upon him. Crushed by the weight of the upholder of the universe, the son of Ugrasena, Kansa the king, gave up the ghost. Krishna then dragged the dead body, by the hair of the head, into the centre of the arena, and a deep furrow was made by the vast and heavy carcass of Kansa, when it was dragged along the ground by Krishna, as if a torrent of water had run through it. Seeing Kansa thus treated, his brother Sumālin came to his succour; but he was encountered, and easily killed, by Balabhadra. Then arose a general cry of grief from the surrounding circle, as they beheld the king of Mathura thus slain, and treated with such contumely, by Krishna. Krishna, accompanied by Balabhadra, embraced the feet of Vasudeva and of Devaki; but Vasudeva raised him up; and he and Devaki recalling to recollection what he had said to them at his birth, they bowed to Janārddana, and the former thus addressed him: "Have compassion upon mortals, O god, benefactor and lord of deities: it is by thy favour to us two, that thou hast become the (present) upholder of the world. That for the punishment of the rebellious, thou hast descended upon earth in my house, having been propitiated by my prayers, sanctifies our race. Thou art the heart of all creatures; thou abidest in all creatures, and all that has been, or will be, proceeds from thee, O universal spirit! Thou, Achyuta, who comprehendest all the gods, art eternally worshipped with sacrifices: thou art sacrifice itself, and the offerer of sacrifices. The affection that inspires my heart and the heart of Devaki towards thee as if thou wast our child, is indeed but error, and a great delusion. How shall the tongue of a mortal such as I am call the creator of all things who is without beginning or end, son? It is reasonable, that the lord of the world from whom the world proceeds should be born of me, except through illusion? How should he, in whom all mobile and immobile beings exist, be conceived in the womb and born of a mortal being? Have pity on me, therefore, O Supreme lord, and being incarnate do thou protect the universe. O god, thou art not my son: thou comprisest the whole universe from Brahmā to a tree. Therefore, O great soul, why dost thou beguile me? Blinded by illusion I considered thee, as my son and hence I was afraid of Kansa. And therefore I did carry thee to Gokula where thou hast grown up; but I no longer consider thee as mine own son. Thou Vishnu the supreme lord of all, whose actions Rudra, the Maruts, the Aswins, Indra and the celestials cannot equal although they behold them; thou, who hast descended amongst us for the behoof of the universe, art recognized, and delusion is no more".

verses.sa:
तौ समुत्पन्नविज्ञानौ भगवत्कर्म्मदर्शनात् ।
देवकी-वसुदेवौ तु दृष्ट्वा मायां पुनर्हरिः ।
मोहाय यदुचक्रस्य विततान स वैष्णवीम ॥
verses.rom:
tau samutpannavijnanau bhagavatkarmmadarshanat |
devaki-vasudevau tu drishtva mayam punarharih |
mohaya yaduchakrasya vitatana sa vaishnavima ||

verses.sa:
उवाच चाम्ब! भोस्तात! चिरादुत्कण्ठितेन मे ।
भवन्तौ कंसभीतेन दृष्टौ सङ्कर्षणेन च ॥
verses.rom:
uvacha chamba! bhostata! chiradutkanthitena me |
bhavantau kamsabhitena drishtau sankarshanena cha ||

verses.sa:
कुर्व्वतां याति यः कालो मातापित्रोरपूजनम् ।
तत्खणडमायुषो व्यर्थमसाधूनां हि जायते ॥
verses.rom:
kurvvatam yati yah kalo matapitrorapujanam |
tatkhanadamayusho vyarthamasadhunam hi jayate ||

verses.sa:
गुरु-देव-द्विजातीनां मातापित्रोश्व पूजनम् ।
कुर्व्वतां सफलं जन्म देहिनां तात!जायते ॥
verses.rom:
guru-deva-dvijatinam matapitroshva pujanam |
kurvvatam saphalam janma dehinam tata!jayate ||

verses.sa:
तत् क्षन्तव्यमिदं सर्वमतिक्रमकृतं पितः ।
कंसप्रतापवीर्य्याभ्यामार्त्तयोः परवश्ययोः ॥
verses.rom:
tat kshantavyamidam sarvamatikramakritam pitah |
kamsapratapaviryyabhyamarttayoh paravashyayoh ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वाथ प्रणम्योभौ यदुवृद्धाननुक्रमात् ।
यथावदभिपूज्याथ चक्रतुः पौर-माननम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktvatha pranamyobhau yaduvriddhananukramat |
yathavadabhipujyatha chakratuh paura-mananam ||

verses.sa:
कंसपत्न्यस्ततः कंसं परिवार्य्यहतं भुवि ।
विलेपुर्मातरश्वास्य दुःखशोकपरिप्लुताः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsapatnyastatah kamsam parivaryyahatam bhuvi |
vilepurmatarashvasya duhkhashokapariplutah ||

verses.sa:
बहुप्रकारमत्यर्थ पश्वात्तापातुरो हरिः ।
ताः समाश्वासयामास स्वयमस्त्राविलेक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
bahuprakaramatyartha pashvattapaturo harih |
tah samashvasayamasa svayamastravilekshanah ||

verses.sa:
उग्रसेनं ततो बन्धान्मुमोच मधुसूदनः ।
अभ्यषिञ्चत् तथैवैनं निजराज्ये हतात्मजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ugrasenam tato bandhanmumocha madhusudanah |
abhyashinchat tathaivainam nijarajye hatatmajam ||

verses.sa:
राज्याभिषिक्तः कृष्णेन यदुसिहः सुतस्य सः ।
चकार प्रेतकार्य्याणि ये चान्ये तत्र घातिताः ॥
verses.rom:
rajyabhishiktah krishnena yadusihah sutasya sah |
chakara pretakaryyani ye chanye tatra ghatitah ||

verses.sa:
कृतौर्द्ध्व दैहिकं चैनं सिहासनगतं हरिः ।
उवाचाज्ञापय विभो! यत् कार्य्यमविशङ्कितः ॥
verses.rom:
kritaurddhva daihikam chainam sihasanagatam harih |
uvachajnapaya vibho! yat karyyamavishankitah ||

verses.sa:
ययातिशापाद वंशोऽयमराज्यार्होऽपि साम्प्रतम् ।
मयि भृत्ये स्थिते देवानाज्ञापयतु किं नुपैः ॥
verses.rom:
yayatishapada vamsho'yamarajyarho'pi sampratam |
mayi bhritye sthite devanajnapayatu kim nupaih ||

verses.sa:
इत्युत्त्वा सोऽस्मरदू वायुमाजगाम स तत्क्षणात् ।
उवाच चैनं भगवान केशवः कार्य्यमानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuttva so'smaradu vayumajagama sa tatkshanat |
uvacha chainam bhagavana keshavah karyyamanushah ||

verses.sa:
गच्छेन्द्रं ब्रूहि वायो ! त्वमलं गर्व्वेणा वासव!
दीयतामुग्रसेनाय सुधर्म्मा भवता सभा ॥
verses.rom:
gachchhendram bruhi vayo ! tvamalam garvvena vasava!
diyatamugrasenaya sudharmma bhavata sabha ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णो ब्रवीति राजांर्हमेतद्रत्नमनुत्तमम् ।
सुधर्म्माख्या सभा युक्तमस्यां यदुभिरासितुम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishno braviti rajamrhametadratnamanuttamam |
sudharmmakhya sabha yuktamasyam yadubhirasitum ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तः पवनो गत्वा सर्व्वमाह शचीपतिम् ।
ददौ सोऽपि सुधर्म्माख्यां सभां वायोः पुरन्दरः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah pavano gatva sarvvamaha shachipatim |
dadau so'pi sudharmmakhyam sabham vayoh purandarah ||

verses.sa:
वायुना चाहृतां दिव्यां सभां ते यदुपुङ्गवाः ।
बुभुजुः सर्व्वरत्नाढ्यां गोविन्दभुजसंश्रयात् ॥
verses.rom:
vayuna chahritam divyam sabham te yadupungavah |
bubhujuh sarvvaratnadhyam govindabhujasamshrayat ||

verses.sa:
विदिताखिलविज्ञानौ सर्व्वज्ञानमयावपि ।
शिष्याचार्य्यक्रमं वीरौ ख्यापयन्तौ यदूत्तमौ ॥
verses.rom:
viditakhilavijnanau sarvvajnanamayavapi |
shishyacharyyakramam virau khyapayantau yaduttamau ||

verses.sa:
ततः सान्दीपनिं काश्यमवन्तीपुरवासिनम् ।
अस्त्रर्थं जग्मतुर्वीरौ बलदेव-जनार्द्दनौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sandipanim kashyamavantipuravasinam |
astrartham jagmaturvirau baladeva-janarddanau ||

verses.sa:
तस्य शिष्यत्त्वमभ्येत्य गुरुवृत्तपरौ हि तौ ।
दर्शयाञ्चक्रतुर्वीरावाचारमखिले जने ॥
verses.rom:
tasya shishyattvamabhyetya guruvrittaparau hi tau |
darshayanchakraturviravacharamakhile jane ||

verses.sa:
सरहस्यं धनुर्व्वेदं ससंग्रहमधीयताम् ।
अहोरात्रैश्वतुः षष्ट्य तदद्भुतमभूदू द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
sarahasyam dhanurvvedam sasamgrahamadhiyatam |
ahoratraishvatuh shashtya tadadbhutamabhudu drija ||

verses.sa:
सान्दीपनिरसम्भाव्यं तयोः कर्म्मातिमानुषम् ।
विचिन्त्य तौ तदा मेन प्राप्तौ चन्द्र-दिवाकारौ ॥
verses.rom:
sandipanirasambhavyam tayoh karmmatimanusham |
vichintya tau tada mena praptau chandra-divakarau ||

verses.sa:
अस्त्रग्राममशेषञ्च प्रोक्तमात्रमवाप्य तौ ।
ऊचतुर्व्रियतां या ते दातव्या गुरुदक्षिणा ॥
verses.rom:
astragramamasheshancha proktamatramavapya tau |
uchaturvriyatam ya te datavya gurudakshina ||

verses.sa:
सोऽप्यतीन्द्रियमालोक्य तयोः कर्म्म महामतिः ।
अयाचत मृतं पुत्रं प्रभासे लवणार्णावे ॥
verses.rom:
so'pyatindriyamalokya tayoh karmma mahamatih |
ayachata mritam putram prabhase lavanarnave ||

verses.sa:
गृहीतास्त्रौ ततस्तौ तु सार्घ्यहस्तो महोदधिः ।
उवाच न मया पुत्रो हतः सान्दीपनेरिति ॥
verses.rom:
grihitastrau tatastau tu sarghyahasto mahodadhih |
uvacha na maya putro hatah sandipaneriti ||

verses.sa:
दैत्यः पञ्चजनो नाम शङ्खरूपः स बालकम् ।
जग्राह सोऽस्ति सलिले ममैवासुरसूदन ॥
verses.rom:
daityah panchajano nama shankharupah sa balakam |
jagraha so'sti salile mamaivasurasudana ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तोऽन्तर्ज्जलं गत्वा हत्वा पञ्चजनं खलम् ।
कृष्णो जग्राह तस्यास्थि-प्रभवं शङ्खमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityukto'ntarjjalam gatva hatva panchajanam khalam |
krishno jagraha tasyasthi-prabhavam shankhamuttamam ||

verses.sa:
यस्य नादेन दैत्यानां बलहानिरजायत ।
देवानां ववृधे तेजो यात्यधर्म्मश्व संक्षयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya nadena daityanam balahanirajayata |
devanam vavridhe tejo yatyadharmmashva samkshayam ||

verses.sa:
तं पाञ्चजन्यमापूर्य्य गत्वा यमपुरीं हरिः ।
बलदेवश्व बलवान् जित्वा वैवस्वतं यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam panchajanyamapuryya gatva yamapurim harih |
baladevashva balavan jitva vaivasvatam yamam ||

verses.sa:
तं बालं यातनासंस्थं यथापूर्व्वशरीरिणम् ।
पित्रे प्रदत्तवान् कृष्णो बलश्व बलिनां वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tam balam yatanasamstham yathapurvvasharirinam |
pitre pradattavan krishno balashva balinam varah ||

verses.sa:
मथुराञ्च पुनः प्राप्तावुग्रसेनेन पालिताम् ।
प्रहृष्टपुरुषस्त्रीकामुभौ राम-जनार्द्दनौ ॥
verses.rom:
mathurancha punah praptavugrasenena palitam |
prahrishtapurushastrikamubhau rama-janarddanau ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Beholding Devaki and Vasudeva obtain true discriminative knowledge on seeing his wonderful feat, Krishna, being anxious to beguile them and other descendants of Yadu race, spread again the illusions of Vishnu. Thereupon he said to his parents—"O father, O mother, my elder brother Baladeva was all along anxious to behold you. It is out of fear of Kansa he could not do so. So long the pious do not serve their parents that portion of their life is spent in vain. O father, blessed is the birth of those men who serve their spiritual preceptors, celestials, Brāhmanas and their parents. Thou shouldst therefore forgive us, O father, for the violations committed. For up to this time we were greatly distressed and under the influence of another on account of the prowess and strength of Kansa". Saying this Krishna bowed unto his parents and other elderly members of the Yadu race and duly honoured the citizens. Thereupon Kansa's mothers and wives being stricken with grief and sorrow, began to lament encircling Kansa lying dead on the ground. Hari then expressed his regret for what had happened, and with eyes saturated with tears he consoled them. The slayer of Madhu then released Ugrasena from prison and placed him on the throne rendered vacant by the death of his son. Being installed on the throne the Yadava-chief performed the funeral rites of Kansa and of the rest of the slain. When the ceremony was finished and Ugrasena had taken his royal seat, Krishna addressed him and said:—"O Supreme lord, order me freely what else to be done. By the curse of Yayati, our race cannot govern—but having me as your servant you may order even the celestials. How should kings disobey them?"

Parāçara said:—Having said this, Kesava, assuming human shape summoned mentally the deity of the wind, who immediately came there, and said to him—"Proceed, Vāyu, to Indra and tell him to lay aside his pomp, and resign to Ugrasena his splendid hall Sudharman: tell him that Krishna commands him to send the royal hall, the unrivalled gem of princely courts, for the assemblage of the race of Yādu". Accordingly Vāyu went and delivered the message to the husband of Sachi, who immediately gave up to him the hall Sudharman, and Vāyu conveyed it to the Yādavas, the chiefs of whom thenceforth possessed this celestial court, emblazoned with jewels, and defended by the arms of Govinda. The two excellent Yadu youths, versed in all knowledge, and possessed of all wisdom, then submitted to instruction, as the disciples of teachers. Accordingly they repaired to Sāndipani—who, though born in Kāsi, resided at Avanti—to study the science of arms, and, becoming his pupils, were obedient and attentive to their master, exhibiting an example to all men of the observance of instituted rules. In the course of sixty-four days they had gone through the elements of military science, with the treatises on the use of arms, and directions for the mystic incantations, which secure the aid of supernatural weapons. Sāndipani, astonished at such proficiency, and knowing that it exceeded human faculties, imagined that the sun and the moon had become his scholars. When they had acquired all that he could teach, they said to him, "Now say what present shall be given to you, as the preceptor's fee". The prudent Sāndipani, perceiving that they were endowed with more than mortal powers, requested them to give him his dead son, drowned in the sea of Prabhāsa. Taking up their arms, they marched against the ocean; but the all-comprehending sea said to them, "I have not killed the son of Sāndipani; a demon named Panchajana, who lives in the form of a conch shell, seized the boy; he is still under my waters". On hearing this, Krishna plunged into the sea; and having slain the vile Panchajana, he took the conch shell, which was formed of his bones (and bore it as his horn), the sound of which fills the demon hosts with dismay, animates the vigour of the gods, and annihilates unrighteousness. The heroes also recovered the boy from the pains of death, and restored him in his former person to his father. Rāma and Janārddana then returned to Mathura, which was well presided over by Ugrasena, and abounded in a happy population both of men and women.

verses.sa:
जरासन्घसुते कंस उपयेमे महाबलः ।
अस्ति प्राप्तिञ्च मैत्रेय!तयोर्भर्त्तृहनं हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
jarasanghasute kamsa upayeme mahabalah |
asti praptincha maitreya!tayorbharttrihanam harim ||

verses.sa:
महाबलपरीवारो मगधाघिपतिर्बली ।
हन्तुमभ्याययौ कोपाज्जरासन्धः सयादवम ॥
verses.rom:
mahabalaparivaro magadhaghipatirbali |
hantumabhyayayau kopajjarasandhah sayadavama ||

verses.sa:
उपेत्य मथुरां सोऽथ रुरोध मगधेखरः ।
अक्षौहिणीभिः सैन्यस्य त्रयोविंशतिभिर्वृतः ॥
verses.rom:
upetya mathuram so'tha rurodha magadhekharah |
akshauhinibhih sainyasya trayovimshatibhirvritah ||

verses.sa:
निष्कम्याल्पपरीवारावुभौ राम-जनार्द्दनौ ।
युयुधातौ समं तस्य बलिनौ बलिसैनिकैः ॥
verses.rom:
nishkamyalpaparivaravubhau rama-janarddanau |
yuyudhatau samam tasya balinau balisainikaih ||

verses.sa:
ततो बलश्व कृष्णश्व चक्राते मतिमुत्तमाम् ।
आयुधानां पुराणानामादाने मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tato balashva krishnashva chakrate matimuttamam |
ayudhanam purananamadane munisattama ||

verses.sa:
अनन्तरं हरेः शाङ्ग तूणौ चाक्षयसायकौ ।
आकाशादागतौ वीर!तथा कौमोदकी गदा ॥
verses.rom:
anantaram hareh shanga tunau chakshayasayakau |
akashadagatau vira!tatha kaumodaki gada ||

verses.sa:
हलञ्च बलभद्रस्य गगनादागतं कवे !
मनसोऽभिमतं विप्र!सौनन्दं मुसलं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
halancha balabhadrasya gaganadagatam kave !
manaso'bhimatam vipra!saunandam musalam tatha ||

verses.sa:
ततो युद्धे पराजित्य ससैन्यं मगधाधिपम् ।
पुरीं विविशतुर्वीरावुभौ राम-जनार्द्दनौ ॥
verses.rom:
tato yuddhe parajitya sasainyam magadhadhipam |
purim vivishaturviravubhau rama-janarddanau ||

verses.sa:
जते तस्मिन् सुदुर्वृत्ते जरासन्धे महामुने !
जीवमाने गते कृष्णस्तं नामन्यत निर्ज्जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
jate tasmin sudurvritte jarasandhe mahamune !
jivamane gate krishnastam namanyata nirjjitam ||

verses.sa:
पुनरप्याजगामाथ जरासन्धो बलान्वितः ।
जितश्व राम-कृष्णाभ्यामपक्रान्तो द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
punarapyajagamatha jarasandho balanvitah |
jitashva rama-krishnabhyamapakranto drijottama ||

verses.sa:
दश चाष्टौ च संग्रामानेवमत्यन्तदुर्म्मदः ।
यदुभिर्मागधो राजा चक्र कृष्णापुरोगमैः ॥
verses.rom:
dasha chashtau cha samgramanevamatyantadurmmadah |
yadubhirmagadho raja chakra krishnapurogamaih ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वेष्वेतेषु युद्धेषु यादवैः स पराजितः ।
अपक्रान्तो जरासन्धः स्वल्पसैन्यैर्बलाधिकः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvveshveteshu yuddheshu yadavaih sa parajitah |
apakranto jarasandhah svalpasainyairbaladhikah ||

verses.sa:
तदू बल यादवानां तैरर्ज्जितं यदनेकशः ।
तत्तु सन्निधिमाहात्म्यं विष्णोरंशस्य चक्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
tadu bala yadavanam tairarjjitam yadanekashah |
tattu sannidhimahatmyam vishnoramshasya chakrinah ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्यधर्म्मशीलस्य लीला सा जगतः पतेः ।
अस्त्रणयनेकरूपाणि यदरातिषु मुञ्चति ॥
verses.rom:
manushyadharmmashilasya lila sa jagatah pateh |
astranayanekarupani yadaratishu munchati ||

verses.sa:
मनसैव जगत्सृष्टिं संहारञ्च करोति यः ।
तस्यारिपक्षक्षपणे कोऽयमुद्यमविस्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
manasaiva jagatsrishtim samharancha karoti yah |
tasyaripakshakshapane ko'yamudyamavistarah ||

verses.sa:
तथापि यो मनुष्याणां धर्म्मस्तमनुवर्त्तते ।
कुर्व्वने बलवता सन्धिं हीनैर्युद्धं करोत्यसौ ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi yo manushyanam dharmmastamanuvarttate |
kurvvane balavata sandhim hinairyuddham karotyasau ||

verses.sa:
साम चोपप्रदानञ्च तथा भेदं प्रदर्शयन् ।
करोति दण्डपातञ्च क्बचिदेव पलायनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sama chopapradanancha tatha bhedam pradarshayan |
karoti dandapatancha kbachideva palayanam ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्यदेहिनां चेष्टामित्येवमनुवर्त्ततः ।
लीला जगतूपतेस्तस्य च्छन्दतः सम्प्रवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
manushyadehinam cheshtamityevamanuvarttatah |
lila jagatupatestasya chchhandatah sampravarttate ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—The mighty Kansa had married the two daughters of Jarāsandha, one named Asti, the other Prāpti. Jarāsandha was king of Magadha, and a very powerful prince, who, when he heard that Krishna had killed his son-in-law, was much incensed, and, collecting a large force, marched against Mathura, determined to put the Yādavas and Krishna to the sword. Accordingly he invested the city with three and twenty numerous divisions of his forces. Rāma and Janārddana sallied from the town with a slender, but resolute force, and fought bravely with the armies of Magadha. The two youthful leaders prudently resolved to have recourse to their ancient weapons, and accordingly the bow of Hari, with two quivers filled with exhaustless arrows and the mace called Kaumodaki, and the ploughshare of Balabhadra, as well as the club Saunanda, descended at a wish from heaven. Armed with these weapons, they speedily discomfited the king of Magadha and his hosts, and re-entered the city in triumph.

Although the wicked king of Magadha, Jarāsandha, was defeated, yet Krishna knew that whilst he escaped alive he was not subdued; and in fact, he soon returned with a mighty force, and was again forced by Rāma and Krishna to fly. Eighteen times did the haughty prince of Magadha renew his attack upon the Yādavas, headed by Krishna; and was as often defeated and put to the rout by them, with very inferior numbers. That the Yādavas were not overpowered by their foes, was owing to the present might of the portion of the discus-armed Vishnu. It was the pastime of the lord of the universe, in his capacity of man, to launch various weapons against his enemies; for what effort of power to annihilate his foes could be necessary to him, whose fiat creates and destroys the world? But as subjecting himself to human customs, he formed alliances with the brave, and engaged in hostilities with the base. He had recourse to the four devices of policy, or negotiation, presents, sowing dissension, and chastisement; and sometimes even betook himself to flight. Thus imitating the conduct of human beings, the lord of the world pursued at will his sports.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
गार्ग्यं गोष्ठ्यां द्विजं श्यालष्षंड इत्युक्तवान्द्विज
यदूनां सन्निधौ सर्वे जहसुर्यादवास्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
gargyam goshthyam dvijam shyalashshamda ityuktavandvija
yadunam sannidhau sarve jahasuryadavastada ||

verses.sa:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा दक्षिणापथमेत्य सः
सुतमिच्छंस्तपस्तेपे यदुचक्रभयावहम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kopaparitatma dakshinapathametya sah
sutamichchhamstapastepe yaduchakrabhayavaham ||

verses.sa:
आराधयन्महादेवं लोहचूर्णमभक्षयत्
ददौ वरं च तुष्टोऽस्मै वर्षे तु द्वादशो! हरः ॥
verses.rom:
aradhayanmahadevam lohachurnamabhakshayat
dadau varam cha tushto'smai varshe tu dvadasho! harah ||

verses.sa:
संतोषयामास च तं यवनेशो ह्यनात्मजः
तद्योषित्संगमाच्चास्य पुत्रोऽभूदलिसन्निभः ॥
verses.rom:
samtoshayamasa cha tam yavanesho hyanatmajah
tadyoshitsamgamachchasya putro'bhudalisannibhah ||

verses.sa:
तं कालयवनं नाम राये स्वे यवनेश्वरः
अभिषिच्य वनं यातो वज्राग्रकठिनोरसम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam kalayavanam nama raye sve yavaneshvarah
abhishichya vanam yato vajragrakathinorasam ||

verses.sa:
स तु वीर्यमदोन्मत्तः पृथिव्यां बलिनो नृपान्
अपृच्छन्नारदस्तस्मै कथयामास यादवान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu viryamadonmattah prithivyam balino nripan
aprichchhannaradastasmai kathayamasa yadavan ||

verses.sa:
म्लेच्छकोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रैस्सोभिसंवृतः
गजाश्वरथसंपन्नैश्चकार परमोद्यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
mlechchhakotisahasranam sahasraissobhisamvritah
gajashvarathasampannaishchakara paramodyamam ||

verses.sa:
प्रययौ स व्यवच्छिन्नं छिन्नयानो दिनेदिने
यादवान्प्रति सामर्षो मैत्रेय मथुरां पुरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
prayayau sa vyavachchhinnam chhinnayano dinedine
yadavanprati samarsho maitreya mathuram purim ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोऽपि चिंतयामास क्षपितं यादवं बलम्
यवनेन रणे गम्यं मागधस्य भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
krishno'pi chimtayamasa kshapitam yadavam balam
yavanena rane gamyam magadhasya bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
मागधस्य बलं क्षीणं स कालयवनो बली
हंतैतदेवमायातं यदूनां व्यसनं द्विधा ॥
verses.rom:
magadhasya balam kshinam sa kalayavano bali
hamtaitadevamayatam yadunam vyasanam dvidha ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्दुर्गं करिष्यामि यदूनामरिदुर्जयम्
स्त्रियोऽपि यत्र युद्धेयुः किं पुनर्वृष्णिपुंगवाः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmaddurgam karishyami yadunamaridurjayam
striyo'pi yatra yuddheyuh kim punarvrishnipumgavah ||

verses.sa:
मयि मत्ते प्रमत्ते वा सुप्ते प्रवसितेऽपि वा
यादवाभिभवं दुष्टा मा कुर्वंस्त्वरयोधिकाः ॥
verses.rom:
mayi matte pramatte va supte pravasite'pi va
yadavabhibhavam dushta ma kurvamstvarayodhikah ||

verses.sa:
इति संचिंत्य गोविंदो योजनानां महोदधिम्
ययाचे द्वादशपुरीं द्वारकां तत्र निर्ममे ॥
verses.rom:
iti samchimtya govimdo yojananam mahodadhim
yayache dvadashapurim dvarakam tatra nirmame ||

verses.sa:
महोद्यानां महावप्रां तटाकशतशोभिताम्
प्रासादगृहसंबाधामिंद्रस्येवामरावतीम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahodyanam mahavapram tatakashatashobhitam
prasadagrihasambadhamimdrasyevamaravatim ||

verses.sa:
मथुरावासिनं लोकं तत्रानीय जनार्दनः
आसन्ने कालयवने मथुरां च स्वयं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
mathuravasinam lokam tatraniya janardanah
asanne kalayavane mathuram cha svayam yayau ||

verses.sa:
बहिरावासिते सैन्ये मथुराया निरायुधः
निर्जगाम च गोविंदो ददर्श यवनश्च तम् ॥
verses.rom:
bahiravasite sainye mathuraya nirayudhah
nirjagama cha govimdo dadarsha yavanashcha tam ||

verses.sa:
स ज्ञात्वा वासुदेवं तं बाहुप्रहरणं नृपः
अनुयातो महायोगी चेतोभिः प्राप्यते न यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa jnatva vasudevam tam bahupraharanam nripah
anuyato mahayogi chetobhih prapyate na yah ||

verses.sa:
तेनानुयातः कृष्णोऽपि प्रविवेश महागुहाम्
यत्र शेते महावीर्यो मुचुकुंदो नरेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tenanuyatah krishno'pi pravivesha mahaguham
yatra shete mahaviryo muchukumdo nareshvarah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽपि प्रविष्टो यवनो दृष्ट्वा शय्यागतं नृपम्
पादेन ताडयामास मत्वा कृष्णं सुदुर्मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
so'pi pravishto yavano drishtva shayyagatam nripam
padena tadayamasa matva krishnam sudurmatih ||

verses.sa: उत्थाय मुचुकुंदोऽपि ददर्श यवनं नृपः ॥
verses.rom: utthaya muchukumdo'pi dadarsha yavanam nripah ||

verses.sa:
दृष्टमात्रश्च तेनाऽसौ जज्वाल यवनोग्निना
तत्क्रोधजेन मैत्रेय भस्मीभूतश्च तत्क्षणात् ॥
verses.rom:
drishtamatrashcha tena'sau jajvala yavanognina
tatkrodhajena maitreya bhasmibhutashcha tatkshanat ||

verses.sa:
स हि देवासुरे युद्धे गतो हत्वा महासुरान्
निद्रा र्त्तस्सुमहाकालं निद्रा ं! वव्रे वरं सुरान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi devasure yuddhe gato hatva mahasuran
nidra rttassumahakalam nidra m! vavre varam suran ||

verses.sa:
प्रोक्तश्च देवैस्संसुप्तं यस्त्वामुत्थापयिष्यति
देहजेनाग्निना सद्यस्स तु भस्मीभविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
proktashcha devaissamsuptam yastvamutthapayishyati
dehajenagnina sadyassa tu bhasmibhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
एवं दग्ध्वा स तं पापं दृष्ट्वा च मधुसूदनम्
कस्त्वमित्याह सोऽप्याह जातोहं शशिनः कुले
वसुदेवस्य तनयो यदोर्वंशसमुद्भवः ॥
verses.rom:
evam dagdhva sa tam papam drishtva cha madhusudanam
kastvamityaha so'pyaha jatoham shashinah kule
vasudevasya tanayo yadorvamshasamudbhavah ||

verses.sa: मुचुकुंदोऽपि तत्राऽसौ वृद्धगार्ग्यवचोऽस्मरत् ॥
verses.rom: muchukumdo'pi tatra'sau vriddhagargyavacho'smarat ||

verses.sa:
संस्मृत्य प्रणिपत्यैनं सर्वं सर्वेश्वरं हरिम्
प्राह ज्ञानो भवान्विष्णोरंशस्त्वं परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
samsmritya pranipatyainam sarvam sarveshvaram harim
praha jnano bhavanvishnoramshastvam parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
पुरा गार्ग्येण कथितमष्टाविंशतिमे युगे
द्वापरांते हरेर्जन्म यदुवंशो! भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
pura gargyena kathitamashtavimshatime yuge
dvaparamte harerjanma yaduvamsho! bhavishyati ||

verses.sa: स त्वं प्राप्तो न संदेहो मर्त्त्यानामुपकारकृत् ॥
verses.rom: sa tvam prapto na samdeho marttyanamupakarakrit ||

verses.sa:
तथाहि सुमहत्तेजो नालं सोढुमहं तव
तथाहि सजलांभोदनादधीरतरं तव
वाक्यं नमति चैवोर्वी युष्मत्पादप्रपीडिता ॥
verses.rom:
tathahi sumahattejo nalam sodhumaham tava
tathahi sajalambhodanadadhirataram tava
vakyam namati chaivorvi yushmatpadaprapidita ||

verses.sa:
देवासुरमहायुद्धे दैत्यसैन्यमहाभटाः
न सेहुर्मम तेजस्ते त्वत्तेजो न सहाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
devasuramahayuddhe daityasainyamahabhatah
na sehurmama tejaste tvattejo na sahamyaham ||

verses.sa:
संसारपतितस्यैको जंतोस्त्वं शरणं परम्
प्रसीद त्वं प्रपन्नार्त्तिहर नाशय मेऽशुभम् ॥
verses.rom:
samsarapatitasyaiko jamtostvam sharanam param
prasida tvam prapannarttihara nashaya me'shubham ||

verses.sa:
त्वं पयो निधयश्शैलसरितस्त्वं वनानि च
मेदिनी गगनं वायुरापोग्निस्त्वं तथा मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam payo nidhayashshailasaritastvam vanani cha
medini gaganam vayurapognistvam tatha manah ||

verses.sa:
बुद्धिरव्याकृतप्राणाः प्राणेशस्त्वं तथा पुमान्
पुंसः परतरं यच्च व्याप्य जन्म विकारवत् ॥
verses.rom:
buddhiravyakritapranah praneshastvam tatha puman
pumsah parataram yachcha vyapya janma vikaravat ||

verses.sa:
शब्दादिहीनमजरममेयं क्षयवर्जितम्
अवृद्धिनाशं तद्ब्रह्म त्वमाद्यंतविवर्जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shabdadihinamajaramameyam kshayavarjitam
avriddhinasham tadbrahma tvamadyamtavivarjitam ||

verses.sa:
त्वत्तोऽमरास्सपितरो यक्षगंधर्वकिन्नराः
सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसस्त्वत्तो मनुष्याः पशवः खगाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvatto'marassapitaro yakshagamdharvakinnarah
siddhashchapsarasastvatto manushyah pashavah khagah ||

verses.sa:
सरीसृपा मृगास्सर्वे त्वत्तस्सर्वे महीरुहाः
यच्च भूतं भविष्यं च किंचिदत्र चराचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarisripa mrigassarve tvattassarve mahiruhah
yachcha bhutam bhavishyam cha kimchidatra characharam ||

verses.sa:
मूर्त्तामूर्त्तं तथा चापि स्थूलं सूक्ष्मतरं तथा
तत्सर्वं त्वं जगत्कर्त्ता नास्ति किंचित्त्वया विना ॥
verses.rom:
murttamurttam tatha chapi sthulam sukshmataram tatha
tatsarvam tvam jagatkartta nasti kimchittvaya vina ||

verses.sa:
मया संसारचक्रेऽस्मिन्भ्रमता भगवंस्तदा
तापत्रयाभिभूतेन न प्राप्ता निर्वृतिः क्वचित् ॥
verses.rom:
maya samsarachakre'sminbhramata bhagavamstada
tapatrayabhibhutena na prapta nirvritih kvachit ||

verses.sa:
दुःखान्येव सुखानीति मृगतृष्णाजलाशयाः
मया नाथ गृहीतानि तानि तापाय मेऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
duhkhanyeva sukhaniti mrigatrishnajalashayah
maya natha grihitani tani tapaya me'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
राज्यमुर्वी बलं कोशो मित्रपक्षस्तथात्मजाः
भार्या भृत्य जनो ये च शब्दाद्या विषयाः प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
rajyamurvi balam kosho mitrapakshastathatmajah
bharya bhritya jano ye cha shabdadya vishayah prabho ||

verses.sa:
सुखबुद्ध्या मया सर्वं गृहीतमिदमव्ययम्
परिणामे तदेवेश तापात्मकमभून्मम ॥
verses.rom:
sukhabuddhya maya sarvam grihitamidamavyayam
pariname tadevesha tapatmakamabhunmama ||

verses.sa:
देवलोकगतिं प्राप्तो नाथ देवगणोऽपि हि
मत्तस्साहाय्यकामोभूच्छाश्वती कुत्र निर्वृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
devalokagatim prapto natha devagano'pi hi
mattassahayyakamobhuchchhashvati kutra nirvritih ||

verses.sa:
त्वामनाराध्य जगतां सर्वेषां प्रभवास्पदम्
शाश्वती प्राप्यते केन परमेश्वर निर्वृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamanaradhya jagatam sarvesham prabhavaspadam
shashvati prapyate kena parameshvara nirvritih ||

verses.sa:
त्वन्मायामूढमनसो जन्ममृत्युजरादिकान्
अवाप्य तापान्पश्यंति प्रेतराजमनंतरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvanmayamudhamanaso janmamrityujaradikan
avapya tapanpashyamti pretarajamanamtaram ||

verses.sa:
ततो निजक्रियासूतिनरकेष्वतिदारुणम्
प्राप्नुवंति नरा दुःखमस्वरूपविदस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
tato nijakriyasutinarakeshvatidarunam
prapnuvamti nara duhkhamasvarupavidastava ||

verses.sa:
अहमत्यंतविषयी मोहितस्तव मायया
ममत्वगर्वगर्त्तांतर्भ्रमामि परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
ahamatyamtavishayi mohitastava mayaya
mamatvagarvagarttamtarbhramami parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं त्वां शरणमपारमप्रमेयं संप्राप्तः परमपदं यतो न किंचित्
संसारभ्रमपरितापतप्तचेतानिर्वाणे परिणतधाम्नि साभिलाषः ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham tvam sharanamaparamaprameyam sampraptah paramapadam yato na kimchit
samsarabhramaparitapataptachetanirvane parinatadhamni sabhilashah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो! त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho! trayovimsho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Syāla having called Gargya, the Brāhmana, whilst at the cow-pens, impotent, in an assembly of the Yādavas, they all laughed; at which he was highly offended, and repaired to the shores of the western sea, where he engaged in arduous penance to obtain a son, who should be a terror to the tribe of Yadu. Propitiating Mahādeva, and living upon iron sand for twelve years, the deity at last was pleased with him, and gave him the desired boon. The king of the Yadanas, who was childless, became the friend of Gārgya; and the latter begot a son by his wife, who was as black as a bee, and thence called Kālayavana. The Yavana king having placed his son, whose breast was as hard as the point of the thunderbolt, upon the throne, retired to the woods. Inflated with the conceit of his prowess Kālayavana demanded of Nārada who were the most mighty heroes on earth. To which the sage answered. "The Yādavas". Accordingly Kālayavana assembled many myriads of Mlechhas and barbarians, with a vast armament of elephants, cavalry, chariots, and foot, advanced impatiently against Mathura and the Yādavas; wearying every day the animal that carried him, but insensible of fatigue himself.

When Krishna knew of his approach, he reflected that if the Yādavas encountered the Yavana, they would be so much weakened by the conflict, that they would then be overcome by the king of Magadha; that their force was much reduced by the war with Magadha, whilst that of Kālayavana was unbroken; and that the enemy might, therefore, be victorious. Thus the Yādavas were exposed to a double danger. He resolved therefore to construct a citadel for the Yadu tribe, that should not be easily taken; one that even women might defend, and in which therefore the heroes of the house of Vrishni should be secure; one in which the male combatants of the Yādavas should dread no peril, though he himself should be drunk or careless, asleep or abroad. Thus reflecting, Krishna solicited a space of twelve furlongs from the ocean, and there he built the city of Dwārakā, defended by high ramparts, and beautified with gardens and reservoirs of water, crowded with houses and buildings, and splendid as the capital of Indra, Amarāvati. Thither Janārddana conducted the inhabitants of Mathura, and then awaited at that city the approach of Kālayavana.

When the hostile army encamped round Mathura, Krishna, unarmed, went forth, and beheld the Yavana king. Kālyavana, the strong-armed, recognising Vāsudeva, pursued him; him whom the thoughts of perfect ascetics cannot overtake. Thus pursued, Krishna entered a large cavern where Muchukunda, the king of men, was asleep. The rash Yavana entering the cave and beholding a man lying asleep there, concluded it must be Krishna, and kicked him; at which Muchukunda awoke, casting on him an angry glance, the Yavana was instantly consumed, and reduced to ashes. For, in a battle between the gods and demons, Muchukunda had formerly contributed to the defeat of the latter; and being overcome with sleep, he solicited of the gods as a boon that he should enjoy a long repose. "Sleep long and soundly," said the gods; "whoever disturbs you shall be instantly burnt to ashes by fire emanating from your body".

Having burnt up the iniquitous Yavana, and beholding the foe of Madhu, Muchukunda asked him who he was. "I am born," he replied, "in the lunar race, in the tribe of Yadu, and am the son of Vasudeva". Muchukunda, recollecting the prophecy of old Garga, fell down before the lord of all, Hari, saying. "Thou art known, supreme lord, to be a portion of Vishnu; for it was said of old by Garga, that at the end of the twenty-eighth Dwāpara age, Hari would be born in the family of Yadu. Thou art he, without doubt, the benefactor of mankind for thy glory I am unable to endure. Thy words are of deeper tone than the muttering of the rain cloud; and earth sinks down beneath the pressure of thy feet. As in the battle between the gods and demons, the Asuras were unable to sustain my lustre, so even am I incapable of bearing thy radiance. Thou alone art the refuge of every living being who has lighted on the world. Do thou, who art the alleviator of all distress, show favour upon me, and remove from me all that is evil. Thou art the oceans, the mountains, the rivers, the forests; thou art earth, sky, air, water, and fire; thou art mind, intelligence, the unevolved principle, vital airs, the lord, life—the soul; all that is beyond the soul; the all-pervading; exempt from the vicissitudes of birth; devoid of sensible properties, sound and the like: undecaying, illimitable, imperishable, subject neither to increase nor diminution; thou art that which is Brahmā, without beginning or end. From thee the immortals, the progenitors, the Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras, the Siddhas, the nymphs of heaven, men, animals, birds, deers, reptiles, and all the vegetable world, proceed; and all that has been, or will be, or is now movable or fixed. All that is amorphous or has form, all that is subtile, gross, salable, or movable, thou art, O creator of the world; and beside thee there is not anything. O lord, I have been whirled round in the circle of worldly existence for ever, and have suffered the three classes of affliction, and there is no rest whatever. I have mistaken pains for pleasures, sultry vapours for a pool of water; and their enjoyment has yielded me nothing but sorrow. The earth, dominion, forces, treasures, friends, children, wife, dependants, all the objects of sense, have I possessed imagining them to be sources of happiness; but I found that in their changeable nature, O lord, they were nothing but vexation. The gods themselves though high in heaven, were in need of my alliance. Where then is everlasting repose? Who, without adoring thee, who art the origin of all worlds, shall attain, O supreme deity, that rest which endures for ever? Beguiled by thy delusions, and ignorant of thy nature, men, after suffering the various penalties of birth, death, and infirmity, behold the countenance of the king of ghosts, and suffer in hell dreadful tortures, the reward of their own deeds. Addicted to sensual objects through thy delusions, I revolve in the whirlpool of selfishness and pride; and hence I come to thee, as my final refuge who art the lord deserving of all homage, than whom there is no other asylum; my mind afflicted with repentance for my trust in the world, and desiring the fullness of felicity, emancipation from all existence".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्थंस्तुतस्तदा तेन मुचुकुन्देन धीमता ।
प्राहेशः सर्वभूतानामनादिनिधनो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
itthamstutastada tena muchukundena dhimata |
praheshah sarvabhutanamanadinidhano harih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यथाभिवाञ्छितान्दिव्यान्गच्छलोकान्नराधिप ।
अव्याहतपरैश्वर्यो मत्प्रसादोपबृंहितः ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
yathabhivanchhitandivyangachchhalokannaradhipa |
avyahataparaishvaryo matprasadopabrimhitah ||

verses.sa:
भुक्त्वा दिव्यन्महा भोगान्भविष्यसि महाकुले ।
जातिस्मरो मत्प्रसादात्ततोमोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
bhuktva divyanmaha bhoganbhavishyasi mahakule |
jatismaro matprasadattatomokshamavapsyasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्येशं जगतामच्युतं नृपः ।
गुहामुखाद्विनिष्क्रान्ततःस ददर्शाल्पकान्नरान् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktah pranipatyesham jagatamachyutam nripah |
guhamukhadvinishkrantatahsa dadarshalpakannaran ||

verses.sa:
ततः कलियुगं मत्वा प्राप्तं तप्तुं नृपस्तपः ।
नरनारायणस्थानं प्रययौ गन्धमादनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kaliyugam matva praptam taptum nripastapah |
naranarayanasthanam prayayau gandhamadanam ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोपि घातयित्वारिमुपायेन हि तद्वलम् ।
जग्राह मथुरामेत्य हस्त्यश्वस्यन्दनोज्ज्वलम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishnopi ghatayitvarimupayena hi tadvalam |
jagraha mathurametya hastyashvasyandanojjvalam ||

verses.sa:
आनीय चोग्रसेनाय द्वारवत्वां न्यवेदयत् ।
पराभिभवनिः शङ्कं बभूव च यदोः कुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
aniya chograsenaya dvaravatvam nyavedayat |
parabhibhavanih shankam babhuva cha yadoh kulam ||

verses.sa:
बलदेवोऽपि मैत्रेय प्रशान्ताखिलविग्रहः ।
ज्ञातिदर्शनसोत्कण्ठः प्रययौ नन्दगोकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
baladevo'pi maitreya prashantakhilavigrahah |
jnatidarshanasotkanthah prayayau nandagokulam ||

verses.sa:
ततो गोपाश्च गोप्यश्च यथा पूर्वममित्रजित् ।
तथैवाभ्यवदत्प्रम्णा बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato gopashcha gopyashcha yatha purvamamitrajit |
tathaivabhyavadatpramna bahumanapurahsaram ||

verses.sa:
स कैश्चित्संपरिष्वक्तः कांश्चिच्च परिषस्वजे ।
हास्यं चक्रे समं कैश्चिद्गोपैर्गोपीजनैस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
sa kaishchitsamparishvaktah kamshchichcha parishasvaje |
hasyam chakre samam kaishchidgopairgopijanaistatha ||

verses.sa:
प्रियाण्यनेकान्यवदन् गोपास्तत्र हलायुधम् ।
गोप्यश्च प्रेमकुपिताः प्रोचुःसेर्ष्यमथापराः ॥
verses.rom:
priyanyanekanyavadan gopastatra halayudham |
gopyashcha premakupitah prochuhsershyamathaparah ||

verses.sa:
गोप्यः पप्रच्छुरपरा नागरीजनवल्लभम् ।
कच्चिदास्ते सुखं कृष्णश्चलप्रेमलवात्मकः ॥
verses.rom:
gopyah paprachchhurapara nagarijanavallabham |
kachchidaste sukham krishnashchalapremalavatmakah ||

verses.sa:
अस्मच्चेष्टामपहसन्न कच्चित्पुरयोषिताम् ।
सौभाग्यमान मधिकं करोति क्षणसौहृदः ॥
verses.rom:
asmachcheshtamapahasanna kachchitpurayoshitam |
saubhagyamana madhikam karoti kshanasauhridah ||

verses.sa:
कच्चित्स्मरति नः कृष्णो गीतानुगमनं कलम् ।
अप्यसौ मातरं द्रष्टु सकृदप्यागमिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kachchitsmarati nah krishno gitanugamanam kalam |
apyasau mataram drashtu sakridapyagamishyati ||

verses.sa:
अथ वा किं तदालापैः क्रियन्तामपराः कथाः ।
यस्यास्मभिर्विना तेन विनास्माकं भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
atha va kim tadalapaih kriyantamaparah kathah |
yasyasmabhirvina tena vinasmakam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
पिता माता तथा भ्राता भर्ता बन्धुजनश्च किम् ।
संत्यक्तस्तत्कृतेस्माभिरकृतज्ञध्वजो हि सः ॥
verses.rom:
pita mata tatha bhrata bharta bandhujanashcha kim |
samtyaktastatkritesmabhirakritajnadhvajo hi sah ||

verses.sa:
तथापि कच्चिदालापमिहागमनसंश्रयम् ।
करोति कृष्णो वक्तव्यं भवता राम नानृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi kachchidalapamihagamanasamshrayam |
karoti krishno vaktavyam bhavata rama nanritam ||

verses.sa:
दामोदरोऽसौ गोविन्दः पुरस्त्रीसक्तमानसः ।
अपेतप्रीतिरस्मासु दुर्दर्शः प्रतिभाति नः ॥
verses.rom:
damodaro'sau govindah purastrisaktamanasah |
apetapritirasmasu durdarshah pratibhati nah ||

verses.sa:
आमन्त्रितश्च कृष्णेति पुनर्दामोदरेति च ।
जहसुःसस्वरं गोप्यो हरिणा हृतचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
amantritashcha krishneti punardamodareti cha |
jahasuhsasvaram gopyo harina hritachetasah ||

verses.sa:
संदेशैः साममधुरैः प्रेमगर्भैरगर्वितैः ।
रामेणाश्वासिता गोप्यः कृष्णस्यातिमनोहरैः ॥
verses.rom:
samdeshaih samamadhuraih premagarbhairagarvitaih |
ramenashvasita gopyah krishnasyatimanoharaih ||

verses.sa:
गोपैश्च पूर्ववद्रामः परिहासमनोहराः ।
कथाश्चकार रेमे च सह तैर्व्रजभूमिषु ॥
verses.rom:
gopaishcha purvavadramah parihasamanoharah |
kathashchakara reme cha saha tairvrajabhumishu ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पञ्चमांशे चतुर्विंशोध्यायः (२४)
इत्थं स्तुतस्तदा तेन मुचुकुन्देन धीमता ।
प्राहेशः सर्व्वभूतानामनादिर्भगवान हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
iti shrivishnumahapurane panchamamshe chaturvimshodhyayah (24)
ittham stutastada tena muchukundena dhimata |
praheshah sarvvabhutanamanadirbhagavana harih ||

verses.sa:
यथाभिवाञ्छितान् दिव्यान् गच्छ लोकान् नरेखर ।
अव्याहतपरैश्वर्य्यो मतप्रसादोपबुं हितः ॥
verses.rom:
yathabhivanchhitan divyan gachchha lokan narekhara |
avyahataparaishvaryyo mataprasadopabum hitah ||

verses.sa:
भुक्त्वा भोगान् महादिव्यान् भविष्यसि महाकुले ।
जातिस्मरो मत्प्रसादात ततो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
bhuktva bhogan mahadivyan bhavishyasi mahakule |
jatismaro matprasadata tato mokshamavapsyasi ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्येशं जगतामच्युतं नृपः ।
गुहामुखाद् विनिष्कान्तो ददृशे सोऽल्पकान् नरान ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah pranipatyesham jagatamachyutam nripah |
guhamukhad vinishkanto dadrishe so'lpakan narana ||

verses.sa:
ततः कलियुगं ज्ञात्वा प्राप्तं तप्तुं नृपस्तपः ।
नरनारायणस्थानं प्रययौ गन्धमादनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kaliyugam jnatva praptam taptum nripastapah |
naranarayanasthanam prayayau gandhamadanam ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोऽपि घातयित्वारिमुपायेन हि तद्बलम् ।
जग्राह मथुरामेत्य हस्त्यश्वस्यन्दनोज्जवलम् ॥
verses.rom:
krishno'pi ghatayitvarimupayena hi tadbalam |
jagraha mathurametya hastyashvasyandanojjavalam ||

verses.sa:
आनीय चोग्रसेनाय द्रारवत्यां न्यवेदयत् ।
पराभिभवनिःशङ्क बभूव च यदोः कुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
aniya chograsenaya draravatyam nyavedayat |
parabhibhavanihshanka babhuva cha yadoh kulam ||

verses.sa:
बलदेवोऽपि मैत्रेय! प्रशान्ताखिलविग्रहः ।
ज्ञातिसन्दर्शनोत्कण्ठः प्रययौ नन्दगौकुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
baladevo'pi maitreya! prashantakhilavigrahah |
jnatisandarshanotkanthah prayayau nandagaukulam ||

verses.sa:
ततो गोपीश्व गोपांश्व यथापूर्व्वममित्रजित् ।
तथैवाभ्यवदत् प्रेम्णा बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato gopishva gopamshva yathapurvvamamitrajit |
tathaivabhyavadat premna bahumanapurahsaram ||

verses.sa:
कैश्वापि सम्परिष्वक्तः कांश्वित् स परिषस्वजे ।
हास्यञ्चक समं कैश्विद् गोपैर्गोपीजनैस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
kaishvapi samparishvaktah kamshvit sa parishasvaje |
hasyanchaka samam kaishvid gopairgopijanaistatha ||

verses.sa:
प्रियाण्यनेकान्यवदन् गोपास्तत्र हलायुधम् ।
गोप्यश्व प्रेमकुपिताः प्रोचुः सेर्ष्यमथापराः ॥
verses.rom:
priyanyanekanyavadan gopastatra halayudham |
gopyashva premakupitah prochuh sershyamathaparah ||

verses.sa:
गोप्यः पप्रच्छुरपरा नागरीजनवल्लभः ।
कज्विदास्ते सुखं कृष्णश्वलत्प्र मलवात्मकः ॥
verses.rom:
gopyah paprachchhurapara nagarijanavallabhah |
kajvidaste sukham krishnashvalatpra malavatmakah ||

verses.sa:
अस्मच्चेष्टामुपहसन् कज्विन्न पुरयोताम् ।
सौभाग्यमानमधिकं करोति करोति क्षणसौह्टदः ॥
verses.rom:
asmachcheshtamupahasan kajvinna purayotam |
saubhagyamanamadhikam karoti karoti kshanasauhtadah ||

verses.sa:
कज्वित् स्मरति नः कृष्णो गातानुगमन कलम् ।
अप्यसौ मातरं द्रष्टुं सकृदप्यागमिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kajvit smarati nah krishno gatanugamana kalam |
apyasau mataram drashtum sakridapyagamishyati ||

verses.sa:
अथवा कि तदालापरपरा क्रियतां कथा ।
तस्यास्माभिर्विना तेन विनास्माकं भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
athava ki tadalaparapara kriyatam katha |
tasyasmabhirvina tena vinasmakam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
पिता माता तथा भ्राता भर्त्ता बन्धुजनश्व किम् ।
न त्यक्तस्ततूकृतेऽस्माभिरकृतज्ञध्वजो हि सः ॥
verses.rom:
pita mata tatha bhrata bhartta bandhujanashva kim |
na tyaktastatukrite'smabhirakritajnadhvajo hi sah ||

verses.sa:
तथापि क्वचिदालापमिहागमनसंश्रयम् ।
करोति कृष्णो वक्तव्यं भवताकृष्ण नानृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi kvachidalapamihagamanasamshrayam |
karoti krishno vaktavyam bhavatakrishna nanritam ||

verses.sa:
दामोदरोऽसौ गोविन्दः पुरस्त्रीन्यस्तमानसः ।
अपेतप्रीतिरस्मासु दुर्द्दर्शः प्रतिभाति नः ॥
verses.rom:
damodaro'sau govindah purastrinyastamanasah |
apetapritirasmasu durddarshah pratibhati nah ||

verses.sa:
आमन्त्रितः स कृष्णोति पुनर्दामोदरेति च ।
जहसुः सुस्वर गोप्यो हरिणा ह्टतचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
amantritah sa krishnoti punardamodareti cha |
jahasuh susvara gopyo harina htatachetasah ||

verses.sa:
सन्देशैः साममधुरैः प्रमगर्भैरगर्व्वितैः ।
रामेणाश्वासिता गोप्यः कृष्णस्यातिमनोहरैः ॥
verses.rom:
sandeshaih samamadhuraih pramagarbhairagarvvitaih |
ramenashvasita gopyah krishnasyatimanoharaih ||

verses.sa:
गोपैश्व पूर्व्ववदू रामः परिहासमनोरमाः ।
कथाश्वकार रेमे च सह तैर्व्रजभूमिषु ॥
verses.rom:
gopaishva purvvavadu ramah parihasamanoramah |
kathashvakara reme cha saha tairvrajabhumishu ||

prose.en:
Thus praised by the wise Muchukunda, the sovereign of all things, the eternal lord, Hari, said to him, "Go to whatever celestial regions you wish, lord of men, possessed of might irresistible, honoured by my favour. When you have fully enjoyed all heavenly pleasures, you shall be born in a distinguished family, retaining the recollection of your former births; and you shall finally obtain emancipation". Having heard this promise, and prostrated himself before Achyuta, the lord of the world, Muchukunda, went forth from the cave and beholding men of diminutive stature, now first knew that the Kali age had arrived. The king therefore departed to Gandhamāddana, the shrine of Naranārāyana, to perform penance.

Krishna having by this stratagem destroyed his enemy returned to Mathura and took captive his army, rich in horses, elephants and cars, which he conducted to Dwārakā, and delivered to Ugrasena, and the Yadu race was relieved from all fear of invasion. Baladeva, when hostilities had entirely ceased, being desirous of seeing his kinsmen, went to Nanda's cow-pens, and there again conversed with the herdsmen and their females, with affection and respect. By some, the elders, he was embraced; others, the juniors, he embraced; and with those of his own age, male or female, he talked and laughed. The cowherds made many kind speeches to Halayudha; but some of the Gopis spoke to him with the affectation of anger, or with feelings of jealousy, as they inquired after the loves of Krishna with the women of Mathura. "Is all well with the fickle and inconstant Krishna?" said they; "Does the volatile swain, the friend of an instant amuse the women of the city by laughing at our rustic efforts (to please him)? Does he ever think of us, singing in chorus to his sons? Will come here once again to see his mother? But But why talk of these things? It is a different tale to tell for him without us, and for us without him. Father, mother, brother, husband, kin, what have we not abandoned for him; but he is a monument of ingratitude. Yet tell us, does not Krishna talk of coming here? Falsehood is never, O Krishna, to be uttered by thee. Verily this is Dāmodara, this is Govinda, who has given up his heart to the damsels of the city, who has no longer any regard for us, but looks upon us with disdain". So saying, the Gopis, whose minds were fixed on Krishna, addressed Rāma in his place, calling him Dāmodara and Govinda, and laughed and were merry; and Rāma consoled them by communicating to them agreeable, modest, affectionate, and gentle messages from Krishna. With the cow-herds he talked mirthfully, as he had been wont to do, and rambled along with them over the lands of Vraja.

verses.sa:
वने विचरतस्तस्य सह गोपैर्महात्मनः ।
मानुषच्छद्मरूपस्य शेषस्य धरणीभृतः ॥
verses.rom:
vane vicharatastasya saha gopairmahatmanah |
manushachchhadmarupasya sheshasya dharanibhritah ||

verses.sa:
निष्पादितोरुकाय्यस्य काय्यणोर्व्वीविचारिणः ।
उपभोगाथमत्यर्थ वरुणः प्राह वारुणीम् ॥
verses.rom:
nishpaditorukayyasya kayyanorvvivicharinah |
upabhogathamatyartha varunah praha varunim ||

verses.sa:
अभीष्टा सर्व्वदा यस्य मदिरे त्व!महौजसः ।
अनन्तस्यौपभोगाय तस्य गच्छ मुदे शुभे ॥
verses.rom:
abhishta sarvvada yasya madire tva!mahaujasah |
anantasyaupabhogaya tasya gachchha mude shubhe ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्ता वारुणी तेन सन्निधानमथाकरोत् ।
वृन्दावनवनोतूपन्न-कदम्बतरुकोटरे ॥
verses.rom:
ityukta varuni tena sannidhanamathakarot |
vrindavanavanotupanna-kadambatarukotare ||

verses.sa:
विचरन् बलदेवोऽपि मदिरागन्धमुत्तमम् ।
आघ्राय मादरातर्षमवापाथ पुरातनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vicharan baladevo'pi madiragandhamuttamam |
aghraya madaratarshamavapatha puratanam ||

verses.sa:
ततः कदम्बात् सहसा मद्यधारां स लाङ्गली ।
पतन्तीं वीक्ष्य मंत्रेय !प्रययौ परमां मुदम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kadambat sahasa madyadharam sa langali |
patantim vikshya mamtreya !prayayau paramam mudam ||

verses.sa:
पपौ च गोपगोपीभिः समवेतो मुदान्वितः ।
प्रगीयमानो ललितं गीतवाद्यविशारदैः ॥
verses.rom:
papau cha gopagopibhih samaveto mudanvitah |
pragiyamano lalitam gitavadyavisharadaih ||

verses.sa:
समन्तोतूपन्न-घर्म्माम्भः कणिकामौक्तिकोज्जवलः ।
आगच्छ यमुने! स्त्रतुमिच्चामीत्त्याह विह्वलः ॥
verses.rom:
samantotupanna-gharmmambhah kanikamauktikojjavalah |
agachchha yamune! stratumichchamittyaha vihvalah ||

verses.sa:
तस्य वाचं नदी सा च मत्तोक्तामवमत्य वै ।
नाजगाम ततः क्रुद्धो हलं जग्राह लाङ्गली ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vacham nadi sa cha mattoktamavamatya vai |
najagama tatah kruddho halam jagraha langali ||

verses.sa:
गृहीत्वा तां तटे तेन चकर्ष मदविह्वलः ।
पापे नायासि नायासि गम्यतामिच्छयात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
grihitva tam tate tena chakarsha madavihvalah |
pape nayasi nayasi gamyatamichchhayatmanah ||

verses.sa:
सा कृष्टा तेन सहसा गार्ग सन्त्यज्य निम्रगा ।
यत्रास्ते बलभद्रोऽसौ प्लावयामास तदूनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa krishta tena sahasa garga santyajya nimraga |
yatraste balabhadro'sau plavayamasa tadunam ||

verses.sa:
शरीरिणी तथोत्पत्य त्रासविह्वललोचना ।
प्रसीदेत्यब्रवीद् रामं मुञ्च मां मुषलायुध ॥
verses.rom:
sharirini tathotpatya trasavihvalalochana |
