prasidetyabravid ramam muncha mam mushalayudha ||

verses.sa:
सोऽब्रवीदवजानासि मम शौर्य्यबले यदि ।
सोऽहं त्वां हलपातेन विनेष्यामि सहस्त्रधा ॥
verses.rom:
so'bravidavajanasi mama shauryyabale yadi |
so'ham tvam halapatena vineshyami sahastradha ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तयातिसन्त्रासात् तया नद्या प्रसादितः ।
भूभागे प्लाविते तस्मिन् मुमोच यमुनां बलः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktayatisantrasat taya nadya prasaditah |
bhubhage plavite tasmin mumocha yamunam balah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स्त्रातस्य वै कान्तिराजगाम महात्मनः ।
अवतंसोतूपलं चारु गृहीत्वैकञ्च कुण्डलम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah stratasya vai kantirajagama mahatmanah |
avatamsotupalam charu grihitvaikancha kundalam ||

verses.sa:
वरुणप्रहितां चास्मै मालामम्लानपङ्कजाम् ।
समूद्राभे तथा वस्त्रे नीले लक्ष्मीरयच्छत ॥
verses.rom:
varunaprahitam chasmai malamamlanapankajam |
samudrabhe tatha vastre nile lakshmirayachchhata ||

verses.sa:
कृतावतंसः स तदा चारुकुण्जलभूषितः ।
नीलाम्बरधरः स्क्षग्वी शुशुबे कान्तिसंयुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kritavatamsah sa tada charukunjalabhushitah |
nilambaradharah skshagvi shushube kantisamyutah ||

verses.sa:
इत्थं विभूषितो रेमे तत्र रामस्तथा व्रजे ।
मासदूयेन यातश्व पुनः स द्रारकां पुरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
ittham vibhushito reme tatra ramastatha vraje |
masaduyena yatashva punah sa drarakam purim ||

verses.sa:
रेवतीं नाम तनयां रैवतस्य महीपतेः ।
उपयेमे बलस्तस्यां जज्ञाते निशठोल्मुकौ ॥
verses.rom:
revatim nama tanayam raivatasya mahipateh |
upayeme balastasyam jajnate nishatholmukau ||

prose.en: Whilst the mighty Sesha, the upholder of the globe, was thus engaged in wandering amidst the forests with the herdsmen, in the disguise of a mortal—having rendered great services to earth, and still considering what more was to be achieved—Varuna, in order to provide for his recreation, said his wife Vāruni (the goddess of wine), "Thou, Madirā, art ever acceptable to the powerful Ananta; go therefore, auspicious and kind goddess, and promote his enjoyments". Obeying these commands, Vāruni went and established herself in the hollow of a Kadamba bee in the woods of Vrindāvana. Baladeva, roaming about, came there, and smelling the pleasant fragrance of liquor, resumed his ancient passion for strong drink. The holder of the ploughshare observing the vinous drops distilling from the Kadamba tree, was much delighted, and gathered and quaffed them along with the herdsmen and the Gopis, whilst those who were skilful with voice and lute celebrated him in their songs. Being inebriated with the wine, and the drops of perspiration standing like pearls upon his limbs, he called out, not knowing what he said, "Come hither, Yamunā river, I want to bathe". The river, disregarding the words of a drunken man came not at his bidding: on which Rāma in a rage took up his ploughshare, which he plunged into her bank, and dragged her to him, calling out, "Will you not come, you jade, will you not come? Now go where you please (if you can)". Thus saying, he compelled the dark river to quit its ordinary course, and follow him whithersoever he wandered through the wood. Assuming a mortal figure, the Yamunā, with distracted looks, approached Balabhadra, and entreated him to pardon her, and let her go: but he replied, "I will drag you with my ploughshare in a thousand directions, since you condemn my prowess and strength". At last, however, appeased by her reiterated prayers, he let her go, after she had watered all the country. When he had bathed, the goddess of beauty, Lakshmi, came and gave him a beautiful lotus to place in one ear, and an ear-ring for the other; a fresh necklace of lotus flowers, sent by Varuna; and garments of a dark blue colour, as costly as the wealth of the ocean: and thus decorated with a lotus in one ear, a ring in the other, dressed in blue garments, and wearing a garland, Balarāma appeared united with loveliness. Thus decorated, Rāma sported two months in Vraja, and then returned to Dwārakā, where he married Revati, the daughter of king Raivata, by whom he had two sons, Nishātha and Ulmuka.

verses.sa:
भीष्मकः कुणिडने राजा विदर्भविषयेऽभवत् ।
रूकमी तस्याभवत् पुत्रो रुविमणी च वराङ्गन ॥
verses.rom:
bhishmakah kunidane raja vidarbhavishaye'bhavat |
rukami tasyabhavat putro ruvimani cha varangana ||

verses.sa:
रुक्मिणी चकमे कृष्णः सा च तं चारुहासिनी ।
नि ददौ याचते चैनां रुक्मी द्रेषेण चक्रिणो ॥
verses.rom:
rukmini chakame krishnah sa cha tam charuhasini |
ni dadau yachate chainam rukmi dreshena chakrino ||

verses.sa:
ददौ च शिशुपालाय जरासन्धप्रदेशितः ।
भीष्मको रुक्मिणा सार्द्ध रुक्मिणीमुरुविक्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
dadau cha shishupalaya jarasandhapradeshitah |
bhishmako rukmina sarddha rukminimuruvikramah ||

verses.sa:
विवाहार्थं ततः सर्व्वे जरासन्धमुखा नृपाः ।
भीष्मकस्य पुरं जग्मुः शिशुपालप्रियैषिणः ॥
verses.rom:
vivahartham tatah sarvve jarasandhamukha nripah |
bhishmakasya puram jagmuh shishupalapriyaishinah ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोऽपि बलभद्राद्यर्यादवैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।
प्रययौ कुण्दिनं द्रष्टुं विवाहञ्चैव भूभृतः ॥
verses.rom:
krishno'pi balabhadradyaryadavairbahubhirvritah |
prayayau kundinam drashtum vivahanchaiva bhubhritah ||

verses.sa:
शोभाविनि विवाहे तु तां कन्यां ह्टतवान् हरिः ।
विपक्षभारमासज्य रामाद्य ष्वथ बन्धुषु ॥
verses.rom:
shobhavini vivahe tu tam kanyam htatavan harih |
vipakshabharamasajya ramadya shvatha bandhushu ||

verses.sa:
ततश्व पौण्ड्रकः श्रीमान् दन्तवक्रो विदूरथः ।
शिशुपाल-जरासन्ध-शाल्वाद्याश्व महीभृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatashva paundrakah shriman dantavakro vidurathah |
shishupala-jarasandha-shalvadyashva mahibhritah ||

verses.sa:
कुपितास्ते हरिं हन्तुं चक्रु रुदूयोगमुत्तमम् ।
निर्ज्जिताश्व समागम्य रामाद्यर्यदुपुङ्गवैः ॥
verses.rom:
kupitaste harim hantum chakru ruduyogamuttamam |
nirjjitashva samagamya ramadyaryadupungavaih ||

verses.sa:
कुणिडनं न प्रवेक्ष्यामि अहत्वा युधि केशवम् ।
कृत्वा प्रतिज्ञां रुकमी च हन्तुं कृष्णमभिद्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kunidanam na pravekshyami ahatva yudhi keshavam |
kritva pratijnam rukami cha hantum krishnamabhidrutah ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा बलं सनागाश्व-पत्ति-स्यन्दनसङ्कुलम् ।
निर्जितः पातितश्वोर्व्व्यां लीलयैव स चकिणा ॥
verses.rom:
hatva balam sanagashva-patti-syandanasankulam |
nirjitah patitashvorvvyam lilayaiva sa chakina ||

verses.sa:
हन्तु कृतमतिः कृष्णो रुक्मिणां युद्धदुर्म्मदम् ।
प्रणम्य याचितो ब्रह्मन् रुविमण्या मगवान हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
hantu kritamatih krishno rukminam yuddhadurmmadam |
pranamya yachito brahman ruvimanya magavana harih ||

verses.sa:
एक एव मम भ्राता न हन्तव्यस्त्वयाधुना ।
कोपं नियम्य देवेश!भ्रातृभिक्षा प्रदीयताम् ॥
verses.rom:
eka eva mama bhrata na hantavyastvayadhuna |
kopam niyamya devesha!bhratribhiksha pradiyatam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तेन परित्यक्तः कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्म्मणा ।
रुक्मी भोजकटं नाम पुरं कुत्वावसत् तदा ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktena parityaktah krishnenaklishtakarmmana |
rukmi bhojakatam nama puram kutvavasat tada ||

verses.sa:
निर्जित्य रुक्मिणं सम्यगुपयेमे स रुक्मिणीम् ।
राक्षसेन विवाहेन सम्प्रप्तां मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
nirjitya rukminam samyagupayeme sa rukminim |
rakshasena vivahena sampraptam madhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
तस्यां जज्ञ ऽथ प्रद्युम्रो मदनांश- स वीर्य्यवान् ।
जहार शम्बरो यं वै यो जघान च शम्बरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyam jajna 'tha pradyumro madanamsha- sa viryyavan |
jahara shambaro yam vai yo jaghana cha shambaram ||

prose.en:
Bhishmaka was king of Vidarbha, residing at Kundina. He had a son named Rukmin, and a beautiful daughter termed Rukmini. Krishna fell in love with the latter, and solicited her in marriage: but her brother who hated Krishna, would not assent to the espousals. At the suggestion of Jarāsandha, and with the concurrence of his son, the powerful sovereign Bhishmaka affianced Rukmini to Sisupāla. In order to celebrate the nuptials, Jarāsandha and other princes, the friends of Sisupāla, assembled in the capital of Vidharba; and Krishna, attended by Balabhadra and many other Yādavas, also went to Kundina to witness the wedding. When there, Hari contrived on the eve of the nuptials, to carry off the princess, leaving Rāma and his kinsmen to sustain the weight of his enemies. Paundraka, the illustrious Dantavakra, Viduratha, Sisupāla, Jarāsandha, Salya, and other kings, indignant at the insult, exerted themselves to kill Krishna, but were repelled by Balarāma and the Yādavas. Rukmin, vowing that he would never enter Kundina again until he had slain Kesava in fight, pursued and overtook him. In the combat that ensued, Krishna destroyed with his discus, as if in sport the host of Rukmin, with all its horses, and elephants, and foot, and chariots, and overthrew him, and hurled him on the ground; and would have put him to death, but was withheld by the entreaties of Rukmini. "He is my only brother," she exclaimed, "and must not be slain by thee; restrain your wrath, O divine Lord, and give me my brother in charity".

Thus addressed by her, Krishna, whom no acts affect, spared Rukmin; and he (in pursuance of his vow) founded the city Bhojakata, and ever afterwards dwelt therein. After the defeat of Rukmin, Krishna married Rukmini in due form, having first made her his own by the Rākshasa ritual. She bore him the gallant Pradyumna, a portion of the deity of love. The demon Sambara carried him off, but he slew the demon.

verses.sa:
शम्बरेण ह्टतो वीरः प्रद्यु म्रः स कथं मुने !
शम्बरश्व महावीर्य्यः प्रद्यु म्नेन कथं हतः ॥
verses.rom:
shambarena htato virah pradyu mrah sa katham mune !
shambarashva mahaviryyah pradyu mnena katham hatah ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
षष्ठेऽह्नि जातमात्रन्तु प्रद्युम्र सूतिकागृहात् ।
ममैष हन्तेति मुने! ह्टतवान् कालशम्बरः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
shashthe'hni jatamatrantu pradyumra sutikagrihat |
mamaisha hanteti mune! htatavan kalashambarah ||

verses.sa:
ह्टत्वा चिक्षेप चैवैनं ग्राहोग्र लवणार्णावे ।
कल्लोलजनितावर्त्ते सुघोरे मकरालये ॥
verses.rom:
htatva chikshepa chaivainam grahogra lavanarnave |
kallolajanitavartte sughore makaralaye ||

verses.sa:
पतितं तत्र चैवैको मत्स्यो जग्राह बालकम् ।
न ममार च तस्यापि जठरेऽनलदीपितः ॥
verses.rom:
patitam tatra chaivaiko matsyo jagraha balakam |
na mamara cha tasyapi jathare'naladipitah ||

verses.sa:
मतूस्यबन्धश्व मत्स्योऽसौ मत्स्यैरन्यैः सह द्रिज !
घातितोऽसुरवर्य्याय शम्बराय निवेदितः ॥
verses.rom:
matusyabandhashva matsyo'sau matsyairanyaih saha drija !
ghatito'suravaryyaya shambaraya niveditah ||

verses.sa:
तस्य मायावती नाम पत्री सर्व्वगृहेश्वरी ।
कारयामास सूदानामाधिपत्यमनिन्दिता ॥
verses.rom:
tasya mayavati nama patri sarvvagriheshvari |
karayamasa sudanamadhipatyamanindita ||

verses.sa:
दारिते मत्स्यजठरे सा ददर्शातिशोभनम् ।
कुमारं मन्मथतरोर्दग्धस्य प्रथमाङ्कुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
darite matsyajathare sa dadarshatishobhanam |
kumaram manmathatarordagdhasya prathamankuram ||

verses.sa:
कोऽयं कथमयं मत्स्यजठरं समुपागतः ।
इत्येवं कौतुकाविष्टां तां तन्वीं प्राह नारादः ॥
verses.rom:
ko'yam kathamayam matsyajatharam samupagatah |
ityevam kautukavishtam tam tanvim praha naradah ||

verses.sa:
अयं समस्तजगतः सूतिसंहारकारिणा ।
शम्बरेण ह्टतः कृष्णृ-तनयः सूतिकागृहात् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam samastajagatah sutisamharakarina |
shambarena htatah krishnri-tanayah sutikagrihat ||

verses.sa:
क्षिप्तः समुद्र मत्स्येन निगीर्णास्ते वशं गतः ।
नररत्रमिदं सुभ्रू विस्त्रब्धा परिपालय ॥
verses.rom:
kshiptah samudra matsyena nigirnaste vasham gatah |
nararatramidam subhru vistrabdha paripalaya ||

verses.sa:
नारदेनैवमुक्ता सा पालयामास तं शिशुम् ।
बाल्यादेवातिरागेण रूपातिशयमोहिता ॥
verses.rom:
naradenaivamukta sa palayamasa tam shishum |
balyadevatiragena rupatishayamohita ||

verses.sa:
स यदा यौवनाभोग-भूषितोऽभून्महामते!
साभिलाषा तदा साति बभूव गजगामिनी ॥
verses.rom:
sa yada yauvanabhoga-bhushito'bhunmahamate!
sabhilasha tada sati babhuva gajagamini ||

verses.sa:
मायावती ददौ तस्म मायाः सर्व्वा महामुन !
प्रद्यु म्रायातिरागान्धा तन्नयस्तह्टदयेक्षणा ॥
verses.rom:
mayavati dadau tasma mayah sarvva mahamuna !
pradyu mrayatiragandha tannayastahtadayekshana ||

verses.sa:
प्रसज्जन्तीन्तु तामाह स कार्ष्णिः कमलेक्षणाम् ।
मातृभावमपाहाय किमेवं वर्त्तसेऽन्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
prasajjantintu tamaha sa karshnih kamalekshanam |
matribhavamapahaya kimevam varttase'nyatha ||

verses.sa:
सा चास्मै कथयामास न पुत्रस्त्वं ममेति वै ।
तनयं त्वामयं विष्णोह्ट तवान् कालशम्बरः ॥
verses.rom:
sa chasmai kathayamasa na putrastvam mameti vai |
tanayam tvamayam vishnohta tavan kalashambarah ||

verses.sa:
क्षिप्तः समुद्र मत्स्यस्य सम्प्राप्तो जठरान्मया ।
सा तु रोदिति ते माता कान्ताद्याप्यतिवत्सला ॥
verses.rom:
kshiptah samudra matsyasya samprapto jatharanmaya |
sa tu roditi te mata kantadyapyativatsala ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तः शम्बरं युद्धे प्रद्यु म्रः स समाह्वयत् ।
क्रोधाकुलीकृतमना युयुधे च महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah shambaram yuddhe pradyu mrah sa samahvayat |
krodhakulikritamana yuyudhe cha mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा सैन्यमशेषन्तु तस्य दैत्यस्य माधविः ।
सप्त माया व्यतिक्रम्य मायां प्रयुयुजेऽशष्टमीम् ॥
verses.rom:
hatva sainyamasheshantu tasya daityasya madhavih |
sapta maya vyatikramya mayam prayuyuje'shashtamim ||

verses.sa:
तया जघान तं दैत्यं मायया कालशम्बरम् ।
उत्पत्य च तया सार्द्धमाजगाम पितुर्गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
taya jaghana tam daityam mayaya kalashambaram |
utpatya cha taya sarddhamajagama piturgriham ||

verses.sa:
अन्तः परे निपतितं मायावत्या समन्वितम् ।
तं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णसंकल्पा बभूवुः कृष्णयोषितः ॥
verses.rom:
antah pare nipatitam mayavatya samanvitam |
tam drishtva krishnasamkalpa babhuvuh krishnayoshitah ||

verses.sa:
रुक्मिणी चावदत् प्रेमूणा प्रम्णा साश्रुदृष्टिरनिन्दिता ।
धन्यायाः खल्वयं पुत्रो वर्त्तते नवयौवने ॥
verses.rom:
rukmini chavadat premuna pramna sashrudrishtiranindita |
dhanyayah khalvayam putro varttate navayauvane ||

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् वयसि पुत्रो मे प्रद्यु म्रो यदि जीवति ।
सभाग्या जननी वतूस! त्वया कापि विभूषिता ॥
verses.rom:
asmin vayasi putro me pradyu mro yadi jivati |
sabhagya janani vatusa! tvaya kapi vibhushita ||

verses.sa:
अथवा यादृशः स्नेहो मम यादृगू वपुस्तव ।
हरेरपत्यं सुव्यक्त भवान् वत्स!भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
athava yadrishah sneho mama yadrigu vapustava |
harerapatyam suvyakta bhavan vatsa!bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
एतिस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तः सह कृष्णेन नारदः ।
अन्तः पुरचरीं देवीं रुक्मिणीं प्राह हर्षयन् ॥
verses.rom:
etisminnantare praptah saha krishnena naradah |
antah puracharim devim rukminim praha harshayan ||

verses.sa:
एश ते तनयः सुभ्रु! हत्वा शम्बरमागतः ।
ह्टतो येनाभवद् बालो भवत्याः सूतिकागृहात् ॥
verses.rom:
esha te tanayah subhru! hatva shambaramagatah |
htato yenabhavad balo bhavatyah sutikagrihat ||

verses.sa:
इयं मायावती भार्य्या तनयस्यास्य ते सती ।
शम्बरस्य न भार्य्येयं श्रूयतामत्र कारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam mayavati bharyya tanayasyasya te sati |
shambarasya na bharyyeyam shruyatamatra karanam ||

verses.sa:
मन्मथे तु गते नाशं तदुद्भवपरायाणा ।
शम्बरं मोहयामास मायारूपेण रूपिणी ॥
verses.rom:
manmathe tu gate nasham tadudbhavaparayana |
shambaram mohayamasa mayarupena rupini ||

verses.sa:
व्यवायाद्यु पभोगेषु रूपं मायामयं शुभम् ।
दर्शयामास दैत्यस्य तस्येयं मदिरेक्षणा ॥
verses.rom:
vyavayadyu pabhogeshu rupam mayamayam shubham |
darshayamasa daityasya tasyeyam madirekshana ||

verses.sa:
कामोऽवतीर्णः पुत्रस्ते तस्येयं दयिता रतिः ।
विशङ्का नात्र कर्त्तव्या स्नुषेयं तव शोभना ॥
verses.rom:
kamo'vatirnah putraste tasyeyam dayita ratih |
vishanka natra karttavya snusheyam tava shobhana ||

verses.sa:
ततो हर्षसमाविष्टा रुक्मिणी केशवस्तथा ।
नगरी च समस्ता सा साधु साध्वित्यभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
tato harshasamavishta rukmini keshavastatha |
nagari cha samasta sa sadhu sadhvityabhashata ||

verses.sa:
चिरं नष्टेन पुत्रेण संयुक्तां प्रेक्ष्य रुक्मिणीम् ।
अवाप विस्मयं सर्व्वो द्रारवत्यां जनस्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
chiram nashtena putrena samyuktam prekshya rukminim |
avapa vismayam sarvvo draravatyam janastada ||

prose.en:
Maitreya saidr—How, Muni, happened it that the hero Pradyumna was carried away by Sambara? And in what manner was the mighty Sambara killed by Pradyumna?

Parāçara said:—When Pradyumna was but six days old, he was stolen from the lying-in chamber by Sambara, terrible as death; for the demon foreknew that Pradyumna, if he lived, would be his destroyer. Taking away the boy, Sambara cast him into the ocean, swarming with monsters, into whirlpool of roaring waves, the haunt of the huge creatures of the deep. A large fish swallowed the child, but he died not, and was born anew from its belly: for that fish, and others, was caught by the fishermen, and delivered by them to the great Asura Sambara. His wife Māyādevi, the mistress of the household, lorded over the cooks. And she espied, when the fish was cut open, a beautiful child looking like a new shoot of tree of love. When struck with curiosity she was asking "Who is this child? How has it come into the belly of the fish?" Nārada came and said to her:—"This is the son of Krishna who creates and destroys the universe. He was stolen away from the nursery room by Samvara. He was devoured by the fish when thrown into the ocean; now he has come under thy control; do thou, O beautiful damsel, tenderly rear this jewel of mankind".

Parāçara said:—Thus addressed by Nārada, she took charge of the child and brought it up from boyhood being attracted by the beauty of his person. O great saint, when the boy attained to youth, Māyāvati, moving like a she-elephant, began to cherish desire for him. And fixing her mind and eyes upon the high-minded Pradyumna, Māyāvati, blinded with lust, gave unto him all her magic powers, Beholding that lotus-eyed damsel thus passionately attached unto him, Krishna's son said to her:—"Why dost thou indulge in feelings which do not become a mother?" She said to him:—"Thou art not my son; thou art the son of the illustrious Vishnu; Kāla Samvara stole thee and threw thee into the ocean; thou wast swallowed by a fish but rescued by me from its belly cut open. O lord thy loving mother is still weeping for thee".

Parāçara said;—Hearing those words Pradyumna invited Samvara for battle. And worked up with ire that highly powerful one fought with him. In the battle the son of Mādhava killed the entire host of Samvara. Having seven times baffled the delusions and mastered them in the eighth he destroyed that demon Samvara. And having got into the welkin with her he proceeded to his father's house. And beholding him descend into the inner apartment with Māyāvati, Krishna's wives considered him as Krishna himself. The highly beautiful Rukmini with her eyes full of tears lovingly said:—"Blessed is the woman who has got such a son in the bloom of youth. Had he been alive my own son Pradyumna would have been his age. Who is the fortunate mother adorned by thee? From the affection I feel for thee and from thy appearance I think thou art assuredly the son of Hari".

Parāçara said:—At this time Krishna arrived there with Nārada; and the latter delightedly said to Rukmini. "This is thy own son who has come here after slaying Sambara, by whom he was carried away when a child from the lying-in chamber. This is the pious Māyāvati, his spouse and not the wife of Samvara. Hear the reason; when Manmatha had perished, the goddess of beauty, being desirous of effecting his revival, fascinated Samvara by the charms of her delusive form. And she, having eyes rolling with inebriation, exhibited herself to him in various illusory enjoyments. This thy son is the incarnation of Kama and this his spouse is the goddess Rati. Do not doubt the least that she is your daughter-in-law".

Thereupon Rukmini and Keshava were worked up with delight and the whole city resounded with the exclamations of praise. And beholding Rukmini regain a son who bad been long lost all the people of Dwārakā were surprised.

verses.sa:
चारुदेष्णां सुदेष्णञ्च चारुदेवञ्च वीर्य्यवान् ।
सुषेणं चारुगुप्तञ्च भद्रचारु तथापरम् ॥
verses.rom:
charudeshnam sudeshnancha charudevancha viryyavan |
sushenam charuguptancha bhadracharu tathaparam ||

verses.sa:
चारुविन्दं सुचारुञ्च चारुञ्च बलिनां वरम् ।
रुक्मिण्यजनयत् पुत्रान् कन्यां चारुमतीं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
charuvindam sucharuncha charuncha balinam varam |
rukminyajanayat putran kanyam charumatim tatha ||

verses.sa:
अन्याश्व भार्य्याः कृष्णस्य बभूवुः स्प्त शोभनाः ।
कालिन्दी मित्रविन्दा च सत्या नाग्रजिती तथा ॥
verses.rom:
anyashva bharyyah krishnasya babhuvuh spta shobhanah |
kalindi mitravinda cha satya nagrajiti tatha ||

verses.sa:
देवी जाम्बवती चापि रोहिणी कामरूपिणी ।
मद्रराजसुता चान्या सुशीला शीलभण्डना ॥
verses.rom:
devi jambavati chapi rohini kamarupini |
madrarajasuta chanya sushila shilabhandana ||

verses.sa:
सात्राजिती सत्यभीमा लक्ष्णा चारुहासिनी ।
षोड़शासन सहस्त्राणि स्त्रीणामन्यानि चक्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
satrajiti satyabhima lakshna charuhasini |
shorashasana sahastrani strinamanyani chakrinah ||

verses.sa:
प्रद्यु म्रोऽपि महावीर्य्यो रुक्मिणस्तनयां शुभाम् ।
स्वयंवरस्थां जग्राह सा च तं तनय हरेः ॥
verses.rom:
pradyu mro'pi mahaviryyo rukminastanayam shubham |
svayamvarastham jagraha sa cha tam tanaya hareh ||

verses.sa:
यस्यामस्याभवत् पुत्रो महाबलपराक्रमः ।
अनिरुद्धो रणो क्रे द्धो वीर्य्योदधिररिन्दमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyamasyabhavat putro mahabalaparakramah |
aniruddho rano kre ddho viryyodadhirarindamah ||

verses.sa:
तस्यापि रुक्मिणः पौत्रीं वरयामास केशवः ।
दौहित्राय ददौ रुक्मी तां स्पर्द्धन्नपि शौरिणा ॥
verses.rom:
tasyapi rukminah pautrim varayamasa keshavah |
dauhitraya dadau rukmi tam sparddhannapi shaurina ||

verses.sa:
तस्या विवाहे रामाद्या यादवा हरिणा सह ।
रुक्मिणो नगरं जग्मुर्नाम्रा भोजकटं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vivahe ramadya yadava harina saha |
rukmino nagaram jagmurnamra bhojakatam drija ||

verses.sa:
विवाहे तत्र निवृत्ते प्राद्यूम्नेः सुमहात्मनः ।
कलिङ्गराजप्रमुखा रुक्मिणां वाक्यमब्रु वन् ॥
verses.rom:
vivahe tatra nivritte pradyumneh sumahatmanah |
kalingarajapramukha rukminam vakyamabru van ||

verses.sa:
अनक्षज्ञो हली द्यूते तथास्य व्यसनं महत् ।
न जयामो बलं कस्मादू द्यूतेनैनं महाद्युते ॥
verses.rom:
anakshajno hali dyute tathasya vyasanam mahat |
na jayamo balam kasmadu dyutenainam mahadyute ||

verses.sa:
तथेति तानाह नृपान् रुक्मी बलसमन्वितः ।
सभायां सह रामेण चक्र द्रू तञ्च वै तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatheti tanaha nripan rukmi balasamanvitah |
sabhayam saha ramena chakra dru tancha vai tada ||

verses.sa:
सहस्त्रमेकं निष्काणां रुक्मिणा विजितो बलः ।
द्रितीयेऽपि पणे चान्यत् सहस्त्र रुक्मिणा जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahastramekam nishkanam rukmina vijito balah |
dritiye'pi pane chanyat sahastra rukmina jitam ||

verses.sa:
ततो दश सहस्त्राणि निष्काणां पणमाददे ।
बलभद्रोऽजयत्तानि रुक्मी द्यूतविदां वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tato dasha sahastrani nishkanam panamadade |
balabhadro'jayattani rukmi dyutavidam varah ||

verses.sa:
ततो जहास खनवत् कलिङ्गाधिपतिर्द्रिज!
दन्तान् विदर्शयन् मूढ़ो रुक्मी चाह मदोद्धतः ॥
verses.rom:
tato jahasa khanavat kalingadhipatirdrija!
dantan vidarshayan murho rukmi chaha madoddhatah ||

verses.sa:
ग्रविज्ञोऽयं मया द्यूते बलदेवः पराजितः ।
मुधैवाक्षावलेपान्धो यः स्वं मेनेऽक्षकाविदम् ॥
verses.rom:
gravijno'yam maya dyute baladevah parajitah |
mudhaivakshavalepandho yah svam mene'kshakavidam ||

verses.sa:
दृष्टा कलिङ्गराजं तं प्रकाशदशनाननम् ।
रुक्मिणञ्चपि दुव्वक्यिं कोपं चक्र हलायुधः ॥
verses.rom:
drishta kalingarajam tam prakashadashanananam |
rukminanchapi duvvakyim kopam chakra halayudhah ||

verses.sa: ग्लहं जग्राह रुक्मी च तदर्थेऽक्षानपातयत् ॥
verses.rom: glaham jagraha rukmi cha tadarthe'kshanapatayat ||

verses.sa:
अजयद् बलदेवस्तं प्राहोच्चैस्तं जितं मया ।
मयेति रुक्मी प्राहोच्चैरलीकोक्तेरलं बल ॥
verses.rom:
ajayad baladevastam prahochchaistam jitam maya |
mayeti rukmi prahochchairalikokteralam bala ||

verses.sa:
त्वयोक्तोऽ.यं ग्लहः सत्यं न ममैषोऽनुमोदितः ।
एवं त्वया चेदू विजितं मया न विजितं कथम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvayokto'.yam glahah satyam na mamaisho'numoditah |
evam tvaya chedu vijitam maya na vijitam katham ||

verses.sa:
अथान्तरिक्षे वागुच्चैः प्राह गम्भीरनादिनी ।
बलदेवस्य तदूकोपं वर्द्धयन्ती महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
athantarikshe vaguchchaih praha gambhiranadini |
baladevasya tadukopam varddhayanti mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
जितं बलेन धर्म्मेण रुक्मिणो भाषितं मृषा ।
अनुक्त्वापि वचः किञ्चित् कृतं भवति कर्म्मा ॥
verses.rom:
jitam balena dharmmena rukmino bhashitam mrisha |
anuktvapi vachah kinchit kritam bhavati karmma ||

verses.sa:
ततो बलः समुत्थाय कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ।
जघानाष्टापदेनैव रुक्मिणं सुमहाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
tato balah samutthaya kopasamraktalochanah |
jaghanashtapadenaiva rukminam sumahabalah ||

verses.sa:
कलिङ्गराजञ्चादाय विस्फुरन्तं बलाद बलः ।
वभञ्च दन्तान् कुपितो यैः प्रकाशं जहास सः ॥
verses.rom:
kalingarajanchadaya visphurantam balada balah |
vabhancha dantan kupito yaih prakasham jahasa sah ||

verses.sa:
आकृष्य च महास्तम्भं जातरूपमयं बलः ।
जघान येऽन्ये तत्पक्षा बूभृतः कुपितो बलात ॥
verses.rom:
akrishya cha mahastambham jatarupamayam balah |
jaghana ye'nye tatpaksha bubhritah kupito balata ||

verses.sa:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्व्वं पलायनपरं द्रिज!
तद्राजमणडलं भीतं बभूव कुपिते बले ॥
verses.rom:
tato hahakritam sarvvam palayanaparam drija!
tadrajamanadalam bhitam babhuva kupite bale ||

verses.sa:
बलेन निहतं श्रुत्वा रुक्मिणं मधुसूदनः ।
नोवाच किञ्चिन्मैत्रेय!रुक्मिणी-बलयोर्भयात् ॥
verses.rom:
balena nihatam shrutva rukminam madhusudanah |
novacha kinchinmaitreya!rukmini-balayorbhayat ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽनिरुद्धमादाय कृतोद्राहं द्रिजोत्तम!
द्रारकामाजगामाथ यदुचक्र द्रिजोत्तम !
verses.rom:
tato'niruddhamadaya kritodraham drijottama!
drarakamajagamatha yaduchakra drijottama !

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Rukmini bore Krishna these other sons Charudeshna, Sudeshna, Charudeha, Sushena, Charugupta, Bhadracharu, Charuvinda, Sucharu and the very powerful Charu; also one daughter Charumati. Krishna had seven other beautiful wives:-Kālindi, Mitravrindā, the virtuous Nāgnajiti, the queen Jāmbavati; Rohini, of beautiful form; the amiable and excellent daughter of the king of Madra, Mādrí; Satyabhāmā, the daughter of Satrujit; and Lakshmanā, of lovely smiles. Besides these, he had sixteen thousand other wives. The highly powerful Pradyumna took the beautiful daughter of Rukmin at her public choice of a husband and she too accepted Hari's son. Of her was born a highly powerful son Aniruddha, fierce in fight on account of prowess and the subduer of enemies. Keshava demanded in marriage the grand daughter of Rukmin and though the latter was inimical to Krishna he gave him his grand daughter. On the occasion of his nuptials Rāma and other Yādavas accompanied Krishna to Bhojakata, the city of Rukmin. After the wedding had been finished several of the kings headed by him of Kalinga said to Rukmin "Although the wielder of plough-share is ignorant of dice he has got a great passion for it; why may we not fight with him and beat him in play?"

Parāçara said:—The powerful Rukmin replied to the kings, saying "so be it" and he engaged Balarāma at a game of dice in the palace. Balarāma lost to Rukmin a thousand gold coins; he betted a second time and lost another thousand to Rukmin. And the third time he staked ten thousand Niskshas and this time also won Rukmin the foremost of those expert of gambling, At this time the king of Kalinga laughed aloud and the weak and vain Rukmin groaned and said:—"By me this Baladava, ignorant of gambling, has been defeated; and blinded by a vain passion for play he think that he understands dice". Beholding the king of Kalinga laugh aloud and hearing the contemptuous words of Rukmin the wielder of plough-share was worked up with ire and increased his stake to ten millions of Niskshas Rukmi accepted the challenge and threw dice.

This time Baladeva won and cried aloud. "This stake is mine". Rukmin cried loudly and said that he was the winner. "Tell no lies Bala," cited he. "It is true that the stake is yours, but I did not agree to it; although this be won by you, yet still I am the winner".

Thereupon a deep voice was heard in the welkin increasing the more the ire of the high-minded Baladeva, saying:—"Baladeva has justly won the whole amount; Rukmin speaks lies; although he did not accept the pledge in words he did so by his acts". Thus inflamed and having his eyes reddened with rage, Balarāma got up and struck Rukmin with the board on which the game was played and slew him. And holding the trembling king of Kalinga, Bala forcibly knocked out the teeth which he had shown when he laughed. And uprooting a huge golden column he, enraged, killed therewith all those princes who had assisted his adversaries. Thereupon, O twice-born one, Bala being enraged, the whole circle cried out with fear and fled on all sides from his terror. When the slayer of Madhu heard that Rukmin had been slain by Bala he could not speak anything, being afraid of Rukmin on one hand and Bala on the other. Thereupon taking with him the newly wedded Aniruddha and the Yadu tribe he returned to Dwārakā.

verses.sa:
द्वारवत्यां स्थिते कृष्णे शक्रस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः ।
आजगामाथ मैत्रेय मत्तैरावतपृष्ठगः ॥
verses.rom:
dvaravatyam sthite krishne shakrastribhuvaneshvarah |
ajagamatha maitreya mattairavataprishthagah ||

verses.sa:
प्रविश्य द्वारकां सोऽथ समेत्य हरिणा ततः ।
कथयामास दैत्यस्य नरकस्य विचोष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
pravishya dvarakam so'tha sametya harina tatah |
kathayamasa daityasya narakasya vichoshtitam ||

verses.sa:
त्वयानाथेन देवानां मनष्यत्वेपि तिष्ठता ।
प्रशमं सर्वदुःखानि नीतानि मधुसूदन ॥
verses.rom:
tvayanathena devanam manashyatvepi tishthata |
prashamam sarvaduhkhani nitani madhusudana ||

verses.sa:
तपस्विव्यमनार्थाय सोरिष्टो धेनुकस्तथा ।
प्रवृत्तो यस्तथा केशीते सर्वे निहतास्त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
tapasvivyamanarthaya sorishto dhenukastatha |
pravritto yastatha keshite sarve nihatastvaya ||

verses.sa:
कंसः कुवलयापीडः पूतना बालघातिनी ।
नाशं नीतास्त्वया सर्वे येऽन्ये जगदुपद्रवाः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsah kuvalayapidah putana balaghatini |
nasham nitastvaya sarve ye'nye jagadupadravah ||

verses.sa:
युष्मद्दोर्दडसंभूतिपरित्राते जगत्त्रये ।
यज्वयज्ञांशसंप्राप्त्या तृप्तिं यान्ति दिवौकसः ॥
verses.rom:
yushmaddordadasambhutiparitrate jagattraye |
yajvayajnamshasampraptya triptim yanti divaukasah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं सांप्रतमायातो यन्निमित्तं जनार्दन ।
तच्छुत्वा तत्प्रतीकारप्रयत्नं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham sampratamayato yannimittam janardana |
tachchhutva tatpratikaraprayatnam kartumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
भौमोऽयं नरको नाम प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरेश्वरः ।
करोति सर्वभूतानामुपघातमरिन्दम ॥
verses.rom:
bhaumo'yam narako nama pragjyotishapureshvarah |
karoti sarvabhutanamupaghatamarindama ||

verses.sa:
देवसिद्दसुरादीनां नृपाणां च नजार्दन ।
हृत्वा तु सोऽसुरः कन्या रुरुधे निजमन्दिरे ॥
verses.rom:
devasiddasuradinam nripanam cha najardana |
hritva tu so'surah kanya rurudhe nijamandire ||

verses.sa:
छत्रं यत्सलिलस्रावि तज्जहार प्रचेतसः ।
मदंरस्य तथा शृङ्गं हृतवान्मणिपर्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
chhatram yatsalilasravi tajjahara prachetasah |
madamrasya tatha shringam hritavanmaniparvatam ||

verses.sa:
अमृतस्त्राविणी दिव्ये मन्मातुः कृष्णकुञ्जले ।
जहार सोऽसुरो दित्या वाञ्छत्यैरावतं गजम् ॥
verses.rom:
amritastravini divye manmatuh krishnakunjale |
jahara so'suro ditya vanchhatyairavatam gajam ||

verses.sa:
दुर्नीतमेतद्गोविन्दमया तस्य निवेदितम् ।
यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्स्वयं परिमृश्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
durnitametadgovindamaya tasya niveditam |
yadatra pratikartavyam tatsvayam parimrishyatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशस उवाच
इतिश्रुत्वा स्मितं कृत्वा भगवान्देवकीसुतः ।
गृहीत्वा वासवं हस्ते समुत्तस्थौ वरासनात् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashasa uvacha
itishrutva smitam kritva bhagavandevakisutah |
grihitva vasavam haste samuttasthau varasanat ||

verses.sa:
संचिन्त्यागतमारुह्य गरुडं गगनेचरम् ।
सत्यभामां समारोप्य ययौ प्राग्ज्योतिषं पुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
samchintyagatamaruhya garudam gaganecharam |
satyabhamam samaropya yayau pragjyotisham puram ||

verses.sa:
आरुह्यौरावतं नागं शक्रोऽपि त्रिदिवं ययौ ।
ततौ जगाम कृष्णश्च पश्यतां द्वारकौकसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
aruhyauravatam nagam shakro'pi tridivam yayau |
tatau jagama krishnashcha pashyatam dvarakaukasam ||

verses.sa:
प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरस्यापि समन्ताच्छतयोजनम् ।
आचिता मौरवैः पाशैः क्षुरान्तैर्भूर्द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
pragjyotishapurasyapi samantachchhatayojanam |
achita mauravaih pashaih kshurantairbhurdvijottama ||

verses.sa:
ताञ्चिच्छेद हरिः पाशान्क्षिप्त्वा चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ।
ततो मुरःसमुत्तस्थौ तं जघान च केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
tanchichchheda harih pashankshiptva chakram sudarshanam |
tato murahsamuttasthau tam jaghana cha keshavah ||

verses.sa:
मुरस्य तनयान्सप्त सहस्रांस्तांस्ततो हरिः ।
चक्रधाराग्निनिर्दग्धांश्चकार शलभानिव ॥
verses.rom:
murasya tanayansapta sahasramstamstato harih |
chakradharagninirdagdhamshchakara shalabhaniva ||

verses.sa:
हत्वासुरं हयग्रीवं तथा पञ्चजनं द्विज ।
प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं धीमांस्त्वारावान्समुपाद्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
hatvasuram hayagrivam tatha panchajanam dvija |
pragjyotishapuram dhimamstvaravansamupadravat ||

verses.sa:
नरकेणास्य तत्राभून्महासैन्येन संयुगम् ।
कृष्णस्य यत्र गोविन्दो यत्र गोविन्दो जघ्ने दैत्यान्सहस्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
narakenasya tatrabhunmahasainyena samyugam |
krishnasya yatra govindo yatra govindo jaghne daityansahasrashah ||

verses.sa:
शस्त्रास्त्रवर्षं मुञ्चन्तं तं भौमं नरकं बली ।
क्षिप्त्वा चक्रं द्विधा चक्रे चक्री दैतेयचक्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
shastrastravarsham munchantam tam bhaumam narakam bali |
kshiptva chakram dvidha chakre chakri daiteyachakraha ||

verses.sa:
हते तु नरके भूमिर्गृहीत्वादितिकुण्डले ।
उपतस्थे जगन्नाथं वाक्यं चेदमथाब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
hate tu narake bhumirgrihitvaditikundale |
upatasthe jagannatham vakyam chedamathabravit ||

verses.sa:
पृथ्व्युवाच
यदाहमुद्धृता नाथ त्वया सूकरमूर्तिना ।
त्वत्स्पर्शसंभवः पुत्रस्तदायं मय्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
prithvyuvacha
yadahamuddhrita natha tvaya sukaramurtina |
tvatsparshasambhavah putrastadayam mayyajayata ||

verses.sa:
सोऽयं त्वयैव दत्तो मे त्वयैब विनिपातितः ।
गृहाम कुण्डले चेमे पालयास्य च संततिम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'yam tvayaiva datto me tvayaiba vinipatitah |
grihama kundale cheme palayasya cha samtatim ||

verses.sa:
भारावतरणार्थाय ममैव भगवानिमम् ।
अंशेन लोकमायातः प्रसादसुमुखः प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
bharavataranarthaya mamaiva bhagavanimam |
amshena lokamayatah prasadasumukhah prabho ||

verses.sa:
त्वं कर्ता च विकर्ता च संहर्ता प्रभवोऽप्ययः ।
जगतान्त्वं जगद्रूपःस्तूयतेऽच्युत किं तव ॥
verses.rom:
tvam karta cha vikarta cha samharta prabhavo'pyayah |
jagatantvam jagadrupahstuyate'chyuta kim tava ||

verses.sa:
व्याप्तिव्याप्यं क्रियाकर्ता कार्यं च भगवान्यथा ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्य स्तूयते तव किं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
vyaptivyapyam kriyakarta karyam cha bhagavanyatha |
sarvabhutatmabhutasya stuyate tava kim tatha ||

verses.sa:
परमात्मा च भूतात्मा त्वमात्मा चाप्ययो भवान् ।
यथातथा स्तुतिर्नाथ किमर्थं ते प्रवर्तते ॥
verses.rom:
paramatma cha bhutatma tvamatma chapyayo bhavan |
yathatatha stutirnatha kimartham te pravartate ||

verses.sa:
प्रसीद सर्वभूतात्मन्नरकेण तु यत्कृतम् ।
तत्क्षम्यतामदोषाय त्वत्सुतस्त्वन्निपातितः ॥
verses.rom:
prasida sarvabhutatmannarakena tu yatkritam |
tatkshamyatamadoshaya tvatsutastvannipatitah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तथेति चोक्त्वा धरणीं भगवान् भूतभावनः ।
रत्नानि नरकावासाज्जग्राह मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatheti choktva dharanim bhagavan bhutabhavanah |
ratnani narakavasajjagraha munisattama ||

verses.sa:
कन्यापुरे स कन्यानां षोडःशातुलविक्रमः ।
शताधिकानि ददृशे सहस्राणि महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
kanyapure sa kanyanam shodahshatulavikramah |
shatadhikani dadrishe sahasrani mahamune ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दंष्ट्रान्गजांश्चाग्र्यान् षट्सहस्रांश्च दृष्टवान् ।
कांभोजानां तथाश्वानां नियुतान्येकविंशतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdamshtrangajamshchagryan shatsahasramshcha drishtavan |
kambhojanam tathashvanam niyutanyekavimshatim ||

verses.sa:
ताः कन्यास्तांस्तथा नागांस्तानश्वान् द्वारकां पुरीम् ।
प्रापयामास गोविन्दः सद्यो नरककिङ्करैः ॥
verses.rom:
tah kanyastamstatha nagamstanashvan dvarakam purim |
prapayamasa govindah sadyo narakakinkaraih ||

verses.sa:
ददृशे वारुणं च्छत्रं तथैव मणिपर्वतम् ।
आरोपयामास हरिर्गरुडेपतगेश्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
dadrishe varunam chchhatram tathaiva maniparvatam |
aropayamasa harirgarudepatageshvare ||

verses.sa:
आरुह्य च स्वयं कृष्णः सत्यभामासहायवान् ।
अदित्याः कुण्डले दानुं जगाम त्रिदशालयम् ॥
verses.rom:
aruhya cha svayam krishnah satyabhamasahayavan |
adityah kundale danum jagama tridashalayam ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पञ्चमांश एकोनत्रिंशोध्यायः (२९)
द्रारवत्यां ततः शौरिं शक्रस्त्रिभुवनश्वरः ।
आजगामाथ मैत्रेय!मत्तैरावतपृष्ठगः ॥
verses.rom:
iti shrivishnumahapurane panchamamsha ekonatrimshodhyayah (29)
draravatyam tatah shaurim shakrastribhuvanashvarah |
ajagamatha maitreya!mattairavataprishthagah ||

verses.sa:
प्रिवश्य द्रारकां सोऽथ समेत्य हरिणा ततः ।
कथयामास दैत्यस्य नरकस्य विचेष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
privashya drarakam so'tha sametya harina tatah |
kathayamasa daityasya narakasya vicheshtitam ||

verses.sa:
त्वया नाथेन देवानां मनुष्यत्वेऽपि तिष्ठता ।
प्रशमं सर्व्वदुःखानि नीतानि मधुसूदन ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya nathena devanam manushyatve'pi tishthata |
prashamam sarvvaduhkhani nitani madhusudana ||

verses.sa:
तपस्वि-जननाशाय सोऽरिष्टो धेनुकस्तथा ।
चाणूरो मुष्टिकः केशी ते सर्व्वे निहतास्त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
tapasvi-jananashaya so'rishto dhenukastatha |
chanuro mushtikah keshi te sarvve nihatastvaya ||

verses.sa:
कंसः कुवलयापीड़ः पूतना बालघातिनी ।
नाशं नीतास्त्वया सर्व्वे येऽन्ये जगदुपद्रवाः ॥
verses.rom:
kamsah kuvalayapirah putana balaghatini |
nasham nitastvaya sarvve ye'nye jagadupadravah ||

verses.sa:
युष्मद्दोर्दण्ड-सदूबुद्धि परित्राते जगत्त्रये ।
यज्वियज्ञांशसम्प्राप्त्या तृप्तिं यान्ति दिवौवसः ॥
verses.rom:
yushmaddordanda-sadubuddhi paritrate jagattraye |
yajviyajnamshasampraptya triptim yanti divauvasah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं साम्प्रतमायातो यन्निमित्तं जनार्द्दन!
तच्छु त्वा तत्प्रतीकारप्रयत्नं कर्त्तुमर्हसि ॥

यदत्र प्रतिपव्यं तत् खयं प्रविमृष्यताम् ॥

verses.sa:
सोऽयं त्वयैव दत्तो मे त्वयैव विनिपातितः ।
गृहाण कुण्डले चेमे पालयास्य च सन्ततिम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'yam tvayaiva datto me tvayaiva vinipatitah |
grihana kundale cheme palayasya cha santatim ||

verses.sa:
भारावतारणार्थाय ममैव भगवानिमम् ।
अंशेन लोकमायातः प्रसादसुमुखः प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
bharavataranarthaya mamaiva bhagavanimam |
amshena lokamayatah prasadasumukhah prabho ||

verses.sa:
त्वं कर्त्ता त्वं विकर्त्ता च संहर्त्ता प्रभवोऽप्ययः ।
जगतो त्वं जगद्रूपः स्तूयतेऽच्युत!किं तव ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kartta tvam vikartta cha samhartta prabhavo'pyayah |
jagato tvam jagadrupah stuyate'chyuta!kim tava ||

verses.sa:
व्यापी व्याप्यः क्रिया कर्त्ता कार्य्यञ्च भगवान् यथा ।
सर्व्वभूतात्मभूतस्य स्तूयते तव किं तदा ॥
verses.rom:
vyapi vyapyah kriya kartta karyyancha bhagavan yatha |
sarvvabhutatmabhutasya stuyate tava kim tada ||

verses.sa:
परमात्मा च भूतात्मा महात्मा चाव्ययो भवानु ।
यदा तदा स्तुतिर्नाथ!किमर्थं ते प्रवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
paramatma cha bhutatma mahatma chavyayo bhavanu |
yada tada stutirnatha!kimartham te pravarttate ||

verses.sa:
प्रसीद सर्व्वभूतात्मन् !नरकेणा हि यत् कृतम् ।
तत् क्षम्यतामदोषाय त्वत्सुतः त्वन्निपातितः ॥
verses.rom:
prasida sarvvabhutatman !narakena hi yat kritam |
tat kshamyatamadoshaya tvatsutah tvannipatitah ||

verses.sa:
तथेति चोक्र्वा धरणीं भगवान् भूतभावनः ।
रत्रानि नरकावासाज्जग्राह मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tatheti chokrva dharanim bhagavan bhutabhavanah |
ratrani narakavasajjagraha munisattama ||

verses.sa:
कन्यापुरे स कन्यानां षोड़शातुलविक्रमः ।
शताधिकानि ददृशे सहस्त्राणि महामते ॥
verses.rom:
kanyapure sa kanyanam shorashatulavikramah |
shatadhikani dadrishe sahastrani mahamate ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दन्तान् गजाश्वोग्रयान् षटूसहस्त्रान् स दृष्टवान् ।
काम्बोजानां तथाश्वानां नियुतान्येकविंशतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdantan gajashvograyan shatusahastran sa drishtavan |
kambojanam tathashvanam niyutanyekavimshatim ||

verses.sa:
कन्यास्ताश्व तता नागांस्तानश्वान् द्रारकां पुरीम् ।
प्रषयामास गोनविन्दः सद्यो नरककिङ्करेः ॥
verses.rom:
kanyastashva tata nagamstanashvan drarakam purim |
prashayamasa gonavindah sadyo narakakinkareh ||

verses.sa:
ददृशे वारुणं छत्रं तथैव मणिपर्व्वतम् ।
आरोपयामास हरिर्गरुड़ पन्नगाशने ॥
verses.rom:
dadrishe varunam chhatram tathaiva maniparvvatam |
aropayamasa harirgarura pannagashane ||

verses.sa:
आरुह्य च स्वयं कृष्णाः सत्यभामा-सहायवान ।
अदित्याः कुण्डले दातु जगाम त्रिदिवालयम् ॥
verses.rom:
aruhya cha svayam krishnah satyabhama-sahayavana |
adityah kundale datu jagama tridivalayam ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Thereupon Sakra, the lord of the three worlds, came mounted on his infuriated elephant Airāvata to visit Sauri at Dwārakā. Having entered Dwārakā and been welcomed by Hari he communicated unto him the actions of the demon Naraka. (He said) "O slayer of Madhu, by thee, the lord of the deities, although situated in mortal condition, all afflictions have been soothed; thou hast slain Arishta, Dhenuka, Chānura, Mushtika, Kesin,—all the demons who were slaying the ascetics. Kansa, Kavalayapida and child-destroying Putanā, as well as other oppressors of the world have all been slain by thee. The three worlds being protected by thy valour and wisdom, the deities, obtaining the share of sacrifices undertaken by the devout, enjoy satisfaction. Hear, O Janārddana, for why I have come to thee and try to remedy it. O slayer of enemies, residing in the city of Pragyotish, the demon Naraka, son of Bhumi, has been inflicting the creatures. Carrying off the maidens of the celestials, saints, demons and kings he shuts them up in his own palace. He has carried away the umbrella of Varuna, always producing water, the jewel mountain crest of Mandara, and the nectar-dropping ear-rings of my mother Aditi; and he now demands my elephant Airāvat. O Govinda, I have thus related unto thee the oppressions of the demon Naraka—do thou now consider what thou shouldst do in this". Having heard this, the illustrious son of Devaki gently smiled and taking Vāsava by the hand rose up from the excellent seat. Thereupon the lord thinking of the eater of serpents Garuda, he immediately appeared there. And having first placed Satyabhāmā on his back he ascended and flew to the city of Pragyotish. Having ascended the elephant Airivat, Indra, the lord of the celestials, set out for his city in the sight of the inhabitants of Dwārakā.

O foremost of twice-born ones, the four sides of the city Pragyotish to the extent of a yojana were environed by nooses made by the demon Mura, whose edges were as sharp as razors. But throwing his discus Sudarshana amongst them Hari sundered them into pieces. Thereupon Mura rose up but Krishna killed him and burnt his seven thousand sons like so many moths with the flame of the edge of his discus. Having slain Mura, Hayagriva, and Panchajana the wise Hari soon reached the city of Pragyotish. There ensued a dreadful conflict with Naraka's troops in which Govinda slew thousands of demons. And the annihilator of the demon tribe cut in two with his discus Bhumi's son Naraka who came there showering arrows and weapons upon the celestials. The demon Naraka being slain, Earth, taking the two ear-rings of Aditi, approached the lord of the world and said "O lord, when I was upheld by thee in the shape of a boar, then this my son was engendered by thy contact. Thou didst confer this son upon me and thou hast slain him now. Do thou now take this pair of ear-rings and protect his progeny. Thou, O lord, whose aspect is ever pleasing, hast incarnated on this sphere a portion of thyself to lighten my burden. Thou art the eternal creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe, the origin of all the worlds and identical with the universe; how can we worthily chant thy glories? Thou art the pervader and that which is pervaded, the act, the agent and the effect—thou art the soul of all creatures and how can we sufficiently chant thy glories? Thou art the great soul—the sentient and living soul of all beings and imperishable—there is no praise worthy of thee—how can we chant thy glories? Have pity, O universal soul and forgive the iniquities which Naraka has committed. Verily it is for his purification that he hath been killed by thee".

Parāçara said Having replied to the Earth saying "so be it" the lord, who is the substance of all creatures, took various jewels from Naraka's abode. Having entered the female apartment the highly powerful Krishna saw sixteen thousand and one hundred damsels. He also found in the palace sixteen thousand huge elephants each having four tusks, twenty-one lakhs of horses of Kāmboja and other excellent breeds. All those Govinda sent to Dwārakā in charge of the servants of Naraka. Thereupon he placed Varuna's umbrella and the golden mountain on Garuda's back, And having ascended with Satyabhāmā he repaired to the city of celestials to restore to Aditi her ear-rings.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
गरुडो वारुणं छत्रं तथैव मणिपर्वतम् ।
सभार्यं च हृषीकेशं लीलयैव वहन्ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
garudo varunam chhatram tathaiva maniparvatam |
sabharyam cha hrishikesham lilayaiva vahanyayau ||

verses.sa:
ततः शंखमुपाध्मासीत्स्वर्गद्वारगतो हरिः ।
उपतस्थुस्तथा देवाःसार्घ्यहस्ता जनर्दनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah shamkhamupadhmasitsvargadvaragato harih |
upatasthustatha devahsarghyahasta janardanam ||

verses.sa:
स देवैरर्चितः कृष्णो देवमातुर्निवेशनम् ।
सिताभ्रशिखराकारं प्रविश्य ददृशेऽदितिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa devairarchitah krishno devamaturniveshanam |
sitabhrashikharakaram pravishya dadrishe'ditim ||

verses.sa:
स तां प्रणम्य शक्रेण सह ते कुण्डलोत्तमे ।
ददौ नरकनाशं च शशंसास्यै जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tam pranamya shakrena saha te kundalottame |
dadau narakanasham cha shashamsasyai janardanah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रीताजगन्माता धातारं जगतां हरिम् ।
तुष्टावादितिरव्यग्रा कृत्वा तत्प्रवणं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah pritajaganmata dhataram jagatam harim |
tushtavaditiravyagra kritva tatpravanam manah ||

verses.sa:
अदितिरुवाच
नमस्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष भक्तानामभयङ्कर ।
सनातनात्मन् सर्वात्मन् भूतात्मन् भूतभावन ॥
verses.rom:
aditiruvacha
namaste pundarikaksha bhaktanamabhayankara |
sanatanatman sarvatman bhutatman bhutabhavana ||

verses.sa:
प्रणेतर्मनसो बुद्धेरिन्द्रियाणां गुणात्मक ।
त्रिगुणातीत निर्द्वंद्व शुद्धसत्त्व हृदि स्थित ॥
verses.rom:
pranetarmanaso buddherindriyanam gunatmaka |
trigunatita nirdvamdva shuddhasattva hridi sthita ||

verses.sa:
सितदीर्घादिनिः शेषकल्पनापरिवर्जित ।
जन्मादिभिरसंस्पृष्ट स्वप्नादिपरिवर्जित ॥
verses.rom:
sitadirghadinih sheshakalpanaparivarjita |
janmadibhirasamsprishta svapnadiparivarjita ||

verses.sa:
संध्यारात्रिरहो भूमिर्गगनं वायुरंबु च ।
हुताशनो मनो बुद्धिर्भूतादिस्त्वं तथाच्युत ॥
verses.rom:
samdhyaratriraho bhumirgaganam vayurambu cha |
hutashano mano buddhirbhutadistvam tathachyuta ||

verses.sa:
सर्गस्थितिविनाशानां कर्ता कर्तृपतिर्भवान् ।
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाख्याभिरात्ममूर्तिभिरीश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
sargasthitivinashanam karta kartripatirbhavan |
brahmavishnushivakhyabhiratmamurtibhirishvara ||

verses.sa:
देवा दैत्यास्तथा यक्षा राक्षसाः सिद्धपन्नगाः ।
कूष्माण्डाश्च पिशाचाश्च गन्धर्वा मनुजास्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
deva daityastatha yaksha rakshasah siddhapannagah |
kushmandashcha pishachashcha gandharva manujastatha ||

verses.sa:
पशवश्च मृगाश्चैव पतङ्गाश्च सरीसृपाः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलताबह्व्यःसमस्तास्तृणजातयः ॥
verses.rom:
pashavashcha mrigashchaiva patangashcha sarisripah |
vrikshagulmalatabahvyahsamastastrinajatayah ||

verses.sa:
स्थूला मध्यास्तथा सूक्ष्माःसूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतराश्च ये ।
देहभेदा भवान् सर्वे ये केचित्पुर्गलाश्रयाः ॥
verses.rom:
sthula madhyastatha sukshmahsukshmatsukshmatarashcha ye |
dehabheda bhavan sarve ye kechitpurgalashrayah ||

verses.sa:
माया तवेयमज्ञातपरमार्थातिमोहिनी ।
अनात्मन्यात्मविज्ञानं यया मूढो निरुद्ध्यते ॥
verses.rom:
maya taveyamajnataparamarthatimohini |
anatmanyatmavijnanam yaya mudho niruddhyate ||

verses.sa:
अस्वे स्वमिति भावोत्र यत्पुंसामुपजायते ।
अहं ममेति भावो यत्प्रायेणैवाभिजायते ।
संसारमातुर्मायायास्तवैतन्नाथ चेष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
asve svamiti bhavotra yatpumsamupajayate |
aham mameti bhavo yatprayenaivabhijayate |
samsaramaturmayayastavaitannatha cheshtitam ||

verses.sa:
यैः स्वधर्मपरैर्नाथ नरैराराधितो भवान् ।
ते तरन्त्यखिलामेतां मायामात्मविमुक्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yaih svadharmaparairnatha narairaradhito bhavan |
te tarantyakhilametam mayamatmavimuktaye ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माद्याःसकला देवा मनुष्याः पशवस्तथा ।
विष्णुमाया महावर्तमोहान्धतमसावृताः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmadyahsakala deva manushyah pashavastatha |
vishnumaya mahavartamohandhatamasavritah ||

verses.sa:
आराध्य त्वामभीप्संते कामानात्मभवक्षयम् ।
यदेते पुरुषा माया सैवेयं भगवंस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
aradhya tvamabhipsamte kamanatmabhavakshayam |
yadete purusha maya saiveyam bhagavamstava ||

verses.sa:
मया त्वं पुत्रकामिन्या वैरिपक्षजयाय च ।
आराधितो न मोक्षाय मायाविलसितं हि तत् ॥
verses.rom:
maya tvam putrakaminya vairipakshajayaya cha |
aradhito na mokshaya mayavilasitam hi tat ||

verses.sa:
कौपीनाच्छादनप्राया वाञ्छा कल्पद्रुमादपि ।
जायते यदपुण्यानां सोपराधः स्वदोषजः ॥
verses.rom:
kaupinachchhadanapraya vanchha kalpadrumadapi |
jayate yadapunyanam soparadhah svadoshajah ||

verses.sa:
तत्प्रसीदाखिलजगन्मायामोहकराव्यय ।
अज्ञानं ज्ञानसद्भावभूतं भूतेश नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
tatprasidakhilajaganmayamohakaravyaya |
ajnanam jnanasadbhavabhutam bhutesha nashaya ||

verses.sa:
नमस्ते चक्रहस्ताय शार्ङ्गहस्ताय ते नमः ।
नन्दहस्ताय ते विष्णो शङ्खहस्ताय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste chakrahastaya sharngahastaya te namah |
nandahastaya te vishno shankhahastaya te namah ||

verses.sa:
एतत्पश्यामि ते रूपं स्थूलचिह्नोपलक्षितम् ।
न जानामि परं यत्ते प्रसीद परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
etatpashyami te rupam sthulachihnopalakshitam |
na janami param yatte prasida parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
अदित्यैवं स्तुतो विष्णुः प्रहस्याह सुरारणिम् ।
माता देवि त्वमस्माकं प्रसीद वरदा भव ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
adityaivam stuto vishnuh prahasyaha suraranim |
mata devi tvamasmakam prasida varada bhava ||

verses.sa:
अदिदिरुवाच
एवमस्तु यथेच्छा ते त्वमशेषैः सुरासुरैः ।
अजेयः पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्त्यलोके भविष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
adidiruvacha
evamastu yathechchha te tvamasheshaih surasuraih |
ajeyah purushavyaghra sartyaloke bhavishyasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः कृष्णस्य पत्नी च शक्रेण सहितादितिम् ।
सत्यभामा प्रणम्याह प्रसीदेति पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah krishnasya patni cha shakrena sahitaditim |
satyabhama pranamyaha prasideti punah punah ||

verses.sa:
अदितिरुवाच
मत्प्रसादान्न ते सुभ्रु जरा वैरूप्यमेव वा ।
भविष्यत्यनवद्याङ्गि सुस्थिरं नवयौवनम् ॥
verses.rom:
aditiruvacha
matprasadanna te subhru jara vairupyameva va |
bhavishyatyanavadyangi susthiram navayauvanam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
अदित्या तु कृतानुज्ञो देवराजो जनार्दनम् ।
यथावत्पूजयामास बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
aditya tu kritanujno devarajo janardanam |
yathavatpujayamasa bahumanapurahsaram ||

verses.sa:
शची च सत्यभामायै पारिजातस्य पुष्पकम् ।
न ददौ मानुषीं मत्वा स्वयं पुष्पैरलङ्कृता ॥
verses.rom:
shachi cha satyabhamayai parijatasya pushpakam |
na dadau manushim matva svayam pushpairalankrita ||

verses.sa:
ततो ददर्श कृष्णोऽपि सत्यभामासहायवान् ।
दवोद्यानानि हृद्यानि नन्दनादीनि सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tato dadarsha krishno'pi satyabhamasahayavan |
davodyanani hridyani nandanadini sattama ||

verses.sa:
ददर्श च सुगन्धाढ्यं मञ्जरीपुञ्जधारिणम् ।
नित्याह्लादकरं ताम्रबालपल्लवशोभितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadarsha cha sugandhadhyam manjaripunjadharinam |
nityahladakaram tamrabalapallavashobhitam ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यमानेऽमृते जातं जातरूपोपमत्वचम् ।
पारिजातं जगन्नाथः केशवः केशिसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
mathyamane'mrite jatam jatarupopamatvacham |
parijatam jagannathah keshavah keshisudanah ||

verses.sa:
तुतोष परमप्रीत्या तरुराजमनुत्तमम् ।
तं दृष्ट्वा प्राह गोविन्दं सत्यभामा द्विजोत्तम ।
कस्मान्न द्वारकामेष नीयते कृष्ण पादपः ॥
verses.rom:
tutosha paramapritya tarurajamanuttamam |
tam drishtva praha govindam satyabhama dvijottama |
kasmanna dvarakamesha niyate krishna padapah ||

verses.sa:
यदि चेत्त्वद्वचः सत्यं त्वमत्यर्थं प्रियेति मे ।
मद्गेहनिष्कुटार्थाय तदयं नीयतां तरुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi chettvadvachah satyam tvamatyartham priyeti me |
madgehanishkutarthaya tadayam niyatam taruh ||

verses.sa:
न मे जांबवती तादृगभीष्टा न च रुक्मिणी ।
सत्ये यथा त्वमित्युक्तं त्वया कृष्णासकृत्प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
na me jambavati tadrigabhishta na cha rukmini |
satye yatha tvamityuktam tvaya krishnasakritpriyam ||

verses.sa:
सत्यं तद्यदि गोविन्द नोपचारकृतं मम ।
तदस्तु पारिजातोऽयं मम गेहविभूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
satyam tadyadi govinda nopacharakritam mama |
tadastu parijato'yam mama gehavibhushanam ||

verses.sa:
बिभ्रती पारिजातस्य केशपक्षेण मञ्जरीम् ।
सपत्नीनामहं मध्ये शोभेयमिति कामये ॥
verses.rom:
bibhrati parijatasya keshapakshena manjarim |
sapatninamaham madhye shobheyamiti kamaye ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्तःस प्रहस्यैनां पारिजातं गरुत्मति ।
आरोपयामास हरिस्तमूचुर्वनरक्षिणः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktahsa prahasyainam parijatam garutmati |
aropayamasa haristamuchurvanarakshinah ||

verses.sa:
भो शची देवराजस्य महिषी तत्परीग्रहम् ।
पारिजातं न गोविन्द हर्तुमर्हसि पादपम् ॥
verses.rom:
bho shachi devarajasya mahishi tatparigraham |
parijatam na govinda hartumarhasi padapam ||

verses.sa:
उत्पन्नो देवराजाय दत्तःसोऽपि ददौ पुनः ।
महिष्यै सुमहाभाग देव्यै शच्यै कुतूहलात् ॥
verses.rom:
utpanno devarajaya dattahso'pi dadau punah |
mahishyai sumahabhaga devyai shachyai kutuhalat ||

verses.sa:
शचीविभूषणार्थाय देवैरमृतमन्थने ।
उत्पादितोऽयं न क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं गमिष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
shachivibhushanarthaya devairamritamanthane |
utpadito'yam na kshemi grihitvainam gamishyasi ||

verses.sa:
देवराजो मुखप्रेक्षी यस्यास्तस्याः परिग्रहम् ।
मैढ्यात्प्रार्थयसे क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं हि को व्रजेत् ॥
verses.rom:
devarajo mukhaprekshi yasyastasyah parigraham |
maidhyatprarthayase kshemi grihitvainam hi ko vrajet ||

verses.sa:
अवश्यमस्य देवेन्द्रो निष्कृतिं कृष्ण यास्यति ।
वज्रोद्यतकरं शक्रमनुयास्यन्ति चामराः ॥
verses.rom:
avashyamasya devendro nishkritim krishna yasyati |
vajrodyatakaram shakramanuyasyanti chamarah ||

verses.sa:
तदलं सकलैर्देवैर्विग्रहेण तवाच्युत ।
विपाककटु यत्कर्म तन्न शंसंति पण्डिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tadalam sakalairdevairvigrahena tavachyuta |
vipakakatu yatkarma tanna shamsamti panditah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्ते तैरुवाचैतान् सत्यभामातिकोपिनी ।
का शची पारिजातस्य को वा शक्रःसुराधिपः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityukte tairuvachaitan satyabhamatikopini |
ka shachi parijatasya ko va shakrahsuradhipah ||

verses.sa:
सामान्यःसर्वलोकस्य यद्येषोऽमृतमन्थने ।
समुत्पन्नस्तरुः कस्मादोको गृह्णाति वासवः ॥
verses.rom:
samanyahsarvalokasya yadyesho'mritamanthane |
samutpannastaruh kasmadoko grihnati vasavah ||

verses.sa:
यथा सुरा यथैवेन्दुर्यथा श्रीर्वनरक्षिणः ।
सामान्यःसर्वलोकस्य पारिजातस्तथा द्रुमः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha sura yathaivenduryatha shrirvanarakshinah |
samanyahsarvalokasya parijatastatha drumah ||

verses.sa:
भर्तृ बहुमहागर्वाद्रुणद्ध्येनमथो शची ।
तत्कथ्यतामलं क्षान्त्या सत्वा हारयति द्रुमम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhartri bahumahagarvadrunaddhyenamatho shachi |
tatkathyatamalam kshantya satva harayati drumam ||

verses.sa:
कथ्यतां च द्रुतं गत्वा पौलोम्या वचनं मम ।
सत्यभामा वदत्येतदितिगर्वोद्धताक्षरम् ॥
verses.rom:
kathyatam cha drutam gatva paulomya vachanam mama |
satyabhama vadatyetaditigarvoddhataksharam ||

verses.sa:
यदि त्वं दयिता भर्तुर्यदि वश्यः पतिस्तव ।
मद्भर्तुर्हरतो वृक्षं तत्कारय निवारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi tvam dayita bharturyadi vashyah patistava |
madbharturharato vriksham tatkaraya nivaranam ||

verses.sa:
जानामि ते पतिं शक्रं जानामि त्रिदशेश्वरम् ।
पारिजातं तथाप्येनं मानुषी हारयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
janami te patim shakram janami tridasheshvaram |
parijatam tathapyenam manushi harayami te ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्ता रक्षिणो गत्वा शच्याः प्रोचुर्यथोदितम् ।
श्रुत्वा चोत्साहयामास शची चक्रं सुराधिपम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityukta rakshino gatva shachyah prochuryathoditam |
shrutva chotsahayamasa shachi chakram suradhipam ||

verses.sa:
ततःसमस्तदेवानां सैन्यैः परिवृतो हरिम् ।
प्रययौ पारिजातार्थमिन्द्रोयोद्धुं द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tatahsamastadevanam sainyaih parivrito harim |
prayayau parijatarthamindroyoddhum dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
ततः परिघनिस्त्रिंशगदाशूलवरायुधाः ।
बभूवुस्त्रिदसाःसज्जाः शक्रे वज्रकरे स्थिते ॥
verses.rom:
tatah parighanistrimshagadashulavarayudhah |
babhuvustridasahsajjah shakre vajrakare sthite ||

verses.sa:
ततो निरिक्ष्य गोविन्दो नागराजोपरि स्थितम् ।
शक्रं देवपरिवारं युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato nirikshya govindo nagarajopari sthitam |
shakram devaparivaram yuddhaya samupasthitam ||

verses.sa:
चकार शङ्खनिर्घोषं दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ।
मुमोच शरसंघातान् सहस्रायुतशः शितान् ॥
verses.rom:
chakara shankhanirghosham dishah shabdena purayan |
mumocha sharasamghatan sahasrayutashah shitan ||

verses.sa:
ततो दिशो नभश्चैव दृष्ट्वा शरशतैश्चितम् ।
मुमुचुस्त्रिदशाःसर्वे ह्यस्त्रशस्त्राम्यनेकशः ॥
verses.rom:
tato disho nabhashchaiva drishtva sharashataishchitam |
mumuchustridashahsarve hyastrashastramyanekashah ||

verses.sa:
एकैकमस्त्रं शस्त्रं च दैवैर्मुक्तं सहस्रशः ।
चिच्छेद लीलयैवेशो जगतां मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
ekaikamastram shastram cha daivairmuktam sahasrashah |
chichchheda lilayaivesho jagatam madhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
पाशं सलिलराजस्य समाकृष्यीरगात्पुनः ।
चकार खण्डशश्चञ्च्वा बालपन्नगदेहवत् ॥
verses.rom:
pasham salilarajasya samakrishyiragatpunah |
chakara khandashashchanchva balapannagadehavat ||

verses.sa:
यमेन प्रहितं दण्डं गदाविक्षेपखण्डितम् ।
पृथिव्यां पातयामास भगवान् देवकीसुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yamena prahitam dandam gadavikshepakhanditam |
prithivyam patayamasa bhagavan devakisutah ||

verses.sa:
शिबिकां च धनेशस्य चक्रेण तिलशो विभुः ।
चकार शौरिरर्कं च दृषृदृष्टहतौजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
shibikam cha dhaneshasya chakrena tilasho vibhuh |
chakara shaurirarkam cha drishridrishtahataujasam ||

verses.sa:
नीतोऽग्निः शीततां बाणैर्द्राविता वसवो दिशः ।
चक्रविच्छिन्नशुलाग्रा रुद्रा भुवि निपातिताः ॥
verses.rom:
nito'gnih shitatam banairdravita vasavo dishah |
chakravichchhinnashulagra rudra bhuvi nipatitah ||

verses.sa:
साध्या विश्वेऽथ मरुतो गन्धर्वाश्चैव सा यकैः ।
शार्ङ्गिणा प्रेरितैरस्ता व्योम्नि शाल्मलितूलवत् ॥
verses.rom:
sadhya vishve'tha maruto gandharvashchaiva sa yakaih |
sharngina preritairasta vyomni shalmalitulavat ||

verses.sa:
गरुत्मानपि तुण्डेन पक्षाभ्यां च नखाङ्कुरैः ।
भक्षयंस्ताडयन् देवान् दारयंश्च चचार वै ॥
verses.rom:
garutmanapi tundena pakshabhyam cha nakhankuraih |
bhakshayamstadayan devan darayamshcha chachara vai ||

verses.sa:
ततः शतसहस्रेण देवेन्द्रमधुसूदनौ ।
परस्परं ववर्षाते धाराभिरिव तोयदौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatah shatasahasrena devendramadhusudanau |
parasparam vavarshate dharabhiriva toyadau ||

verses.sa:
ऐरावतेन गरुडो युयुधे तत्र संकुले ।
देवैः समस्तैर्युयुधे शक्रेण च जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
airavatena garudo yuyudhe tatra samkule |
devaih samastairyuyudhe shakrena cha janardanah ||

verses.sa:
भिन्नेष्वशेषबाणेषु शस्त्रेष्वस्त्रेषु च त्वरन् ।
जग्राह वासवो वज्रं कृष्णश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhinneshvasheshabaneshu shastreshvastreshu cha tvaran |
jagraha vasavo vajram krishnashchakram sudarshanam ||

verses.sa:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं द्विजसत्तम ।
वज्रचक्रकरौ दृष्ट्वा देवाराजजनार्दनौ ॥
verses.rom:
tato hahakritam sarvam trailokyam dvijasattama |
vajrachakrakarau drishtva devarajajanardanau ||

verses.sa:
क्षिप्तं वज्रमथेन्द्रेण जग्राह भगवान्हरिः ।
न मुमोच तदा चक्रं शक्रं तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
kshiptam vajramathendrena jagraha bhagavanharih |
na mumocha tada chakram shakram tishtheti chabravit ||

verses.sa:
प्रणष्टवज्रं देवेन्द्रं गरुडक्षतवाहनम् ।
सत्यभामाब्रवीद्वीरं पलायनपरायणम् ॥
verses.rom:
pranashtavajram devendram garudakshatavahanam |
satyabhamabravidviram palayanaparayanam ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्येश न ते युक्तं शचीभर्तुः पलायनम् ।
पारिजातस्रगाभोगा त्वामुपस्थास्यते शची ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyesha na te yuktam shachibhartuh palayanam |
parijatasragabhoga tvamupasthasyate shachi ||

verses.sa:
कीदृशं देवराज्यं ते पारिजातस्रगुज्ज्वलाम् ।
अपश्यतो यथापूर्वं ग्रणयाभ्यागतां शचीम् ॥
verses.rom:
kidrisham devarajyam te parijatasragujjvalam |
apashyato yathapurvam granayabhyagatam shachim ||

verses.sa:
अलं शक्र प्रयासेन न व्रीडां गन्तुमर्हसि ।
नीयतां पारिजातोयं देवाःसंतु गतव्यथाः ॥
verses.rom:
alam shakra prayasena na vridam gantumarhasi |
niyatam parijatoyam devahsamtu gatavyathah ||

verses.sa:
परिगर्वावलेपेन बहुमानपुरःसरम् ।
न ददर्श गृहं यातामुपचारेण मां शची ॥
verses.rom:
parigarvavalepena bahumanapurahsaram |
na dadarsha griham yatamupacharena mam shachi ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रीत्वादगुरुचित्ताहं स्वभर्तृश्लाघनापरा ।
ततः कृतवती शक्र भवता सह विग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
stritvadaguruchittaham svabhartrishlaghanapara |
tatah kritavati shakra bhavata saha vigraham ||

verses.sa:
तदलं पारिजातेन परस्वेन हृतेन मे ।
रूपेण गर्विता सा तु भर्त्रा का स्त्री न गर्विता ॥
verses.rom:
tadalam parijatena parasvena hritena me |
rupena garvita sa tu bhartra ka stri na garvita ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्तो वै निववृते देवराजस्तया द्विज ।
प्राह चैनामलं चण्डि सख्युः खेदोक्तिविस्तरैः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityukto vai nivavrite devarajastaya dvija |
praha chainamalam chandi sakhyuh khedoktivistaraih ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्र उवाच
न चापि सर्गसंहारस्थितिकर्ताखिलस्य यः ।
जितस्य तेन मे व्रीडा जायते विश्वरूपिणा ॥
verses.rom:
indra uvacha
na chapi sargasamharasthitikartakhilasya yah |
jitasya tena me vrida jayate vishvarupina ||

verses.sa:
यस्माज्जगत्सकलमेतदनादिमध्याद्यस्मिन्यतश्च न भविष्यति सर्वभूतात् ।
तेनोद्भवप्रलयपालनकारणेन व्रीडा कथं भवति देवि निराकृतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
yasmajjagatsakalametadanadimadhyadyasminyatashcha na bhavishyati sarvabhutat |
tenodbhavapralayapalanakaranena vrida katham bhavati devi nirakritasya ||

verses.sa:
सकलभुवनसूतिर्मूर्तिरल्पाल्पसूक्ष्माविदितसकलवेद्यैर्ज्ञायते यस्य नान्यैः ।
तमजमकृतमीशं शाश्वतं स्वेच्छयैनं जगदुपकृतिमर्त्यं को विजेतुं समर्थः ॥
verses.rom:
sakalabhuvanasutirmurtiralpalpasukshmaviditasakalavedyairjnayate yasya nanyaih |
tamajamakritamisham shashvatam svechchhayainam jagadupakritimartyam ko vijetum samarthah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पञ्चमांसे त्रिंशोध्यायः (३०)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane panchamamse trimshodhyayah (30)

prose.en:
Carrying the umbrella of Varuna, the jewel mountain and Hrishikesh with his spouse on his back, Garuda went along lightly and sportively. When Hari arrived at the gate of Swarga he blew his conch on which the celestials came forward to meet him bearing respectful offerings. Having received the homage of the celestials he proceeded to the palace of the mother of gods whose turrets resembled the white clouds and found Aditi there. Thereupon having bowed unto her along with the king of celestials he conferred the pair of ear-rings upon her and related unto her the destruction of the demon Naraka. Well-pleased, Aditi, the mother of Gods with her thoughts wholly devoted unto Hari, the protector of the universe, began to chant his glories:—"Salutation unto thee, O thou having lotus eyes, who removest all fear of the devotees, who art eternal, the soul of all creatures, the creator of all and identical with all. Thou art at one with the three qualities and the creator of mind, intellect and senses. Thou art beyond the three qualities, exempt from contraries, pure, residing in the hearts of all; void of colour, extension and every transient modification and uninfluenced by the changes of birth and death and sleep and waking. Thou art evening, night and day, earth, sky, air, water and fire, mind, intellect and individuality. Thou art the agent of creation, preservation and destruction and the lord over the agent—thou appearest in various forms which are Brahmā, Vishnu and Siva—and thou art the master of all these thy forms. Thou art Gods, Yakshas, Daityas, Rākshasas, Sidhas, Pannagas, Kushmandas, Pisāchas, Gandharvas, men, animals, deer, elephants, reptiles, trees, shrubs, creepers, climbers, and grasses—all things, large, middling, and small, immense or minute; thou art all bodies whatsoever composed of aggregated atoms. Those who are ignorant of thy true nature cannot understand thy illusion—the fools (only) follow the illusion and think 'this is mine'. O Lord, thy illusion is the mother of the world—and the notions 'I am, this is mine' are but delusions. O Lord, those men, who attentive to their duties, worship thee, obtain salvation after traversing these illusions. Brahmā and all the celestials, men and animals are alike enshrouded by the thick darkness of delusion in the abyss of the illusions of Vishnu. This is also thy delusion, O lord, that men having worshipped thee seek the gratification of desires and their own preservation. That people having worshipped thee desire for the total annihilation of themselves is but the outcome of thy delusion. That I have worshipped thee for son and the destruction of the enemies and not for salvation is also the result of thy fascination. It is the fruit of the iniquitous acts of the impious (to pray for vain things to one who is able to give better things) like asking for a rag to cover nakedness from the tree that confers whatever is solicited from it. Be propitious with me, O thou imperishable, who hast deceived the whole universe with thy delusion. O lord of creatures, do thou remove this ignorance of mine—the notion that I am wise; salutation unto thee, the holder of discus; salutation unto thee the wielder of bow; salutation unto thee, the holder of a club; salutation unto thee, the holder of a conch. O god, I do perceive thy perceptible form—but cannot perceive thy real form; do thou therefore be propitious with me".

Parāçara said:—The mother of gods, having thus chanted the glories of Vishnu, he smiling said:—"Thou art our mother, O goddess, be thou propitious and confer upon me a boon".

Aditi said:—"So be it, ever as thou wilt; O foremost of men, as long as shalt thou dwell in the land of mortals thou shalt be invincible by celestials and demons". Thereupon Satyabhāmā, along with Sachi, bowed unto Aditi again and again and said, "Be thou pleased". Whereto Aditi replied saying:—"Fair-browed dame, by my favour thou shalt never experience decrepitude or loss of beauty; thou shalt be of a blameless person and asylum of all graces".

Parāçara said:—Being commanded by Aditi, the lord of the celestials duly honored Janārddana. Thereupon Krishna, accompanied by Satyabhāmā beheld Nandana and other pleasant gardens of the celestials. There Kesava, the lord of the universe and the slayer of Kesi, saw Pārijāta, the favourite of Sachi, having golden bark, young sprouting leaves of a copper colour and bearing numerous fragrant clusters of flowers, and which was produced when the ocean was churned for ambrosia. Beholding that tree, O foremost of twice-born ones, Satyabhāmā said to Govinda. "Why should not this celestial tree be taken to Dwārakā. If what you always say is true that I am really dear to you then take this tree from here for the gardens of my dwelling. O Krishna, you always say 'O Satya, neither Rukmini nor Jāmbavati is beloved unto me like thee,' if this is true and not mere flattery then let this Pārijāta be the ornament of my dwelling. Wearing the flowers of this tree in the braids of my hair I wish to appear graceful amidst my fellow queens".

Parāçara said:—Thus requested by Satyabhāmā Hari, smiled and taking the Pārijāta plant placed it upon Garuda.

The guards said: "O Govinda, this tree belongs to Sachi, the queen of the king of celestials; it is not becoming for thee to remove it. When the ocean was churned by the celestials this tree was produced for the purpose of providing Sachi with flowery ornaments; thou shalt not go with it uncatched. This is the property of one whose countenance the king of the celestials delights to look; it is out of ignorance that thou dost attempt to take it—taking this no one shall be suffered to depart in peace. Forsooth shall the celestial chief punish this audacity; and when he shall take up his thunderbolt all the deities shall follow him. O thou imperishable, it is not proper for thee, to enter into conflict with all the divinities. The wise never undertake a work that terminates fatally". The guards having said this Satyabhāmā was greatly worked up with ire and said: "How does this Pārijāta belong to Sachi? Who is Sakra, the lord of the celestials? If this had been produced when the ocean was churned by the celestials then all have equal right over it—why shall Vāsava alone possess it? O ye warders of the garden, ambrosia, the moon and Lakshmi are the common properties of all; so is this Pārijāta tree. If Sachi has taken possession of it forcibly by the valour of her husband, do ye go and communicate unto her that Satyabhāmā is taking it away and let not Sachi forgive her. Do ye soon go to her and according to my instructions tell her that Satyabhāmā has given vent to these proud words. 'If thou art dear unto thy husband, if he is under thine control then let him take back the Pārijāta tree which my husband is taking away. I know thy husband Sakra is the master of the three worlds. Still being a mortal I take away this Panjata tree.'"

Parāçara said:—Being thus accosted, the warders went to Sachi and communicated unto her everything duly. And Sachi excited the lord of the three worlds. Thereupon accompanied by the army of the celestials, Indra, issued out to fight with Hari, in defence of the Pārijāta tree. The celestials were armed with clubs, swords, maces and darts and Indra wielded the thunderbolt. As soon as Govinda beheld the king of the celestials proceeding against him mounted on his elephant attended by the immortals he blew his shell so that all regions were filled with the sound thereof and he smilingly showered myriads of shafts upon his assailants. When the celestials saw that all the directions and atmosphere were overspread with arrows they also in return hurled numberless missiles. But all these, the slayer of Madhu, and the lord of the three worlds, sundered easily into a thousand pieces with his shafts. Garuda, the devourer of serpents, laid hold of the noose of the king of seas and tore it to pieces with his beak as if it had been a little snake. Devaki's son hurled his mace at the club of Yama and cast it broken upon the ground; he sundered in pieces the litter of the lord of riches with his discus; his eye-looks overclouded the radiance of the sun; he cut Agni into a hundred parts with his shafts and scattered the Vasus through the realms of the space; he sundered with his discus the points of the tridents of the Rudras and cast themselves upon the earth; and with the arrows shot from his bow he scattered the Sadhyas, Viswas, Maruts and Gandharvas through the sky, like fleeces of cotton from the pods of the Simal tree. Garuda also diligently plied his beak and wings and bit and bruised and scratched the celestials who opposed his lord. Like unto two heavy clouds showering raindrops the king of the celestials and the slayer of Madhu overpowered each other with numberless arrows. Garuda fought with Airavata in that conflict and Janārddana engaged with his discus with all the celestials. When all other weapons had been sundered into pieces Indra stood armed with his thunderbolt and Krishna with the discus Sudarshana. Beholding them thus ready for fight all the inhabitants of the three worlds, cried aloud "Alas! Alas!" In vain did Indra hurl his bolt for Hari caught and arrested it. He however, did not hurl his discus, but only called out to Indra to stay. Beholding Indra disarmed and his elephant disabled by Garuda and the deity about to fly away Satyabhāmā said to him:—"O king of three worlds, it becomes not the husband of Sachi to run away. She will approach you adorned with Pārijāta garlands. What shalt thou do with the kingdom of heaven when no longer thou dost behold Sachi approach thee, like before, embellished with Pārijāta garlands? Fly not O Sakra; you must suffer shame, take the Pārijatā; let the celestials be no longer annoyed. Worked up with the pride of her husband Sachi has not welcomed me to her dwelling with her respectful presents. O king of the celestials, I am a woman and therefore of light purpose and am anxious of my husband's fame; for this I have instituted this fight with thee. I do not require the Pārijatā any more. Why shall we steal another's property? What female is not inflated with the pride of her husband? But she is proud of her beauty".

Parāçara said:—Thus addressed by her the king of the celestials turned back and said:—"O wrathful dame, thou shouldst not afflict thy friend with further reproaches. I am not ashamed of being defeated by him who is the author of the creation, preservation and destruction of the world, who is the substance of all things, and in whom the universe exists, without beginning or middle, and from whom and by whom at one with all things, it proceeds and will cease to be. O goddess, what disgrace it is to any one, to be vanquished by him who is the agent of creation, preservation and destruction? His form, though infinitely subtle, is the parent of all worlds and is known to those only by whom all that may be known is known; who is capable of defeating the unborn, unconstituted, eternal lord, who has, of his own accord, descended for the behoof of the world?"

verses.sa:
संस्तुतो भगवानित्थं देवराजेन केशवः ।
प्रहंस्य भावगम्भीरमुवाचेदं द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
samstuto bhagavanittham devarajena keshavah |
prahamsya bhavagambhiramuvachedam drijottama ||

verses.sa:
देवराजो भवानिन्द्रो वयं मर्त्त्या जगत्पते !
क्षन्तव्यं भवता चदमपराधकृत मम ॥
verses.rom:
devarajo bhavanindro vayam marttya jagatpate !
kshantavyam bhavata chadamaparadhakrita mama ||

verses.sa:
पारिजाततरुश्वायं नीयतामुचितास्पदम ।
गृहीतोऽयं मया शक्र!सत्यावचनकारणात् ॥
verses.rom:
parijatatarushvayam niyatamuchitaspadama |
grihito'yam maya shakra!satyavachanakaranat ||

verses.sa:
वज्रञ्चेदं गृहाण त्वं यत्त्वया प्रहितं मयि ।
तवैवैतत् प्रहरणां शक्र!वैरिविदारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
vajranchedam grihana tvam yattvaya prahitam mayi |
tavaivaitat praharanam shakra!vairividaranam ||

verses.sa:
विमोहयसि मामीश!मर्त्त्योऽहमिति किं वदन् ।
जानीमस्त्वां भगवतो न तु सूक्ष्मविदो वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
vimohayasi mamisha!marttyo'hamiti kim vadan |
janimastvam bhagavato na tu sukshmavido vayam ||

verses.sa:
योऽसि सोऽसि जगत्त्रण!प्रवृत्तौ नाथ!संस्थितः ।
जगतः शल्यनिष्कर्षं करोष्यसुरसूदन ॥
verses.rom:
yo'si so'si jagattrana!pravrittau natha!samsthitah |
jagatah shalyanishkarsham karoshyasurasudana ||

verses.sa:
नीयतां पारिजातोऽयं कृष्ण!द्रारवतीं पुरीम् ।
मर्त्त्यलोके त्वया त्यक्ते नायं संस्थास्यते भुवि ॥
verses.rom:
niyatam parijato'yam krishna!draravatim purim |
marttyaloke tvaya tyakte nayam samsthasyate bhuvi ||

verses.sa:
तथेत्युक्त्वा च देवेन्द्रमाजगाम भुवं हरिः ।
प्रसक्तैः सिद्ध-गन्धर्व्वैः स्तूयमानस्तथषिंभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tathetyuktva cha devendramajagama bhuvam harih |
prasaktaih siddha-gandharvvaih stuyamanastathashimbhih ||

verses.sa:
ततः शङ्खमुपाध्माय द्रारकोपरि संस्थितः ।
हर्षमुत्पादयामास द्रारकावासिनां द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
tatah shankhamupadhmaya drarakopari samsthitah |
harshamutpadayamasa drarakavasinam drija ||

verses.sa:
अवतीर्य्यथ गरुड़ात् सत्यभामासहायवान् ।
निष्कुटे स्थापयामास पारिजातं महातरुम ॥
verses.rom:
avatiryyatha garurat satyabhamasahayavan |
nishkute sthapayamasa parijatam mahataruma ||

verses.sa:
यमभ्येत्य जनः सर्व्वो जातिं स्मरति पौर्व्विकीम् ।
वास्यते सादराः सर्व्वे देहबन्धानमानुषान् ।
ददृशुः पादपे तस्मिन् कुर्व्वन्तो सुखदर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamabhyetya janah sarvvo jatim smarati paurvvikim |
vasyate sadarah sarvve dehabandhanamanushan |
dadrishuh padape tasmin kurvvanto sukhadarshanam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते सादराः सर्व्वे देहबन्धानमानुषान् ।
ददृशुः पादपे तस्मिन् कुर्व्वन्तो मुखदर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tataste sadarah sarvve dehabandhanamanushan |
dadrishuh padape tasmin kurvvanto mukhadarshanam ||

verses.sa:
किङ्करैः समुपानीतं हस्त्यश्वादि ततो धनम ।
स्त्रियश्व कृष्णो जग्राह नरकस्य परिग्रहान् ॥
verses.rom:
kinkaraih samupanitam hastyashvadi tato dhanama |
striyashva krishno jagraha narakasya parigrahan ||

verses.sa:
ततः काले शुभे प्राप्त उपयेमे जनार्द्दनः ।
ताः कन्या नरकेणासन् सर्व्वतो याः समाह्टताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kale shubhe prapta upayeme janarddanah |
tah kanya narakenasan sarvvato yah samahtatah ||

verses.sa:
एकस्मिन्नेव गोविन्दः काले तासां महामते!
जग्राह विधिवत् पाणीन् पृथगूगेहेषु धर्म्मतः ॥
verses.rom:
ekasminneva govindah kale tasam mahamate!
jagraha vidhivat panin prithagugeheshu dharmmatah ||

verses.sa:
षोड़शस्त्रीसहस्त्राणि शतमेकं तथाधिकम् ।
तावन्ति चक्र रूपाणि भगवान् मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
shorashastrisahastrani shatamekam tathadhikam |
tavanti chakra rupani bhagavan madhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
एकैकश्येन ताः कन्या मेनिरे मधुसूदनम् ।
ममैव पाणिग्रहणं भगवान् कृतवानिति ॥
verses.rom:
ekaikashyena tah kanya menire madhusudanam |
mamaiva panigrahanam bhagavan kritavaniti ||

verses.sa:
निशासु च जगतस्त्रष्टा तासां गुहेषु केशवः ।
उवास विप्र! सर्व्वासां विश्वरूपधरो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
nishasu cha jagatastrashta tasam guheshu keshavah |
uvasa vipra! sarvvasam vishvarupadharo harih ||

prose.en:
Thus chanted by the king of the celestials, Kesava smiled and replied gravely saying:—"Thou art, O Indra, the king of the celestials: we are mere mortals, O king of the universe. Thou must therefore forgive me, for the offence I have committed. Let this Pārijatā tree be taken to its proper place. I remove it to satisfy Satya's desire. Take back also this thy thunderbolt which thou didst hurl at me; for this is your proper weapon—O slayer of thy enemies". Whereto Indra replied, saying:—"O lord, thou dost beguile us in calling thyself mortal. We are endowed with subtlety of discernment and therefore know thee as gifted with six qualities. Whoever thou mayst be, O slayer of thine enemies, thou art engaged in the active preservation of earth and thou removest the thorns implanted in her bosom. O Krishna, do thou take this Pārijatā tree to the city of Dwārakā and when thou shalt renounce this land of mortals it shall no longer remain on earth".

Parāçara said:—Having agreed to the proposal of the king of the celestials Hari returned to earth eulogised by attendant sages, saints and quiristers of heaven.

When Krishna arrived over the city of Dwārakā he blew his conch and delighted the inhabitants with the sound. Thereupon alighting from Garuda he proceeded with Satyabhāmā to her garden, and there planted the great Pārijāta tree the smell of which extended over the earth for three furlongs and an approach to which enabled every one to recollect the events of a pristine existence. And beholding their faces in that tree the Yadavas know themselves in their (original) celestial forms. Then Krishna took possession of wealth, elephants, horses and men which he had recovered from Naraka and which had brought to Dwārakā by the servants of the demon; and at an auspicious hour he married all the maidens whom Naraka had carried off from their friends; and simultaneously at the same time in different mansions he received the hands the damsels. The number of the maidens was sixteen thousand and one hundred and in so many forms did the slayer of Madhu appear, so that every one of them thought that he had wedded her in his single person. Hari the creator of the world and the assumer of the universal shape lived severally in the mansion of each of these his wives.

verses.sa:
पराशार उवाच ।
प्रद्यु म्राद्या हरेः पुत्रा रुक्मिण्याः कथितास्तव ।
भानुं भैमरिकञ्चैव सत्यभामा व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
pradyu mradya hareh putra rukminyah kathitastava |
bhanum bhaimarikanchaiva satyabhama vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
दीप्तिमान् ताम्रपक्षाद्या रोहिणयां तनया हरेः ।
बभूवुर्जाम्बवत्याञ्च शाम्बाद्या बलशालिनः ॥
verses.rom:
diptiman tamrapakshadya rohinayam tanaya hareh |
babhuvurjambavatyancha shambadya balashalinah ||

verses.sa:
तनया भद्रविन्दाद्या नाग्रजित्यां महाबलाः ।
संग्रामजित्प्रधानास्तु शैव्यायान्त्वभवन् सुताः ॥
verses.rom:
tanaya bhadravindadya nagrajityam mahabalah |
samgramajitpradhanastu shaivyayantvabhavan sutah ||

verses.sa:
वृकाद्याश्व सुता माद्रयां गात्रवत्प्रमुखान् सुतान् ।
अवाप लक्ष्मणा पुत्राः कालिन्द्याञ्च श्रुतादयः ॥
verses.rom:
vrikadyashva suta madrayam gatravatpramukhan sutan |
avapa lakshmana putrah kalindyancha shrutadayah ||

verses.sa:
अन्यासाञ्चैव भार्य्याणां समुतूपन्नानि चक्रिणः ।
अष्टायुतानि पुत्राणां सहस्त्रणां शतं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
anyasanchaiva bharyyanam samutupannani chakrinah |
ashtayutani putranam sahastranam shatam tatha ||

verses.sa:
प्रद्यु म्रः प्रथमस्तेषा सर्व्वेषां रुक्मिणीसुतः ।
प्रद्यु म्रादनिरुद्धोऽभूदू वजूस्तस्मादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
pradyu mrah prathamastesha sarvvesham rukminisutah |
pradyu mradaniruddho'bhudu vajustasmadajayata ||

verses.sa:
अनिरुद्धो रणो रुद्धो बलेः पौत्रीं महाबलः ।
वाणास्य तनयामूषामुपयेमे द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
aniruddho rano ruddho baleh pautrim mahabalah |
vanasya tanayamushamupayeme drijottama ||

verses.sa:
यत्र युद्धमभूदू घोरं हरि-शङ्करयोर्महत् ।
