छिन्न सहस्त्र बाहूनां यत्र वाणस्य चक्रिणा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra yuddhamabhudu ghoram hari-shankarayormahat |
chhinna sahastra bahunam yatra vanasya chakrina ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
कथं युद्धमभूदू ब्रह्मन्नुषार्थे हर-कृष्णयोः ।
कथं क्षयञ्च वाणस्य बाहूनां कृतवान् हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
katham yuddhamabhudu brahmannusharthe hara-krishnayoh |
katham kshayancha vanasya bahunam kritavan harih ||

verses.sa:
एतत् सर्व्व महाभाग! समाख्यातु त्वमर्हसि ।
महत् कौतूहलं जातं कथां श्रोतुमिमां हरेः ॥
verses.rom:
etat sarvva mahabhaga! samakhyatu tvamarhasi |
mahat kautuhalam jatam katham shrotumimam hareh ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
ऊषा वाणसुता विप्र! पार्व्वतीं सह शम्भुना ।
क्रीड़न्तीमुपलक्ष्योच्चैः स्पृहाञ्चक्र तदाश्रयाम् ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
usha vanasuta vipra! parvvatim saha shambhuna |
krirantimupalakshyochchaih sprihanchakra tadashrayam ||

verses.sa:
ततः सकलाचित्तज्ञा गौरी तामाह भामिनीम् ।
अलमत्यर्थतापेन भर्त्रा त्वमपि रंस्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sakalachittajna gauri tamaha bhaminim |
alamatyarthatapena bhartra tvamapi ramsyase ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्ते सा तदा चक्र कदेति मतिमात्मनः ।
को वा भर्त्ता ममेत्येतां पुनरप्याह पार्व्वती ॥
verses.rom:
ityukte sa tada chakra kadeti matimatmanah |
ko va bhartta mametyetam punarapyaha parvvati ||

verses.sa:
वैशाखशुक्लद्रादश्यां स्वप्ने योऽभिभवं तव ।
करिष्यति स ते भर्त्ता राजपुत्रि!भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vaishakhashukladradashyam svapne yo'bhibhavam tava |
karishyati sa te bhartta rajaputri!bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
तस्यां तिथौ पुमान् खप्ने यथा देव्या उदीरितम् ।
तथैवाभिभवं चक्र रागञ्चक्र तथैव सा ॥
verses.rom:
tasyam tithau puman khapne yatha devya udiritam |
tathaivabhibhavam chakra raganchakra tathaiva sa ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रबुद्धा पुरुषमपश्यन्ती तमुत्सुका ।
क्व गतोऽसीति निर्लज्जा मैत्रेयोक्तवती सखीम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabuddha purushamapashyanti tamutsuka |
kva gato'siti nirlajja maitreyoktavati sakhim ||

verses.sa:
वाणस्य मन्त्री कुम्भाणडश्वित्रलेशा तु तत्सुता ।
तस्याः सख्यभवत् सा च प्राह कोऽय त्वयोच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
vanasya mantri kumbhanadashvitralesha tu tatsuta |
tasyah sakhyabhavat sa cha praha ko'ya tvayochyate ||

verses.sa:
यदा लज्जाकुला नास्यै कथयामास सा सती ।
तदा विश्वासमानीय सर्व्वमेवाभ्यवादयत् ॥
verses.rom:
yada lajjakula nasyai kathayamasa sa sati |
tada vishvasamaniya sarvvamevabhyavadayat ||

verses.sa:
विदितार्थान्तु तामाह पुनरूषा यथोदितम् ।
देव्या तथैव तत्प्राप्तौ योऽभ्युपायः कुरुष्व तम् ॥
verses.rom:
viditarthantu tamaha punarusha yathoditam |
devya tathaiva tatpraptau yo'bhyupayah kurushva tam ||

verses.sa:
ततः पटे सुरान् दैत्यान् गन्धर्व्वांश्व प्रधानतः ।
मनुष्यांश्वाबिलिख्यास्यै चित्रलेखा व्यदर्शयत् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah pate suran daityan gandharvvamshva pradhanatah |
manushyamshvabilikhyasyai chitralekha vyadarshayat ||

verses.sa:
अपास्य सा तु गन्धर्व्वांस्तथोरगसुरासुरान् ।
मनुष्येषु ददौ दृष्टिं तेष्वप्यन्धकवृष्णिषु ॥
verses.rom:
apasya sa tu gandharvvamstathoragasurasuran |
manushyeshu dadau drishtim teshvapyandhakavrishnishu ||

verses.sa:
कृष्ण-रामौ विलोक्यासौ सुभ्रु र्लज्जाजड़ेव सा ।
प्रद्यु म्रदर्शाने व्रीड़ा-दृष्टिं निन्येऽन्यतो द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
krishna-ramau vilokyasau subhru rlajjajareva sa |
pradyu mradarshane vrira-drishtim ninye'nyato drija ||

verses.sa:
दृष्टमात्रे ततः कान्ते प्रद्यु म्रतनये द्रिज ।
दृष्ट्यात्यर्थविकाशिन्या लज्जा क्कापि निराकृता ॥
verses.rom:
drishtamatre tatah kante pradyu mratanaye drija |
drishtyatyarthavikashinya lajja kkapi nirakrita ||

verses.sa:
सोऽयं सोऽयमितीत्युक्त तया सा योगगामिनी ।
ययौ द्रारवतीमूषां समाश्वास्य ततः सखीम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'yam so'yamitityukta taya sa yogagamini |
yayau draravatimusham samashvasya tatah sakhim ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—I have enumerated to you Pradyumna and other sons begotten on Rukmini by Krishna. Satyabhāmā bore Bhanu and Bhairika. The sons of Rohini were Diptimat, Tamrepakshi and others; Jamvabati gave birth to the powerful Samba and other sons. Bhadravinda and other valiant youths were the sons of Nagnajiti. Saivya bore several sons of whom Sangramajit was the chief. Vikra and others were begotten by Hari on Madri. Lakshmanā gave birth to Gatravat and others; and Sruta and others were the sons of Kālindi. Besides Krishna had sons by his other wives, in all one hundred and eighty thousand. The eldest of the whole was Pradyumna, the son of Rukmini; his son was Aniruddha, whose son was Vraja; his mother was Ushā, the daughter of Bāna the grand daughter of Bāli, whom Aniruddha won in war. On that occasion a dreadful onset endued between Hari and Sankara in which the thousand arms of Bāna were cut off by the discus of the former.

Maitreya said: How is it, O venerable Brahman, that a contest took place, on account of Ushā, between Siva and Krishna? And in what manner did Hari cut off the thousand arms of Bāna? I am stricken with curiosity to hear this story of Hari—do thou, O venerable Sir, relate this.

Parāçara said: Having seen Pārvati dallying with her lord Sambhu, Ushā, the daughter of Bāna, was inspired with a similar desire. The charming Gauri, knowing the hearts of all, said to her:—"Do not grieve; you shall have a husband". "But when will this be and who shall be my husband?" thought Ushā within herself, on which Pārvati said:—"He who shall appear to you, princess, in a dream, on the twelfth lunation of the light half of Vaishāk, shall be your lord". Accordingly, in consonance with the goddess' foretelling a youth appeared in dream to Ushā on that lunar day, of whom she became enamoured. When she got up and no longer saw him she was distressed with grief and not caring for modesty asked of her companion whither he had gone. This companion and friend of the princess was Chitralekha, the daughter of Kubandha, the minister of Bāna. She said to Ushā "of whom do you speak?" But ashamed she did not reply. However gaining her confidence Chitralekha heard from her everything. And again Ushā requested her who had been informed of all, to devise means by which she might be united with the person whom she had beheld in dream.

Parāçara said:—Thereupon Chitralekha painted the figures of the most eminent celestials, demons, spirits and mortals and showed them to Ushā. Putting aside the likenesses of celestials, spirits, snake-gods and demons, the princess selected those of mortals and amongst them the heroes of the races of Andhaka and Vrishni. And when she found the portraits she was bewildered by shame; then she took her eyes away with shame from the portrait of Pradyumna. But as soon as she saw the picture of his son, the object of her passions, she set aside all bashfulness and with wide expanded eyes, cried aloud, "This is he! this is he!" Her friend, who was gifted with magic power, requested her to be cheerful and started for Dwārakā through the air.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
बाणोपि प्रणिपत्याग्रे मैत्रेयाह त्रिलोचनम्
देव बाहुसहस्रेण निर्विण्णोस्म्याहवं विना ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
banopi pranipatyagre maitreyaha trilochanam
deva bahusahasrena nirvinnosmyahavam vina ||

verses.sa:
कच्चिन्ममैषां बाहूनां साफल्यजनको रणः
भविष्यति विना युद्धं भाराय मम किं भुजैः ॥
verses.rom:
kachchinmamaisham bahunam saphalyajanako ranah
bhavishyati vina yuddham bharaya mama kim bhujaih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीशंकर उवाच
मयूरध्वजभंगस्ते यदा बाण भविष्यति
पिशिताशिजनानंदं प्राप्स्यसे त्वं तदा रणम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrishamkara uvacha
mayuradhvajabhamgaste yada bana bhavishyati
pishitashijananamdam prapsyase tvam tada ranam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः प्रणम्य वरदं शंभुमभ्यागतो गृहम्
सभग्नं ध्वजमालोक्य हृष्टो हर्षं पुनर्ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah pranamya varadam shambhumabhyagato griham
sabhagnam dhvajamalokya hrishto harsham punaryayau ||

verses.sa:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु योगविद्याबलेन तम्
अनिरुद्धमथानिन्ये चित्रलेखा वराप्सराः ॥
verses.rom:
etasminneva kale tu yogavidyabalena tam
aniruddhamathaninye chitralekha varapsarah ||

verses.sa:
कन्यांतःपुरमभ्येत्य रममाणं सहोषया
विज्ञाय रक्षिणो गत्वा शशंसुर्दैत्यभूपतेः ॥
verses.rom:
kanyamtahpuramabhyetya ramamanam sahoshaya
vijnaya rakshino gatva shashamsurdaityabhupateh ||

verses.sa:
व्यादिष्टं किंकराणां तु सैन्यं तेन महात्मना
जघान परिघं घोरमादाय परवीरहा ॥
verses.rom:
vyadishtam kimkaranam tu sainyam tena mahatmana
jaghana parigham ghoramadaya paraviraha ||

verses.sa:
हतेषु तेषु बाणोपि रथस्थस्तद्वधोद्यतः
युध्यमानो यथाशक्ति यदुवीरेण निर्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
hateshu teshu banopi rathasthastadvadhodyatah
yudhyamano yathashakti yaduvirena nirjitah ||

verses.sa:
मायया युयुधे तेन स तदा मंत्रिचोदितः
ततस्तं पन्नगास्त्रेण बबंध यदुनंदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
mayaya yuyudhe tena sa tada mamtrichoditah
tatastam pannagastrena babamdha yadunamdanam ||

verses.sa:
द्वारवत्यां क्व यातोऽसावनिरुद्धेति जल्पताम्
यदूनामाचचक्षे तं बद्धं बाणेन नारदः ॥
verses.rom:
dvaravatyam kva yato'savaniruddheti jalpatam
yadunamachachakshe tam baddham banena naradah ||

verses.sa:
तं शोणितपुरं नीतं श्रुत्वा विद्याविदग्धया
योषिता प्रत्ययं जग्मुर्यादवा नामरैरिति ॥
verses.rom:
tam shonitapuram nitam shrutva vidyavidagdhaya
yoshita pratyayam jagmuryadava namarairiti ||

verses.sa:
ततो गरुडमारुह्य स्मृतमात्रागतं हरिः
बलप्रद्युम्नसहितो बाणस्य प्रययौ पुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato garudamaruhya smritamatragatam harih
balapradyumnasahito banasya prayayau puram ||

verses.sa:
पुरप्रवेशो! प्रमथैर्युद्धमासीन्महात्मनः
ययौ बाणपुराभ्याशं नीत्वा तान्संक्षयं हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
purapravesho! pramathairyuddhamasinmahatmanah
yayau banapurabhyasham nitva tansamkshayam harih ||

verses.sa:
ततस्त्रिपादस्त्रिशिरा ज्वरो माहेश्वरो महान्
बाणरक्षार्थमभ्येत्य युयुधे शार्ङ्गधन्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tatastripadastrishira jvaro maheshvaro mahan
banaraksharthamabhyetya yuyudhe sharngadhanvana ||

verses.sa:
तद्भस्मस्पर्शसंभूततापः कृष्णांगसंगमात्
अवाप बलदेवोपि श्रममामीलितेक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
tadbhasmasparshasambhutatapah krishnamgasamgamat
avapa baladevopi shramamamilitekshanah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्स युद्ध्यमानस्तु सह देवेन शार्ङ्गिणा
वैष्णवेन ज्वरेणाशु कृष्णदेहान्निराकृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatassa yuddhyamanastu saha devena sharngina
vaishnavena jvarenashu krishnadehannirakritah ||

verses.sa:
नारायणभुजाघातपरिपीडनविह्वलम्
तं वीक्ष्य क्षम्यतामस्येत्याह देवः पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
narayanabhujaghataparipidanavihvalam
tam vikshya kshamyatamasyetyaha devah pitamahah ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च क्षांतमेवेति प्रोक्त्वा तं वैष्णवं ज्वरम्
आत्मन्येव लयं निन्ये भगवान्मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha kshamtameveti proktva tam vaishnavam jvaram
atmanyeva layam ninye bhagavanmadhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
ज्वर उवाच
मम त्वाय समं युद्धं ये स्मरीष्यंति मानवाः
विज्वरास्ते भविष्यंती त्युक्त्वा चैनं ययौ ज्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
jvara uvacha
mama tvaya samam yuddham ye smarishyamti manavah
vijvaraste bhavishyamti tyuktva chainam yayau jvarah ||

verses.sa:
ततोग्नीन्भगवान्पंच जित्वा नीत्वा तथा क्षयम्
दानवानां बलं कृष्णश्चूर्णयामास लीलया ॥
verses.rom:
tatogninbhagavanpamcha jitva nitva tatha kshayam
danavanam balam krishnashchurnayamasa lilaya ||

verses.sa:
ततस्समस्तसैन्येन दैतेयानां बलेस्सुतः
युयुधे शंकरश्चैव कार्त्तिकेयश्च शौरिणा ॥
verses.rom:
tatassamastasainyena daiteyanam balessutah
yuyudhe shamkarashchaiva karttikeyashcha shaurina ||

verses.sa:
हरिशंकरयोर्युद्धमतीवासीत्सुदारुणम्
चुक्षुभुस्सकला लोकाश्शस्त्रास्त्रांशुप्रतापिताः ॥
verses.rom:
harishamkarayoryuddhamativasitsudarunam
chukshubhussakala lokashshastrastramshupratapitah ||

verses.sa:
प्रलयोयमशेषस्य जगतो नूनमागतः
मेनिरे त्रिदशास्तत्र वर्त्तमाने महारणे ॥
verses.rom:
pralayoyamasheshasya jagato nunamagatah
menire tridashastatra varttamane maharane ||

verses.sa:
जृंभ कास्त्रेण गोविंदो जृंभयामास शंकरम्
ततः प्रणेमुर्दैतेयाः प्रमथाश्च समंततः ॥
verses.rom:
jrimbha kastrena govimdo jrimbhayamasa shamkaram
tatah pranemurdaiteyah pramathashcha samamtatah ||

verses.sa:
जृंभाभिभूतस्यु हरो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्
न शशाक ततो योद्धुं कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
jrimbhabhibhutasyu haro rathopastha upavishat
na shashaka tato yoddhum krishnenaklishtakarmana ||

verses.sa:
गरुजक्षतवाहश्च प्रद्युम्नास्त्रेम पीडितः
कृष्णहुंकारनिर्धूतशक्तिश्चापययौ गुहः ॥
verses.rom:
garujakshatavahashcha pradyumnastrema piditah
krishnahumkaranirdhutashaktishchapayayau guhah ||

verses.sa:
जृंभिते शंकरे नष्टे दैत्यसैन्ये गुहे जिते
नीते प्रमथसैन्ये च संक्षयं शार्ङ्गधन्वना ॥
verses.rom:
jrimbhite shamkare nashte daityasainye guhe jite
nite pramathasainye cha samkshayam sharngadhanvana ||

verses.sa:
नंदिना संगृहीताश्वमधिरूढो महारथम्
बाणस्तत्राययौ योद्धुं कृष्णकार्ष्णिबलैस्सह ॥
verses.rom:
namdina samgrihitashvamadhirudho maharatham
banastatrayayau yoddhum krishnakarshnibalaissaha ||

verses.sa:
बलभद्रो महावीर्यो बाणसैन्यमनेकधा
विव्याध बाणैः प्रभ्रश्य धर्मतश्चापलायत ॥
verses.rom:
balabhadro mahaviryo banasainyamanekadha
vivyadha banaih prabhrashya dharmatashchapalayata ||

verses.sa:
आकृष्य लांगलाग्रेण मुसलेनाशु ताडितम्
बलं बलेन ददृशो! बाणो बाणैश्च चक्रिणा ॥
verses.rom:
akrishya lamgalagrena musalenashu taditam
balam balena dadrisho! bano banaishcha chakrina ||

verses.sa: ततः कृष्णेन बाणस्य युद्धमासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥
verses.rom: tatah krishnena banasya yuddhamasitsudarunam ||

verses.sa:
समस्यतोरिषून्दीप्तान्कायत्राणविभेदिनः
कृष्णश्चिच्छेद बाणैस्तान्बाणेन प्रहिताञ्छितान्
विव्याध केशवं बाणो बाणं विव्याध चक्रधृक् ॥
verses.rom:
samasyatorishundiptankayatranavibhedinah
krishnashchichchheda banaistanbanena prahitanchhitan
vivyadha keshavam bano banam vivyadha chakradhrik ||

verses.sa:
मुमुचाते तथास्त्राणि बाणकृष्णौ जिगीषया
परस्परक्षतिकरौ लाघवादनिशं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
mumuchate tathastrani banakrishnau jigishaya
parasparakshatikarau laghavadanisham dvija ||

verses.sa:
भिद्यमानेष्वश्षोए!षु शरेष्वस्त्रे च सीदति
प्राचुर्येण ततो बाणं हंतुं चक्रे हरिर्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
bhidyamaneshvashshoe!shu shareshvastre cha sidati
prachuryena tato banam hamtum chakre harirmanah ||

verses.sa:
ततोर्कशतसंघाततेजसा सदृशद्युति
जग्राह दैत्यचक्रारिर्हरिश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatorkashatasamghatatejasa sadrishadyuti
jagraha daityachakrarirharishchakram sudarshanam ||

verses.sa:
मुञ्चतो बाणनाशाय ततश्चक्रं मधुद्विषः
नग्ना दैतेयविद्याऽभूत्कोटरी पुरतो हरेः ॥
verses.rom:
munchato bananashaya tatashchakram madhudvishah
nagna daiteyavidya'bhutkotari purato hareh ||

verses.sa:
तामग्रतो हरिर्दृष्ट्वा मीलिताक्षस्सुदर्शनम्
मुमोच बाणमुद्दिश्य च्छेत्तुं बाहुवनं रिपोः ॥
verses.rom:
tamagrato harirdrishtva militakshassudarshanam
mumocha banamuddishya chchhettum bahuvanam ripoh ||

verses.sa:
क्रमेण तत्तु बाहूनां बाणस्याच्युतचोदितम्
छेदं चक्रेऽसुरापास्तशस्त्रौघक्षपणादृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
kramena tattu bahunam banasyachyutachoditam
chhedam chakre'surapastashastraughakshapanadritam ||

verses.sa:
छिन्ने बाहुवने तत्तु करस्थं मधुसूतनः
मुमुक्षुर्बाणनाशाय विज्ञातस्त्रिपुरद्विषा ॥
verses.rom:
chhinne bahuvane tattu karastham madhusutanah
mumukshurbananashaya vijnatastripuradvisha ||

verses.sa:
समुपेत्याह गोविंदं सामपूर्वमुमापतिः
विलोक्य बाणं दादडच्छेदासृक्स्राववर्षिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
samupetyaha govimdam samapurvamumapatih
vilokya banam dadadachchhedasriksravavarshinam ||

verses.sa:
शंकर उवाच
कृष्णकृष्ण जगन्नाथ जाने त्वां पुरुषोत्तमम्
परेशं परमात्मानमनादिनिधनं हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shamkara uvacha
krishnakrishna jagannatha jane tvam purushottamam
paresham paramatmanamanadinidhanam harim ||

verses.sa:
देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्येषु शरीरग्रहणात्मिका
लीलेयं सर्वभूतस्य तव चेष्टोपलक्षणा ॥
verses.rom:
devatiryanmanushyeshu shariragrahanatmika
lileyam sarvabhutasya tava cheshtopalakshana ||

verses.sa:
तत्प्रसीदाभयं दत्तं बाणस्यास्य मया प्रभो
तत्त्वाय नानृतं कार्यं यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tatprasidabhayam dattam banasyasya maya prabho
tattvaya nanritam karyam yanmaya vyahritam vachah ||

verses.sa:
अस्मत्संश्रयदृप्तोयं नापराधी तवाव्यय
मया दत्तवरो दैत्यस्ततस्त्वां क्षमयाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmatsamshrayadriptoyam naparadhi tavavyaya
maya dattavaro daityastatastvam kshamayamyaham ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्तः प्राह गोविंदश्शूलपाणिमुमापतिम्
प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा गतामर्षोऽसुरं प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktah praha govimdashshulapanimumapatim
prasannavadano bhutva gatamarsho'suram prati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
युष्मद्दत्तवरो बाणो जीवतामेष शंकर
त्वद्वाक्यगौरवादेतन्मया चक्रं निवर्त्तितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
yushmaddattavaro bano jivatamesha shamkara
tvadvakyagauravadetanmaya chakram nivarttitam ||

verses.sa:
त्वया यदभयं दत्तं तद्दत्तमखिलं मया
मत्तोऽविभिन्नमात्मानं द्र ष्टुमर्हसि शंकर ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya yadabhayam dattam taddattamakhilam maya
matto'vibhinnamatmanam dra shtumarhasi shamkara ||

verses.sa:
योहं स त्वं जगच्चेदं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
मत्तो नान्यदश्षॐ यत्तत्त्वं ज्ञातुमिहार्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
yoham sa tvam jagachchedam sadevasuramanusham
matto nanyadashshaom yattattvam jnatumiharhasi ||

verses.sa:
अविद्यामोहितात्मानः पुरुषा भिन्नदर्शिनः
वदंति भेदं पश्यंति चावयोरंतरं हर ॥
verses.rom:
avidyamohitatmanah purusha bhinnadarshinah
vadamti bhedam pashyamti chavayoramtaram hara ||

verses.sa: प्रसन्नोऽहं गमिष्यामि त्वं गच्छ वृषभध्वज ॥
verses.rom: prasanno'ham gamishyami tvam gachchha vrishabhadhvaja ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ कृष्णः प्राद्युम्निर्यत्र तिष्ठति
तद्बंधफणिनो नेशुर्गरुडानिलपोथिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityuktva prayayau krishnah pradyumniryatra tishthati
tadbamdhaphanino neshurgarudanilapothitah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽनिरुद्धमारोप्य सपत्नीकं गरुत्मति
आजग्मुर्द्वारकां रामकार्ष्णिदामोदराः पुरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'niruddhamaropya sapatnikam garutmati
ajagmurdvarakam ramakarshnidamodarah purim ||

verses.sa:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतस्तत्र रेमे जनार्दनः
देवीभिस्सततं विप्र भूभारतरणेच्छया ॥
verses.rom:
putrapautraih parivritastatra reme janardanah
devibhissatatam vipra bhubharataranechchhaya ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो! त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho! trayastrimsho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Before this, once Bāna prayed to the three-eyed deity saying "O lord I am humiliated by the possession of a thousand arms; let some conflict take place in which I may make use of my arms. Without any war what is the use of these arms; they are but a burden to me".

Sankara said:—"When this peacock banner shall be broken thou shalt have war, the delight of the evil spirits that live on human flesh". Thereupon pleased and bowing unto Sankara he returned to his house where he found the standard broken which increased his joy.

At that time the foremost of Apsaras, Chitralekha, came back from Dwārakā and by virtue of her magic powers brought Aniruddha with her. Finding him there with Ushā, the warders of the inner apartments reported it to the king, who immediately sent a number of his retinue to seize the prince. But taking up an iron club the powerful youth killed all his adversaries. Thereat Bāna ascended his chariot, proceeded against him and tried to kill him. Finding however that Aniruddha was not to be vanquished by power he followed the counsel of his minister and brought his magical faculties into the conflict, by which he succeeded in capturing the Yadu prince and binding him in serpent bonds.

When Aniruddha was found missing from Dwārāvati and the Yādavas were inquiring of one another whither he had gone, Nārada came and communicated unto them that he was a prisoner of Bāna having been taken by a female by virtue of her magical abilities to Sonitpura. When they heard that he had been taken to Sonitpura, by a damsel, conversant with magical powers, they did not place confidence in his words. Thereupon Krishna thought of Garuda who immediately arrived there. And mounting upon him along with Bala and Pradyumna he started for the city of Bāna. On their approach to the city they were opposed by the attendant spirits of Rudra; but they were soon slain by Hari and he and his companions entered the city. Thereupon mighty fever, an emanation of Maheshwara, having three feet and three heads, fought desperately with the holder of conch in defence of Bāna. Baladeva, upon whom his ashes were scattered, was seized with burning heat and his eye-lids trembled—but he obtained relief by clinging to the body of Krishna. Thereupon fighting with the holder of bow, the fever, emanating from Siva, was soon driven out from Krishna's person by the fever engendered by himself; Beholding the Saiva fever bewildered by the strokes of the arms of Krishna, Brahmā, the patriarch of the deities, entreated him to desist, upon which the slayer of Madhu refrained and absorbed into himself the fever he had created. The rival fever then went away saying to Krishna; "Those men who shall recollect the fight between us shall be freed from febrile disease".

Thereupon Vishnu overcame and destroyed the five fires and with perfect ease slew the Dānavas. Then the son of Bali, with the entire Daitya army, aided by Sankara and Kartikeya fought with Krishna. A dreadful battle ensued between Hari and Sankara. Scorched by their burning weapons, all the regions trembled and the celestials thought for certain that the end of the universe was at hand. With the weapon of Yawning Krishna set Sankara agape; then the attendant demons and demi-gods attendant upon Siva were slain on all sides, for Hara, overcome with incessant gaping, sat down in his car and was unable to fight with Krishna any longer, who is above the influence of any acts. The deity of war Kartikeya, wounded in the arm by Garuda, struck by the weapons of Pradyumna and disarmed by the shout of Hari, fled away. Beholding Sankara disabled, the demons slain, Guha fled and Siva's attendants destroyed, Bāna proceeded in his huge car, the steeds of which were harnessed by Nandisha, to fight with Hari and his associates Bala and Pradyumna. Attacking the army of Bāna, the valiant Balabhadra wounded them in diverse ways with his shafts and put them to a shameful confusion. And their king saw them dragged about by Rāma with his ploughshare or beaten by him with his mace and pierced by Krishna with his shafts; he therefore attacked Krishna and a fight took place between them; they hurled at each other burning arrows that pierced through their armour; but Krishna intercepted with his arrows those of Bāna and sundered them into pieces. Bāna however wounded Kesava and the wielder of the discus wounded Bāna; and both of them, desirous of victory and endeavouring angrily to bring about the death of his antagonist, hurled diverse missiles at each other. When a number of weapons had been sundered into pieces and the weapons began to be exhausted, Krishna determined to slay Bāna. Thereupon the destroyer of the demons took up his discus Sudarshana shining with the radiance of a hundred suns. As he was about to meet it the mystical goddess of Kotair, the magic lore of the demons, stood naked before him. Beholding her before him, Krishna, with open eyes, cast Sudarshana to cut off the arms of Bāna. The discus lopped off successively the numberless arms of Bāna which proved useless the missiles discharged by the celestials. When the slayer of Madhu again took in his hand the discus, after ten thousand arms had been sundered, for the total destruction of Bāna the destroyer of Tripura came to know it. Beholding blood gushing out from the dissevered arms of Bāna the husband of Umā approached Govinda and requested him to put off his hostilities, said:—"O Krishna, the lord of the universe, I know thee, the excellent Purusha, the supreme lord, the infinite felicity without beginning or end and beyond all things. This sport of universal being in which thou assumest the person of god, animals and men is a subordinate attribute of thy energy. Be propitious, therefore O lord, unto me. I have given Bāna assurance of safety, do not thou falsify my words. O thou eternal, this Bāna has grown old under my protection, let him not incur thy displeasure. I conferred a boon on this Daitya and therefore I am begging thy forgiveness".

Being thus addressed, Govinda, dismissing his resentment against the Asura, smilingly said to Umā's lord, the holder of trident "O Sankara, let this Bāna, the king of demons draw his breath since thou hast conferred a boon upon him; to honour thy words, I withhold my discus; the assurance of safety given by thee, is also given by me. Do not consider me as distinct from thee. The celestials, Asuras and men and the whole universe are not distinct from us. Those who have been possessed by ignorance consider me as separate from thee".

Having said this Krishna went to where Aniruddha was; and the snakes that bound him were destroyed by the breath of Govinda. And placing him along with his wife upon the celestial bird, Krishna with Pradyumna and Rāma returned to Dwārakā.

verses.sa:
चक्र कर्म्म महच्छौरिर्बिब्राणो मानुषीं तनुम् ।
जिगाय शक्र सर्व्वञ्च सर्व्वदेवांश्व लीलया ॥
verses.rom:
chakra karmma mahachchhaurirbibrano manushim tanum |
jigaya shakra sarvvancha sarvvadevamshva lilaya ||

verses.sa:
यज्वान्यदकरोत् कर्म्म दिव्यचेष्टाविघातकृत् ।
तत् कथ्यतां महाभाग!परं कातूहलं हि मे ॥
verses.rom:
yajvanyadakarot karmma divyacheshtavighatakrit |
tat kathyatam mahabhaga!param katuhalam hi me ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
गदतो मम विप्रर्षे!श्रूयतामिदमादरात् ।
नरावतारे कृष्णेन दग्धा वाराणसी यथा ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
gadato mama viprarshe!shruyatamidamadarat |
naravatare krishnena dagdha varanasi yatha ||

verses.sa:
पौण्डुको वासुदेवस्तु वासुदेवीऽभवद् भिवि ।
अवतीर्णस्त्वमित्युक्तो जनैरज्ञानमोहितैः ॥
verses.rom:
paunduko vasudevastu vasudevi'bhavad bhivi |
avatirnastvamityukto janairajnanamohitaih ||

verses.sa:
स-मेने वासुदेवोऽहमवतीर्णो महीतले ।
नष्टस्मृतिस्ततः सर्व्व विष्णचिह्निमचीकरत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa-mene vasudevo'hamavatirno mahitale |
nashtasmritistatah sarvva vishnachihnimachikarat ||

verses.sa:
दूतञ्च प्रेरयामास कृष्णाय सुमहात्मने ।
त्यत्तवा चक्रादिकं चिह्न मदीयं नाम चात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
dutancha prerayamasa krishnaya sumahatmane |
tyattava chakradikam chihna madiyam nama chatmanah ||

verses.sa:
वासुदेवात्मकं मूढ़!मुत्तवा सर्व्वं विशेषतः ।
आत्मनो जीवितार्थाय ततो मे प्रणति व्रज ॥
verses.rom:
vasudevatmakam murha!muttava sarvvam visheshatah |
atmano jivitarthaya tato me pranati vraja ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तः सम्प्रहस्यैन दूतं प्राह जनार्द्दनः ।
निजचिह्नमहं चक्र समुत्स्मरक्ष्य त्वयीति वै ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah samprahasyaina dutam praha janarddanah |
nijachihnamaham chakra samutsmarakshya tvayiti vai ||

verses.sa:
वाच्यः स पौण्ड्रको गत्वा त्वया दूत!वचो मम ।
ज्ञातस्त्वद्राक्यसद्भावो यत् कार्य्यं तद्रिधीयताभ् ॥
verses.rom:
vachyah sa paundrako gatva tvaya duta!vacho mama |
jnatastvadrakyasadbhavo yat karyyam tadridhiyatabh ||

verses.sa:
गृहीतचिह्न एवाहमागमिष्यामि ते पुरम् ।
समुत्स्त्रक्ष्यामि ते चक्र निजनिह्नमसंशयम् ॥
verses.rom:
grihitachihna evahamagamishyami te puram |
samutstrakshyami te chakra nijanihnamasamshayam ||

verses.sa:
आज्ञापूर्व्वञ्च यदिदमागच्छेति त्वयोदितम् ।
सम्पादयिष्ये श्वस्तुभ्यं तदप्येषोऽविलम्बितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajnapurvvancha yadidamagachchheti tvayoditam |
sampadayishye shvastubhyam tadapyesho'vilambitam ||

verses.sa:
शरणां ते समब्येत्य कर्त्तास्मि नृपते!तदा ।
यथा त्वत्त्वो भयं बूयो न मे किञ्चिद्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sharanam te samabyetya karttasmi nripate!tada |
yatha tvattvo bhayam buyo na me kinchidbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तेऽपगते दूते संस्मृत्याभ्यागतं हरिः ।
गरुत्मन्तमथारुह्य त्वरितं तत्पुरं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
ityukte'pagate dute samsmrityabhyagatam harih |
garutmantamatharuhya tvaritam tatpuram yayau ||

verses.sa:
स चापि केशवोद्योगं श्रुत्वा काशिपतिस्तदा ।
सर्व्वसैन्यपरीवारः पार्ष्णिग्राह उपाययौ ॥
verses.rom:
sa chapi keshavodyogam shrutva kashipatistada |
sarvvasainyaparivarah parshnigraha upayayau ||

verses.sa:
ततो बलेन महता काशिराजबलेन च ।
पौण्ड्रको वासुदेवोऽसौ केशवाभिमुखं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
tato balena mahata kashirajabalena cha |
paundrako vasudevo'sau keshavabhimukham yayau ||

verses.sa:
तं ददर्श हरिर्द्दूरादुदारस्यन्दने स्थितम् ।
चक्रहस्तं गदाखड़ गबाहु पाणिगताम्बुजम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam dadarsha harirdduradudarasyandane sthitam |
chakrahastam gadakhara gabahu panigatambujam ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रग्धरं धृतशाङ्गञ्च सुपर्णारचितध्वजम् ।
वक्षःस्थले कृतञ्चास्य श्रीवत्सं ददृशे हिरः ॥
verses.rom:
stragdharam dhritashangancha suparnarachitadhvajam |
vakshahsthale kritanchasya shrivatsam dadrishe hirah ||

verses.sa:
किरीटकूणडलधरं पीतवासःसमन्वितम् ।
दृष्ट्वा तं भावगम्भरं जहास गरुडध्वजः ॥
verses.rom:
kiritakunadaladharam pitavasahsamanvitam |
drishtva tam bhavagambharam jahasa garudadhvajah ||

verses.sa:
युयुध च बलेनास्य हस्त्यश्वबहलिना द्रिज !
निस्त्रिंशर्ष्टिगदाशूलशक्तिकार्म्मुकशालिना ॥
verses.rom:
yuyudha cha balenasya hastyashvabahalina drija !
nistrimsharshtigadashulashaktikarmmukashalina ||

verses.sa:
क्षणेन शार्ह्गनिर्म्मुक्तैः शरैरिषुविदारणैः ।
गदाचक्रनिपातैश्व सूदयामास तदूबलम् ॥
verses.rom:
kshanena sharhganirmmuktaih sharairishuvidaranaih |
gadachakranipataishva sudayamasa tadubalam ||

verses.sa:
काशिराजबलञ्चैव क्षर्यं नित्वा जनार्द्दनः ।
उवाच पौण्ड्रकं मूद़मात्मचिह्नोपलक्ष्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
kashirajabalanchaiva ksharyam nitva janarddanah |
uvacha paundrakam mudamatmachihnopalakshnam ||

verses.sa:
पौण्ड्रकोक्तं त्वया यत्तु दूतवक्तूणे मां प्रति ।
समुतूसृजेति चिह्नानि तत्ते सम्पादयाम्यहम ॥
verses.rom:
paundrakoktam tvaya yattu dutavaktune mam prati |
samutusrijeti chihnani tatte sampadayamyahama ||

verses.sa:
चक्रमेतत् समुत्सृष्टं गदेयं ते विसर्जिता ।
गरुत्मानेष निर्द्दिष्टः समारोहतु ते ध्वजम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakrametat samutsrishtam gadeyam te visarjita |
garutmanesha nirddishtah samarohatu te dhvajam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युज्वार्य्य विमुक्तेन चक्रणोसौ विदारितः ।
पोथितो गदया भग्रो गरुत्माश्व गरुत्मता ॥
verses.rom:
ityujvaryya vimuktena chakranosau vidaritah |
pothito gadaya bhagro garutmashva garutmata ||

verses.sa:
ततो हाहाकृते लोके काशिपुर्य्यधिपो बली ।
युयुधे वासुदेवेन मित्रस्यापचितौ स्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
tato hahakrite loke kashipuryyadhipo bali |
yuyudhe vasudevena mitrasyapachitau sthitah ||

verses.sa:
ततः शार्ङ्गधनुर्मुक्तैश्छित्त्वा तस्य शरैः शिरः ।
काशिपुर्य्याञ्च चिक्षेप कुर्व्वन् सोकस्य विस्मयम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sharngadhanurmuktaishchhittva tasya sharaih shirah |
kashipuryyancha chikshepa kurvvan sokasya vismayam ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा च पौणड्रकं शौरिः काखिराजञ्च सानुगम् ।
पुनर्द्रारवतीं प्राप्तो रेमे स्वर्गगतो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
hatva cha paunadrakam shaurih kakhirajancha sanugam |
punardraravatim prapto reme svargagato yatha ||

verses.sa:
तच्छिरः पतितं दृष्ट्वा तत्र काशिपतेः पुरे ।
जनः किमेतदित्याह केनत्यत्यन्तविस्मितः ॥
verses.rom:
tachchhirah patitam drishtva tatra kashipateh pure |
janah kimetadityaha kenatyatyantavismitah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञात्वा तं वासुदेवेन हतं तस्य सुतस्ततः ।
पुरोहितेन सहितस्तो।यामास शङ्करम् ॥
verses.rom:
jnatva tam vasudevena hatam tasya sutastatah |
purohitena sahitasto|yamasa shankaram ||

verses.sa:
अविमुक्ते महाक्षेत्रे तोषितस्तन शङ्करः ।
वरं वृणीष्वेति तदा तं प्रोवाच नृपात्मजम् ॥
verses.rom:
avimukte mahakshetre toshitastana shankarah |
varam vrinishveti tada tam provacha nripatmajam ||

verses.sa:
स वब्र भगवान् कृत्या पितृहन्तुर्वधाय मे ।
समुत्तिष्ठतु कृष्णस्य त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
sa vabra bhagavan kritya pitrihanturvadhaya me |
samuttishthatu krishnasya tvatprasadanmaheshvara ||

verses.sa:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्ते दक्षिणाग्नेरनन्तरम् ।
महाकृत्या समुत्तस्थौ तस्यैवाग्नेर्विन्मशिनी ॥
verses.rom:
evam bhavishyatityukte dakshinagneranantaram |
mahakritya samuttasthau tasyaivagnervinmashini ||

verses.sa:
ततो ज्वालाकरालास्या ज्वलत्केशकलापिका ।
कृष्ण कृष्णेति कुपिता कृत्या द्रारवतीं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
tato jvalakaralasya jvalatkeshakalapika |
krishna krishneti kupita kritya draravatim yayau ||

verses.sa:
तामवेक्ष्य जनस्त्रासविचल्लोचनो मुने!
ययौ शरण्यं जगतां शरणं मधुसूदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamavekshya janastrasavichallochano mune!
yayau sharanyam jagatam sharanam madhusudanam ||

verses.sa:
काशिराजसुतेनेयमाराध्य वृषभध्वजम् ।
उत्पादिता महाकृत्येत्यवगम्याथ चक्रिणा ॥
verses.rom:
kashirajasuteneyamaradhya vrishabhadhvajam |
utpadita mahakrityetyavagamyatha chakrina ||

verses.sa:
जहि कृत्यामिमामुग्रां वह्निज्वालाजटालकाम् ।
चक्रमुत्सृष्टमक्षेषु क्रीड़ासक्तेन लीलया ॥
verses.rom:
jahi krityamimamugram vahnijvalajatalakam |
chakramutsrishtamaksheshu krirasaktena lilaya ||

verses.sa:
तदग्रिमालाजटिलज्वालोदूगारातिभीषणाम् ।
कृत्यामनुजगामाशु विष्णुचक्र सुदर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadagrimalajatilajvalodugaratibhishanam |
krityamanujagamashu vishnuchakra sudarshanam ||

verses.sa:
चक्रगतापविध्वस्ता कृत्या माहेश्वरी तदा ।
ननाश वेगिनी वेगात् तदप्यनुजगाम ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakragatapavidhvasta kritya maheshvari tada |
nanasha vegini vegat tadapyanujagama tam ||

verses.sa:
कृत्.या वाराणसीमेव प्रविवेश त्वरान्विता ।
विष्णचक्रप्रतिहतप्रभावा मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
krit.ya varanasimeva pravivesha tvaranvita |
vishnachakrapratihataprabhava munisattama ||

verses.sa:
ततः काशिबलं भूरि प्मथानां तथा बलम् ।
समस्तशस्त्रस्त्रयुतं चक्रस्याभिमुखं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kashibalam bhuri pmathanam tatha balam |
samastashastrastrayutam chakrasyabhimukham yayau ||

verses.sa:
शस्त्रस्त्रमोक्षचतुरं दग्ध्वा तदूबलमोजसा ।
कृत्यागर्भामशेषां तां दग्ध्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
shastrastramokshachaturam dagdhva tadubalamojasa |
krityagarbhamashesham tam dagdhva varanasim purim ||

verses.sa:
सभूभृदूभृत्यपौरान्तु साश्वमातङ्गमानवाम् ।
अशेषकोषकोष्ठां तां दुनिंरीक्ष्यां सुरैरपि ॥
verses.rom:
sabhubhridubhrityapaurantu sashvamatangamanavam |
asheshakoshakoshtham tam dunimrikshyam surairapi ||

verses.sa:
ज्वालापरिप्लुताशेष-गृहृ-प्राकारचत्वराम् ।
ददाह तद्धरेश्वक्रं सकलामेव तां पुरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
jvalapariplutashesha-grihri-prakarachatvaram |
dadaha taddhareshvakram sakalameva tam purim ||

verses.sa:
अक्षीणामर्षमत्युग्रसाध्यसाधनसस्पृहम् ।
तज्वक्र प्रस्फुरद्दीप्ति विष्णोरभ्याययौ करम् ॥
verses.rom:
akshinamarshamatyugrasadhyasadhanasaspriham |
tajvakra prasphuraddipti vishnorabhyayayau karam ||

prose.en:
Maiteya said:—"Having achieved a mortal form Sauri performed mighty achievements and discomfitted Sakra and Siva and all other attendant divinities. O great sir, do thou also describe unto me, his other exploits by which he humiliated the prowess of the celestials; I am desirous to hear them".

Parāçara said:—Hear with respectful attention, O Brāhman, as described by me of the burning of Vārānashi by Krishna in the course of his relieving the burden of the earth.

There was a king of Pundra, who was known as Vasudeva and flattered by the ignorant people as the descended deity until he thought himself to be the Vāsudeva who had come down upon earth. Forgetting his real character he assumed the emblems of Vishnu and sent an ambassador to the high-minded Krishna with this message. "Give up thy discus, O foolish man, lay aside all my insignia, my name and the character of Vāsudeva and come and do me homage and I shall grant thee, the means of subsistence". Hearing those words and laughing, Janārddana said to the messenger "Go back, messenger to Paundraka and tell him in my name 'I shall hand over my emblem, the discus to him. Thou wilt properly understand my meaning and consider what is to be done; for I shall come to thy city bringing the discus with me and shall surely give it over to thee. If thou dost command me to come I immediately obey and be with thee tomorrow and shall not delay, and having sought thy protection I shall so manage, O king, that I shall not have to fear anything from thee.'" So saying he sent away the messenger to communicate these words unto the sovereign, and summoning Garuda mounted him and started for the city of Paundrāka.

When the king of Kāsi heard of the preparations of Kesava he sent his army to help Paundrāka, himself bringing up the rear, and with the army of the king of Kāsi and his own troops, the false Vasudeva marched to meet Krishna. He beheld him at a distance standing in his car holding a disc, a club, a mace, a scimitar and a lotus in his hands adorned with a garland of flowers, and bearing a bow; and having his standard made of gold, he had also the mystical mark Sribatsa on his breast; he was robed in yellow raiment and embellished with ear rings, and a tiara. When the god, whose emblem is Garuda, saw him, he laughed aloud and engaged in encounter with the hostile army of cavalry and elephants fighting with swords, scimitars, maces, tridents spears and bows. Showering upon the enemy the arrows from his Sāranga bow and hurling at them his mace and discus he soon destroyed both the army of Paundrāka and that of the king of Kāsi. He then addressed the former who was foolishly wearing his emblems saying:—"Paundrāka, you wanted me through your messenger, to resign to you all my insignia, I now deliver them to you. Here is my discus; here is my mace; and here is Garuda, let him mount upon thy banner". Saying this he discharged the discus and mace by which Paundrāka was sundered to pieces and cast on the ground; whilst the Garuda which was on the banner of Paundrāka was destroyed by the Garuda of Vishnu. Beholding this the people cried "Alas! alas"; but the brave king still siding the imposture of his friend carried on the encounter till Sauri cut off his head with his arrows and shot into the city of Kāsi to the surprise of all the inhabitants. Having thus destroyed Paundrāka and the king of Kāsi with all their retinue Sauri came back to Dwārakā where he resided enjoying heavenly delights.

When the inhabitants of Kāsi beheld the head of their king shot into the city they were much surprised and wondered how it could have been accomplished. Having come to know that the king had been slain by Krishna, the king's son together with the priest of the family propitiated Sankara. Well pleased on account of being worshipped in the sacred place Avimuktā the deity asked the prince to pray for a boon, on which he said:—"O lord, mighty god, through thy favour, let thy mystic spirit slay Krishna, the murderer of my father!"

"It shall be so" answered Sankara and from out of the southern fire up sprang a vast and formidable female like flame out of fire, blazing with ruddy light and fiery radiance streaming amidst her hair. Worked up with ire she called upon Krishna and departed to Dwārakā. There the people seeing her were struck with terror and fled for protection to the slayer of Madhu the refuge all worlds. Understanding that the fiend had been created by the son of the king of Kāsi through his worship of the deity whose emblem is the bull, the wielder of the discus being engaged in sport and playing at dice said to the discus "Kill this dreadful creature whose tresses are of plaited flame". Accordingly Sudarshana, the discus of Vishnu, attacked the fiend in no time, dreadfully covered with fire and wearing tresses of plaited flame. Terrified at the might of Sudarshana, the creation of Maheswara did not wait for his attack but fled quickly followed by him with equal velocity until she arrived at Varānashi repelled by the superior prowess of the discus of Vishnu.

The arms of the king of Kāsi and the whole number of the attendant divinities of Siva armed with various weapons marched out to oppose the discus. But an expert in the use of arms he consumed the whole host by his radiance and then set fire to the city, in which the magic power of Siva had concealed herself. Thus was Varanashi burnt with all its princes and their followers, its inhabitants, elephants, horses and men, treasures and granaries, houses, palaces and markets. The whole of the city that was inaccessible to the celestials was thus covered with flames by the discus of Hari and was totally destroyed. The discus, with unsoothed wrath, blazing fiercely and not satisfied with the accomplishment of so easy a task, then returned to the hands of Vishnu.

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
भूय एवाहमिच्छामि बलभद्रस्य धीमतः ।
श्रोतु पराक्रमं ब्रह्मन् ! तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
bhuya evahamichchhami balabhadrasya dhimatah |
shrotu parakramam brahman ! tanmamakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
यमुनाकर्षणादीनि श्रुतानि भगवन्मया ।
तत् कथ्यतां महाभाग! यदन्यत् कृतवान् बलः ॥
verses.rom:
yamunakarshanadini shrutani bhagavanmaya |
tat kathyatam mahabhaga! yadanyat kritavan balah ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
मैत्रेय!श्रूयतां कर्म्म यदू रोमेणाभवत् कृतम् ।
अनन्तेनाप्रमेयेण शेषेणा धरणीभृता ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
maitreya!shruyatam karmma yadu romenabhavat kritam |
anantenaprameyena sheshena dharanibhrita ||

verses.sa:
दुर्य्योधनस्य तनयां खयंवरकृतक्षणाम् ।
बलादादत्तवान् वीरः शाम्बो जाम्बवतीसुतः ॥
verses.rom:
duryyodhanasya tanayam khayamvarakritakshanam |
baladadattavan virah shambo jambavatisutah ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्रुद्धा महावीर्य्याः कर्ण-दुर्य्योधनादयः ।
भीष्म-ग्रोणादयश्चैव बबुन्धर्यघि निर्ज्जितम् ॥ ५-३५-५?॥
तच्छ्रत्वा यादवाः सर्व्वे क्रोधं दुर्य्योधनादिषु ।
मैत्रेय! चक्रुश्व ततो तिहन्तु ते महोद्यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kruddha mahaviryyah karna-duryyodhanadayah |
bhishma-gronadayashchaiva babundharyaghi nirjjitam || 5-35-5?||
tachchhratva yadavah sarvve krodham duryyodhanadishu |
maitreya! chakrushva tato tihantu te mahodyamam ||

verses.sa:
तान् निवार्य्य बलः प्राह मदलोलाकुलाक्षरम् ।
मोक्ष्यन्ति ते मद्धचनादू यास्याम्येको हि कौरवान् ॥
verses.rom:
tan nivaryya balah praha madalolakulaksharam |
mokshyanti te maddhachanadu yasyamyeko hi kauravan ||

verses.sa:
बलदेवस्तातो गत्वा नगरं नागसाह्वयम् ।
बाह्योपवनमध्येऽभूदू न विवेश च ततूपुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
baladevastato gatva nagaram nagasahvayam |
bahyopavanamadhye'bhudu na vivesha cha tatupuram ||

verses.sa:
बलमागतमाज्ञाय भूपा दुर्य्योधनादयः ।
गामर्घ्यमुदकञ्चैव रामाय प्रत्यवेदयन् ॥
verses.rom:
balamagatamajnaya bhupa duryyodhanadayah |
gamarghyamudakanchaiva ramaya pratyavedayan ||

verses.sa:
गृहीत्वा विधिवत् सर्व्वं ततस्तानाह कौरवान् ।
आज्ञापयत्युग्रसेनः शाम्बमाशु विमुञ्चत ॥
verses.rom:
grihitva vidhivat sarvvam tatastanaha kauravan |
ajnapayatyugrasenah shambamashu vimunchata ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते तदूचः श्रुत्वा भीष्मद्रोणादये द्रिज ।
कर्णादुर्य्योधनाद्याश्व चक्रुधुर्द्रिजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tataste taduchah shrutva bhishmadronadaye drija |
karnaduryyodhanadyashva chakrudhurdrijasattama ||

verses.sa:
ऊचुश्व कुपिताः सर्व्वे वाह्लीकाद्याश्व कौरवाः ।
अराज्यार्हं यदोर्व्वशमवेक्ष्य मुसलायुधम् ॥
verses.rom:
uchushva kupitah sarvve vahlikadyashva kauravah |
arajyarham yadorvvashamavekshya musalayudham ||

verses.sa:
भो भोः !किमेतद्भवता बलभद्रेरितं बचः ।
आज्ञां कुरुकुलोत्थानां यादवः कः प्रदास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
bho bhoh !kimetadbhavata balabhadreritam bachah |
ajnam kurukulotthanam yadavah kah pradasyati ||

verses.sa:
उग्रसेनोऽपि यद्याज्ञां कौरवाणां प्रदास्यति ।
तदलं पाण्डुरच्छत्रैर्नृ पयोग्यैर्विड़म्बितैः ॥
verses.rom:
ugraseno'pi yadyajnam kauravanam pradasyati |
tadalam pandurachchhatrairnri payogyairvirambitaih ||

verses.sa:
तदूगच्छ बल!पापाढ्य शाम्बमन्यायचेष्टितम् ।
विमोक्ष्यामो न भवतो नोग्रसेनस्य शासनात् ॥
verses.rom:
tadugachchha bala!papadhya shambamanyayacheshtitam |
vimokshyamo na bhavato nograsenasya shasanat ||

verses.sa:
प्रणतिर्या कृतास्माकमार्य्याणां कुकुरान्धकैः ।
ननाम सा कृता केयमाज्ञा स्वामिनि भृत्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
pranatirya kritasmakamaryyanam kukurandhakaih |
nanama sa krita keyamajna svamini bhrityatah ||

verses.sa:
गर्व्वमारोपिता युयं समानासनभोजनैः ।
को दोषो भवतां नितिर्यत् प्रीत्या नावलोकिता ॥
verses.rom:
garvvamaropita yuyam samanasanabhojanaih |
ko dosho bhavatam nitiryat pritya navalokita ||

verses.sa:
अस्माभिरर्घो भवतो योऽयं बल! निवेदितः ।
प्र मूणैतन्नैतदस्माक कुल्यं युष्मत्कुलोचितम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhirargho bhavato yo'yam bala! niveditah |
pra munaitannaitadasmaka kulyam yushmatkulochitam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा कुरवः सर्व्वे न मुञ्चामो हरेः सुतम् ।
कृतैकनिश्वयास्तूर्णं विविशुर्गजसाह्वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva kuravah sarvve na munchamo hareh sutam |
kritaikanishvayasturnam vivishurgajasahvayam ||

verses.sa:
मत्तःकोपेन चाघूर्णंस्तदधिक्षेपजन्मना ।
अत्थाय पार्ष्ण्या वसुधां जघान स हलायुधः ॥
verses.rom:
mattahkopena chaghurnamstadadhikshepajanmana |
atthaya parshnya vasudham jaghana sa halayudhah ||

verses.sa:
ततो विदारिता पृथ्वी पार्ष्णिघातान्महात्मनः ।
आस्फोटयामास तथा दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ॥
verses.rom:
tato vidarita prithvi parshnighatanmahatmanah |
asphotayamasa tatha dishah shabdena purayan ||

verses.sa:
स उवाचातिताम्राक्षो भ्रु कुटीकुटिलाननः ।
अहो मदापलेपोऽयमसाराणां द्ररात्मनाम ॥
verses.rom:
sa uvachatitamraksho bhru kutikutilananah |
aho madapalepo'yamasaranam draratmanama ||

verses.sa:
कौरवाणां महीपत्वमस्माकं किल कालजम् ।
उग्रसेनस्य ये नाज्ञां मन्यन्तेऽद्यापि लङ्खनम् ॥
verses.rom:
kauravanam mahipatvamasmakam kila kalajam |
ugrasenasya ye najnam manyante'dyapi lankhanam ||

verses.sa:
आज्ञां प्रतीच्छेद्धर्म्मेण सह देवैः शचीपतिः ।
सदाध्यास्ते सुधर्म्मा तामुग्रसेनः शचीपतेः ॥
verses.rom:
ajnam pratichchheddharmmena saha devaih shachipatih |
sadadhyaste sudharmma tamugrasenah shachipateh ||

verses.sa:
धिङूमनुष्यशतोच्छिष्टे तुष्टिरेषां नृपासने ।
पारिजाततरोः पुष्पमञ्चरीर्वनिताजनः ॥
verses.rom:
dhinumanushyashatochchhishte tushtiresham nripasane |
parijatataroh pushpamancharirvanitajanah ||

verses.sa:
बिभर्त्ति यस्य भृत्यानां सोऽप्येषां न महीपतिः ।
समस्तभूभृतां नाथ उग्रसेनः स तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.rom:
bibhartti yasya bhrityanam so'pyesham na mahipatih |
samastabhubhritam natha ugrasenah sa tishthatu ||

verses.sa:
अद्य निष्कौरवामुर्व्वीं कृत्वा यास्यामि तत्पुरीम् ।
कर्णं दुर्य्योघनं द्रोणमद्य भीष्मं सवाह्लिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
adya nishkauravamurvvim kritva yasyami tatpurim |
karnam duryyoghanam dronamadya bhishmam savahlikam ||

verses.sa:
दुष्टान् दुःशासनादींश्व भूरिश्रवसमेव च ।
सोमदत्तं शलं भीममर्ज्जुनं सयुधिष्ठिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
dushtan duhshasanadimshva bhurishravasameva cha |
somadattam shalam bhimamarjjunam sayudhishthiram ||

verses.sa:
ममजौ कौरवांश्वान्यान् ह्टत्वा साश्वरथद्रिपान् ।
वीरमादाय शाम्बञ्च सपत्रीक ततः पुरीम् ।
द्रारकामुग्रसेनादीन् गत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि बान्धवान् ॥
verses.rom:
mamajau kauravamshvanyan htatva sashvarathadripan |
viramadaya shambancha sapatrika tatah purim |
drarakamugrasenadin gatva drakshyami bandhavan ||

verses.sa:
अथवा कौरवाधीनं समस्तैः कुरुभिः सह ।
भारावतरणो शीघ्र देवराजेन चोदितः ॥
भागीरथ्यां क्षिपाम्याशु नगरं नागसाह्वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
athava kauravadhinam samastaih kurubhih saha |
bharavatarano shighra devarajena choditah ||
bhagirathyam kshipamyashu nagaram nagasahvayam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा मदरक्ताक्षः कर्षणाधोमुखं हलम् ।
प्राकारवप्र विन्यस्य चकर्ष मुषलायुधः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva madaraktakshah karshanadhomukham halam |
prakaravapra vinyasya chakarsha mushalayudhah ||

verses.sa:
आघूर्णितं तत् सहसा ततो वै हस्तिनापुरम् ।
दृष्ट्वा संक्षुब्धह्टदयाश्चुंक्र शुः सर्व्वकौरवाः ॥
verses.rom:
aghurnitam tat sahasa tato vai hastinapuram |
drishtva samkshubdhahtadayashchumkra shuh sarvvakauravah ||

verses.sa:
लाम!राम!महावाहो!क्षम्यतां क्षम्यतां त्वया ।
उपसंह्रियतां कोपः प्रसीद मुषलायुघ ॥
verses.rom:
lama!rama!mahavaho!kshamyatam kshamyatam tvaya |
upasamhriyatam kopah prasida mushalayugha ||

verses.sa:
एष शाम्बः सपत्रीकस्तव निर्यातितो बल!
अविज्ञातप्रभावाणां क्षम्यतामपराधिनाम ॥
verses.rom:
esha shambah sapatrikastava niryatito bala!
avijnataprabhavanam kshamyatamaparadhinama ||

verses.sa:
ततो निर्यातयामासुः शाम्बं पत्रीसमन्वितम् ।
निष्कम्य नगरात्तूर्णां कौरवा मुनिपुङ्गव ॥
verses.rom:
tato niryatayamasuh shambam patrisamanvitam |
nishkamya nagaratturnam kaurava munipungava ||

verses.sa:
भीष्म-द्रोण-कृपादीनां प्रणम्य वदतां प्रियम् ।
क्षान्तमेतन्मयेत्याह बलो बलवतां वरः ॥
verses.rom:
bhishma-drona-kripadinam pranamya vadatam priyam |
kshantametanmayetyaha balo balavatam varah ||

verses.sa:
अद्याप्याघूर्णिताकारं लक्ष्यते तत् पुरं द्रिज!
एष प्रवादो रामस्य बलशौर्य्योपलक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
adyapyaghurnitakaram lakshyate tat puram drija!
esha pravado ramasya balashauryyopalakshanah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु कौरवाः शाम्ब सम्पूज्य हलिना सह ।
प्रषयामासुरुद्राहधनभार्य्यासमन्वितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu kauravah shamba sampujya halina saha |
prashayamasurudrahadhanabharyyasamanvitam ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—O Brahman, I have a great desire to listen to some other exploits of Balarāma; do thou describe them unto me. You have related to me, O reverend Sir, his dragging the Yamuna and other mighty deeds; do thou now recount some other of his acts.

Parāçara said:—Listen O Maitreya, to the exploits accomplished by Rāma who is the eternal, illimitable Sesha, the upholder of the earth. At the choice of a husband by the daughter of Duryodhana, the princess was taken away by the hero Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavati. Being pursued by Duryodhana, Karna, Bhishma, Drona and other illustrious chiefs who were enraged for his audacity, he was defeated and taken prisoner. When the Yādavas heard of this event they were greatly enraged with Duryodhana and his companions and addressed themselves to fight with them. But Baladeva, in accents suppressed by the effects of inebriety, forbade them and said, "I will go alone to the sons of Kuru and at my request they will let Sāmba free". Accordingly he went to Hastināpur and took his abode in a grove outside the town which he did not enter. When Duryodhana and others were informed of his arrival, they sent him a cow, a present of fruits and flowers and water. Bala received the offering in the customary form and said to the descendants of Kuru "Ugrasena commands you to liberate Sāmba". When Duryodhana, Karna, Bhishma, Drona and others heard this they were worked up with ire, and Bāhlika and other friends of the Kauravai who considered the Yadu race as having no claims to regal dignity said to the wielder of the club. "What is this, O Balarāma, that thou hast uttered? What Yadava shall command the chiefs of the Kurus? If Ugrasena thus commands the Kuravas, we will take away the white umbrella which he has usurped and which is only fit for the kings. You should go away therefore, Balarāma; you are entitled to our respect; but Sāmba has been guilty of an improper conduct and we shall not let him free either at Ugrasena's commands or yours. The Kukkura and Andhaka races might not pay the homage due to us, their superiors, but who ever heard of a servant commanding his master? You have been rendered arrogant by our treating you equally with seat and food; we have committed a great mistake in neglecting the policy, for our great friendship for you. The present that we sent you today was a sign of personal regard, but it was not fit for us to have offered nor for yours to have expected".

Having said this, the Kuru chiefs unanimously refused to liberate Hari's sons and came back to their city. Moving about with intoxication and anger caused by their insolent words, Bala struck the ground furiously with his heel so that it burst to pieces with a loud sound that reverberated through the regions of space. His eyes reddened with rage and his brow curved with frowns he exclaimed. "What pride is this in such vile and pithless creatures. The sovereignty of Kauravas as well as our own is the work of destiny whose decree it also is that they now disrespect or disobey the commands of Ugrasena. Indra may, as is his right, command the celestials and Ugrasena exercises equal authority with the lord of Sachi. Fie upon the pride that boasts a throne, the leavings of a hundred mortals. Is not he the sovereign of earth, the wives of whose servants adorn themselves with the blossoms of the Pārijāta tree? Ugrasena shall be the undisputed lord of kings; for I will not return to his capital until I have rid the world wholly of the sons of Kuru. I will destroy Karna, Duryodhana, Drona, Bhishma, Bāhlika, Dussāsana, Bhurisrava, Somadatta, Salya, Bhima, Arjuna, Yudhishthira, the twins, and all the other wretched sons of Kuru with their horses, elephants and chariots. I will liberate the hero Sāmba and carry him along with his wife to Dwārakā where I shall again behold Ugrasena and the rest of my kinsmen. Or commanded by the king of celestials, to remove the burden of the earth, I will take this capital of the Kauravas with all the sons of Kuru, and throw Hastināpur into the Bhāgirathi".

Saying this with his eyes reddened with ire, Baladeva, the wielder of the club, plunged the blade of his ploughshare downwards beneath the ramparts of the city, and drew them towards him. When the Kauravas beheld Hastināpur tottering, they were much afraid, and called loudly on Rāma, saying, "O Rāma! Rāma! hold, hold; supress your anger and have compassion upon us. Here is Sāmba and his wife also delivered up to you. Forgive the sins committed by us ignorant of your wondrous power". Accordingly the Kauravas hurried out of the city and delivered Sāmba and his wife to the mighty Balarāma, who, bowing to Bhishma, Drona and Kripa, who pacified him, said, "I am satisfied," and desisted. The city bears the mark of the shock even to the present day—such was the might of Rāma proving both his strength and power. The Kauravas then, offering homage to Sāmba and Bala, sent away the former with his wife and dowry.

verses.sa:
मेत्रेय!श्रूयतां तस्य बलस्य बलशालिनः ।
कृतं यदन्यत्तेनाभूत्तदपि श्रूयतां द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
metreya!shruyatam tasya balasya balashalinah |
kritam yadanyattenabhuttadapi shruyatam drija ||

verses.sa:
नरकस्यासुरेन्द्रस्य देवपक्षविरोधिनः ।
सखाभवन्महावीर्य्यो द्रिविदो नाम वानरः ॥
verses.rom:
narakasyasurendrasya devapakshavirodhinah |
sakhabhavanmahaviryyo drivido nama vanarah ||

verses.sa:
वैरानुबन्ध बलवान् स चकार सुरान् प्रित ।
नरक हतवान् कृष्णो बलदर्पसमन्वितम् ॥
verses.rom:
vairanubandha balavan sa chakara suran prita |
naraka hatavan krishno baladarpasamanvitam ||

verses.sa:
करिष्ये सर्व्वदेवानां तस्मादेतत्प्रतिक्रियाम् ।
यज्ञविध्वंसनं कुर्व्वन् मर्त्तलोकक्षयं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
karishye sarvvadevanam tasmadetatpratikriyam |
yajnavidhvamsanam kurvvan marttalokakshayam tatha ||

verses.sa:
ततो विध्वसयामास यज्ञानज्ञानमोहितः ।
बिबेद साधुमर्य्यादां क्षयं चक्र च देहिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato vidhvasayamasa yajnanajnanamohitah |
bibeda sadhumaryyadam kshayam chakra cha dehinam ||

verses.sa:
ददाह च वनोद्देशान् पुरग्रामान्तराणि च ।
क्वचिज्व पर्व्वताक्षेपैर्ग्रामादीन् समचूणोयत् ॥
verses.rom:
dadaha cha vanoddeshan puragramantarani cha |
kvachijva parvvatakshepairgramadin samachunoyat ||

verses.sa:
शैलानुतूपाट्य तोयेषु मुमोचाम्बुनिधौ तथा ।
पुनञ्चार्णवमध्यस्थः क्षोभयामास सागरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shailanutupatya toyeshu mumochambunidhau tatha |
punancharnavamadhyasthah kshobhayamasa sagaram ||

verses.sa:
तेन विक्षोभितश्वाब्धिरुद्रेलोऽजायत द्रिज ।
प्लावयंस्तीरजान् ग्रामान् पुरादीनतिवेगवान् ॥
verses.rom:
tena vikshobhitashvabdhirudrelo'jayata drija |
plavayamstirajan graman puradinativegavan ||

verses.sa:
कामरूपी महारूपं कृत्वा संस्थानशेषतः ।
लुण्ठन् भ्रमणसंमर्द्देः सञ्चूर्णायति वानरः ॥
verses.rom:
kamarupi maharupam kritva samsthanasheshatah |
lunthan bhramanasammarddeh sanchurnayati vanarah ||

verses.sa:
तेन विप्रकृतं सर्व्वं जगदेतदूदुरात्मना ।
निः स्वाध्यायवषटूकारं मैत्रेयासीत् सुदुः खितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tena viprakritam sarvvam jagadetaduduratmana |
nih svadhyayavashatukaram maitreyasit suduh khitam ||

verses.sa:
एकदा रैवतोद्याने पपौ पानं हलायुधः ।
रेवती च महाभागा तथैवान्या वरस्त्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
ekada raivatodyane papau panam halayudhah |
revati cha mahabhaga tathaivanya varastriyah ||

verses.sa:
उपगीयमानो विलसल्ललनामौलिमध्यगः ।
रेमे यदुवरश्वष्ठः कुवेर इव मन्दरे ॥
verses.rom:
upagiyamano vilasallalanamaulimadhyagah |
reme yaduvarashvashthah kuvera iva mandare ||

verses.sa:
ततः स वानरोऽभ्येत्य गृहीत्वा सीरिणो हलम् ।
मुषलञ्च चकारास्य सम्मुख़्च बिड़म्बनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa vanaro'bhyetya grihitva sirino halam |
mushalancha chakarasya sammukhcha birambanam ||

verses.sa:
तथैव योषितां तासां जहासाभिमुखं कपिः ।
पानपूर्णाश्व करकांश्विक्षेपाहत्य वै तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tathaiva yoshitam tasam jahasabhimukham kapih |
panapurnashva karakamshvikshepahatya vai tada ||

verses.sa:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा भर्तूसयामास तं बलः ।
तथापि तमवज्ञाय चक्र किलकिलाध्वनिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kopaparitatma bhartusayamasa tam balah |
tathapi tamavajnaya chakra kilakiladhvanim ||

verses.sa:
ततः समुत्थाय बलो जग्राह मुषल रुषा ।
सोऽपि शैलशिलां भीमां जग्राह प्लवगोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah samutthaya balo jagraha mushala rusha |
so'pi shailashilam bhimam jagraha plavagottamah ||

verses.sa:
चिक्षेप च स तां क्षिप्तां मुषलेन सहस्त्रधा ।
बिभेद यादवश्वेष्ठः सा पपात महीतले ॥
verses.rom:
chikshepa cha sa tam kshiptam mushalena sahastradha |
bibheda yadavashveshthah sa papata mahitale ||

verses.sa:
आपतन्मुषलञ्चासौ समुल्लङ्घय प्लवङ्गमः ।
वेगेनागम्य रोषेण तलेनोरस्यताड़यत् ॥
verses.rom:
apatanmushalanchasau samullanghaya plavangamah |
vegenagamya roshena talenorasyatarayat ||

verses.sa:
ततो बलेन कोपेन मुष्टिना मूद्धि ताड़ितः ।
पपात रुधिरोदूगारी द्रिविदः क्षीणाजीवितः ॥
verses.rom:
tato balena kopena mushtina muddhi taritah |
papata rudhirodugari drividah kshinajivitah ||

verses.sa:
पतता तच्छरीरेण गिरेः श्वृङ्गमदीर्य्यत ।
मैत्रेय!शतधा वज्रिवजणेव हि ताड़ितम् ॥
verses.rom:
patata tachchharirena gireh shvringamadiryyata |
maitreya!shatadha vajrivajaneva hi taritam ||

verses.sa:
पुष्पवृष्टिं ततो देवा रामस्योपरि चिक्षिपुः ।
प्रशशंसुस्तथाभ्येत्य साध्वेतत्ते महत् कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pushpavrishtim tato deva ramasyopari chikshipuh |
prashashamsustathabhyetya sadhvetatte mahat kritam ||

verses.sa:
अनेन दुष्टकपिना दैत्यपक्षोपकारिणा ।
जगन्निराकृतं वीर! दिष्ट्यासौ क्षयमागतः ॥
verses.rom:
anena dushtakapina daityapakshopakarina |
jagannirakritam vira! dishtyasau kshayamagatah ||

verses.sa: इत्युक्त्वा दिवमाजग्मुर्देवा ह्टष्टाः सगुह्यकाः ॥
verses.rom: ityuktva divamajagmurdeva htashtah saguhyakah ||

verses.sa:
एवंविधान्यनेकानि बलदेवस्य धीमतः ।
कर्म्माण्यपरिमेयाणि शेषस्य धरणीबृतः ॥
verses.rom:
evamvidhanyanekani baladevasya dhimatah |
karmmanyaparimeyani sheshasya dharanibritah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Listen, O Maitreya, to another achievement accomplished by the powerful Balarāma. The great Asura, Naraka, the enemy of the friends of the celestials, had a friend of exceeding might in a monkey named Dwivida, who was worked up with implacable hostility against the celestials, and vowed to revenge on all of them the destruction of Naraka by Krishna at the instigation of the king of the celestials, by preventing sacrifices and bringing about the total destruction of the world. Blinded by ignorance therefore, he interrupted all religious practices, put down all righteous observances, and brought about the death of living creatures; he set fire to forests, to villages and towns; sometimes he deluged cities and villages with a downpour of rocks or lifting up mountains in the waters he cast them into the ocean; then placing himself in the midst of the deep, he agitated the waves until the foaming sea rose above its confines and swept away the villages and cities situated upon its shores. Dwivida, who was capable of assuming shapes as he liked, enlarged his bulk to an immense proportion, and rolling and tumbling and trampling amidst the corn-fields, he crushed and spoiled the harvest. The whole world, disorganised by this vicious monkey, was deprived of sacred study and religious ceremonies, and was greatly afflicted.

Once on a time Halāyudha was drinking in the groves of Raivata along with the illustrious Revati and other beautiful females; and the celebrated Yadu whose glories were sung and who was pre-eminent amidst graceful and sportive women, resembled Kuvera, the god of riches, in his palace. In the meantime, the monkey Dwivida came there and stealing the ploughshare and the club of Balarāma, grinned at and mocked him, and laughed at the women and threw over and broke the cups filled with wine. Enraged at this, Balarāma threatened the monkey; but the latter disregarded his threats and chattering noise. Thereupon Balarāma started up and seized his club in anger, and the monkey laid hold of a large rock which he hurled at the hero. And casting his club at it as it approached him, Bala broke it into a thousand pieces, which together with the club, fell upon the ground. Beholding the club thus fallen, the monkey sprang over it and struck the Yādava violently on the breast with his paws. Bala returned it with a blow of his fist upon the fore-head of Dwivida which felled him, vomiting blood and lifeless to the earth. The crest of the mountain on which he fell was sundered into a hundred pieces by the weight of his body, as if the Thunderer had shivered it with his thunder-bolt. The celestials threw down a shower of flowers upon Rāma and approached him and praised him for the glorious feat he had performed.

"Well has the world been freed" said they "by thy prowess, O hero, of his vile ape, who was the enemy of the celestials". Then well pleased, they and their attendant spirits returned to heaven. Many such inimitable deeds were performed by the illustrious Baladeva, the impersonation of Sesha, the supporter of the earth.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
एवं दैत्यवधं कृष्णो बलदेव सहायवान् ।
चक्रे दुष्टक्षितीशानां तथैव जगतः कृते ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
evam daityavadham krishno baladeva sahayavan |
chakre dushtakshitishanam tathaiva jagatah krite ||

verses.sa:
क्षितेश्च भारं भगवान्फाल्गुनेन समन्वितः ।
आवतारयामास विभुस्समस्ताक्षोहिणी वधात् ॥
verses.rom:
kshiteshcha bharam bhagavanphalgunena samanvitah |
avatarayamasa vibhussamastakshohini vadhat ||

verses.sa:
कृत्वा भारावतरणं भुवो हत्वाऽखिलान्नृपान् ।
शापव्याजेन विप्राणामुपसंहृतवान्कुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
kritva bharavataranam bhuvo hatva'khilannripan |
shapavyajena vipranamupasamhritavankulam ||

verses.sa:
उत्सृज्य द्वारकां कृष्णस्त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यमात्मनः ।
सांशो विष्णुमयं स्थानं प्रविवेश मुने निजम् ॥
verses.rom:
utsrijya dvarakam krishnastyaktva manushyamatmanah |
samsho vishnumayam sthanam pravivesha mune nijam ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच।
स विप्रशापव्याजेन संजह्रे स्वकुलं कथम् ।
कथं च मानुषं देहमुत्ससर्ज जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha|
sa viprashapavyajena samjahre svakulam katham |
katham cha manusham dehamutsasarja janardanah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
विश्वामित्रस्तथा कण्वो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।
पिंडारके महातीर्थे दृष्ट्वा यदुकुमारकैः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
vishvamitrastatha kanvo naradashcha mahamunih |
pimdarake mahatirthe drishtva yadukumarakaih ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते यौवनोन्मत्ता भाविकार्यप्रचोदिताः ।
सांबं जांबवतीपुत्रं भूषयित्वा स्त्रियं यथा ॥
verses.rom:
tataste yauvanonmatta bhavikaryaprachoditah |
sambam jambavatiputram bhushayitva striyam yatha ||

verses.sa:
प्रश्रितास्तान्मुनीनूचुः प्रणिपातपुरस्सरम् ।
इयं स्त्री पुत्रकामा वै ब्रूत किं जनयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
prashritastanmuninuchuh pranipatapurassaram |
iyam stri putrakama vai bruta kim janayishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
दिव्यज्ञानोपपन्नास्ते विप्रलब्धाः कुमारकैः ।
मुनयः कुपिताः प्रोचुर्मुसलं जनयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
divyajnanopapannaste vipralabdhah kumarakaih |
munayah kupitah prochurmusalam janayishyati ||

verses.sa:
सर्वयादवसंहारकारणं भुवनोत्तरम् ।
येनाखिलकुलोत्सादो यादवानां भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sarvayadavasamharakaranam bhuvanottaram |
yenakhilakulotsado yadavanam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तास्ते कुमारास्तु आचचक्षुर्यथातथम् ।
उग्रसेनाय मुसलं जज्ञे सांबस्य चोदरात् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktaste kumarastu achachakshuryathatatham |
ugrasenaya musalam jajne sambasya chodarat ||

verses.sa:
तदुग्रसेनो मुसलमयश्चूर्णमकारयत् ।
जज्ञे तदेरकाचूर्णं प्रक्षिप्तं तैर्महोदधौ ॥
verses.rom:
tadugraseno musalamayashchurnamakarayat |
jajne taderakachurnam prakshiptam tairmahodadhau ||

verses.sa:
मुसलस्याथ लोहस्य चूर्णितस्य तु यादवैः ।
खंडं चूर्णितशेषं तु ततो यत्तोमराकृति ॥
verses.rom:
musalasyatha lohasya churnitasya tu yadavaih |
khamdam churnitashesham tu tato yattomarakriti ||

verses.sa:
तदप्यंबुनिधौ क्षिप्तं मत्स्यो जग्राह जालिभिः ।
घातितस्योदरात्तस्य लुब्धो जग्राह तज्जराः ॥
verses.rom:
tadapyambunidhau kshiptam matsyo jagraha jalibhih |
ghatitasyodarattasya lubdho jagraha tajjarah ||

verses.sa:
विज्ञातपरमार्थोपि भगवान्मधुसूदनः ।
नैच्छत्तदन्यथा कर्त्तुं विधिना यत्समीहितम् ॥
verses.rom:
vijnataparamarthopi bhagavanmadhusudanah |
naichchhattadanyatha karttum vidhina yatsamihitam ||

verses.sa:
देवैश्च प्रहितो वायुः प्रणिपत्त्याह केशवम् ।
रहस्येवमहं दूतः प्रहितो भगवन्सुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
devaishcha prahito vayuh pranipattyaha keshavam |
rahasyevamaham dutah prahito bhagavansuraih ||

verses.sa:
वस्वश्विमरुदादित्यरुद्र साध्यादिभिस्सह ।
विज्ञापयति शक्रस्त्वां तदिदं श्रूयतां विभो ॥
verses.rom:
vasvashvimarudadityarudra sadhyadibhissaha |
vijnapayati shakrastvam tadidam shruyatam vibho ||

verses.sa:
भारावतरणार्थाय वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
भगवानवतीर्णोत्र त्रिदशैस्सह चोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
bharavataranarthaya varshanamadhikam shatam |
bhagavanavatirnotra tridashaissaha choditah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्वृत्ता निहता दैत्या भुवो भारोऽवतारितः ।
त्वया मनाथास्त्रिदशा भवंतु त्रिदिवे सदा ॥
verses.rom:
durvritta nihata daitya bhuvo bharo'vataritah |
tvaya manathastridasha bhavamtu tridive sada ||

verses.sa:
तदतीतं जगन्नाथ वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
इदानीं गम्यतां स्वर्गो भवता यदि रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
tadatitam jagannatha varshanamadhikam shatam |
idanim gamyatam svargo bhavata yadi rochate ||

verses.sa:
देवैर्विज्ञाप्यते देव तथात्रैव रतिस्तव ।
तत्स्थीयतां यथाकालमास्थेयमनुजीविभिः ॥
verses.rom:
devairvijnapyate deva tathatraiva ratistava |
tatsthiyatam yathakalamastheyamanujivibhih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
यत्त्वमात्थाखिलं दूत वेद्म्येतदहमप्युत ।
प्रारब्ध एव हि मया यादवानां परिक्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha|
yattvamatthakhilam duta vedmyetadahamapyuta |
prarabdha eva hi maya yadavanam parikshayah ||

verses.sa:
भुवो नाद्यापि भारोऽयं यादवैरनिबर्हितैः ।
अवतार्य करोम्येतत्सप्तरात्रेण सत्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvo nadyapi bharo'yam yadavairanibarhitaih |
avatarya karomyetatsaptaratrena satvarah ||

verses.sa:
यथा गृहीतमंभोधेर्दत्त्वाहं द्वारकाभुवम् ।
यादवानुपसंहृत्य यास्यामि त्रिदशालयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha grihitamambhodherdattvaham dvarakabhuvam |
yadavanupasamhritya yasyami tridashalayam ||

verses.sa:
मनुष्यदेहमुत्सृज्य संकर्षणसहायवान् ।
प्राप्त एवास्मि मंतव्यो देवेंद्रे ण तथाऽमरैः ॥
verses.rom:
manushyadehamutsrijya samkarshanasahayavan |
prapta evasmi mamtavyo devemdre na tatha'maraih ||

verses.sa:
जरासंधादयो येऽन्ये निहता भारहेतवः ।
क्षितेस्तेभ्यःकुमारोऽपि यदूनां नापचीयते ॥
verses.rom:
jarasamdhadayo ye'nye nihata bharahetavah |
kshitestebhyahkumaro'pi yadunam napachiyate ||

verses.sa:
तदेतं सुमहाभारमवतार्य क्षितेरहम् ।
यास्याम्यमरलोकस्य पालनाय ब्रवीहि तान् ॥
verses.rom:
tadetam sumahabharamavatarya kshiteraham |
yasyamyamaralokasya palanaya bravihi tan ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन देवदूतः प्रणम्य तम् ।
मैत्रेय दिव्यया गत्या देवराजांतिकं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityukto vasudevena devadutah pranamya tam |
maitreya divyaya gatya devarajamtikam yayau ||

verses.sa:
भगवानप्यथोत्पातान्दिव्यभौमांतरिक्षजान् ।
ददर्श द्वारकापुर्य्यां विनाशाय दिवानिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavanapyathotpatandivyabhaumamtarikshajan |
dadarsha dvarakapuryyam vinashaya divanisham ||

verses.sa:
तान्दृष्ट्वा यादवानाह पश्यध्वमतिदारुणान् ।
महोत्पाताञ्छमायैषां प्रभासं याम मा चिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tandrishtva yadavanaha pashyadhvamatidarunan |
mahotpatanchhamayaisham prabhasam yama ma chiram ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन यादवप्रवरस्ततः ।
महाभागवतः प्राह प्रणिपत्योद्धवो हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
evamukte tu krishnena yadavapravarastatah |
mahabhagavatah praha pranipatyoddhavo harim ||

verses.sa:
भगवन्यन्मया कार्यं तदाज्ञापय सांप्रतम् ।
मन्ये कुलमिदं सर्वं भगवान्संहरिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavanyanmaya karyam tadajnapaya sampratam |
manye kulamidam sarvam bhagavansamharishyati ||

verses.sa: नाशायास्य निमित्तानि कुलस्याच्युत लक्षये ॥
verses.rom: nashayasya nimittani kulasyachyuta lakshaye ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
गच्छ त्वं दिव्यया गत्या मत्प्रसादसमुत्थया ।
यद्बदर्याश्रमं पुण्यं गंधमादनपर्वते ।
नरनारायणस्थाने तत्पवित्रं महीतले ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha|
gachchha tvam divyaya gatya matprasadasamutthaya |
yadbadaryashramam punyam gamdhamadanaparvate |
naranarayanasthane tatpavitram mahitale ||

verses.sa:
मन्मना मत्प्रसादेन तत्र सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ।
अहं स्वर्गं गमिष्यामि ह्युपसंहृत्य वै कुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
manmana matprasadena tatra siddhimavapsyasi |
aham svargam gamishyami hyupasamhritya vai kulam ||

verses.sa:
द्वारकां च मया त्यक्तां समुद्र ः! प्लावयिष्यति ।
मद्वेश्म चैकं मुक्त्वा तु भयान्मत्तो जलाशये ।
तत्र सन्निहितश्चाहं भक्तानां हितकाम्यया ॥
verses.rom:
dvarakam cha maya tyaktam samudra h! plavayishyati |
madveshma chaikam muktva tu bhayanmatto jalashaye |
tatra sannihitashchaham bhaktanam hitakamyaya ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं जगामाशु तपोवनम् ।
नरनारायणस्थानं केशवेनानुमोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityuktah pranipatyainam jagamashu tapovanam |
naranarayanasthanam keshavenanumoditah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते यादवास्सर्वे रथानारुह्य शीघ्रगान् ।
प्रभासं प्रययुस्सार्द्धं कृष्णरामादिभिर्द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
tataste yadavassarve rathanaruhya shighragan |
prabhasam prayayussarddham krishnaramadibhirdvija ||

verses.sa:
प्रभासं समनुप्राप्ताः कुकुरांधकवृष्णयः ।
चक्रुस्तत्र महापानं वासुदेवेन चोदिताः ॥
verses.rom:
prabhasam samanupraptah kukuramdhakavrishnayah |
chakrustatra mahapanam vasudevena choditah ||

verses.sa:
पिबतां तत्र चैतेषां संघर्षेण परस्परम् ।
अतिवादेंधनो जज्ञे कलहाग्निः क्षयावहः ॥
verses.rom:
pibatam tatra chaitesham samgharshena parasparam |
ativademdhano jajne kalahagnih kshayavahah ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच।
स्वंस्वं वै भुंजतां तेषां कलहः किंनिमित्तकः ।
संघर्षो वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha|
svamsvam vai bhumjatam tesham kalahah kimnimittakah |
samgharsho va dvijashreshtha tanmamakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
मृष्टं मदीयमन्नं ते न मृष्टमिति जल्पताम् ।
मृष्टामृष्टकथा जज्ञे संघर्षकलहौ ततः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
mrishtam madiyamannam te na mrishtamiti jalpatam |
mrishtamrishtakatha jajne samgharshakalahau tatah ||

verses.sa:
ततश्चान्योन्यमभ्येत्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः ।
जघ्नुः परस्परं ते तु शस्त्रैर्दैवबलात्कृताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchanyonyamabhyetya krodhasamraktalochanah |
jaghnuh parasparam te tu shastrairdaivabalatkritah ||

verses.sa: क्षीणशस्त्राश्च जगृहुः प्रत्यासन्नामथैरकाम् ॥
verses.rom: kshinashastrashcha jagrihuh pratyasannamathairakam ||

verses.sa:
एरका तु गृहीता वै वज्रभूतेव लक्ष्यते ।
तया परस्परं जघ्नुस्संप्रहारे सुदारुणे ॥
verses.rom:
eraka tu grihita vai vajrabhuteva lakshyate |
taya parasparam jaghnussamprahare sudarune ||

verses.sa:
प्रद्युम्नसांबप्रमुखाः कृतवर्माथ सात्यकिः ।
अनिरुद्धादयश्चान्ये पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च ॥
verses.rom:
pradyumnasambapramukhah kritavarmatha satyakih |
aniruddhadayashchanye prithurviprithureva cha ||

verses.sa:
चारुवर्मा चारुकश्च तथाक्रूरादयो द्विज ।
एरकारूपिभिर्वज्रैस्ते निजघ्नुः परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
charuvarma charukashcha tathakruradayo dvija |
erakarupibhirvajraiste nijaghnuh parasparam ||

verses.sa:
निवारयामास हरिर्यादवांस्ते च केशवम् ।
सहायं मेनिरेरीणां प्राप्तं जघ्नुः परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
nivarayamasa hariryadavamste cha keshavam |
sahayam menirerinam praptam jaghnuh parasparam ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णोऽपि कुपितस्तेषामेरकामुष्टिमाददे ।
वधाय सोपि मुसलं मुष्टर्लौहमभूत्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
krishno'pi kupitasteshamerakamushtimadade |
vadhaya sopi musalam mushtarlauhamabhuttada ||

verses.sa:
जघान तेन निश्श्षोआ!न्यादवानाततायिनः ।
जघ्नुस्ते सहसाभ्येत्य तथाऽन्येपि परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
jaghana tena nishshshoa!nyadavanatatayinah |
jaghnuste sahasabhyetya tatha'nyepi parasparam ||

verses.sa:
ततश्चार्णवमध्येन जैत्रोऽसौ चक्रिणो रथः ।
पश्यतो दारुकस्याथ प्रायादश्वैर्धृतो द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcharnavamadhyena jaitro'sau chakrino rathah |
pashyato darukasyatha prayadashvairdhrito dvija ||

verses.sa:
चक्रं गदा तथा शार्ङ्गं तूणीशंखोसिरेव च ।
प्रदक्षिणं हरिं कृत्वा जग्मुरादित्यवर्त्त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
chakram gada tatha sharngam tunishamkhosireva cha |
pradakshinam harim kritva jagmuradityavarttmana ||

verses.sa:
क्षणेन नाभवत्कश्चिद्यादवानामघातितः ।
ऋते कृष्णं महात्मानं दारुकं च महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
kshanena nabhavatkashchidyadavanamaghatitah |
rite krishnam mahatmanam darukam cha mahamune ||

verses.sa:
चंक्रम्यमाणौ तौ रामं वृक्षमूले कृतासनम् ।
ददृशाते मुखाच्चास्य निष्क्रामंतं महोरगम् ॥
verses.rom:
chamkramyamanau tau ramam vrikshamule kritasanam |
dadrishate mukhachchasya nishkramamtam mahoragam ||

verses.sa:
निष्क्रम्य स मखात्तस्य महाभोगो भुजंगमः ।
प्रययावर्णवं सिद्धैः पूज्यमानस्तथोरगैः ॥
verses.rom:
nishkramya sa makhattasya mahabhogo bhujamgamah |
prayayavarnavam siddhaih pujyamanastathoragaih ||

verses.sa:
ततोर्घ्यमादाय तदा जलधिस्संमुखं ययौ ।
प्रविवेश ततस्तोयं पूजितः पन्नगोत्तमैः ॥
verses.rom:
tatorghyamadaya tada jaladhissammukham yayau |
pravivesha tatastoyam pujitah pannagottamaih ||

verses.sa:
दृष्ट्वा बलस्य निर्याणं दारुकं प्राह केशवः ।
इदं सर्वं समाचक्ष्व वसुदेवोग्रसेनयोः ॥
verses.rom:
drishtva balasya niryanam darukam praha keshavah |
idam sarvam samachakshva vasudevograsenayoh ||

verses.sa:
निर्याणं बलभद्र स्य यादवानां तथा क्षयम् ।
योगे स्थित्वाहमप्येतत्परित्यक्ष्ये कलेवरम् ॥
verses.rom:
niryanam balabhadra sya yadavanam tatha kshayam |
yoge sthitvahamapyetatparityakshye kalevaram ||

verses.sa:
वाच्यश्च द्वारकावासी जनस्सर्वस्तथाहुकः ।
यथेमां नगरीं सर्वां समुद्र ः! प्लावयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vachyashcha dvarakavasi janassarvastathahukah |
yathemam nagarim sarvam samudra h! plavayishyati ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्भवद्भिस्सर्वैस्तु प्रतीक्ष्यो ह्यर्जुनागमः ।
न स्थेयं द्वारकामध्ये निष्क्रांते तत्र पांडवे ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadbhavadbhissarvaistu pratikshyo hyarjunagamah |
na stheyam dvarakamadhye nishkramte tatra pamdave ||

verses.sa: तेनैव सह गंतव्यं यत्र याति स कौरवः ॥
verses.rom: tenaiva saha gamtavyam yatra yati sa kauravah ||

verses.sa:
गत्वा च ब्रूहि कौंतेयमर्जुनं वचनान्मम ।
पालनीयस्त्वया शक्त्या जनोऽयं मत्परिग्रहः ॥
verses.rom:
gatva cha bruhi kaumteyamarjunam vachananmama |
palaniyastvaya shaktya jano'yam matparigrahah ||

verses.sa:
त्वमर्जुनेन सहितो द्वारवत्यां तथा जनम् ।
गृहीत्वा यादि वज्रश्च यदुराजो भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
tvamarjunena sahito dvaravatyam tatha janam |
grihitva yadi vajrashcha yadurajo bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
इत्युक्तो दारुकः कृष्णं प्रणिपत्य पुनःपुनः ।
प्रदक्षिणं च बहुशः कृत्वा प्रायाद्यथोदितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
ityukto darukah krishnam pranipatya punahpunah |
pradakshinam cha bahushah kritva prayadyathoditam ||

verses.sa:
स च गत्वा तदाचष्ट द्वारकायां तथाऽर्जुनम् ।
आनिनाय महाबुद्धिर्वज्रं चक्रे तथा नृपम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa cha gatva tadachashta dvarakayam tatha'rjunam |
aninaya mahabuddhirvajram chakre tatha nripam ||

verses.sa:
भगवानपि गोविंदो वासुदेवात्मकं परम् ।
ब्रह्मात्मनि समारोप्य सर्वभूतेष्वधारयत् ।
निष्प्रपंचे महाभाग संयोज्यात्मानमात्मनि ।
तुर्यावस्थसलीलं च श्तोए!स्म पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavanapi govimdo vasudevatmakam param |
brahmatmani samaropya sarvabhuteshvadharayat |
nishprapamche mahabhaga samyojyatmanamatmani |
turyavasthasalilam cha shtoe!sma purushottamah ||

verses.sa:
संमानयन्द्विजवचो दुर्वासा यदुवाच ह ।
योगयुक्तोऽभवत्पादं कृत्वा जानुनि सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sammanayandvijavacho durvasa yaduvacha ha |
yogayukto'bhavatpadam kritva januni sattama ||

verses.sa:
आययौ स जरानाम तदा तत्र स लुब्धकः ।
मुसलावशेषलोहैकसायकन्यस्ततोमरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayayau sa jaranama tada tatra sa lubdhakah |
musalavasheshalohaikasayakanyastatomarah ||

verses.sa:
स तत्पादं मृगाकारमवेक्ष्यारादवस्थितः ।
तले विव्याध तेनैव तोमरेण द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sa tatpadam mrigakaramavekshyaradavasthitah |
tale vivyadha tenaiva tomarena dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च ददृशो! तत्र चदुर्बाहुधरं नरम् ।
प्रणिपत्त्याह चैवैनं प्रसीदेति पुनःपुनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha dadrisho! tatra chadurbahudharam naram |
pranipattyaha chaivainam prasideti punahpunah ||

verses.sa:
अजानता कृतमिदं मया हरिणशंकया ।
क्षम्यतां मम पापेन दग्धं मां त्रातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
ajanata kritamidam maya harinashamkaya |
kshamyatam mama papena dagdham mam tratumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
ततस्तं भगवानाह न तेस्तु भयमण्वपि ।
गच्छ त्वं मत्प्रसादेन लुब्ध स्वर्गं सुरास्पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
tatastam bhagavanaha na testu bhayamanvapi |
gachchha tvam matprasadena lubdha svargam suraspadam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
विमानमागतं सद्यस्तद्वाक्यसमनंतरम् ।
आरुह्य प्रययौ स्वर्गं लुब्धकस्तत्प्रसादतः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
vimanamagatam sadyastadvakyasamanamtaram |
aruhya prayayau svargam lubdhakastatprasadatah ||

verses.sa:
गते तस्मिन्सभगवान्संयोज्यात्मानमात्मनि ।
ब्रह्मभूतेऽव्ययेचिंत्ये वासुदेवमयेऽमले ॥
verses.rom:
gate tasminsabhagavansamyojyatmanamatmani |
brahmabhute'vyayechimtye vasudevamaye'male ||

verses.sa:
अजन्मन्यमरे विष्णावप्रमेयेऽखिलात्मनि ।
तत्याज मानुषं देहमतीत्य त्रिविधां गतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajanmanyamare vishnavaprameye'khilatmani |
tatyaja manusham dehamatitya trividham gatim ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशे सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamshe saptatrimsho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
In this way, Krishna, aided by Baladeva, destroyed, for the behoof of the earth, demons and iniquitous kings, and along with Phalguna also did he relieve earth of her burden by the death of seven Akshauhini hosts. Having thus relieved the earth of her load and destroyed many impious kings, he exterminated, by the plea of an imprecation denounced by Brāhmanas, his own Yādava race. Thereupon quitting Dwārakā and renouncing his mortal frame, the self-born with all his emanations re-entered his own sphere of Vishnu.

Maitreya said:—Tell me how Janārddana brought about the extermination of his own family under the pretext of a Brāminical curse and in what manner did he renounce his human body.

Parāçara said;—At the holy place of Pindarika, Viswāmitra, Kanwa and the great sage, Nārada, were seen by some boys of the Yadu family. Inflated with their youths and influenced by predestined results, they dressed and adorned Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavati, as a female and taking her to the sages, they addressed them with usual reverence, saying:—"What child will this female, the wife of Babru, who is anxious to have a son, give birth to?" The sages, who were gifted with divine wisdom, enraged at this insult, said:—"She will give birth to a club that will exterminate the entire Yādava race".

Thus addressed by the sages, the boys went to Ugrasena and related to him what had happened; and after sometime, as foretold, a club was produced from the belly of Sāmba. Ugrasena had the club, which was made of iron, ground to dust and thrown into the sea, and particles of the dust there became rushes, There was one part of the iron club which was like the blade of a lance and which the Andhakas could not break; this when thrown into the sea was swallowed by a fish; the fish was caught, the iron spike was extracted from its belly, and was taken by a hunter named Jāra. The all-wise and illustrious slayer of Madhu did not think it proper to counteract the predestination of fate.

In the interval an emissarry despatched by the celestials came to Krishna and said to him in private:—"I am sent to thee, O lord, by the celestials; and do thou hear what Indra together with the Viswas, Maruts, Adityas, Sādhyas and Rudras respectfully represent. More than a century has gone by since thou in compliance with the request of the celestials, descended upon earth for the purpose of relieving it of its load. The demons have been destroyed and the burden of earth has been removed; now let the immortals once again see their king in heaven. More than a hundred years have passed, and if thou dost wish, do thou return to heaven. This is the prayer of the celestials. And if this be not thy will, do thou remain here as long as it may be desirable to thy dependants". Whereto Krishna replied, "I am well aware of all thou hast said. The earth is not relieved of her load until the Yādavas are extirpated. I shall also speedily bring it about in my descent, and it shall take place in seven nights. Having restored the land of Dwārakā to the ocean and destroyed the race of Yadu, I shall proceed to the region of the celestials. Inform the celestials that having renounced my mortal frame and been accompanied by Sankarshana, I will then return to them. The tyrants that oppressed the earth, Jarāsandha and the rest, have been slain and a youth even of the race of Yadu is so less than they an incumbrance. Having removed this huge weight of the earth, I will proceed to the mansions of the celestials. Say this to them".

Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, being thus addressed by Vāsudeva, the messenger of the celestials bowed and took his heavenly course to the king of the deities. The illustrious Krishna too now espied signs and portents both on earth and in heaven prognosticating day and night the destruction of Dwārakā.
