Beholding those evil omens, he said to the Yādavas; "Behold these dreadful portents; let us hasten to Prabhāsa to avert them". When he had thus said to the eminent Yādavas, the illustrious Uddhava saluted and said to him: "Tell me, O lord, what it is proper that I should do, for it seems to me that thou wilt destroy all this race. The signs that are manifest declare nothing less than the annihilation of the race". Then Krishna replied:—"Do thou, by my favour proceed, this celestial course, to the holy place Badrikāsrama in the Gandhamādana mountain, the shrine of Nara Nārāyana; and on that spot sanctified by them, thou, meditating upon me, shalt obtain perfection through my favour. Having extirpated this Yadu race, I shall proceed to Baikuntha; and after I have quilted Dwārakā; the ocean shall inundate it".

Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed by him and commanded by Kesava, Uddhava proceeded to the holy shrine of Nara Nārāyana. And the Yādavas, with Krishna, Balarāma and others, having ascended swift-coursing cars, proceeded to Prabhāsa. Having reached Prabhāsa, the Kukkuras and Andhakas bathed there and, being excited by Krishna, indulged in liquor. As they drank, the destructive fire of dissension was engendered amongst them by mutual collision and fed with the fuel of abuse. Worked up with ire by the divine influence, they attacked one another with missile weapons, and when these were finished, they had recourse to the rushes growing nigh. The rushes in their hands became like thunder-bolts, and they assailed one another with them. Pradyumna, Syāmba, Kritavarman, Satyaki, Aniruddha, Prithu, Vipathu, Charuvannan, Charuka, Akrura, and many others, struck one another with the rushes, which became hard like thunder-bolts. Thereupon Krishna arriving there prevented them: but they thought that he was taking part with each severally and continued the conflict.

Thereupon, enraged, Krishna took up a handful of rushes to destroy them, which became a club of iron; and with this he killed many of the murderous Yādavas, whilst others fighting fiercely destroyed one another. At this time in the very presence of Krishna's charioteer, his swift steeds carried off his Jaitra car and entered into the sea. The discus, the club, the bow, the quiver, the shell and the sword of Kesava, having circumambulated their master, flew along the path of the sun. In a short time there was not a single Yādava left alive save the mighty Krishna and Dāruka. Going towards Rāma, who was sitting at the root of a tree, they saw a huge serpent coming out of his mouth. Having issued out of his mouth, the mighty snake proceeded towards the ocean hymned by saints and other great snakes. Bringing an offering of respect, the ocean came to him and then the majestic being worshipped of all the attendant snakes, entered into the waters of the deep. Beholding the departure of the spirit of Baladeva, Kesava said to Dāruka—"Do thou go to Vasudeva and Ugrasena and communicate unto him this. Go and inform them of the departure of Balabhadra, and the destruction of the Yādava race, and also that I shall engage in religious meditation and renounce my body. Do thou also inform Ahuka and the inhabitants of Dwārakā that their city shall be inundated by the ocean. And do ye await the arrival of Arjuna at Dwārakā. When Arjuna, the descendant of Pāndu, shall issue out of the city, none of you should wait there but go whither the descendant of Kuru shall repair. Do thou also go to the son of Kunti and tell him that he may at my request protect my family according to his might. Then go to Hastināpur with Arjuna and all the inhabitants of Dwārakā and let Vajra be installed king over the race of Yadu".

Parāçara said:—Thus instructed and having bowed unto and circumambulated Krishna again and again, Dāruka departed as he had been desired; and having conducted Arjuna to Dwārāvati, the intelligent servant of Krishna established Vajra as king. Thereupon having concentrated in himself that supreme spirit which is identical with Vāsudeva, the divine Govinda was identified with all beings. Respecting the words of the Brāhmana, the curse of Durvāsas, the illustrious Krishna sat engaged in meditation, placing his foot upon his knee. Then there came a hunter named Jāra, whose arrow was tipped with a blade made of the iron club, which had not been reduced to powder; and espying from a distance the foot of Krishna, he mistook it for a part of a deer, and shooting his arrow, lodged it in the sole. Approaching his mark, he saw the four-armed king and falling at his feet, repeatedly besought his forgiveness, exclaming, "I have done this deed unknowingly, thinking I was aiming at a deer. Have pity on me who am consumed by my crime; for thou art able to consume me". Thereupon Bhagavān said: "Thou needst not have the least fear, hunter; by my favour, thou shall repair to the region of the celestials". As soon as Krishna had said this, the celestial car arrived there, ascending which the hunter repaired to the region of the celestials.

Thereupon the divine Krishna having united himself with his own pure, spiritual, inexhaustible, inconceivable, unborn, undecaying, imperishable, and universal spirit, which is one Vāsudeva, renounced his mortal frame and his connection with the three qualities.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
अर्जुनोपि तदान्वीक्ष्य रामकृष्णकलेवरे
संस्कारं लंभयामास तथान्येषामनुक्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
arjunopi tadanvikshya ramakrishnakalevare
samskaram lambhayamasa tathanyeshamanukramat ||

verses.sa:
अष्टौ महिष्यः कथिता रुक्मिणीप्रमुखास्तु याः
उपगुह्य हरेर्देहं विविशुस्ता हुताशनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtau mahishyah kathita rukminipramukhastu yah
upaguhya harerdeham vivishusta hutashanam ||

verses.sa:
रेवती चापि रामस्य देहमाश्लिष्य सत्तमा
विवेश ज्वलितं वह्निं तत्संगाह्लादशीतलम् ॥
verses.rom:
revati chapi ramasya dehamashlishya sattama
vivesha jvalitam vahnim tatsamgahladashitalam ||

verses.sa:
उग्रसेनस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा तथैवानकदुंदुभिः
देवकी रोहिणी चैव विविशुर्जातवेदसम् ॥
verses.rom:
ugrasenastu tachchhrutva tathaivanakadumdubhih
devaki rohini chaiva vivishurjatavedasam ||

verses.sa:
ततोर्जुनः प्रेतकार्यं कृत्वा तेषां यथाविधि
निश्चक्राम जनं सर्वं गृहीत्वा वज्रमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
tatorjunah pretakaryam kritva tesham yathavidhi
nishchakrama janam sarvam grihitva vajrameva cha ||

verses.sa:
द्वारवत्या विनिष्क्रांताः कृष्णपत्न्यः सहस्रशः
वज्रं जनं च कौंतेयः पालयञ्छनकैर्ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
dvaravatya vinishkramtah krishnapatnyah sahasrashah
vajram janam cha kaumteyah palayanchhanakairyayau ||

verses.sa:
सभा सुधर्मा कृष्णेन मर्त्यलोके समुज्झिते
स्वर्गं जगाम मैत्रेय पारिजातश्च पादपः ॥
verses.rom:
sabha sudharma krishnena martyaloke samujjhite
svargam jagama maitreya parijatashcha padapah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्दिने हरिर्यातो दिवं संत्यज्य मेदिनीम्
तस्मिन्नेवावतीर्णोऽयं कालकायो बली कलिः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmindine hariryato divam samtyajya medinim
tasminnevavatirno'yam kalakayo bali kalih ||

verses.sa:
प्लावयामास तां शून्यां द्वारकां च महोदधिः
वासुदेवगृहं त्वेकं न प्लावयति सागरः ॥
verses.rom:
plavayamasa tam shunyam dvarakam cha mahodadhih
vasudevagriham tvekam na plavayati sagarah ||

verses.sa:
नातिक्रांतुमलं ब्रह्मंस्तदद्यापि महोदधिः
नित्यं सन्निहितस्तत्र भगवान्केशवो यतः ॥
verses.rom:
natikramtumalam brahmamstadadyapi mahodadhih
nityam sannihitastatra bhagavankeshavo yatah ||

verses.sa:
तदतीव महापुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम्
विष्णुश्रियान्वितं स्थानं दृष्ट्वा पामाद्विमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tadativa mahapunyam sarvapatakanashanam
vishnushriyanvitam sthanam drishtva pamadvimuchyate ||

verses.sa:
पार्थः पंचनदे देशो! बहुधान्यधनान्विते
चकार वासं सर्वस्य जनस्य मुनिसत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
parthah pamchanade desho! bahudhanyadhananvite
chakara vasam sarvasya janasya munisattamah ||

verses.sa:
ततो लोभस्समभवत्पार्थेनैकेन धन्विना
दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियो नीयमाना दस्यूनां निहतेश्वराः ॥
verses.rom:
tato lobhassamabhavatparthenaikena dhanvina
drishtva striyo niyamana dasyunam nihateshvarah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते पापकमाणो लोभोपहृतचेतसः
आभीरा मंत्रयामासुस्समेत्यात्यंतदुर्मदाः ॥
verses.rom:
tataste papakamano lobhopahritachetasah
abhira mamtrayamasussametyatyamtadurmadah ||

verses.sa:
अयमेकोऽर्जुनो धन्वी स्त्रीजनं निहतेश्वरम्
नयत्यस्मानतिक्रम्य धिगेतद्भवतां बलम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayameko'rjuno dhanvi strijanam nihateshvaram
nayatyasmanatikramya dhigetadbhavatam balam ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा गर्वसमारूढो भीष्मद्रो णजयद्र थान्
कर्णादींश्च न जानाति बलं ग्रामनिवासिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
hatva garvasamarudho bhishmadro najayadra than
karnadimshcha na janati balam gramanivasinam ||

verses.sa:
यष्टिहस्तानवेक्ष्यास्मान्धनुष्पाणिस्स दुर्मतिः
सर्वानेवावजानाति किं वो बाहुभिरुन्नतैः ॥
verses.rom:
yashtihastanavekshyasmandhanushpanissa durmatih
sarvanevavajanati kim vo bahubhirunnataih ||

verses.sa:
ततो यष्टिप्रहरणादस्यवो लोष्टधारिणः
सहस्रशोभ्यधावंत तं जनं निहतेश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato yashtipraharanadasyavo loshtadharinah
sahasrashobhyadhavamta tam janam nihateshvaram ||

verses.sa:
ततो निर्भर्त्स्य कौंतेयः प्राहाभीरान्हसन्निव
निवर्त्तध्वमधर्मज्ञा यदि न स्थ मुमूर्षवः ॥
verses.rom:
tato nirbhartsya kaumteyah prahabhiranhasanniva
nivarttadhvamadharmajna yadi na stha mumurshavah ||

verses.sa:
अवज्ञाय वचस्तस्य जगृहुस्ते तदा धनम्
स्त्रीधनं चैव मैत्रेय विष्वक्सेन परिग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
avajnaya vachastasya jagrihuste tada dhanam
stridhanam chaiva maitreya vishvaksena parigraham ||

verses.sa:
ततोर्जुनो धनुर्दिव्यं गांडीवमजरं युधि
आरोपयितुमारेभे न शशाक च वीर्यवान् ॥
verses.rom:
tatorjuno dhanurdivyam gamdivamajaram yudhi
aropayitumarebhe na shashaka cha viryavan ||

verses.sa:
चकार सज्यं कृच्छ्राच्च तच्चाभूच्छिथिलं पुनः
न सस्मार ततोस्त्राणि चिंतयन्नपि पांडवः ॥
verses.rom:
chakara sajyam krichchhrachcha tachchabhuchchhithilam punah
na sasmara tatostrani chimtayannapi pamdavah ||

verses.sa:
शरान्मुमोच चैतेषु पार्थो वैरिष्वमर्षितः
त्वग्भेदं ते परं चक्रुरस्ता गांडीवधन्विना ॥
verses.rom:
sharanmumocha chaiteshu partho vairishvamarshitah
tvagbhedam te param chakrurasta gamdivadhanvina ||

verses.sa:
वह्निना येऽक्षया दत्ताश्शरास्तेपि क्षयं ययुः
युद्ध्यतस्सह गोपालैरर्जुनस्य भवक्षये ॥
verses.rom:
vahnina ye'kshaya dattashsharastepi kshayam yayuh
yuddhyatassaha gopalairarjunasya bhavakshaye ||

verses.sa:
अचिंतयच्च कौंतेयः कृष्णस्यैव हि तद्बलम्
यन्मया शरसंघातैस्सकला भूभृतो हताः ॥
verses.rom:
achimtayachcha kaumteyah krishnasyaiva hi tadbalam
yanmaya sharasamghataissakala bhubhrito hatah ||

verses.sa:
मिषतः पांडुपुत्रस्य ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः
आभीरैरपकृष्यंत कामं चान्याः प्रदुद्रु वुः ॥
verses.rom:
mishatah pamduputrasya tatastah pramadottamah
abhirairapakrishyamta kamam chanyah pradudru vuh ||

verses.sa:
ततश्शरेषु क्षीणेषु धनुष्कोट्या धनंजयः
जघान दस्यूंस्ते चास्य प्रहाराञ्जहसुर्मुने ॥
verses.rom:
tatashshareshu kshineshu dhanushkotya dhanamjayah
jaghana dasyumste chasya praharanjahasurmune ||

verses.sa:
प्रेक्षतस्तस्य पार्थस्य वृष्ण्यंधकवरस्त्रियः
जग्मुरादाय ते म्लेच्छाः समस्ता मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
prekshatastasya parthasya vrishnyamdhakavarastriyah
jagmuradaya te mlechchhah samasta munisattama ||

verses.sa:
ततस्सुदुःखितो जिष्णुः कष्टं कष्टमिति ब्रुवन्
अहो भगवतानेन मुष्टोस्मीति रुरोद वै ॥
verses.rom:
tatassuduhkhito jishnuh kashtam kashtamiti bruvan
aho bhagavatanena mushtosmiti ruroda vai ||

verses.sa:
तद्धनुस्तानि शस्त्राणि स रथस्ते च वाजिनः
सर्वमेकपदे नष्टं दानमश्रोत्रिये यथा ॥
verses.rom:
taddhanustani shastrani sa rathaste cha vajinah
sarvamekapade nashtam danamashrotriye yatha ||

verses.sa:
अहोतिबलबद्दैवं विना तेन महात्मना
यदसामर्थ्ययुक्तेपि निचवर्गे जयप्रदम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahotibalabaddaivam vina tena mahatmana
yadasamarthyayuktepi nichavarge jayapradam ||

verses.sa:
तौ बाहू स च मे मुष्टिः स्थानं तत्सोस्मि चार्जुनः
पुण्येनैव विना तेन गतं सर्वमसारताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tau bahu sa cha me mushtih sthanam tatsosmi charjunah
punyenaiva vina tena gatam sarvamasaratam ||

verses.sa:
ममार्जुनत्वं भीमस्य भीमत्वं तत्कृते ध्रुवम्
विना तेन यदा भीरैर्जितोहं रथिनां वरः ॥
verses.rom:
mamarjunatvam bhimasya bhimatvam tatkrite dhruvam
vina tena yada bhirairjitoham rathinam varah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्थं वदन्ययौ जिष्णुरिंद्र प्रस्थं पुरोत्तमम्
चकार तत्र राजानं वज्रं यादवनंदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ittham vadanyayau jishnurimdra prastham purottamam
chakara tatra rajanam vajram yadavanamdanam ||

verses.sa:
स ददर्श ततो व्यासं फाल्गुनः काननाश्रयम्
तमुपेत्य महाभागं विनयेनाभ्यवादयत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa dadarsha tato vyasam phalgunah kananashrayam
tamupetya mahabhagam vinayenabhyavadayat ||

verses.sa:
तं वंदमानं चरणाववलोक्य मुनिश्चिरम्
उवाच वाक्यं विच्छायः कथमद्य त्वमीदृशः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vamdamanam charanavavalokya munishchiram
uvacha vakyam vichchhayah kathamadya tvamidrishah ||

verses.sa:
अवीरजोनुगमनं ब्रह्महत्या कृताथ वा
दृढाशाभंगदुःखीव भ्रष्टच्छायोऽसि सांप्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
avirajonugamanam brahmahatya kritatha va
dridhashabhamgaduhkhiva bhrashtachchhayo'si sampratam ||

verses.sa:
सांतानिकादयो वाते याचमाना निराकृताः
अगम्यस्त्रीरतिर्वा त्वं येनासि विगतप्रभः ॥
verses.rom:
samtanikadayo vate yachamana nirakritah
agamyastriratirva tvam yenasi vigataprabhah ||

verses.sa:
भुङ्तेऽप्रदाय विप्रेभ्यो मृष्टमेकोथ वा भवान्
किं वा कृपणवित्तानि हृतानि भवताऽर्जुन ॥
verses.rom:
bhunte'pradaya viprebhyo mrishtamekotha va bhavan
kim va kripanavittani hritani bhavata'rjuna ||

verses.sa:
कचिन्नु शूर्पवातस्य गोचरत्वं गतोऽर्जुन
दुष्टचक्षुर्हतो वासि निश्श्रीकः कथमन्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
kachinnu shurpavatasya gocharatvam gato'rjuna
dushtachakshurhato vasi nishshrikah kathamanyatha ||

verses.sa:
स्पृष्टो नखांभसा वाथ घटवचार्युक्षितोपि वा
केन त्वं वासि विच्छायो न्यूनैर्वा युधि निर्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
sprishto nakhambhasa vatha ghatavacharyukshitopi va
kena tvam vasi vichchhayo nyunairva yudhi nirjitah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः पार्थो विनिश्वस्य श्रूयतां भगवन्निति
प्रोक्त्वा यथावदाचष्टे व्यासायात्मपराभवम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah partho vinishvasya shruyatam bhagavanniti
proktva yathavadachashte vyasayatmaparabhavam ||

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
यद्बलं यच्च मत्तेजो यद्वीर्यं यः पराक्रमः
या श्रीश्छाया च नः सोस्मान्परित्यज्य हरिर्गतः ॥
verses.rom:
arjuna uvacha
yadbalam yachcha mattejo yadviryam yah parakramah
ya shrishchhaya cha nah sosmanparityajya harirgatah ||

verses.sa:
ईश्वरेणापि महता स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणा
हीना वयं मुने तेन जातास्तृणमया इव ॥
verses.rom:
ishvarenapi mahata smitapurvabhibhashina
hina vayam mune tena jatastrinamaya iva ||

verses.sa:
अस्त्राणां सायकानां च गांडीवस्य तथा मम
सारता याभवन्मूर्त्तिस्स गतः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
astranam sayakanam cha gamdivasya tatha mama
sarata yabhavanmurttissa gatah purushottamah ||

verses.sa:
यस्यावलोकनादस्माञ्छ्रीर्जयः संपदुन्नतिः
न तत्याज स गोविंदस्त्यक्त्वास्मान्भगवान्गतः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyavalokanadasmanchhrirjayah sampadunnatih
na tatyaja sa govimdastyaktvasmanbhagavangatah ||

verses.sa:
भीष्मद्रो णांगराजाद्यास्तथा दुर्योधनादयः
यत्प्रावेन निर्दग्धास्स कृष्णस्त्यक्तवान्भुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhishmadro namgarajadyastatha duryodhanadayah
yatpravena nirdagdhassa krishnastyaktavanbhuvam ||

verses.sa:
निर्यौवना गतश्रीका नष्टच्छायेव मेदिनी
विभाति तात नैकोहं विरहे तस्य चक्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
niryauvana gatashrika nashtachchhayeva medini
vibhati tata naikoham virahe tasya chakrinah ||

verses.sa:
यस्य प्रभावाद्भीष्माद्यैर्मय्यग्नौ शलभायतम्
विना तेनाद्य कृष्णेन गोपालैरस्मि निर्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya prabhavadbhishmadyairmayyagnau shalabhayatam
vina tenadya krishnena gopalairasmi nirjitah ||

verses.sa:
गांडीवस्त्रिषु लोकेषु ख्यातिं यदनुभावतः
गतस्तेन विनाऽऽभीरलगुडैस्स तिरस्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
gamdivastrishu lokeshu khyatim yadanubhavatah
gatastena vina''bhiralagudaissa tiraskritah ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रीसहस्राण्यनेकानि मन्नाथानि महामुने
यततो मम नीतानि दस्युभिर्लगुडायुधैः ॥
verses.rom:
strisahasranyanekani mannathani mahamune
yatato mama nitani dasyubhirlagudayudhaih ||

verses.sa:
आनीयमानमाभीरैः कृष्ण कृष्णावरोधनम्
हृतं यष्टिप्रहरणैः परिभूय बलं मम ॥
verses.rom:
aniyamanamabhiraih krishna krishnavarodhanam
hritam yashtipraharanaih paribhuya balam mama ||

verses.sa:
निश्श्रीकता न मे चित्रं यज्जीवामि तदद्भुतम्
नीचावमानपंकांकी निर्लज्जोस्मि पितामह ॥
verses.rom:
nishshrikata na me chitram yajjivami tadadbhutam
nichavamanapamkamki nirlajjosmi pitamaha ||

verses.sa:
व्यास उवाच
अलं ते व्रीडया पार्थ न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
अवेहि सर्वभूतेषु कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ॥
verses.rom:
vyasa uvacha
alam te vridaya partha na tvam shochitumarhasi
avehi sarvabhuteshu kalasya gatiridrishi ||

verses.sa:
कालो भवाय भूतानामभवाय च पांडव
कालमूलमिदं ज्ञात्वा भव स्थैर्यपरोऽर्जुन ॥
verses.rom:
kalo bhavaya bhutanamabhavaya cha pamdava
kalamulamidam jnatva bhava sthairyaparo'rjuna ||

verses.sa:
नद्यः समुद्रा गिरयस्सकला च वसुंधरा
देवा मनुष्याः पशवस्तरवश्च सरीसृपाः ॥
verses.rom:
nadyah samudra girayassakala cha vasumdhara
deva manushyah pashavastaravashcha sarisripah ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टाः कालेन कालेन पुनर्यास्यंति संक्षयम्
कालात्मकमिदं सर्वं ज्ञात्वा शममवाप्नुहि ॥
verses.rom:
srishtah kalena kalena punaryasyamti samkshayam
kalatmakamidam sarvam jnatva shamamavapnuhi ||

verses.sa:
कालस्वरूपी भगवान्कृष्णः कमललोचनः
यच्चात्थ कृष्णमाहात्म्यं तत्तथैव धनंजय ॥
verses.rom:
kalasvarupi bhagavankrishnah kamalalochanah
yachchattha krishnamahatmyam tattathaiva dhanamjaya ||

verses.sa:
भारावतारकार्यार्थमवतीर्णस्स मेदिनीम्
भाराक्रांता धरा याता देवानां समितिं पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
bharavatarakaryarthamavatirnassa medinim
bharakramta dhara yata devanam samitim pura ||

verses.sa:
तदर्थमवतीर्णोऽसौ कालरूपी जनार्दनः
तच्च निष्पादिनं कार्यमश्षोआ! भूभुजो हताः ॥
verses.rom:
tadarthamavatirno'sau kalarupi janardanah
tachcha nishpadinam karyamashshoa! bhubhujo hatah ||

verses.sa:
वृष्ण्यंधककुलं सर्वं तथा पार्थोपसंहृतम्
न किंचिदन्यत्कर्त्तव्यं तस्य भूमितले प्रभोः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishnyamdhakakulam sarvam tatha parthopasamhritam
na kimchidanyatkarttavyam tasya bhumitale prabhoh ||

verses.sa:
अतो गतस्स भगवान्कृतकृत्यो यथेच्छया
सृष्टिं सर्गे करोत्येष देवदेवः स्थितौ स्थितिम्
अंतेंताय समर्थोयं सांप्रतं वै यथा गतः ॥
verses.rom:
ato gatassa bhagavankritakrityo yathechchhaya
srishtim sarge karotyesha devadevah sthitau sthitim
amtemtaya samarthoyam sampratam vai yatha gatah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्यार्थ न संतापस्त्वया कार्यः पराभवे
भवंति भावाः कालेषु पुरुषाणां यतः स्तुतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatyartha na samtapastvaya karyah parabhave
bhavamti bhavah kaleshu purushanam yatah stutih ||

verses.sa:
त्वयैकेन हता भीष्मद्रो णकर्णादयो रणे
तेषामर्जुन कालोत्थः किं न्यूनाभिभवो न सः ॥
verses.rom:
tvayaikena hata bhishmadro nakarnadayo rane
teshamarjuna kalotthah kim nyunabhibhavo na sah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णोस्तस्य प्रभावेन यथा तेषां पराभवः
कृतस्तथैव भवतो दस्युभ्यस्स पराभवः ॥
verses.rom:
vishnostasya prabhavena yatha tesham parabhavah
kritastathaiva bhavato dasyubhyassa parabhavah ||

verses.sa:
स देवेशश्शरीराणि समाविश्य जगत्स्थितिम्
करोति सर्वभूतानां नाशमंते जगत्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa deveshashsharirani samavishya jagatsthitim
karoti sarvabhutanam nashamamte jagatpatih ||

verses.sa:
भगोदये ते कौंतेय सहायोऽभूज्जनार्दनः
तथांते तद्विपक्षास्ते केशवेन विनाशिताः ॥
verses.rom:
bhagodaye te kaumteya sahayo'bhujjanardanah
tathamte tadvipakshaste keshavena vinashitah ||

verses.sa:
कश्श्रद्दद्ध्यात्सगांगेयान्हन्यास्त्वं कौरवानिति
आभीरेभ्यश्च भवतः कः श्रद्दध्यात्पराभवम् ॥
verses.rom:
kashshraddaddhyatsagamgeyanhanyastvam kauravaniti
abhirebhyashcha bhavatah kah shraddadhyatparabhavam ||

verses.sa:
पार्थैतत्सर्वभूतस्य हरेर्लीलाविचेष्टितम्
त्वया यत्कौरावा ध्वस्ता यदाभीरैर्भवाञ्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
parthaitatsarvabhutasya harerlilavicheshtitam
tvaya yatkaurava dhvasta yadabhirairbhavanjitah ||

verses.sa:
गृहीता दस्युभिर्याश्च भवाञ्छोचति तास्स्त्रियः
एतस्याह यथावृत्तं कथयामि तवार्जृन ॥
verses.rom:
grihita dasyubhiryashcha bhavanchhochati tasstriyah
etasyaha yathavrittam kathayami tavarjrina ||

verses.sa:
अष्टावकः पुरा विप्रो जलवासरतोऽभवत्
बहून्वर्षगणान्पार्थ गृणन्ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtavakah pura vipro jalavasarato'bhavat
bahunvarshagananpartha grinanbrahma sanatanam ||

verses.sa:
जितेष्वसुरसंघेषु मेरुपृष्ठे महोत्सवः
बभूव तत्र गच्छंत्यो ददृशुस्तं सुरस्त्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
jiteshvasurasamgheshu meruprishthe mahotsavah
babhuva tatra gachchhamtyo dadrishustam surastriyah ||

verses.sa:
रंभातिलोत्तमाद्यास्तु शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
तुष्टुवुस्तं महात्मानं प्रशशंसुश्च पांडव ॥
verses.rom:
rambhatilottamadyastu shatasho'tha sahasrashah
tushtuvustam mahatmanam prashashamsushcha pamdava ||

verses.sa:
आकंठमग्नं सलिले जटाभारवहं मुनिम्
विनयावनताश्चैनं प्रणेमुस्तोत्रतत्पराः ॥
verses.rom:
akamthamagnam salile jatabharavaham munim
vinayavanatashchainam pranemustotratatparah ||

verses.sa:
यथायथा प्रसन्नोऽसौ तुष्टुवुस्तं तथातथा
सर्वास्ताः कौरवश्रेष्ठ तं वरिष्ठं द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathayatha prasanno'sau tushtuvustam tathatatha
sarvastah kauravashreshtha tam varishtham dvijanmanam ||

verses.sa:
अष्टावक्र उवाच
प्रसन्नोऽहं महाभागा भवतीनां यदिष्यते
मत्तस्तद्व्रियतां सर्वं प्रदास्याम्यतिदुर्लभम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtavakra uvacha
prasanno'ham mahabhaga bhavatinam yadishyate
mattastadvriyatam sarvam pradasyamyatidurlabham ||

verses.sa:
रंभातिलोत्तमाद्यास्तं वैदिक्योप्सरसोब्रुवन्
प्रसन्ने त्वय्यपर्याप्तं किमस्माकमिति द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
rambhatilottamadyastam vaidikyopsarasobruvan
prasanne tvayyaparyaptam kimasmakamiti dvija ||

verses.sa:
इतरास्त्वब्रुवन्विप्र प्रसन्नो भगवान्यदि
तदिच्छामः पतिं प्राप्तुं विप्रेंद्र पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
itarastvabruvanvipra prasanno bhagavanyadi
tadichchhamah patim praptum vipremdra purushottamam ||

verses.sa:
व्यास उवाच
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा ह्युत्ततार जलान्मुनिः
तमुत्तीर्णं च दृदृशुर्विरूपं वक्रमष्टधा ॥
verses.rom:
vyasa uvacha
evam bhavishyatityuktva hyuttatara jalanmunih
tamuttirnam cha dridrishurvirupam vakramashtadha ||

verses.sa:
तं दृष्ट्वा गूहमानानां यासां हासः स्फुटोऽभवत्
ताश्शशाप मुनिः कोपमवाप्य कुरुनंदन ॥
verses.rom:
tam drishtva guhamananam yasam hasah sphuto'bhavat
tashshashapa munih kopamavapya kurunamdana ||

verses.sa:
यस्माद्विकृतरूपं मां मत्वा हीसावमानना
भवतीभिः कृता तस्मादेतं शापं ददामि वः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadvikritarupam mam matva hisavamanana
bhavatibhih krita tasmadetam shapam dadami vah ||

verses.sa:
मत्प्रसादेन भर्त्तारं लब्ध्वा तु पुरुषोत्तमम्
मच्छापोपहतास्सर्वा दस्युहस्तं गमिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
matprasadena bharttaram labdhva tu purushottamam
machchhapopahatassarva dasyuhastam gamishyatha ||

verses.sa:
व्यास उवाच
इत्युदीरितमाकर्ण्य मुनिस्ताभिः प्रसादितः
पुनस्सुरेंद्र लोकं वै प्राह भूयो गमिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
vyasa uvacha
ityudiritamakarnya munistabhih prasaditah
punassuremdra lokam vai praha bhuyo gamishyatha ||

verses.sa:
एवं तस्य मुनेश्शापादष्टावक्रस्य चक्रिणम्
भर्त्तारं प्राप्य ता याता दस्युहस्तं सुरांगनाः ॥
verses.rom:
evam tasya muneshshapadashtavakrasya chakrinam
bharttaram prapya ta yata dasyuhastam suramganah ||

verses.sa:
तत्त्वया नात्र कर्त्तव्यश्शोकोऽल्पोपि हि पांडव
तेनैवाखिलनाथेन सर्वं तदुपसंहृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tattvaya natra karttavyashshoko'lpopi hi pamdava
tenaivakhilanathena sarvam tadupasamhritam ||

verses.sa:
भवतां चोपसंहार आसन्नस्तेन पांडव
बलं लेजस्तथा वीर्यं माहात्म्यं चोपसंहृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhavatam chopasamhara asannastena pamdava
balam lejastatha viryam mahatmyam chopasamhritam ||

verses.sa:
जातस्य नियतो मृत्युः पतनं च तथोन्नतेः
विप्रयोगावमानस्तु संयोगः संचये क्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
jatasya niyato mrityuh patanam cha tathonnateh
viprayogavamanastu samyogah samchaye kshayah ||

verses.sa:
विज्ञाय न बुधाश्शोकं न हर्षमुपयांति ये
तेषामेवेतरे चेष्टां शिक्षंतस्संति तादृशाः ॥
verses.rom:
vijnaya na budhashshokam na harshamupayamti ye
teshamevetare cheshtam shikshamtassamti tadrishah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्त्वया नरश्रेष्ठ ज्ञात्वैतद्भ्रातृभिस्सह
परित्यज्याऽखिलं तंत्रं गंतव्यं तपसे वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmattvaya narashreshtha jnatvaitadbhratribhissaha
parityajya'khilam tamtram gamtavyam tapase vanam ||

verses.sa:
तद्गच्छ धर्मराजाय निवेद्यैतद्वचो मम
परश्वो भ्रातृडभिस्सार्द्धं यथा यासि तथा कुरु ॥
verses.rom:
tadgachchha dharmarajaya nivedyaitadvacho mama
parashvo bhratridabhissarddham yatha yasi tatha kuru ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तोभ्येत्य पार्थाभ्यां यमाभ्यां च सहार्जुनः
दृष्टं चैवानुभूतं च सर्वमाख्यातवांस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktobhyetya parthabhyam yamabhyam cha saharjunah
drishtam chaivanubhutam cha sarvamakhyatavamstatha ||

verses.sa:
व्यासवाक्यं च ते सर्वे श्रुत्वार्जुनमुखेरितम्
राज्ये परीक्षितं कृत्वा ययुः पांडुसुता वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vyasavakyam cha te sarve shrutvarjunamukheritam
rajye parikshitam kritva yayuh pamdusuta vanam ||

verses.sa:
इत्येतत्तव मैत्रेय विस्तरेण मयोदितम्
जातस्य यद्यदोर्वंशो! वासुदेवस्य चेष्टितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityetattava maitreya vistarena mayoditam
jatasya yadyadorvamsho! vasudevasya cheshtitam ||

verses.sa:
यश्चैतच्चरितं तस्य कृष्णस्य शृणुयात्सदा
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
yashchaitachcharitam tasya krishnasya shrinuyatsada
sarvapapavinirmukto vishnulokam sa gachchhati ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे पंचमांशो!ऽष्टात्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane pamchamamsho!'shtatrimsho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Having found the bodies of Krishna and Rāma, Arjuna performed for them and the rest of the slain the obsequial rites. The eight queens of Krishna, who have been named with Rukmini at the head, embraced Hari and entered the funeral fire. O foremost of the pious, embracing the corpse of Rāma, Revati too entered fire which was cool to her happy heart in contract with her lord. Thereupon hearing all this Ugrasena and Vasudeva with Devaki and Rohini entered fire. Having performed duly the obsequious rites of the Yadavas, Arjuna, with the inhabitants of Dwārakā and Vajra, issued out of the city. And Kunti's son proceeded slowly with thousands of Krishna's wives and the residents of Dwārakā. With the departure of Krishna from the land of mortals both the Sudharman palace and the Pārijāta tree proceeded to heaven; and on the same day that Hari departed from the earth the dark-bodied Kali age set in. The ocean rose and inundated the whole of Dwārakā, except only the dwelling of the deity of the race of Yadu. The sea has not been able to wash away that temple and there even up to the present day Kesava constantly resides; whoever visits that holy shrine where Krishna pursued his sports is freed from sins.

O foremost of ascetics, one day while proceeding, Arjuna, the son of Pritha, halted the people he had brought from Dwārakā in the Panchanada country; in a rich and fertile spot; the desires of the neighbouring robbers were excited When they saw a number of widowed females and immense riches in the possession of Arjuna alone. Worked up with their cupidity they assembled their villainous herds and said to them:—"This Arjuna, alone with his bow, is passing amongst us having immense riches and numberless women with him, whose husbands have been slain; cursed is thy strength therefore. His pride hath been increased by the death of Bhishma Drona, Jayadratha, Karna and others; he is not cognisant of the prowess of the simple villagers. Up, up, take your long thick staves; this stupid fellow hates us. Why should we not lift up our arms?" Saying this they rushed armed with cudgels and clods of earth, upon the people who were without their lord. Arjuna met them and said to them in contempt: "Go away, O ye wretches, ignorant of what is right, if you do not wish to die". But they neglected his threats seized his treasures and women, the wives of Viswaksena.

Thereupon Arjuna began to brace his celestial bow Gāndiva, irresistible in encounter, but it was in vain, for in spite of his efforts to lighten it, it continued flaccid; neither could he recollect the incantation of superhuman weapons. Losing all patience he discharged, as best as he could, his arrows upon the foes, but they merely scratched the skin. The shafts that were given him by Agni for certain destruction, were themselves destroyed and proved fatal to Arjuna in his encounter with herdsmen. Thereupon he tried to recall the prowess of Krishna by the strength whereof his shafts had slain many a mighty king; but he tried in vain, for they were either put aside by peasants or they flew at random wide of their marks. His arrows being all exhausted he beat the robbers with the horn of his bow. They laughed at his blows and in the very sight of Arjuna the barbarians carried off all the women of the Vrishni and Andhaka tribes and went their way. Thereupon Jishnu was greatly sorry, and lamented bitterly saying "Alas! Alas! I am deserted by my lord". And immediately the bow, the heavenly arms, his car and steeds perished entirely like a donation to an unlearned Brahmin. "Alas! how powerful is the destiny" said he "deprived of my illustrious friend I have been defeated by the base. These two arms are mine; mine is this fist, this is my place; I am Arjuna, but without that righteous help all these are pithless. The bravery of Arjuna, the strength of Bhima was all his work; without him I am defeated by peasants; it cannot be from any other cause". Saying this, Arjuna went to the city of Mathurā and there installed the Yādava prince Vajra as a king. There he saw Vyāsa who was living in a forest and he approached the sage and saluted him respectfully. The ascetic observed him for some time as he lay prostrate at his feet and said to him. "How is it that I see you shorn of lustre? Have you been guilty of an illicit intercourse with a woman or Brahmincide? Or have you suffered any grievous disappointment that you are so dejected. Have your prayers for offspring or other good gifts proved fruitless? Or have you indulged improper passions that your lustre has been clouded? Or have you devoured the meal given to Brahmanas? Arjuna, say, have you seized upon the property of the poor? Has the wind of a winnowing basket lighted upon you? Or has an evil eye gazed upon you that you look so miserable. Have you been touched by the water of a finger nail? Or has the water of a water-jar sprinkled you? Or, what is most probably the case, have you been beaten by your inferiors in battle?"

Having sighed deeply Arjuna described to Vyāsa all the circumstances of his defeat, and said:—"Hari who was our strength, our heroism, our might, our prowess, our prosperity and brightness, has left us and departed. Deprived of our illustrious friend who was ever kindly speaking we have become as feeble as if made of straw. Excellent Purusha, he, who was the living vigour of my weapon, my arrow, my bow, has departed. When he looked upon us, fortune, fame, wealth and dignity crowded us; but Govinda has departed from our midst. That Krishna has left earth by whose power Bhishma, Drona, the king of Anga, Duryodhana and the rest were slain. Not I alone but earth has grown old, miserable and lustreless in the absence of the holder of the discus. Krishna, through devotion to whom Bhishma and other powerful men perished like moths in the flame of my valour, has departed and I am now vanquished by cow-herds. The bow Gāndiva, that was celebrated all over the three-worlds, has been foiled, on account of his departure, by the sticks of peasants. The numberless women, over whom I was lord, have been carried off from me by thieves armed only with cudgels; the whole household of Krishna, O Krishna, has been forcibly carried off by peasants, who with their staves have put my strength to shame. I do not wonder that I am shorn of my lustre; it is a marvel that I live. Surely grandsire, I am so shameless that I survive the stain of indignity inflicted by the vile".

Vaysa replied to Arjuna and said, "Think no more my son of the indignity; it does not behold you to grieve. Know that time subjects all beings to similar vicissitude: Time brings out the production and dissolution of all creatures. All that exists is founded on time. Know this, Arjuna, and preserve thy fortitude. Rivers, oceans, mountains, the entire earths, celestials, men, animals, trees, are all created and will all be destroyed by time. Be thou sober, knowing that all that is the effect of time. These mighty works of Krishna, whatever they have been, have been performed to relieve earth of her load; for this he has come down. Oppressed by her load earth has had recourse to the assembly of the celestials and Janārddana, who is identical with time, has descended on that account. This object has now been accomplished: all the kings of the earth have been destroyed; no more remained for him to accomplish. Therefore the lord has departed whither he pleased, his ends being all fulfilled. At the period of creation the god of gods creates; in that of duration he preserves, at the end of all he is the powerful destroyer. Now all is done. Therefore O Arjuna, be not pained by thy defeat; the power of mortals is the gift of time. Bhishma, Karna and other kings have been slain by this alone; this was the work of time; and why should not therefore thy defeat by those inferior to thee occur? In the same manner as through thy devotion to Vishnu these were overthrown by thee, so has thy discomfiture by cursed thieves been brought about by time. That divinity, assuming various shapes, preserves the world; and in the end the lord of creatures destroys it. O son of Kunti, on the occasion of thy good fortune, the illustrious Janārddana was thy help; in thy decline thy enemies have been favoured by Kesava. Who will now believe, that thou didst alone defeat Bhishma and other Kauravas. Who would believe peasants have defeated thee? Know it for certain, O son of Pritha, that it is but the sport of the Universal Hari that the Kauravas have been slain by thee and thou hast been vanquished by herdsmen. As regards the women for whom thou dost grieve and who have been carried off by the thieves, hear from me an ancient story that will explain why this has happened.

"In ancient time, a Brāhman, named Ashtāvakra, was pursuing his religious penances, standing in water and meditating on the eternal spirit for many years. On account of the overthrow of the Asuras there was a great festival on the summit of Meru; on their way to which Rambhā, Tilottamā and hundreds of other beautiful nymphs praised and hymned him for his devotions. They bowed unto him and eulogised him when he was immersed in water up to his throat, his hair twisted in a braid. They sang in honour of him whatever they thought would be agreeable to that most eminent of Brāhmanas. Ashtāvakra at last said to them:—'I am well pleased with you, illustrious damsels; ask of me whatever you wish and I will give it however difficult it may be of attainment'. Thereupon all these nymphs, Rambhā, Tillottamā and others mentioned in the Vedas, replied:—'It is enough for us that thou art pleased, what else need we say, O Brāhman?' But some amongst them said:—'If you are indeed pleased with us, O illustrious sire, thou grant us a husband, the best of men and sovereign of Brāhmanas'. Thereupon saying 'so be it,' Ashtāvakra came up from the waters. When the nymphs observed him coming out of the water and saw that he was very ugly and crooked in eight places they could not restrain their merriment and laughed aloud. The Muni was very angry and imprecated them with a curse, saying 'Since you have been so impertinent as to laugh at my deformity, I denounce upon you this curse; through the favour I have shown unto you, you shall obtain the first of males for your husband; and on account of my curse, you shall afterwards fall into the hands of thieves'. When the nymphs heard this imprecation they tried to appease the Muni, and they so far succeeded that he told them that they should finally go to the region of the celestials. It is on account of the curse of the ascetic Ashtāvakra that these women, who were the wives of Kesava, have fallen into the hands of the barbarians; and there is nothing for you, Arjuna to regret it in the least. All this destruction has been brought about by the lord of all, and your end is also near at hand, since he has withdrawn from your strength, splendour, valour and pre-eminence. Death is the doom of every one who is born; fall is the end of exhaltation; union terminates in separation and growth tends only to decay. Knowing all this, wise men are neither subject to grief nor joy; and those who know these ways are equally free from pleasure or joy. Do you therefore, most excellent prince, understand this truth and along with your brothers relinquish everything and repair to the holy forest. Go now and say from me to Yudhishthira that he, to-morrow with his brethren, will tread the path of heroes".

Thus instructed by Vyāsa, Arjuna went and described to the other sons of Pritha all that he had seen, experienced and heard. When he had related unto them the message of Vyāsa, the sons of Pandu placed Pārikshit on the throne and went to the forest.

I have thus described to you, O Maitreya, in detail the actions of Vāsudeva when he was born in the race of Yadu.

THE END OF PART V.
